jobs.title: Systems Test Engineer, IBCS-M
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Air Defense team builds robots that find other robots and knock them out of the sky. At a time when air superiority can no longer be taken for granted, the Air Defense Team provides mission critical capabilities to warfighters. From detection to tracking, identification, deterrence, and defeat, our family of networked sensors and effectors enables our customers to rapidly close the kill chain against a broad range of Unmanned Aerial System (UAS) threats. Working across product, engineering, sales, logistics, operations, and mission success, the Air Defense team develops, tests, deploys, and sustains the Anduril Air Defense Family of Systems (FoS) in challenging operational environments worldwide.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking to hire a Systems Test Engineer to join our rapidly growing team in Costa Mesa, CA. The Air Defense team has the most complex capability that Anduril has fielded to date. Each deployment often comes with a unique combination of hardware and software products in various configurations, targeting different mission sets, and optimized for different customer expectations. We need systems engineers who are capable of internalizing the nuances of each deployment and owning the technical success of the end-to-end solution we ship.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Lead the integration of emerging capabilities, bringing new products into the family of systems. This may include scoping and executing on a combination of hardware and software solutions, both internal and external to the company.

• Lead requirements decomposition across cross-functional teams, defining success in the face of ambiguity.

• Responsible for scoping ideal system laydown, scrutinizing system performance, and ensuring the deployed system is meeting customer requirements. Also responsible for making tradeoffs across capability, timelines, risk, cost, and other factors to deliver an outcome.

• Own systems end to end with the ability to identify and solve problems between the seams and push through to reach an ultimate outcome.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 1- 3 years of hardware and software systems engineering experience.

• Degree in Engineering, Physics, Robotics, Mathematics, or a related field.

• Demonstrated use of model based systems engineering in program lifecycle.

• Experience with tools such as: JAMA, Cameo, Matlab, Simulink, AFSIM.

• Experience with programming languages such as Python, C/C++, or Rust for analysis and simulation.

• Skilled in Statistics, AI/ML, MBSE, Requirements.

• Demonstrated proficiency in the application of engineering standards into engineering processes or requirements.

• Demonstrated experience collaborating across cross-functional teams.

• Comfortable working with ambiguity, evolving priorities, and challenging problems.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills.

• Must be authorized to work in the United States.

• Up to 25% travel to customer sites.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Familiarity with Linux OS. Comfortable obtaining data from software platforms using command-line tools.

• Previous experience in a defense, naval, or aerospace environment

• DO-178, MIL-STD-882E, Airworthiness or Compliance experience

• Experience with any of the following: robotics, autonomous systems, radar, optics, computer vision, wireless communication, software defined radios, networking.

• Experience designing test architecture for verification and validation campaigns

• Exceptional proficiency with Python and/or MATLAB for data parsing and data visualization.

• Experience working with CII, Jenkins or Automation pipelines

US Salary Range

$112,000—$149,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

Our marketplace connects guests with 2,700+ partner hotels and resorts, including the largest brands in hospitality such as Hilton, Hyatt, and Marriott. jobs.title: Security Officer
jobs.location: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo
jobs.description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

We are looking for a security professional to support our operations. You will play a critical role in ensuring the safety of our people and operations.

In this role, you'll;

• Monitor and report on security developments nationwide, providing timely, accurate updates to relevant internal teams to inform decision-making and risk mitigation efforts.

• Inform and advise staff, particularly foreign personnel, on the security situation, including travel restrictions, incident alerts, and recommended precautions. This includes assisting with visa-related security requirements where needed.

• Protect company assets, personnel, and operations by identifying potential threats and implementing appropriate security measures.

• Build and maintain strong, proactive relationships with law enforcement, civil authorities, and other key external stakeholders to support security coordination and response.

• Respond quickly and effectively to security-related questions or incidents, including providing real-time travel guidance within the country.

• Deliver security briefings to new and existing staff, ensuring they are well-informed of risks, protocols, and best practices for operating safely in their environment.

• Conduct security training sessions for staff as needed, tailored to current risks and role-based responsibilities.

• Assist in the investigation for key vendors and potential partners to ensure alignment with company standards and compliance requirements.

• Support and participate in internal investigations, especially those related to financial or operational losses, in coordination with relevant departments.

• Ensure business continuity and security readiness by taking on additional duties as needed in line with evolving risks.

• Be available to travel from Kinshasa and other locations if required to support security operations or assessments.

• Demonstrate a high level of reliability, discretion, and commitment to operational excellence in all aspects of the role.

• Conduct security assessments/audit for offices, PA, or PMA to identify vulnerabilities and recommend appropriate mitigation measures.

Key details

• Location: Kinshasa, and may travel to field locations.

• Work authorization in the Democratic Republic of Congo is required

• This is a permanent position

• Our salaries are competitive and calculated using a transparent formula. We run performance reviews twice a year and award bonuses to strong performers who have been with the company for more than 6 months

• We offer generous health insurance for yourself and your dependents

• We support working parents - we offer 26 weeks of parental leave for mothers and 4 weeks for fathers, in addition to subsidized child care when they return to work

• Airtime reimbursement

• Free food and a beautiful office space

Requirements

• Experience: Proven track record in operational security, risk management, or safety within the private sector (Fintech, NGO, or Multinationals).

• Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of field operations, cash management, and agent networks.

• Context: In-depth knowledge of the security landscape in the DRC and a strong local network.

• Education: Relevant degree or professional certifications in security/risk management.

• Fluency in French and local languages

You might be a good fit if you

• Balance Risk with Growth: You don't just say "no"; you find ways to make operations safer so we can move faster.

• Are Data-Driven: You use indicators and mapping to stay ahead of risks rather than just reacting to incidents.

• Operate with Pragmatism: You value simple, effective solutions over complex, bureaucratic processes.

• Are a Calm Leader: You remain composed and decisive in critical incidents or crises.

• Are a Builder: You enjoy creating frameworks and systems from scratch in a dynamic, evolving environment.

Our team

• We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.

• We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.

• We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.

• We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.

• We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue.

How to apply

Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.

We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals.

Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Senior R&D Engineer, Space PV Product Design & Prototyping
jobs.description:
At Tandem PV, we are a team of people who are passionate about building a more sustainable world by bringing cost effective solar panels onto the market. We’re scaling metal-halide perovskite solar technology to make best-in-class mechanically stacked tandem modules.   We have built efficient, durable cells, monolithic multi-cell submodules, and packaged modules with our scalable, low-cost process. Our next focus is expanding our team to work in our new pilot manufacturing facility. 

Job Summary:

As a Senior R&D Engineer, Space PV Product Design & Prototyping, you will turn our perovskite cell technology into prototype space power products: lightweight, flexible photovoltaic modules and test articles for spacecraft, where the figure of merit is watts per kilogram rather than watts per square meter. You will own the product design, from module layout and electrical architecture through the laminate stack, interconnects, mounting and terminations, and you will build, test and iterate prototypes hands-on with our technicians and process team. You will also be the technical interface to component suppliers and to the external partners who perform environmental testing on your designs.

To be great at this role, you will:

 - Define prototype requirements with the program team (power, voltage, area, mass, stowage and operating environment) and translate them into design specifications and a verification plan.

 - Design module and coupon layouts: cell sizing and interconnect architecture, scribe and busbar patterns, string voltage and current, bypass and blocking protection, and terminations.

 - Design the mechanical build: laminate stack-up of cover, encapsulant, cell and substrate; edge seals; mounting to carriers, panels or flexible blankets; and harnessing and connectors, managing thermal expansion mismatch, stress and warp in low-stiffness structures.

 - Create and maintain CAD models, drawings, bills of materials, and mass and thickness budgets, and report performance in specific-power (W/kg) and areal-mass terms.

 - Build prototypes hands-on with technicians, and design the fixtures, jigs, masks and tooling needed to assemble, handle and test ultrathin and flexible parts.

 - Plan and run design verification (AM0 current-voltage, electroluminescence imaging, flex and bend, thermal cycling) and prepare pre-test baselines for external UV, radiation, vacuum and vibration campaigns; analyze failures and feed the findings into the next design iteration.

 - Work with process engineers to set design rules and tolerances that our cell deposition and laser patterning processes can reliably meet.

 - Own design documentation to design-review standard (requirements, drawings, DFMEA, build travelers and test reports), write build instructions and train technicians, and support government program reviews and reporting.

Qualifications:

 - 5+ years of hands-on hardware or product design experience, including building and testing prototypes).

 - Degree in mechanical, electrical, aerospace or materials engineering, applied physics, or equivalent hands-on experience.

 - Demonstrated design ownership of electromechanical or photovoltaic hardware from concept through prototype build and test; you have taken a design through at least one full cycle of build, test, failure analysis and redesign.

 - Proficiency with 3D CAD (e.g., SolidWorks, Creo or Fusion) and engineering drawing practice, including tolerancing for thin, compliant parts.

 - PV electrical design fundamentals: series and parallel architecture, mismatch and shading losses, reverse bias and bypass protection, and current-voltage characterization.

 - Thermomechanical judgement: thermal expansion mismatch across dissimilar-material joints, stress and warp in thin laminates, and why a joint that survives terrestrial cycling may not survive an orbital one.

 - Structured test planning and data analysis: defined acceptance criteria, controls and clear decisions from small, expensive sample sets.

 - Comfort working hands-on in a small team where prototypes are few and expensive, the plan has to be right before the build starts, and priorities shift as results come in.

 - Clear technical writing and meticulous records: drawings and build instructions others can follow correctly without you present.



Preferred Experience:

 - Space solar array, flexible PV or spacecraft hardware design, including qualification practice (e.g., AIAA S-111/S-112 or ECSS-E-ST-20-08), AM0 measurement, ASTM E595 outgassing, thermal cycling and launch vibration.

 - Perovskite, thin-film or tandem PV device and module experience, including laser-scribed monolithic interconnection.

 - Aerospace or government R&D program experience, such as design reviews, DFMEA, configuration control and federal proposals.

 - Flexible circuits, interconnect welding or soldering, or hermetic and thin-film encapsulation.
   
   

This position may require access to technology and/or technical data subject to U.S. export-control laws. Any eligibility or access requirements will be applied in accordance with applicable U.S. export-control laws, regulations, licenses or authorizations, government-contract requirements, and applicable anti-discrimination laws.

Tandem PV uses perovskite & silicon mechanically-stacked tandems to upgrade silicon solar panels, sharply decreasing installed systems costs, significantly increasing module manufacturing profit margins, and opening up vast new solar markets in the US and worldwide. TPV was co-founded by Stanford PhDs Colin Bailie and Chris Eberspacher; is advised by industry experts from Corning, First Solar, Vivint Solar, and Kateeva; has raised more than $50M in Series A funding.   We were recently recognized as the Best Pre-Commercial Venture of 2025 by the Industry Growth Forum (IGF)



We are a team of people who are passionate about building a more sustainable world by delivering a new generation of solar panels to the market. We are constantly growing and are always looking for dedicated, hardworking, and empathetic teammates.



Tandem PV is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Senior R&D Technician, Space PV Prototyping
jobs.description:
At Tandem PV, we are a team of people who are passionate about building a more sustainable world by bringing cost effective solar panels onto the market. We’re scaling metal-halide perovskite solar technology to make best-in-class mechanically stacked tandem modules.   We have built efficient, durable cells, monolithic multi-cell submodules, and packaged modules with our scalable, low-cost process. Our next focus is expanding our team to work in our new pilot manufacturing facility. 

Job Summary:

As a Senior R&D Technician, Space PV Prototyping, you will work with our engineers and technicians to build prototype solar devices for spacecraft on ultrathin and flexible substrates: preparing substrates, running deposition, coating and patterning tools, laminating covers, and measuring results. Much of what you handle is a fraction of a millimeter thick and hard to replace, so careful execution, exact adherence to written procedures and meticulous records are central to the role. Your work produces the consistent, well-documented sample sets that our development and test campaigns depend on.

To be great at this role, you will have:

 - Clean, inspect, photograph and log substrates, and keep accurate inventory of limited, high-value materials.

 - Load and run sputter and evaporation processes, including bake-outs and controlled pump-down and vent sequences.

 - Coat and thermally process device layers to fixed recipes, and flag anything that looks different from previous runs.

 - Set up and run laser patterning steps, then inspect the result under a microscope and measure electrical isolation.

 - Laminate cover materials, including very thin ones, and inspect for voids and edge-seal quality; handle ultrathin substrates and release them from carriers once formally qualified.

 - Perform routine metrology: sheet-resistance mapping, transmittance, profilometry, optical microscopy, luminescence imaging and current-voltage measurement.

 - Keep run logs and per-part travelers (tools, recipes, temperatures, vacuum cycles, operator, timestamps), and prepare and ship sample batches to external test partners.

 - Build, label, mount and wire coupon sets for test campaigns and exposure chambers, and perform routine tool care, including early warning when a tool starts to drift.

Qualifications:

 - Steady hands and patience for delicate manual work; this is the single most important qualification for the role.

 - Meticulous documentation habits: detailed, legible and consistent notes of processing conditions.

 - Follows written procedures exactly, and speaks up when a procedure does not match what is actually in front of you.

 - Problem-solving orientation and the ability to work autonomously once trained, as part of a team in a scientific or technical environment.

 - Adaptability across a wide range of laboratory tasks and willingness to learn new concepts, tools and measurements.

 - Comfortable with basic laboratory arithmetic, unit conversion, and reading a specification or drawing.

 - Ability to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation, including working in a cleanroom environment while wearing required PPE and gowning; working on your feet for extended periods as required by laboratory activities; occasionally lifting, carrying, or moving materials weighing up to approximately 25 pounds; and safely working in laboratory and manufacturing environments where solvents, chemicals, and Class 4 laser systems may be present. Employees will be required to follow applicable safety procedures and complete required safety training.

Preferred Experience:

jobs.title: Staff Manufacturing Engineer, DFM
jobs.description:
ABOUT RADIANT

Radiant is an El Segundo, CA-based startup building the world’s first mass-produced, portable nuclear microreactors. The company’s first reactor, Kaleidos, is a 1-megawatt, fail-safe microreactor that can be transported anywhere power is needed and run for up to 5 years without refueling. Portable nuclear power with rapid-deploy capability can replace similar-sized diesel generators and provide critical asset support for hospitals, data centers, remote sites, and military bases. Radiant’s unique, practical approach to nuclear development leverages modern software engineering to rapidly deliver safe, factory-built microreactors that use existing, well-qualified materials. Founded in 2020, Radiant is on track to test its first reactor at the Idaho National Laboratory this summer, with initial customer deliveries beginning in 2028.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Radiant is seeking a Senior Manufacturing Engineer to help transition Kaleidos from a first-of-a-kind reactor build into a repeatable, scalable production system.

With the initial Kaleidos reactor build complete, Radiant is now applying what we learned through design, fabrication, assembly, integration, and test to the next generation of the product. This includes reducing mass and part count, improving manufacturability and assembly, increasing production repeatability, and developing the processes, tooling, equipment, suppliers, and quality controls required to manufacture reactors at scale.

In this role, you will work closely with design, quality, test, supply chain, and operations engineers to influence hardware from the earliest stages of design through fabrication and final assembly. You will own manufacturing processes for critical reactor components, mechanisms, structures, and integrated assemblies, ensuring designs can be built safely, reliably, and repeatedly while meeting demanding performance and quality requirements.

You will be expected to identify manufacturing constraints early, drive DFM and DFA into the product, develop and qualify production processes, and close the loop between engineering intent and what happens on the factory floor. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable reviewing a CAD model with a design engineer, developing a fixture or manufacturing process, troubleshooting a build issue, working with a supplier, and using production data to improve the next iteration of the product.

This is a hands-on engineering role with significant influence over how Kaleidos evolves from a development program into a manufacturable product.




RESPONSIBILITIES & DUTIES

 - Own manufacturing and inspection processes for critical Kaleidos components, mechanisms, structures, and assemblies from design release through fabrication, integration, and final acceptance.

 - Partner closely with design engineers to drive design for manufacturability and assembly (DFM/DFA), influencing hardware to reduce mass, part count, manufacturing complexity, assembly time, and production risk.

 - Evaluate designs for manufacturability, inspectability, tolerance stack-up, tooling access, assembly sequence, subsystem integration, and final reactor assembly.

 - Develop, qualify, document, and continuously improve manufacturing processes for complex mechanical hardware and integrated assemblies.

 - Translate engineering drawings, CAD models, requirements, and specifications into manufacturing plans, work instructions, inspection strategies, tooling requirements, and production controls.

 - Define fabrication and assembly approaches for new hardware, including process selection, sequencing, make-versus-buy decisions, and inspection methodology.

 - Design and develop production tooling, fixtures, assembly aids, lifting equipment, and other manufacturing equipment required to safely and repeatably build reactor hardware.

 - Partner with Quality and Test Engineering to establish inspection and acceptance strategies, resolve build and test issues, and incorporate lessons learned into future hardware and processes.

 - Investigate manufacturing defects, nonconformances, and assembly issues using structured root-cause analysis and implement durable corrective actions.

 - Identify, evaluate, and develop suppliers for critical components and manufacturing processes, working directly with suppliers to mature fabrication methods and resolve technical issues.

 - Identify and implement capital equipment, machinery, and production infrastructure needed to support current builds and future production volumes.

 - Support hands-on build, integration, and troubleshooting activities while identifying opportunities to improve repeatability, throughput, yield, labor content, and production scalability.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

 - Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, manufacturing engineering, aerospace engineering, or a related technical discipline from an accredited institution.

 - 8+ years of experience manufacturing complex mechanical hardware in a production, development, or high-reliability engineering environment.

 - Demonstrated experience partnering with design engineering to influence hardware through DFM/DFA.

 - Experience owning manufacturing processes from development through qualification and production implementation.

 - Strong understanding of mechanical fabrication and assembly processes, including machining, joining, fastening, alignment, tolerance control, and inspection.

 - Strong ability to interpret engineering drawings, CAD models, specifications, and Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing (GD&T).

 - Experience developing manufacturing documentation such as work instructions, process specifications, routings, and inspection plans.

 - Experience troubleshooting manufacturing and assembly problems, performing root-cause analysis, and implementing corrective actions.

 - Demonstrated ability to make practical engineering tradeoffs across manufacturability, quality, cost, schedule, performance, and risk.

 - Experience working directly with technicians, machinists, fabricators, inspectors, and operators in a hands-on manufacturing environment.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively across design, quality, test, supply chain, and operations teams.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

 - Master’s degree in mechanical engineering, manufacturing engineering, or a related technical discipline.

 - Experience transitioning complex hardware from prototype or development builds into repeatable or scaled production.

 - Experience manufacturing highly engineered hardware in aerospace, energy, nuclear, automotive, defense, turbomachinery, or another high-reliability industry.

 - Experience with precision machining, mechanical joining, dimensional inspection, and non-destructive evaluation methods.

 - Experience with tolerance analysis and manufacturing or assembly strategies for tightly controlled interfaces.

 - Experience designing custom fixtures, tooling, assembly equipment, or other production hardware.

 - Experience with process qualification, first article inspection, statistical process control, or production quality systems.

 - Experience developing suppliers for low-volume, high-complexity hardware.

 - Experience with manufacturing automation, production equipment, or semi-automated assembly systems.

 - Demonstrated ability to reduce part count, mass, assembly time, production complexity, or manufacturing cost without compromising product performance.


ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

 - Must be willing to support extended hours and weekends when necessary to meet critical program milestones.

 - Must work 100% onsite at Radiant’s El Segundo headquarters.


BENEFITS AND PERKS

 - Stock: Substantial incentive stock plan for all full-time employees.

 - Medical: 100% up to base silver level plan for employee + 50% dependents, offers up to Platinum plans.

 - One Medical: Sponsored memberships for employees and their dependents.

 - Vision: 100% top tier plan coverage + 50% for dependents.

 - Dental: 100% top tier plan coverage, orthodontia extra, 50% for dependents.

 - Voluntary life, accident, hospital, critical illness, commuter and FSA/HSA are offered as employee contributed benefits.

 - 8-weeks of paid parental leave for all parents. Additional paid pregnancy leave for CA employees.

 - Daily catered lunch. Free snacks and drinks.

 - Flexible PTO policy. Remote workday allocation.

 - Company and team-bonding events, happy hours and in-person camaraderie.

 - Beautiful El Segundo headquarters close to the Pacific Ocean.



Total Compensation and Benefits
Radiant compensates people for impact and invests in those who continue to raise the bar. Radiant’s new hire compensation package includes base salary, substantial equity grants, and comprehensive health benefits. Total compensation and level are determined through a rigorous evaluation of interview performance, experience, education, and qualifications, and are designed to support continued growth as scope, responsibility, and impact expand at Radiant.

jobs.title: Staff Nuclear Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT RADIANT

Radiant is an El Segundo, CA-based startup building the world’s first mass-produced, portable nuclear microreactors. The company’s first reactor, Kaleidos, is a 1-megawatt, fail-safe microreactor that can be transported anywhere power is needed and run for up to 5 years without refueling. Portable nuclear power with rapid-deploy capability can replace similar-sized diesel generators and provide critical asset support for hospitals, data centers, remote sites, and military bases. Founded in 2020, Radiant is on track to test its first reactor at the Idaho National Laboratory this summer, with initial customer deliveries beginning in 2028.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Radiant is seeking a Staff Nuclear Engineer to provide technical expertise across the nuclear design and analysis of Kaleidos. You will work across core physics, neutron and radiation transport, shielding, activation and dose, thermal-hydraulics, safety analysis, instrumentation and controls, reactor operations, and regulatory evaluations to solve multidisciplinary reactor design challenges.

This role combines deep hands-on analysis with technical ownership across major nuclear engineering workstreams. You will lead complex projects from requirements definition and early design trades through model development, analysis, verification and validation, testing, and regulatory documentation. You will help establish analytical methods and technical standards, mentor engineers, and serve as a key technical interface between nuclear analysis and the broader reactor engineering organization.

The ideal candidate brings deep technical judgment, strong engineering fundamentals, and the ability to translate complex nuclear analysis into practical reactor design decisions. You should be comfortable operating with significant technical autonomy, working across disciplines, and driving difficult engineering problems through closure.

Responsibilities & Duties

 - Provide technical leadership across reactor physics, core performance, shielding, dose and activation, thermal-hydraulics, safety analysis, I&C, and reactor operations.

 - Own complex nuclear engineering projects from requirements capture and design iteration through model development, analysis, technical review, and final documentation.

 - Perform and guide analyses of criticality, reactivity control, shutdown margin, power distribution, depletion, temperature feedback, radiation transport, dose, activation, and shielding performance.

 - Develop, review, and improve high-fidelity neutron and radiation transport models used to support reactor design, safety, testing, and regulatory evaluations.

 - Translate analytical results into actionable requirements and design decisions affecting the core, shielding, control systems, instrumentation, fluid systems, structures, and surrounding hardware.

 - Lead multidisciplinary technical trades and evaluate the interaction between nuclear performance, thermal behavior, mechanical design, controls, operations, manufacturability, and safety.

 - Establish and improve rigorous practices for model verification and validation, peer review, configuration control, uncertainty evaluation, and technical documentation.

 - Ensure analytical assumptions, limitations, uncertainties, margins, and conclusions are clearly documented and technically defensible.

 - Develop analytical methods, workflows, and tools that improve the accuracy, efficiency, and scalability of Radiant’s nuclear engineering capability.

 - Collaborate with reactor systems, thermal, mechanical, electrical, test, operations, safety, and regulatory teams to resolve multidisciplinary design challenges.

 - Work with the regulatory organization to translate applicable nuclear standards and requirements into analysis plans, design criteria, calculation packages, and verification activities.

 - Support reactor testing and startup by defining analysis needs, instrumentation requirements, acceptance criteria, and methods for comparing predicted and measured performance.

 - Provide technical mentorship and review for engineers across nuclear design and analysis activities.

 - Identify technical risks, develop practical mitigation strategies, and drive complex nuclear engineering problems through closure.

 - Communicate technical status, risks, decisions, and recommendations clearly to engineering teams and company leadership.

Required Qualifications & Skills

 - Bachelor’s degree in nuclear engineering or a related technical discipline from an accredited institution.

 - 8+ years of relevant nuclear engineering experience across reactor design, analysis, testing, licensing, safety, or operations.

 - Demonstrated experience owning complex nuclear engineering projects involving multiple technical disciplines and stakeholders.

 - Deep knowledge of neutron transport theory, Monte Carlo simulation methods, nuclear data, and statistical convergence.

 - Professional experience developing and applying MCNP, OpenMC, or comparable neutron and radiation transport models.

 - Strong understanding of reactor physics concepts, including criticality, reactivity coefficients, depletion, power distribution, shutdown margin, neutron and gamma transport, and uncertainty analysis.

 - Experience translating analytical results into reactor design decisions, technical requirements, safety conclusions, or regulatory documentation.

 - Experience developing or reviewing technically rigorous analysis methodologies, models, calculation packages, or engineering standards.

 - Familiarity with model verification and validation, configuration control, peer review, and nuclear software quality practices.

 - Demonstrated ability to operate independently on technically complex problems and drive work from definition through technical closure.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex analyses, assumptions, uncertainties, and technical conclusions to multidisciplinary teams.

Preferred Qualifications & Skills

 - Master’s degree or Ph.D. in nuclear engineering or a related technical discipline.

 - Subject-matter expertise in safety analysis, shielding, radiation dose and activation, instrumentation and controls, reactor operations, thermal-hydraulics, or radioactive-material transportation.

 - Experience with high-temperature gas-cooled reactors, microreactors, advanced reactors, or first-of-a-kind nuclear systems.

 - Demonstrated experience mentoring engineers and providing technical review across complex engineering programs.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

As an Agent Branding Coordinator at Wave, you will supervise all the agent network branding initiatives. You'll help to coordinate the day-to-day operations of our agent branding of agencies and help us maintain desirable visibility and agent activation rates as we rapidly scale our business in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

In this role you’ll:

• Prepare supporting and branding materials to be installed at each of our agents.

• Recommend cost-efficient sources (new channels, partnerships, etc) for better branding partners for production and installation.

• Improve the visual standards of our agents (normal agents, premium agents, master agents, etc), as per the brand guidelines of the company

• Track the progress and quality of our agent network visibility and branding, by working in collaboration with our branding partners and our field sales and agent network management team

• Receive stock of marketing supplies and materials from our vendors and suppliers, and organize appropriate dispatching; track inventory of all stock and organize orders to avoid stock-outs

Key details

• Location: Kinshasa, Bandundu, Kongo Central and may travel to field locations.

• Work authorization in the Democratic Republic of Congo is required

• This is a permanent position

• Our salaries are competitive and calculated using a transparent formula. We run performance reviews twice a year and award bonuses to strong performers who have been with the company for more than 6 months

• We offer generous health insurance for yourself and your dependents

• We support working parents - we offer 26 weeks of parental leave for mothers and 4 weeks for fathers, in addition to subsidized child care when they return to work

• Airtime reimbursement

• Free food and a beautiful office space

You might be a good fit if you

• Have 2+ years of experience in brand coordination, brand marketing, or marketing coordination.

• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or related field. MBA preferred.

• Are fluent in English / and French

• Are a creative thinker and problem solver

• Demonstrate strong communication skills

• Have project management experience, with a solid understanding of project management principles and techniques

• Have experience at a marketing agency, telecom, payment service provider, FMCG or financial institution and have successfully executed branding campaigns.

Our team

• We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.

• We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.

• We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.

• We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.

• We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue.

How to apply

Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.

We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals.

Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Fuel Analyst
jobs.description:

The Fuel Operations Analyst assists with daily fuel operations activities, including fuel data validation, inventory tracking, invoice reconciliation, and operational reporting. This position supports internal controls, audit readiness, and month end close processes while collaborating with cross functional teams and external vendors to resolve issues and improve data quality. The role emphasizes accuracy, process discipline, and continuous improvement in a fast paced, high volume environment.
Visa Sponsorship Available: No
Minimum Requirements
Combination of Education and Experience will be considered. Must be authorized to work in the US as defined by the Immigration Act of 1986. Must pass a Criminal Background Check.
Education: Bachelor’s Degree
Education Details:  
Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, or related field.
Years of Experience:  
Minimum three (3) years of experience in finance, accounting, or related field.

•    Proficient with Microsoft Office: Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.

jobs.title: Product Manager | Software
jobs.description:
About Plasmidsaurus

Plasmidsaurus is on a mission to accelerate new cures and promote a healthier planet by unlocking a new level of productivity for scientists. Our sequencing services are used daily by thousands of innovators, including Nobel laureates, Fortune 100 pharma, and over 70,000 scientists.



We began by revolutionizing plasmid sequencing, making it exponentially cheaper and faster, with innovative sequencing technologies and a global network of laboratories that turn samples into answers in hours, not weeks.



Now we are expanding that same disruptive model across all of genomics. With the launch of our new RNA-seq service, we are taking a bold step toward our vision to sequence everything, providing scientists everywhere with faster, simpler, and more affordable access to the data that powers discovery.



Every team member at Plasmidsaurus plays a crucial role in driving the future of biotech research. Together, we are building the world’s most efficient sequencing engine that operates overnight, scales globally, and helps scientists make breakthroughs faster than ever before.




THE ROLE

Ordering DNA sequencing is famously miserable: you email a sales rep, wait, get a PDF back, fill another form for the order, or wait for barcodes shipped to you. One reason scientists choose us is that we have one of the best websites in biotech that gets you from research idea to order placed in minutes.

We are hiring a Product Manager to own the UX and growth of the non-biology aspects of our web app. You will talk to our users, create clarity for our engineering teams, and make all facets of the customer experience from first hearing about Plasmidsaurus to becoming a long-term customer.

We operate worldwide and are scaling rapidly - serving everyone from grad students to Fortune 100 pharma.




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 - Talk to world-class researchers about moving their science faster. We have an unusual number of customers who want to talk to us. Distill the customer voice into a roadmap with our engineering teams.

 - Create incredible user experiences. Make sure Plasmidsaurus is the benchmark that customers mention.

 - Own the surfaces that aren't sequencing: onboarding, collaboration, payments, order and logistics tracking, account settings, emails, internationalization, workspaces and sharing. Customers spend a large slice of their research budget with us, and we want to be known as their favorite vendor.

 - Growth. Improve analytics and visibility into key customer workflows. Find where users drop off in onboarding, ordering, and sharing results, then run experiments to fix it.
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - A track record of shipping, you have made significant contributions to shape a B2B product into something customers love.

 - Agency. You don't wait for someone to hand you a brief. You get hands-on with analytics, book your own user interviews, build prototypes, and keep engineers up to date.

 - Your preferred communication style is for prototypes over PRDs, Claude artifacts, standalone HTML.

 - Great product judgment and UX sense.

 - You can ramp fast in technical domains. No science background required, but you should be energized by complexity and willing to learn.
   
   


WHAT WOULD IMPRESS US EVEN MORE

 - You are comfortable shipping code, AI-assisted or not.

 - You have worked at a small company where you were the PM.

 - You got obsessed with a problem and built something to solve it, even though nobody asked you to.
   
   


WHAT WE OFFER

 - We are a bootstrapped, profitable company at an exciting inflection point.

 - Ownership and impact. Your work goes directly to 70,000 scientists, including Nobel laureates, who trust Plasmidsaurus with their research.

 - A tower office in South San Francisco with bay views, a state-of-the-art lab, and the occasional batch of liquid nitrogen ice cream.
   
   

We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly align with the job description as we seek out diverse and creative perspectives. Team members who love to learn and collaborate in an inclusive environment will thrive with us. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. If you need additional accommodations to feel comfortable during your interview process, please let us know at careers@plasmidsaurus.com. careers@plasmidsaurus.com

jobs.title: Contract Sensory Evaluator Panelist (Fragrance)
jobs.description:
Who we are at Osmo:

Osmo is a digital olfaction company, on a mission to give computers a sense of smell to improve the health and wellbeing of human life. Why? Our sense of smell both enriches and saves lives, and has a deep and direct connection to our emotions and memory.

Olfactory Intelligence has applications across industries including fragrance, manufacturing, security, medicine, and more. We believe in the power of automation and thoughtfully applied AI/ML to solve problems beyond the reach of human intuition alone. 



We're headquartered in Elizabeth, NJ, with an additional office in Somerville, MA. We provide complimentary shuttle service from Brooklyn and Newark, NJ.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Osmo is seeking a highly meticulous and olfactively acute individual to join our team as Contract Sensory Panelist (Fragrance). This is a specialized, part-time contract role dedicated exclusively to generating high-quality sensory data that fuels our Olfactory Intelligence models. It's work that rewards genuine curiosity about scent and the tenacity to stay sharp through long, repetitive evaluation sessions.

You'll use your superior sense of smell to characterize the behavior, performance, and stability of fragrance compounds and formulas, directly contributing to the digitization of scent. We're looking for someone with a genuine passion for fragrance, a methodical approach to objective evaluation, and the kindness and patience to work well within a tight-knit panel team relying on each other for consistency.




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Own Dedicated Olfactory Evaluation — Since smelling is an essential function of this role, spend a set number of hours per day actively smelling and evaluating fragrance samples in various formats.

 - Generate Precise Sensory Data — Perform character and intensity annotations based on Osmo's internal scales and taxonomic lexicon.

 - Track Stability and Performance — Evaluate the evolution of odor profiles over time, measuring fragrance integrity and performance in samples from stability chambers and application tests.

 - Show Up as a Reliable Panelist — Rigorously follow established protocols and maintain the highest standards of objectivity and focus, panel after panel.

 - Stay Calibrated With the Team — Participate in required training sessions to stay aligned with other panelists and consistent across data points, with the curiosity to keep learning Osmo's evolving taxonomy.




WHO YOU ARE:

 - Olfactively Proven — Must pass a sensory acuity screening.

 - Focused and Disciplined — Sustained concentration through long, repetitive sensory tasks — tenacity is part of the job description here.

 - Methodical and Objective — Separates personal preference from analytical sensory assessment.

 - A Fast, Curious Learner — Quickly learns Osmo's internal scales and complex olfactive taxonomy.

 - Reliable — Committed to scheduled hours.

 - On-Site in Elizabeth, NJ — Available 6 hours a day, 5 days a week.




WAYS TO STAND OUT:

 - A Genuine Passion for Scent — Deep-seated curiosity about fragrance or olfactory science.

 - A Descriptive Vocabulary — Beyond simple hedonic (like/dislike) terms.

 - A Scientific Foundation — Chemistry, biology, or psychology background or interest.




WHAT WE OFFER:

 - Real Growth Path — Starts as a 90-day probationary period at 20 hours/week, with potential to grow to 30 hours/week and benefits eligibility.

 - Hourly Rate — $30/hour for 4 hours of evaluation

 - Consistent, predictable contract hours

If this role inspires you we’d encourage you to apply. We are committed to recruiting, developing, and retaining an incredible team optimized for a diversity of thought, background, and approaches.

For all Full-Time Employees, compensation is just one component of Osmo’s total rewards approach, which is designed to support the well-being, growth, and long-term success of our team members. About Altruist

Altruist is transforming the multi-trillion dollar wealth management industry by building an AI platform for wealth professionals. We partner with financial advisors nationwide, empowering them to grow, optimize time and resources, and deliver superior outcomes for their clients.

We're looking for exceptional talent to help us achieve our mission of making financial advice better, more affordable, and accessible to all. If you're passionate about challenging the status quo and want to do the most important work of your life, we'd love to meet you!

But first, our values

Kindness - Kindness doesn’t just equal niceness. We listen to understand. We embrace, and encourage healthy debate and diverse perspectives. We approach conflict openly, honestly, and respectfully.

Brilliance - Humility is the skill we’re most proud of and possessing a growth mindset is always top of mind. We take ownership in everything we touch; regularly using our unique superpowers to reach a common goal as a team. We succeed and fail as one.

Grit - When challenges arise, we stay laser focused on achieving our mission and finding a way forward, even when it’s hard. We are nimble and maintain a sense of urgency, swiftly adapting to change and overcoming obstacles.

The opportunity

Altruist is in the midst of an exceptional growth phase and we're excited to hire a Senior Product Manager, Enterprise to join our growing product team. As we move upmarket, the registered investment advisor (RIA) firms we work with are larger and more complex, with multiple offices, dedicated operations and compliance teams, and many advisors serving thousands of clients. You'll shape how these firms set up, onboard, and run their business on Altruist. Your work may span onboarding, firm setup, permissions, branding, and billing. You'll also help inform where we invest as our enterprise offering grows, with the goal of simple, enterprise-grade experiences that firms, advisors, and their clients enjoy using.

Your impact

• Own the roadmap and delivery for one or more enterprise product areas.

• Learn how large firms split work across roles, from operations and compliance to advisors and client service, and build products that fit how each team works.

• Design workflows that support complex organizations, such as delegating tasks, making bulk changes, and letting firms manage their own settings.

• Identify where internal processes create friction or won't hold up at scale, and close those gaps with product features, internal tools, or playbooks.

• Ship iterative, high-quality releases alongside engineering and design.

• Partner with enterprise firms to shape the product, turning their feedback into solutions that delight many types of firms.

• Help sales win enterprise firms by leading product discovery and showing how Altruist fits the way each firm works.

What you bring

• Experience - 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager building B2B2C or multi-sided software, with a track record of shipping complex, high-visibility products.

• Designing products where the buyer, daily user, and end customer are different people.

• Building for enterprise customers with complex organizations while keeping the product simple to use.

• Leading discovery with customers and internal teams to find the problems most worth solving.

• Breaking large, ambiguous problems into smaller releases with measurable impact.

• Technical aptitude - You're comfortable discussing architecture and data models with engineers and understand how integrations connect a firm's systems. You know how to track key user journeys and use the data to guide decisions.

• Ownership - You own outcomes, not just delivery, and stay with a product after launch until it works for the firms using it.

• Superb communication - You create clarity across teams, influence without formal authority, and explain complex tradeoffs in plain language to firms and internal partners alike.

• Adaptability - You thrive in fast-moving environments and bring structure and momentum when the path forward isn't clear.

• Judgment - You make sound decisions with incomplete information, push back when something isn't right for the customer, and stay open to other perspectives.

• Creative problem solving - You have strong product and design instincts and can make complex, rules-heavy problems feel simple. You hold a high bar for experiences that are both enterprise-grade and delightful to use.

Bonus points if you bring

• Experience in fintech, wealth management, or another regulated industry.

• Familiarity with how RIAs operate, including firm structures, advisor transitions, or custodial relationships.

• Experience building onboarding, activation, or implementation experiences for enterprise customers.

• Experience owning platform capabilities such as team management, roles and permissions, admin tools, or multi-level structures like offices and sub-organizations.

Los Angeles, CA salary range

$180,000—$230,000 USD

What we bring

Attracting and retaining top-tier talent is a priority. We are proud of the culture we’ve built and are cognizant of the ever-changing professional landscape. Our dynamic offering of perks and benefits are tailored for you to feel your best while doing your best.

• Stunning, amenity-filled office spaces in Culver City, CA, San Francisco, CA, and Dallas, TX. Our offices are intentionally designed for comfort, collaboration, and productivity.

• Competitive total compensation.

• Premium healthcare, dental, and vision insurance plans (HMO and PPO).

• 401k savings plan with a 4% match and immediate vesting.

• 16 week paid parental leave after one year of employment.

• Professional growth and development opportunities including an employee mobility program and an annual L&D budget allocation for each employee.

• Company perks program (includes discounts on pet insurance, fitness, cell phone plans, and travel, etc.).

• Financial guidance program (includes counseling on navigating debt, tracking personal spend, saving and planning goals, home-purchasing preparedness, etc.).

• One month work from anywhere policy (with the exception of a few countries).

Total compensation includes a competitive benefits package, along with a bonus program for eligible roles. For salaried positions, a salary offer will be determined by a number of factors including experience, skill level, internal pay equity, geographic location, and other relevant business considerations. We review all employee pay and compensation programs regularly to ensure fair, equitable, and competitive pay. At Altruist, we are committed to providing fair, equitable, and competitive compensation by leveraging market data to inform our pay bands. Base salaries will be reviewed at regular intervals throughout the year, typically in conjunction with performance review cycles. By evaluating compensation on a regular basis, we are able to reward high performance and ensure all employees have opportunities for growth.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Altruist we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role, but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

jobs.title: Cell Therapy Account Manager -Southeast
jobs.location: Charlotte, NC; Tampa, FL; Orlando, FL
jobs.description:
CareDx is a leading precision medicine diagnostics company advancing care in transplant, specialty oncology, and cell therapy. Through our innovative portfolio of molecular diagnostics, digital health solutions, AI-powered data and analytics, and patient support services, we partner with healthcare providers, patients, and biopharma organizations to help inform clinical decision-making and improve patient outcomes.

At CareDx, every employee has the opportunity to contribute to innovations that help transform patient care and improve lives.

The Cell Therapy Account Manager is responsible for driving adoption and volume growth of the CareDx Cell Therapy & Transplant portfolio, including AlloHeme and associated molecular testing and digital solutions. Focusing primarily on blood and marrow transplant centers, cell therapy programs, hematology-oncology practices, and academic medical centers, the Cell Therapy Account Manager will educate providers on the clinical value of AlloHeme, support implementation of new testing programs, and drive ongoing utilization through strategic account management.

The Cell Therapy Account Manager will coordinate and collaborate with Clinical Liaisons, Medical Affairs, Customer Experience, Marketing, and Sales Operations to develop and execute account-specific growth strategies. Successful candidates are consultative sellers with strong clinical aptitude, strategic account management skills, and the ability to navigate complex healthcare organizations with multiple stakeholders and approval processes.  This role reports directly to the National Sales Director, Cell Therapy & Transplant

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

Strategic Account Management

• Develop a deep understanding of customer needs, clinical workflows, operational challenges, and organizational objectives. Identify opportunities to expand adoption of CareDx Cell Therapy & Transplant solutions and develop account-specific strategies to drive utilization and long-term growth.

Clinical Education & Belief Building

• Build clinical understanding and confidence in AlloHeme and the broader CareDx Cell Therapy & Transplant portfolio through scientific and clinical discussions with physicians, advanced practice providers, transplant coordinators, laboratory leadership, and other key stakeholders. Partner with Medical Affairs to address advanced scientific and clinical questions when appropriate.

Account Activation & Implementation

• Lead account onboarding and activation activities to support successful implementation of AlloHeme and other CareDx testing solutions. Work with clinical liaisons and customer stakeholders to establish ordering, reporting, sample logistics, and operational workflows. Help customers navigate institutional review and approval processes required for adoption.

Strategic Planning & Execution

• Develop and execute strategic account plans that drive adoption, increase market penetration, expand the CareDx footprint, and achieve commercial objectives. Effectively prioritize opportunities and resources to maximize territory performance.

Contracting & Business Development

• Support execution of Laboratory Service Agreements (LSAs) and other customer agreements as needed. Partner with internal stakeholders to facilitate contracting activities and remove barriers to implementation and adoption.

Building Strong Customer Relationships

• Identify and engage key clinical, laboratory, operational, and administrative stakeholders. Establish trusted partnerships across customer organizations, proactively identify unmet needs, and ensure a high level of customer satisfaction and account retention.

Managing the Sales Pipeline

• Maintain a robust sales pipeline and territory business plan. Forecast opportunities, track implementation milestones, monitor utilization trends, and provide regular business updates on territory performance.

Collaborating with Internal Teams

• Partner closely with Clinical Liaison, Medical Affairs, Marketing, Customer Experience, Market Access, Sales Operations, and Operations teams to develop solutions that support customer success and drive business growth.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree required, advance degree preferred

• Minimum of 10 years sales or strategic account management experience in the healthcare industry

• Demonstrated ability to sell clinically within the hematology-oncology market

• Experience supporting blood and marrow transplant, cell therapy, or CAR-T programs preferred

• Proven success selling into large academic medical centers, cancer centers, hospitals, and complex healthcare systems

• Demonstrated experience navigating multi-stakeholder decision-making environments involving physicians, laboratory leadership, administrators, procurement teams, and operational stakeholders

• Proven ability to establish and implement clinical, operational, laboratory, or workflow protocols within healthcare organizations

• Experience supporting healthcare contracting processes; experience with Laboratory Service Agreements (LSAs) or related agreements preferred

• Strong strategic account management and territory planning skills

• Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills

• Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally to drive customer adoption and implementation success

• Must be willing to travel 50- 75% or greater and effectively manage a large geographic territory

• Proficient with Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Salesforce.com and analytical tools

Key Characteristics:

• Clinical Selling Excellence

• Results Driven

• Strategic Thinking

• Customer Focus

• Problem Solving

• Strong Communication Skills

• Persistence

• Self-Awareness & Adaptability

• Ownership & Accountability

Additional Details:

Every individual at CareDx has a direct impact on our collective mission to improve the lives of organ transplant patients worldwide. We believe in taking great care of our people, so they take even greater care of our patients.

Our competitive Total Rewards package for US Employees includes:

• Competitive base salary and incentive compensation

• Health and welfare benefits, including a gym reimbursement program

• 401(k) savings plan match

• Employee Stock Purchase Plan

• Pre-tax commuter benefits

• And more!

• Please refer to our page to view detailed benefits at https://caredx.com/company/careers

In addition, we have a Living Donor Employee Recovery Policy that allows up to 30 days of paid leave annually to a full-time employee who makes the selfless act of donating an organ or bone marrow.

With products that are making a difference in the lives of transplant patients today and a promising pipeline for the future, it’s an exciting time to be part of the CareDx team. Join us in partnering with transplant patients to transform our future together.

jobs.title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Overflow is a Silicon Valley technology company with a bold mission: to inspire the world to give. We are a B2B SaaS philanthropy platform that enables modern giving across cash, stock, and crypto for nonprofits, churches, and mission-driven organizations. Backed by leading investors including Uncork Capital, Craft Ventures, and Village Global, Overflow builds secure, beautifully designed infrastructure that powers generosity at scale.



OUR FOUNDING PRINCIPLES

Overflow was founded on the belief that generosity transforms people and communities. Inspired by Proverbs 11:24 — "The world of the generous gets larger and larger" — we operate with integrity, stewardship, service, and excellence.



TRAVEL EXPECTATIONS

This is a fully remote role with regular travel. You'll visit each enterprise partner on-site at or near launch and at least once a year after that, and you'll join the team for in-person collaboration weeks at our Los Gatos, CA or Birmingham, AL offices 1-2 times a year.



WHO YOU ARE

Overflow is seeking an Enterprise Customer Success Manager to own the health, retention, and growth of our most complex, high-value partner organizations. These are large, multi-location churches with sophisticated operations - Executive Pastors, CFOs, Finance Committees, Operations, IT, and Communications all at the table - and they require a seasoned account manager who can navigate multi-threaded stakeholder environments and serve as a true strategic partner at the executive level. This role is measured by the ability to retain and expand a focused book of organizationally complex accounts, earn lasting trust from leadership, and consistently identify growth opportunities that match each partner's mission and scale.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Account Management Excellence: Serve as the named Enterprise Customer Success Manager for a focused book of our most complex, high-value partner organizations. Operate as a true strategic partner to each partner's executive leadership, earning trust through consistent delivery, deep product knowledge, and strategic conversation, not just renewal management.

 - Multi-Threaded Relationship Management: Build relationships across the full organizational structure of each partner: Executive Pastors, CFOs, Finance Committees, Operations, IT, and Communications. Ensure no key stakeholder relationship goes unmanaged and that Overflow has advocates at every level of the organization.

 - Quarterly Giving Reviews: Host four structured giving reviews per year with executive stakeholders at each Enterprise partner. Use these sessions to review platform performance, measure giving outcomes, address organizational concerns, and build the strategic case for continued and expanded investment.

 - Monthly Check-Ins: Maintain a consistent monthly check-in cadence with each partner between Quarterly Giving Reviews to track engagement, surface emerging needs, and keep the relationship active and productive.

 - Partner Visits: Visit partner accounts in person, typically at or near launch and then at least once a year, to establish the relationship, meet key stakeholders face-to-face, and develop a high-trust, long-term partnership.

 - Value Retention and Churn Prevention: Flag risks early, manage the renewal pipeline in HubSpot, and execute tailored churn-save strategies. Navigate difficult renewal conversations with full ownership.

 - Strategic Upsells and Expansion: Develop and execute tailored expansion strategies for each Enterprise account. Propose solutions that go beyond the existing playbook, drawing on a deep understanding of each partner's organizational priorities and generosity goals.

 - Proactive Strategies and Playbooks: Build annual strategies for each partner and contribute best-practice playbooks to the broader CS team. Serve as a mentor and resource for junior Customer Success Managers, sharing what is working across your book.

 - Voice of the Customer: Share structured, high-quality feedback with Success leadership and Product based on what you are hearing across your Enterprise accounts. Surface trends, product gaps, and innovation opportunities in a way that influences internal strategy.

 - Product Advocacy: Educate Enterprise partners on new product releases and roadmap developments, articulating how upcoming changes affect their specific organizational goals and giving infrastructure.
   


KPIS

 - 110% NRR for owned book of business

 - 90% GRR for owned book of business

 - 90% on-time renewal closure
   


WHAT YOU SHOULD HAVE

 - 5+ years in account management, customer success, or a strategic sales role

 - Proven experience managing large, complex, multi-stakeholder organizations

 - Demonstrated ability to build and maintain relationships with executive-level stakeholders in churches, including in-person

 - Strong independent judgment - able to navigate difficult partner situations without requiring close direction

 - Strategic thinking and tailored problem-solving skills that go beyond playbook execution

 - Strong pipeline management and renewal forecasting skills in HubSpot or comparable CRM

 - Alignment with Overflow's mission and values

 - Willingness and ability to travel to visit partner accounts
   


IT'D BE NICE IF YOU HAD

 - Background in church operations, stewardship, or generosity consulting at scale

 - Experience contributing to team playbooks or mentoring junior team members
   


TOOLS AND SYSTEMS

 - General Tools: Slack, Google Workspace, Notion, Zoom, TextExpander

 - Partner Management: HubSpot, Monday.com http://Monday.com

 - Design/Collaboration: Pitch

 - HR/Operations: Gusto

 - Security: 1Password

 - AI & Automation: Claude, Loom
   


OUR COMPENSATION PHILOSOPHY

Overflow's compensation philosophy is rooted in Carta Total Compensation benchmarks, ensuring pay that is competitive by role, geography, and function. Actual compensation may vary based on factors including job-related skills, experience, interview performance, and market data.

Total compensation may also include equity, performance-based bonuses (for eligible roles), and a comprehensive benefits package. As a Series B company, we believe equity is a meaningful part of building long-term ownership—when Overflow wins, our team should share in that upside.



BENEFITS & PERKS

Overflow offers a thoughtful benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and life outside of work, including:

 - Competitive base salary and equity

 - Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents

 - Generous paid time off and company holidays

 - Paid parental leave

 - 401(k) retirement plan

 - Dedicated mental health and therapy stipend to support personal well-being

 - Team retreats and intentional in-person gatherings throughout the year
   

Overflow is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

Ready to slice through the competition and rise to the top? As our Assistant Manager, you'll be the big cheese during your shift, making sure everything runs smoother than melted mozzarella! Here's what's on the menu for your role:

• Dough Control: Keep our costs in check and our profits rising like perfectly proofed dough.
• Topping Management: Ensure our inventory is always fresh and ready to create pizza perfection.
• Crust-omer Service: Lead the team in delivering a five-star experience that'll have customers coming back for seconds.
• Team Supreme: Build and mentor a crew that's as tight-knit as our famous stuffed crust.
• Pepperoni to Paperwork: Master the art of managing documents with the same precision you use to place toppings.
• Marketing Maestro: Spread the word about our delicious deals like we spread our signature sauce.
• Cleanliness is Next to Cheesiness: Maintain a spotless store that's as fresh as our ingredients.

But wait, there's more! You'll also be:

• The Master of Ceremonies: Operate all equipment like a pizza-making DJ.
• Stock Star: Keep ingredients flowing from delivery area to storage faster than our express delivery.
• Order Whisperer: Take phone orders with the charm and efficiency of a drive-thru ninja.
• Inventory Guru: Count and track our precious pizza resources with laser focus.

Remember, at Domino's, we believe in having a slice of fun with everything we do. So bring your passion, your pizzazz, and your love for all things cheesy – both in humor and on our pies! Let's make some dough and memories together!

Ready to Rise Like Our Perfect Pizza Dough?

We’re on the hunt for our next Assistant Manager superstar—someone who can lead, inspire, and keep everything running as smoothly as melted mozzarella. Could that be you?

🍕 Dough-main Expertise

• Be the big cheese on your shift, keeping everything running like a well-oiled pizza oven.
• Handle kitchen heat while delivering cool, top-notch customer service.
• Crunch numbers as easily as we crunch our crusts (calculators welcome for extra cheesy math!).

🍕 Slice-of-Life Skills

• Multitask like a pro—phones, ovens, and paperwork all at once.
• Coordinate hands and eyes better than pineapple and ham on a Hawaiian.
• Type and process orders faster than we can say, “extra pepperoni, please!”

🍕 Toppings of Talent

• Speak fluent customer and coworker—your communication skills are the secret sauce.
• Keep our store spotless; a clean environment is as important as a perfect crust.
• Inspire your team to greatness, just like the irresistible aroma of a fresh-baked pizza.

🍕 Extra Cheese (aka Must-Haves)

• Ability to lift and carry up to 50 lbs (about six large pizzas, in case you were wondering).
• Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation.
• Flexibility to work various shifts—because great pizza waits for no one!

If you’re ready to rise to the occasion and be part of our pizza-making magic, apply now and let’s cook up something amazing together!

Additional Info:

• This is a full-time position.
• Must be available 7 days a week with varying shifts.
