jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Mission:

We are automating construction end to end to usher in a new era of abundance and beauty in the physical world in the coming decades. Over the past fifty years, the West’s ability to design and build large scale infrastructure has atrophied, and the entire industry has become less productive. With decaying infrastructure, power shortages, and an aging workforce, the only way through is to hyper-scale development with technology at a rate never before seen.

 

Our team believes that this is the most important work of our lives, and there’s no more significant place to spend our time than on solving these problems. We believe in the sacrifices that we must make to achieve our mission and build a world of abundance. We believe the future can be amazing, but only if we work gut-wrenchingly hard to make it so. Our work is bigger than all of us, and our obsession with manifesting is what drives us. Roughly 50% of our team are former founders, and we strive for technical excellence, but quell our egos to ensure that the best ideas always win.

 

We acknowledge the long and arduous path ahead to achieve our ambitions; that many of the most difficult challenges have yet to even be revealed to us; that the chance of failure is not only possible, but likely. Most of all, we believe that there is no other option: we will either revolutionize how humanity builds or die trying.

 

The role:

We're hiring a Senior Electrical Engineer to bring deep, practicing electrical expertise into our product. You'll pair years of hands-on design experience with product development, to take how an excellent EE thinks, reviews, and makes judgment calls, and turn that into capabilities within our automated design engine product, where we leverage AI to automate every step of the engineering design process to produce end construction design deliverables for large scale capital projects such as utility scale power and data centers. You'll set the bar for what "correct" means on every electrical deliverable we ship.



This role is in-person in San Francisco, CA.



What we're looking for:

 - Experience in one or more phases of design, construction, commissioning and operation of utility-scale power generation facilities

 - Owned the electrical design of large-scale power distribution systems end to end, from one-line diagrams and load flow through HV/MV distribution, substations, transformers, and switchgear, ideally on utility-scale generation (solar, BESS, or gas plants), or on the load side of large industrial power systems such as data centers or heavy industrial facilities

 - T-shaped technical excellence: broad understanding of how the civil scope connects to adjacent disciplines, and the implications of trade-offs across them, while also having deep expertise in 1-2 areas

 - Evidence of strong first principles thinking: someone who has challenged "this is how we've always done it" syndrome

 - Excitement to work in a fast-paced, high-performance environment, and embrace extreme ownership where we rethink many of the traditional "best-practices" of an industry that has been mostly frozen for 70+ years

 - The ability to prioritize impact by ruthlessly finding the bottlenecks and solving the most important problems

 - Hands-on engineers who can speak to the excruciating minutia and details of their work, and are excited to execute instead of manage/organize others' work

 - Mission alignment and desire to build a future of abundance

Experience: Senior. Significant hands-on electrical design experience; PE strongly preferred.



Bonus:

 - Experience building your own calculation, analysis, or design-automation tools. A large part of this role is turning your engineering knowledge into scalable software; even if you've barely written software before, you'll leverage recent advancements in AI coding agents to assist you in building these tools

 - Experience with AI coding agent tools (Codex, Claude Code, etc) for work or personal uses

jobs.title: Harnessing Technician
jobs.description:
Spacecraft represent the most pressing unmet need across the entire aerospace industry. As more launch vehicles come online and the cost to orbit decreases, more companies launching payloads to space continue to emerge.

For the first time in history, this influx of payload companies combined with reduced launch costs has resulted in a massive increase in need for commercial spacecraft platforms, known as satellite buses. These buses hold the payloads of our customers and are flown on launch vehicles.

Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more.

We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet. 




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a highly skilled Harness Technician to join our Avionics Test team. In this role, you will be responsible for the fabrication, assembly, modification, and repair of complex electrical wire harnesses supporting spacecraft avionics and test systems. You will work from schematics, wiring diagrams, and engineering drawings to perform precision crimping, soldering, connectorization, shielding, splicing, routing, and continuity testing. You will work closely with engineers in a cleanroom environment to build high-quality, reliable harnesses to aerospace workmanship standards.

Key Responsibilities

 - Wire Harness Fabrication: Fabricate, assemble, route, and terminate complex electrical wire and coaxial harnesses from engineering drawings, schematics, and work instructions, adhering to NASA and IPC workmanship standards.

 - Crimping & Termination: Perform high-quality crimping, soldering, splicing, pinning, connectorization, shielding, sleeving, and potting across a variety of aerospace-grade wires, cables, and connectors.

 - Harness Inspection & Testing: Inspect and test completed harnesses using digital multimeters and other test equipment to perform continuity, insulation resistance, and point-to-point verification.

 - Harness Troubleshooting & Rework: Diagnose wiring, connector, and termination issues and perform repairs, modifications, and rework while maintaining required workmanship standards.

 - Drawing & Build Documentation: Interpret wiring diagrams, schematics, pinout tables, and harness drawings while maintaining accurate as-built records, build logs, and red-line documentation for full traceability.

 - Cleanroom & ESD Practices: Fabricate and handle harness assemblies in controlled ESD-safe and cleanroom environments while following established aerospace quality and safety procedures.

 - Engineering Collaboration: Work closely with engineers to translate designs into reliable, build-ready harness assemblies and provide feedback on manufacturability, routing, connector selection, and assembly processes.

Required Qualifications & Skills

 - Experience: Minimum 2+ years of experience in satellite or spacecraft assembly and integration, specifically in aerospace structures, avionics integration, and harnessing.

 - Certifications: Active or prior certification in NASA-STD-8739 or IPC-J-STD-001 (Space Addendum).

 - Technical Proficiency: * Expert-level ability to read complex electrical schematics and 3D CAD models.

 - Experience with high-density connectors (Micro-D, Nano-D, Circular Mil-Spec).

 - Familiarity with quality standards and processes related to aerospace manufacturing.

 - Knowledge of vacuum-compatible materials and outgassing prevention.

 - Working knowledge of precision measurement tools and equipment used in satellite and spacecraft assembly and integration.

 - Ability to work effectively in a team environment, collaborating with engineers and technicians.

 - Strong commitment to safety, always adhering to safety protocols and guidelines.

 - Soft Skills: Extreme attention to detail—spaceflight doesn't allow for a "do-over."

Physical Requirements

 - Ability to work under a microscope for extended periods.

 - Manual dexterity for handling tiny components and delicate wiring.

 - Ability to work in a manufacturing lab environment.

 - Ability to carry 50lbs

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Artificial Intelligence/LLM
jobs.description:
ABOUT BEACON AI

We’re a fast-moving team of aviators, engineers, and operators building an AI platform to make flying safer, more efficient, and more capable. Backed by top investors, we’ve secured a dozen Department of Defense contracts and partnered with major airlines to deliver mission-critical systems. We operate without silos or heavy processes. Small, focused teams own what they build, ship quickly, and learn fast, pushing the boundaries of how humans and AI work together in aviation.



You will ship LLM-powered product features end-to-end. That means designing retrieval and tool-calling flows, writing the services that run them, building evals and guardrails, and watching cost, latency, and quality in production. You’ll partner with the ML/infra teammates on embeddings, indexing, and model hosting, and with the product teammates on user experience and outcomes. We move fast, and we care about reliability in a safety-critical domain.



This role is for engineers who set technical direction across services and teams (8+ years experience, with a track record of owning systems or defining standards others build against). You'll lead design for ambiguous, cross-team problems like provider routing or shared retrieval infra.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

Build user-facing LLM features

 - Design and implement retrieval-augmented generation and tool-calling flows using frameworks like LangChain or equivalent primitives, where simpler is better.

 - Deliver robust JSON and schema-bound outputs with validation, retries, and fallbacks.

 - Add function calling to integrate with internal tools, search, routing, and data services.

Own the service layer

 - Ship APIs and workers in Python or TypeScript with clear contracts, streaming, and backoff.

 - Add caching, request shaping, prompt templates, and context packing to control latency and cost.

 - Integrate with AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic, or self-hosted endpoints as needed.

Retrieval and data prep

 - Collaborate with infrastructure teammates to develop chunking, embeddings, and indexing capabilities for documents, time series, and multimedia.

 - Choose and tune vector backends such as OpenSearch, pgvector, or Pinecone.

 - Keep knowledge bases fresh with data syncs from S3, Aurora, DynamoDB, and external sources.

Evaluation and quality

 - Create offline evals and golden sets for prompts, retrievers, and tools.

 - Stand up online metrics for task success, hallucination rate, retrieval precision/recall, p95 latency, and cost per request.

 - Run A/B tests and prompt/version rollouts with guardrails and canaries.

Safety, privacy, and compliance

 - Implement content and policy checks, PII detection and redaction, access controls, and auditing.

 - Design human-in-the-loop paths for sensitive actions.

 - Handle aviation data with care and follow internal security standards.

Operate what you build

 - Add tracing, logs, and dashboards for model calls, token usage, errors, and saturation.

 - Debug tricky failures across retrieval, prompts, tools, and providers.


WHAT WILL MAKE YOU SUCCESSFUL

 - Shipped LLM apps: You’ve put LLM features in front of users and improved them with data.

 - Strong builder: Comfortable writing production code, tests, and docs. You keep things simple and observable.

 - RAG and tools depth: You understand embeddings, chunking, vector search tradeoffs, and function calling.

 - Quality mindset: You design evals, define success metrics, and iterate based on evidence.

 - Cost and latency aware: You track p95, hit SLAs, and reduce cost without hurting quality.

 - Clear communicator: You explain tradeoffs and align partners across product, infra, and security.

 - Technical leadership: You've set direction or standards that other engineers or teams built against, not just shipped your own code.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with Bedrock, OpenSearch Serverless, pgvector, Pinecone, or Weaviate.

 - Prompt versioning, guardrails, and provider routing in production.

 - Multimodal work with time series or video.

 - Familiarity with GPU inference, Triton, or TensorRT-LLM.

 - Aviation or other safety-critical domain exposure.

 - DevOps basics for CI/CD, IaC, and secure secrets handling.


EXAMPLE PROBLEMS YOU MIGHT TACKLE IN MONTH ONE

 - Transform an internal knowledge base into a low-latency RAG service, complete with explicit schemas and evaluations.

 - Add tool-calling to automate a repetitive cockpit or ops workflow with guardrails and audit trails.

 - Reduce the cost per request through improved chunking, caching, and prompt refactoring, while maintaining task success rates.

Work Location
This is a hybrid role based in San Carlos, CA, with 3+ days per week onsite and the option to work remotely on remaining days.

Perks & Benefits (Full-Time Employees)

 - Healthcare: 100%* of employee medical premiums covered; 25% for dependents

 - Time Off: 3 weeks PTO plus 13+ paid company holidays

 - 401(k): Offered (no current employer match, but we are committed to enhancing this benefit in the future)

Due to U.S. export control regulations, we can only hire U.S. Persons (U.S. citizens, Green Card holders, lawful permanent residents, or individuals granted asylum or refugee status). We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa transfers. All work must be performed in the United States.

This role is intended for LPNs with at least one year of hands-on nursing experience who are comfortable supporting day-to-day clinic operations and building proficiency in Tia’s workflows. You will report to the Clinic Manager for operational responsibilities and perform nursing duties under the clinical supervision of a registered nurse or licensed physician, in collaboration with Tia’s in-clinic providers.

What You’ll Do

What You’ll Bring

• Ability to work collaboratively across front- and back-office responsibilities

• Ability to meet the required schedule and location expectations for the role

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in primary care, urgent care, women’s health, reproductive health, or another outpatient setting

• Phlebotomy training or experience

• Experience supporting in-office procedures

• Experience working across both front- and back-office workflows

Work Location

This role is based in our Scottsdale, Arizona clinic and requires an onsite work schedule.

Compensation & Benefits

Tia is committed to pay equity and pay transparency. Compensation for this role will be determined based on job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, location, role leveling, business needs, and market conditions.

You are also eligible for:

About Tia

Tia is on a mission to transform healthcare for women by increasing access, improving outcomes, and delivering a better care experience. Our “Whole Woman, Whole Life” model integrates primary care, gynecology, mental health, dermatology, and wellness across in-person care and a national virtual platform.

We are a Series D, venture-backed company trusted by more than 120,000 women across four markets. Through our technology-enabled care model and partnerships with leading health systems, Tia is building one of the most comprehensive preventive care models for women.

About Tia’s Culture

Tia is building a culture of excellence in people, process, and product. For us, excellence is not perfection. It is the ongoing pursuit of improvement through learning, reflection, experimentation, curiosity, grit, and care for ourselves and others. We are looking for people who are energized by building, iterating, asking why, and helping create a fundamentally better healthcare experience for women.

Equal Opportunity

Tia is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity of experience, perspectives, and background leads to a better environment for our employees and a better product for our users and patients. We strongly encourage people of color and members of the LGBTQ+ community to apply.

If you are committed to collaborative problem solving, high-quality work, and making waves in women’s healthcare, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager of Copy and Brand Storytelling
jobs.description:
We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!

Hello, future Sr. Manager of Copy and Brand Storytelling

This is the person currently in your role. For full dramatic effect, please read this in Dakota Johnson’s voice. I don’t like job descriptions. They’re boring, and I'm convinced no one actually reads them. Plus, I don’t think a regular JD is capable of capturing the true magic of what it is to work here. Don’t worry, there are actual bullet points down below for those of you who need things like “responsibilities” and “qualifications.” blah blah blah

Here's what you really need to know:

Number one: The creative team at Grüns is 1 of 1.

At risk of sounding like a boomer using Gen Z slang, this job is extremely vibe-based.
Nothing is that serious, except for how much everyone cares about the work and each other.
In the wise words of every man who’s ever answered a Hinge prompt, we’re looking for someone who doesn’t take themselves too seriously.
It’s a gummy bear brand. As long as you don’t get us sued, for God's sake, have some fun.

Number two: You are, quite literally, the voice of the brand.

With the help of your partner in crime, our brilliant Junior Copywriter, you’ll own pretty much everything Grüns has to say.
Campaigns. Scripts. New brand launches. Collaborations. Retail.
This isn’t a job for someone who waits around to be told what to do. If you think something could be better, make it better. If you have an idea, pitch it. If nobody asked for it but you think it would be fucking funny, tell our CD.
That’s the beauty of this role. You have a ridiculous amount of creative freedom, and lots of times, the "Stakeholders" are the ones coming up with the crazy ideas in the first place.

Number two point five: About that partner in crime.

You’ll manage our Junior Copywriter.
That means giving thoughtful feedback, bringing her into the bigger thinking, helping her develop her voice and instincts, and giving her room to own things herself.
You should genuinely enjoy mentoring someone, not just tolerate it because “management experience” looks good on LinkedIn.

Number three: You shouldn’t just be a writer.

Being a great writer is obviously important, but it’s not the whole thing.
You’ll concept social ideas alongside our Social Media Manager. You’ll write scripts that shape how the brand comes to life across social, TV, and whatever screen we end up on next.
You’ll work with our Art Director and Creative Director to build entirely new brands from scratch. You’ll partner with our SVP and VP of Brand to flesh out collaborations.
You’ll work with Legal to figure out how to say shit without getting sued.
You’ll work with Retail to bring the brand to life in the aisle of your favorite overpriced grocery store.
You’ll work with Growth and Ecomm to make sure the brand still feels like the brand when someone lands on the site.
Basically, you’ll work with pretty much everyone.
So if you’re looking for a job where someone hands you a brief, you write a few headlines, and then disappear into the night, this probably isn’t it.

Number four: If you don't put your cart back at the grocery store, you need not apply.

This is one of the first things I wrote to describe the Grüns brand if it were a person, but it also happens to describe the people here pretty perfectly. Nobody’s above the small stuff, nobody has an ego, and nobody leaves their cart in the middle of the parking lot.
That last one hasn’t been formally verified, but I’d be devastated to learn otherwise.
Alright, I’m done here.
Good luck out there. And just know I’ll be extremely jealous of whoever gets this job (it’s a really good one).

Actual JD or whatever:

In this role, you will:

• Own and evolve the Grüns voice across campaigns, launches, social, retail, partnerships, and wherever else the brand shows up.

• Manage and mentor our Junior Copywriter, providing creative direction, thoughtful feedback, and room to grow.

• Write scripts across TV, social, digital, and brand campaigns.

• Develop campaign concepts, messaging, naming, and brand narratives.

• Partner with the Social Media Manager to concept social-first ideas and recurring content.

• Work alongside the Art Director, Creative Director, and SVP of Brand to develop new brands from the ground up, including positioning, naming, voice, messaging, and launch.

• Partner with the SVP and VP of Brand to develop the creative narratives behind collaborations and partnerships.

• Work closely with Legal to turn claims and product benefits into language people actually understand while accurately representing what our products can do.

• Partner with Retail to bring Grüns to life in-store through messaging, storytelling, signage, displays, and whatever else we can convince them to let us do.

• Collaborate with Growth and Ecomm to bring campaign ideas and brand storytelling to life across the site and performance channels.

• Push the brand somewhere new without losing what makes it Grüns in the first place.

We're looking for someone who:

• 8+ years of experience in brand storytelling, copywriting, advertising, editorial, entertainment, or another creative discipline where ideas and words matter. Comedy experience and a quippy, funny voice (without being cheesy) is a must.

• Experience operating at a senior creative level within a CPG brand, agency, start-up, or similarly fast-moving environment.

• An exceptional portfolio that proves you can think conceptually.

• Experience building the language behind 360 campaigns

• Finger on the pulse of culture, internet happenings, and what people are talking about (before the brands start talking about it too)

• Experience managing, mentoring, and giving feedback to writers.

• The ability to work closely with designers, art directors, strategists, marketers, product teams, lawyers, executives, and pretty much everyone else.

• A strong point of view without the ego that sometimes comes with having one.

• An instinct for making brands feel like they belong in culture rather than like they’re marketing at it.

• A general disdain for AI but an openness to work with it to make your life easier

Compensation & Benefits:

At Grüns, we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package — grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary range is $140,000-$160,000 plus bonus depending on experience, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team.

A bit about us...

At Grüns, we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you.

Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all.

So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious.

What we care about...

Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation.

Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners.

Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most.

Compensation & Perks:

For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.

Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!

jobs.title: Finance Manager
jobs.description:
About Seen Health

At Seen Health, we are revolutionizing the way senior care is delivered through the PACE (Programs of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly) model. Backed by top VCs, Seen Health is a culturally-focused, technology-enabled healthcare organization that integrates comprehensive medical care and social support with a high-touch, interdisciplinary approach.

Our mission is to empower seniors to age-in-place with dignity and provide their families peace of mind. We are building upon a proven Home and community based services model to create a culturally-competent and scalable PACE program. We are also building a comprehensive operating system focused on data and workflows that span across systems, processes, people, and care contexts. We want to empower our clinicians and staff with tools that deliver relevant data at the time and site of care and enable them to deliver exceptional care to our participants, which improve clinical outcomes, participant & provider satisfaction, and ultimately our strength as an organization.

We are a mission-driven, multidisciplinary team with deep healthcare, technology, and operations expertise, each inspired by our own personal stories of caring for seniors in our lives. Our name, Seen Health, was chosen to reflect our commitment to provide the highest standard of care to underserved older adults while respecting and incorporating their individual beliefs, heritage, and values, so that they can truly be seen.

Overview
We’re hiring a Finance Manager or Senior Finance Manager to be the operating backbone of our finance function. This is a generalist role in the truest sense — you’ll own the day-to-day financial operations, build processes from scratch, work directly with our Head of Finance and executive leadership, and help scale a lean but high-performing team. The right person doesn’t just report on what happened; they help determine what happens next.

This hire is a direct response to our growth: we need someone who can assume full ownership of financial operations. If you’ve thrived in a fast-moving environment and you know what “good” looks like at scale — this is your seat.

Key Responsibilities

• Financial operations ownership: Take over and run all day-to-day finance operations — monthly close, billing, payroll, A/P, A/R, commissions, and cash management.

• FP&A and reporting: Own financial forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis. Prepare investor, board, and management reporting with accuracy and clear financial narratives.

• Accounting oversight: Support and eventually own accounting workflows in coordination with external accounting partners, ensuring compliance and accuracy across all healthcare financial reporting.

• Process design & improvement: Evaluate current workflows in the first 30 days, identify inefficiencies, and implement scalable process improvements within 90 days. You’re not inheriting a polished machine — you’re building one.

• Cross-functional partnership: Work closely with Strategy, Operations and Expansion teams on pricing, gross-margin optimization, unit economics and growth opportunities.

• Strategic support: Serve as a core partner to the Finance Lead and Executive Leadership Team on capital allocation, growth decisions, and financial strategy.

• Technology & tooling: Evaluate, implement, and champion finance tech — including AI-powered tools — to drive operational efficiency and better financial intelligence.

Qualifications

• Healthcare industry background (PACE, value-based care, or health plan experience strongly preferred)

• Experience doing FP&A and accounting together in a single role

• 5–8+ years in finance or related field • Background at a VC- or PE-backed company

• Startup or high-growth environment experience — you’ve built processes in lean settings

• Experience at a scaled or larger company (so you know what “good” looks like)

• Demonstrated ability to own financial operations end-to-end with minimal oversight

• Accounting fluency — you’ve overseen or managed accounting functions, even if not a CPA

• Familiarity with Ramp, Rippling, Sage, or similar finance/accounting platforms

• Strong analytical skills with experience translating data into financial narratives

• Genuine experience with advanced technology and AI tools in finance workflows

• CPA, CFA, or relevant certification preferred

Location

• Remote but must be located in USA

Salary & Benefits

• Salary: $120K - $155K / year

• Equity: may be included as part of team package

• Benefits: Seen Health is proud to offer a robust benefits offering for our employees. In addition to traditional healthcare coverage, we also offer additional benefits to help further your wellness and feeling of being part of the team Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family Life Insurance and Disability Benefits Parental and Caregiver Leave Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized Paid Time Off across holidays, vacation time, personal days, and sick days 401k Plan Personal and professional development, including CME support and career growth opportunities Subscriptions and training on using AI tools including ChatGPT

jobs.description:
Twin Health

At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. Twin Health is the only company applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health.

We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism — drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs — that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives.

Working here

Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. We believe in empowering every Twin to make a meaningful impact for our members, our clients, and each other, while enjoying a supportive, collaborative work environment.

Twin has been recognized not only for our innovation but also for our culture, including: Innovator of the Year by the Employer Health Innovation Roundtable (EHIR), selected to CB Insights’ Digital Health 150, and named one of Newsweek’s Top Most Loved Workplace® .

With more than $100 million raised in recent funding, including a $53 million Series E round in 2025 led by Maj Invest, and a $50 million investment in 2023 led by Temasek, Twin is scaling rapidly across the U.S. and globally. Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world.

Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health.

Opportunity

We are looking for a Client Onboarding & Operations Associate who is a self-starter energized by working with customers and building strong relationships both externally and internally to drive exceptional outcomes for our customers and members. In this role, you will own the entire onboarding and deployment of the Twin program(s) end-to-end. The ability to problem solve, analyze and troubleshoot with strong verbal and written communication skills, tailored to communicate based on the situation and audience in a fast paced environment will be key.

Working with a complex clinical delivery model in a high-growth environment, our Client Onboarding & Operations Associate has to expertly navigate through ambiguity while managing internal and external teams in a highly detail-oriented, organized and structured manner - all while ensuring we deliver on-time and exceed customer expectations. As part of our small and growing team, your input and contributions will be critical to helping Twin continuously improve, optimize and scale our onboarding process.

You should be a highly organized, customer-focused and a resourceful individual. This role will be a great fit for you if you are a doer who is passionate about making a difference, comfortable with ambiguity, and naturally collaborative.

Responsibilities

Drive Client Value

• Establish and maintain highly effective relationships with key stakeholders, executives and the C-suite across small and medium strategic clients and ASO’s

• Develop fluent understanding of Twin Health programs, onboarding processes, growth marketing approach and clinical operations

• Successfully onboard Twin’s program(s) end-to-end across a portfolio of Twin customers, including self-insured employers and ASO’s

• Lead discovery sessions to gain insight into Twin’s customers’ culture, priorities, and goals in order to design tailored solutions that work for their populations

• Provide consultative recommendations to increase member engagement, enhance program results, and optimize overall client satisfaction

• Perform and lead the setup, configuration, and testing of customer instances to ensure proper functionality

• Coordinate internal resources and third parties/vendors for the flawless execution of projects

• Train customers on Twin programs to drive awareness and enrollment

• Analyze customer data pre and post launch to provide actionable insights for internal teams and customers

Deliver Project Management Excellence

• Manage multiple projects simultaneously - setting expectations, managing overall project plan, and managing cross-functional teams to ensure timeliness and launch readiness

• Effectively manage customer stakeholders throughout onboarding, including leading customer meetings, setting and managing expectations, building stakeholder alignment, and managing risks and escalations

• Work with technical partners at the customer (or 3rd parties) to operationalize data access and eligibility file management, including finalizing file/data requirements, setting up file transfer and validation, and ongoing issue resolution

• Prepare, execute and participate in special events held for or hosted by clients

• Prepare slide presentations and reports in a consumable client format that delivers actionable insights post launch

• Manage project expectations through regular meetings, project status reports and maintaining great relationships

• Build out standard onboarding work, templates, playbooks to drive continuous improvement and best practice development in our approach

Lead Cross-functionally

• Assist in managing client issues/escalations and mobilize internal teams such as Client Success & Growth, Client Integration, Clinical Delivery, Product, Member Operations and Business Development, to drive resolution

• Work cross-functionality with teams such as Clinical Delivery, Product, Marketing, Engineering, Billing Operations and Executive teams to ensure client/market feedback is shared for ongoing improvements

• Partner with Client Marketing to develop pre-launch member promotional strategies and toolkits that will increase member engagement, enhance program results, and optimize overall client satisfaction

• Provide input and recommendations for improvements for internal processes to provide efficiency and effectiveness.

• Serve as internal team SME/point person to ensure efficiency and consistency across the onboarding lifecycle

• Assist in driving internal alignment and manage downstream clients with internal cross-functional teams

Qualifications

• 2 - 5 years of onboarding and customer facing experience

• 2 - 5 years of health tech client onboarding and project management experience

• Experience with health benefits, health and wellness, health plans or systems

• Ability to communicate and work across client organizations, engaging on a range of tactical and strategic issues, with senior executives as well as execution teams

• Exceptionally strong project management skills, with demonstrated organizational skills, high attention to detail and ability to balance between thoughtful planning and timely execution

• Ability to manage conflicting priorities and thrive in a fast-paced environment working under time constraints

• Proficiency with Google applications, PM tools, such as InspirePlanner, Monday.com, and MS Project

• Experience working with technical/data partners (internal and external) on data exchange, file specifications, file encryption and transmission and testing

Benefits

Twin has an ambitious vision to empower people to live healthier and happier lives, and to achieve this purpose, we need the very best people to enhance our cutting-edge technology and medical science, deliver the best possible care, and turn our passion into value for our members, clients and investors. We are committed to delivering an outstanding culture and experience for every Twin employee through a company based on the values of passion, talent, and trust. We offer comprehensive benefits and perks in line with these principles, as well as a high level of flexibility for every Twin

• A competitive compensation package in line with leading technology companies

• A remote and accomplished global team

• Opportunity for equity participation

• Unlimited vacation with manager approval

• 16 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for delivering parents; 8 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for non-delivering parents

• 100% Employer sponsored healthcare, dental, and vision for you, and 80% coverage for your family; Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Account options

• 401k retirement savings plan

Salary range for US jobs

US Salary Range

$110,000—$115,000 USD

We have been made aware of fraudulent interview requests being sent using the Twin Health's name. All communications will come from official Twin Health channels and a twinhealth.com email address. We will never ask you to complete a text interview or request financial details during the interview process.

jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer I/II
jobs.description:
Agility’s commercially deployed humanoids operate alongside teams in warehouses, manufacturing facilities, and distribution centers—tackling physically demanding and repetitive tasks while enabling workers to focus on higher-value work. With industry-leading safety standards and years of proven deployment data, we're pioneering a new era of automation that enhances human potential.

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on Robotics Software Engineer to join our Skills team, focused on developing, testing, validating, and integrating robot skills into real customer workflows. In this role, you will operate at the boundary between prototype and production, working directly with our humanoid robot to evaluate performance, root-cause failures, and improve behaviors. You will be hands-on with hardware nearly every day, helping bring new customer workflows online and ensuring existing deployments remain reliable. You will define test plans, execute experiments, and validate that our behaviors meet autonomy and performance requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Develop Behaviors for Humanoid Robots & Integrate into Workflows

• Develop and maintain the core library of production-ready skills that form the foundation of customer workflows.

• Script new skills using behavior trees, state machines, or task planners, defining control flow logic and behavior sequencing.

• Deploy classical as well as modern robotics paradigms to implement robot skills to complete a variety of tasks in target domains

• Build and maintain workflows using the robot’s skill API.

• Prototype new skills and customer use cases to assess their feasibility.

Testing, Validation & Deployment

• Define what “production-ready” means for each skill or workflow and design the test plans and infrastructure to validate it.

• Recreate corner cases from logs and failures into repeatable tests.

• Validate new skills and workflows both in simulation and on hardware before release.

• Travel occasionally (<10%) to customer sites to assist in deployment, perform hands-on validation, and support tuning efforts.

About You

• 2+ years of relevant experience, including research-level and industry experience, preferably applied to mobile manipulation robots

• You have a B.S. or M.S. in Robotics, Computer Science, or a related field.

• You are proficient in Python and write clean code.

• You have experience with Linux systems.

• You are excited about developing physical robot behaviors, not just running simulations. You enjoy getting your hands dirty, iterating on hardware, and watching your work come to life in the field.

• You are curious about how autonomous robots work end-to-end, from low-level control to high-level task planning, and want to help bridge the gap between behavior design and real-world deployment.

• You have a strong sense of ownership and pride in the reliability of your work. You sweat the details and are always looking to eliminate failure modes.

Bonus Qualifications

• Prior experience scripting robot behaviors using state machines, behavior trees, or other control flow logic.

• Understanding of robot manipulation, motion planning, and kinematics (e.g., familiarity with MoveIt framework).

• Exposure to test-driven development, automated regression testing, and CI/CD workflows.

• Experience operating autonomous robots in customer environments or real-world deployments.

Location

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Artificial Intelligence/LLM
jobs.description:
ABOUT BEACON AI

We’re a fast-moving team of aviators, engineers, and operators building an AI platform to make flying safer, more efficient, and more capable. Backed by top investors, we’ve secured a dozen Department of Defense contracts and partnered with major airlines to deliver mission-critical systems. We operate without silos or heavy processes. Small, focused teams own what they build, ship quickly, and learn fast, pushing the boundaries of how humans and AI work together in aviation.



You will ship LLM-powered product features end-to-end. That means designing retrieval and tool-calling flows, writing the services that run them, building evals and guardrails, and watching cost, latency, and quality in production. You’ll partner with the ML/infra teammates on embeddings, indexing, and model hosting, and with the product teammates on user experience and outcomes. We move fast, and we care about reliability in a safety-critical domain.

This role is for senior engineers who can own a feature or service end-to-end (5-8 years experience, including some in production ML/LLM systems). You'll make independent architecture and eval decisions within your service's scope and partner directly with product and infra.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

Build user-facing LLM features

 - Design and implement retrieval-augmented generation and tool-calling flows using frameworks like LangChain or equivalent primitives, where simpler is better.

 - Deliver robust JSON and schema-bound outputs with validation, retries, and fallbacks.

 - Add function calling to integrate with internal tools, search, routing, and data services.

Own the service layer

 - Ship APIs and workers in Python or TypeScript with clear contracts, streaming, and backoff.

 - Add caching, request shaping, prompt templates, and context packing to control latency and cost.

 - Integrate with AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic, or self-hosted endpoints as needed.

Retrieval and data prep

 - Collaborate with infrastructure teammates to develop chunking, embeddings, and indexing capabilities for documents, time series, and multimedia.

 - Choose and tune vector backends such as OpenSearch, pgvector, or Pinecone.

 - Keep knowledge bases fresh with data syncs from S3, Aurora, DynamoDB, and external sources.

Evaluation and quality

 - Create offline evals and golden sets for prompts, retrievers, and tools.

 - Stand up online metrics for task success, hallucination rate, retrieval precision/recall, p95 latency, and cost per request.

 - Run A/B tests and prompt/version rollouts with guardrails and canaries.

Safety, privacy, and compliance

 - Implement content and policy checks, PII detection and redaction, access controls, and auditing.

 - Design human-in-the-loop paths for sensitive actions.

 - Handle aviation data with care and follow internal security standards.

Operate what you build

 - Add tracing, logs, and dashboards for model calls, token usage, errors, and saturation.

 - Debug tricky failures across retrieval, prompts, tools, and providers.


WHAT WILL MAKE YOU SUCCESSFUL

 - Shipped LLM apps: You’ve put LLM features in front of users and improved them with data.

 - Strong builder: Comfortable writing production code, tests, and docs. You keep things simple and observable.

 - RAG and tools depth: You understand embeddings, chunking, vector search tradeoffs, and function calling.

 - Quality mindset: You design evals, define success metrics, and iterate based on evidence.

 - Cost and latency aware: You track p95, hit SLAs, and reduce cost without hurting quality.

 - Clear communicator: You explain tradeoffs and align partners across product, infra, and security.

 - Ownership: You can take a feature from design through production with minimal oversight.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with Bedrock, OpenSearch Serverless, pgvector, Pinecone, or Weaviate.

 - Prompt versioning, guardrails, and provider routing in production.

 - Multimodal work with time series or video.

 - Familiarity with GPU inference, Triton, or TensorRT-LLM.

 - Aviation or other safety-critical domain exposure.

 - DevOps basics for CI/CD, IaC, and secure secrets handling.


EXAMPLE PROBLEMS YOU MIGHT TACKLE IN MONTH ONE

 - Transform an internal knowledge base into a low-latency RAG service, complete with explicit schemas and evaluations.

 - Add tool-calling to automate a repetitive cockpit or ops workflow with guardrails and audit trails.

 - Reduce the cost per request through improved chunking, caching, and prompt refactoring, while maintaining task success rates.

Work Location
This is a hybrid role based in San Carlos, CA, with 3+ days per week onsite and the option to work remotely on remaining days.

Perks & Benefits (Full-Time Employees)

 - Healthcare: 100%* of employee medical premiums covered; 25% for dependents

 - Time Off: 3 weeks PTO plus 13+ paid company holidays

 - 401(k): Offered (no current employer match, but we are committed to enhancing this benefit in the future)

Due to U.S. export control regulations, we can only hire U.S. Persons (U.S. citizens, Green Card holders, lawful permanent residents, or individuals granted asylum or refugee status). We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa transfers. All work must be performed in the United States.


Beacon AI is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. We prohibit harassment or discrimination of any kind in the workplace and comply with all applicable federal, state, and local employment laws.

jobs.title: Director, Membership Planning - Membership Value & LTV
jobs.description:
About Crunchyroll

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

About the role

We're looking for a Director, Membership Value & LTV to help us understand what drives the long-term value of our subscribers and turn those insights into better commercial decisions.

You will connect performance across acquisition, conversion, engagement, retention, and monetization to build a clear view of subscriber and cohort economics. You’ll identify what is driving performance, where we have the biggest opportunities to improve LTV, and help teams prioritize the actions that will have the greatest impact.

Reporting to the VP, Membership Performance, you’ll work across Growth, Lifecycle, Curation, Product, Engineering, Content, Business Development, Finance, CDI (Center for Data and Insights), and Regional teams. This role is for a commercial operator who is highly analytical and deeply understands subscription businesses - someone who can get into the data, form a clear point of view, and influence decisions across the business.

Key Responsibilities

• Build an integrated view of subscriber value across acquisition, conversion, engagement, retention, monetization, and reactivation.

• Understand how acquisition source, offers, markets, content, and subscriber behavior translate into retention, monetization, and long-term value.

• Diagnose changes in LTV, cohort quality, payback, ARPU, churn, retention, and engagement, separating longer-term trends from short-term or one-time effects.

• Identify and prioritize the biggest opportunities to improve subscriber value across acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention, win-back, pricing, payments, and the broader Crunchyroll ecosystem.

• Turn cohort analysis, experimentation, attribution, incrementality, and customer behavior insights into clear recommendations on where we should invest, what we should change, and which opportunities will have the greatest impact.

• Partner with CDI and Finance on the data, definitions, measurement, and analysis needed to answer key business questions and measure initiatives against subscriber value, not just activity or short-term performance.

• Work with Product, Lifecycle, Curation, Content, Business Development, and Regional teams to evaluate opportunities, shape priorities, and understand how content, product capabilities, promotions, pricing, payments, and other experiences affect subscriber economics.

• Lead membership value reviews and give senior leaders a clear point of view on what is happening, why it matters, and what we should do about it.

• Bring learnings into Membership Strategy, Commercial Planning, and functional and regional roadmaps, building a consistent approach to managing subscriber value globally while accounting for differences across markets.

• Build stronger capabilities across the organization in cohort analysis, value measurement, and connecting subscriber behavior to commercial outcomes.

We are considering applicants available to work a hybrid schedule, with three days each week onsite at our Dallas office.

About You

• 12+ years of experience in growth, commercial strategy, membership strategy, or business operations, including significant experience in a direct-to-consumer (DTC) business.

• Demonstrated experience improving subscriber economics across acquisition, engagement, retention, monetization, and lifetime value.

• Strong commercial judgment and analytical fluency - able to get into the data, understand what is driving performance, and turn insights into clear recommendations and actions.

• Deep understanding of subscription metrics and cohort economics, including retention, churn, ARPU, payback, engagement, and LTV.

• Experience using cohort analysis and customer behavior to identify and prioritize opportunities across the subscriber lifecycle.

• Track record of influencing Product, Marketing, Finance, Analytics, and other teams to move from insight to action.

• Strong executive communication skills and sound judgment, including the ability to simplify complex analysis and make clear recommendations.

• Experience in streaming, OTT, digital media, entertainment, gaming, or another consumer subscription business strongly preferred.

• Top-tier consulting or strategy experience and an MBA are pluses.

Why you will love working at Crunchyroll

In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks:

• Receive a great compensation package including salary plus performance bonus earning potential, paid annually.

• Flexible time off policies allowing you to take the time you need to be your whole self.

• Generous medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, and life insurance

• Health Saving Account HSA program

• Health care and dependent care FSA

• 401(k) plan, with employer match

jobs.title: Facility Quality Assurance Manager
jobs.description:
We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!

About the role

Provides overall leadership, ownership, and direction for the Facility Quality Management System (QMS) supporting product quality, food safety, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement. Ensures facility compliance with applicable regulatory, customer, and certification requirements, including FDA 21 CFR requirements, GMPs, HACCP, SQF/GFSI requirements, and internal company standards. Serves as the facility SQF Practitioner and oversees implementation, maintenance, verification, and continuous improvement of food safety and quality programs. Oversees the Quality Assurance Department and promotes a strong food safety culture and accountability throughout facility operations.

• This role is onsite at our Roanoke, Texas location

• Compensation Range: $100,000-$110,000

• PTO: This role offers paid vacation & sick days

• Benefits: Coverage for you as well as your family, company pays 75%

In this role, you will:

• Owns and maintains the facility Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring food safety and quality programs are effectively implemented, maintained, verified, and continuously improved in accordance with applicable FDA 21 CFR requirements, SQF/GFSI requirements, customer requirements, and company standards.

• Serves as the facility SQF Practitioner and maintains the SQF System, including verification activities, program implementation, corrective actions, and continued compliance with certification requirements.

• Leads and participates in Management Review, including evaluation of quality and food safety objectives, KPIs, non-conformances, complaints, audit results, CAPAs, verification activities, and opportunities for continuous improvement.

• Owns and maintains the facility HACCP Program, ensuring hazard analyses, monitoring, verification, validation, corrective actions, and required records remain current and effective. Ensures CCP verification activities are completed and documented as required.

• Oversees facility QA operational controls, including receiving inspections, packaging and label verification, in-process quality checks, and finished product inspections, ensuring products and materials meet approved specifications and established acceptance criteria.

• Reviews and approves Master Manufacturing Records (MMRs), Packaging Batch Records, and completed batch production records, as applicable, to ensure accuracy,completeness, traceability, reconciliation/yield requirements, and compliance with approved procedures and applicable 21 CFR requirements prior to product disposition.

• Oversees the control, investigation, and disposition of nonconforming materials, ingredients, packaging components, work-in-process, and finished products, including holds, deviations, investigations, CAPAs, and corrective action requests.

• Verifies sanitation effectiveness through review of sanitation records, pre-operational inspections, ATP/environmental monitoring results, and other applicable verification activities; ensures identified deficiencies are appropriately corrected and documented.

• Leads and supports SQF/GFSI, FDA/21 CFR, customer, certification, and internal audits, including audit preparation, document readiness, execution, response to findings, corrective actions, and verification of effectiveness.

• Maintains audit and regulatory readiness by ensuring food safety and quality procedures, programs, records, and supporting documentation are current, controlled, complete, accurate, and readily retrievable.

• Reviews food safety and quality records for accuracy, completeness, compliance, and appropriate documentation, ensuring discrepancies are investigated and resolved when required.

• Leads and coordinates traceability exercises and mock recalls, evaluates results against established requirements, documents outcomes, and ensures corrective actions are implemented when deficiencies are identified.

• Reviews new products, processes, specifications, and applicable documentation to ensure food safety, quality, regulatory, and customer requirements are appropriately established and implemented.

• Manages the facility Food Safety and Quality Training Program, including development, implementation, and maintenance of food safety and quality learning plans and the facility training matrix. Ensures required training is assigned based on job responsibilities, completed within established timelines, appropriately documented, and maintained current. Coordinates initial, refresher, and retraining activities and verifies employee competency, as applicable.

• Provides training, coaching, and development to QA personnel and supports the qualification and continued competency of HACCP Team members, Internal Audit Team members, and other personnel with assigned food safety and quality responsibilities.

• Promotes and supports a strong Food Safety Culture through leadership, employee engagement, training, communication, accountability, performance monitoring, and continuous improvement.

• Monitors applicable FDA regulations, SQF/GFSI requirements, and other regulatory or certification changes and ensures relevant facility programs, procedures, and practices are updated as necessary.

• Provides Quality and Food Safety performance metrics, trends, significant issues, and improvement opportunities to facility and Quality leadership and escalates issues that may impact product safety, quality, compliance, or release.

Basic Qualifications:

• Demonstrated knowledge and experience with FDA regulations applicable to food and dietary supplement operations, including 21 CFR Part 111 and applicable Current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMPs).

• SQF Practitioner experience required, with demonstrated knowledge of SQF/GFSI requirements and implementation and maintenance of an SQF System.

• Demonstrated knowledge and practical experience with HACCP programs, including CCP monitoring and verification.

• Experience managing or supporting a facility Quality Management System (QMS), including document control, records review, CAPA, internal audits, management review, traceability, and mock recalls.

• Experience with food safety and quality activities within packaging, labeling, receiving, in-process operations, sanitation verification, and finished product inspection.

• Experience supporting and/or leading regulatory, customer, GFSI/SQF, and internal audits.

• Dietary supplement manufacturing, packaging, or distribution experience.

• Bilingual English/Spanish required, with the ability to communicate effectively in both languages with employees at all levels of the organization.

Education:

• Bachelor’s degree with 7+ years related experience or equivalent combination of education and technical work experience.

• Preferred/Required Certifications: HACCP training/certification, 21 CFR training/certification and SQF Practitioner qualification or demonstrated experience

A bit about us...

At Grüns, we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you.

Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all.

So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious.

What we care about...

Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation.

Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners.

Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most.

Compensation & Perks:

For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.

Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!

jobs.title: Program Security Manager
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Security Team at Anduril is the cornerstone of defense, employing unparalleled security measures and state-of-the-art technology to ensure the protection of our people, assets, operations, and innovations. Given the unique nature of this company, our team supports a host of standard and non-standard taskings integrating physical and digital measures to stay ahead of evolving threats. We also uphold stringent industry and government compliance, creating a secure environment that nurtures the development of cutting-edge defense solutions and ensures Anduril's continued growth and innovation in a complex global landscape.

ABOUT THE JOB

The Program Security Manager will provide embedded security support to a dynamic and robust program. The Program Security Manager must be able to understand and interpret security requirements outlined in 32 CFR Part 117, DoDM 5205.07, ICD-705 and applicable customer-specific security requirements. Must be able to work within a collaborative team environment and take independent action, analyze problems, and provide security focused solutions to Anduril and government personnel.

The position requires a self-motivated candidate able to operate in a dynamic and fast-paced environment, with the ability to quickly establish trust and partnership with the program team. Must be able to leverage expertise with US government security policies, procedures and industry experience as it relates to Industrial & Special Programs.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Provide dedicated program security support on assigned classified contracts. Security support will include personnel and physical security initiatives for program personnel, spaces, and activities.

• Ensure compliance with 32 CFR Part 117, DoDM 5205.07, and applicable customer-specific security requirements as outlined in multiple DD-254s.

• Engage and advise the Contractor Program Manager on security related initiatives by identifying issues that potentially impact business operations.

• Assist in preparation of various security plans, Concept of Operations (CONOPS), as required for the movement, transportation, delivery, storage, and operation of classified information and hardware.

• In conjunction with program requirements, develop and execute a robust and comprehensive security program encompassing multiple security disciplines and efforts.

• In coordination with the government customer and program team, develop and deliver Transportation Security Plans to ensure the secure movement of program material.

• Report and investigate security incidents specific to their assigned program and recommend mitigations to program and security leadership.

• Develops, implements, and administers Operational Security (OPSEC) and Program Protection planning requirements by ensuring compliance with government and company regulations.

• Ability to understand and interpret Security Classification Guidance (SCG) for their assigned program.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• High school diploma and seven years of industrial security-related experience

• Exceptional time management and prioritization skills, with the ability to achieve goals and targets while handling multiple tasks

• Experience with conducting security briefings, debriefings and have the ability to clearly explain security processes and procedures

• Experience implementing multiple security disciplines to include Personnel, Physical, and Operations Security program requirements

• Ability to communicate and interact professionally and courteously both orally and in writing with all levels of employees, management and customers

• Must possess a current U.S. Top Secret security clearance

US Salary Range

$129,000—$171,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Multifamily Fee Compliance Expert
jobs.description:
We’re Changing the PropTech Industry

We’re a profitable, growth-stage company building industry-leading martech and data products for the PropTech space. Our focus is on our category-leading AI and data SaaS products with triple-digit growth rates.

We’re a fully remote team of 100+ spread across the U.S. from coast to coast. We operate on a strict no a**holes policy and are proud to have built a community of highly performant people that take our work seriously, but not ourselves. And, we're looking for exceptional people to help further accelerate our growth.

While we’ve raised $30MM+ to date from some of the world’s best investors, we’re profitable with a strong balance sheet and an indefinite runway. We pride ourselves on achieving rapid growth without having to incinerate capital.

About Our Products

ApartmentIQ is the all-in-one data platform powering smarter decisions across multifamily—covering 40M units with daily property and market intelligence used for surveys, research, and revenue management. We're trusted by 65% of the NMHC Top 50. Our sister company, MavenAI, delivers AI-powered marketing automation built by industry experts and integrated directly with property management systems, serving over 2M units.

The role

ApartmentIQ is hiring a Solutions Consultant to lead our work with multifamily operators on fee transparency and compliance. This person brings hands-on experience with how apartment fees are set, marketed and reviewed, and uses it to help customers advertise fees accurately and consistently across every channel.

Fee regulation in rental housing is evolving quickly, and operators need a clear view of how their fees appear to renters. In this role, you'll lead customer demonstrations, serve as the subject-matter expert in sales conversations, and research regulatory requirements that shape our product.

What you'll do

• Deliver product demonstrations to property management companies, owners and REITs, from regional operators to national portfolios.

• Prepare prospect-specific analyses of live fee data ahead of each meeting.

• Partner with Account Executives on active opportunities, engaging marketing, operations, revenue management and legal stakeholders.

• Address compliance questions and objections using approved positioning, coordinating with the customer's legal team where appropriate.

• Support Customer Success on renewals and expansions as customers enter new markets.

• Monitor federal, state and local developments affecting rental fee advertising and leasing.

• Translate new requirements into clear, concise specifications that guide product development.

• Maintain a jurisdiction-by-jurisdiction reference of applicable requirements and effective dates.

• Develop educational content for Sales and Marketing, including guides, one-pagers and webinars, and represent ApartmentIQ at industry events.

• Share customer feedback and unmet needs with the product team.

Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in multifamily with a property management company, owner-operator or REIT.

• Direct experience with apartment fees in one of the following areas:

• Legal: paralegal or compliance role supporting leases, fee schedules, advertising review or consumer-protection matters.

• Marketing: marketing, ILS or pricing role responsible for how rent and fees are presented on property websites and listing sites.

• Working knowledge of fee disclosure practices, including mandatory, optional and conditional fees.

• Strong research and analytical skills, with the ability to distill complex requirements into clear written guidance.

• Confident presenting to executive audiences and responding to detailed questions.

Nice to have

• Paralegal certificate, JD or compliance credential.

• Pre-sales, solutions consulting or other customer-facing SaaS experience.

• Established relationships across apartment industry associations.

• Experience supporting multi-state portfolios.

Why Choose Us

• Remote-First: We offer the freedom to work from home across most of the U.S. You’ll enjoy the flexibility of remote work, balanced with high-energy in-person offsites to build real connections and celebrate our wins together.

• Competitive Compensation: We believe in hiring the best and paying accordingly. You’ll receive a competitive salary that reflects your impact and expertise.

• Paid Time Off: Take the time you need with our flexible vacation policy and dedicated paid parental leave to support you and your family’s biggest milestones.

• Your Health Matters: Stay healthy with high-quality Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance plans for you and your family.

• Peace of Mind (On Us): We fully invest in your security with 100% company-paid Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, and Basic Life Insurance.

• Protection for Your Whole Crew: Access supplemental insurance for the unexpected, plus specialized coverage to keep your pets happy and healthy, too.

• Invest in Your Future: Secure your financial goals with our 401k Program, helping you build for the long term while you help us build the company.

If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation in the application or recruiting process, please contact your recruiter.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

We want to alert you to potential recruiting scams targeting job seekers. Please note that our company will never request payment, personal information, or any confidential details during the interview process.

We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.






ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re looking for an Analytics Engineer to join the team. In this role you will help lay the foundation for business teams to diagnose issues, uncover opportunities, and drive success using data. If you enjoy building data infrastructure and empowering teams with actionable insights, this role is for you. 




WHAT YOU WILL DO:
