jobs.title: Night Shift Monitoring Supervisor
jobs.description:
The Night Shift Monitoring Supervisor leads the overnight Command Center monitoring team and is accountable for safe, consistent, and responsive operations throughout the shift. This role directs real-time shipment monitoring, prioritizes alerts, coordinates incident response, and ensures timely escalation of service issues and security events. The supervisor assigns work, maintains shift coverage, coaches team members, confirms adherence to customer requirements and standard operating procedures, and provides a complete handoff to the incoming shift. When activity or risk levels require it, the supervisor works directly alongside monitoring specialists to protect service continuity and customer confidence.

The ideal candidate is a calm, decisive people leader with strong situational awareness, sound judgment, and exceptional attention to detail. The candidate understands logistics operations, shipment-risk monitoring, customer service expectations, and the importance of accurate documentation. They must be able to interpret multiple data sources, distinguish routine exceptions from urgent events, communicate clearly under pressure, and sustain team focus during overnight hours. Above all, the candidate models Cargo Signal’s culture, maintains high standards of accountability, and develops team members to deliver reliable operational outcomes.

Shift Leadership & Team Development

• Shift Direction: Lead the night shift, set priorities at the start of the shift, assign monitoring responsibilities, and adjust coverage as shipment activity and risk levels change.
• Team Engagement: Maintain a focused, respectful, and inclusive overnight work environment that supports accountability, collaboration, and employee well-being.
• Issue Documentation: Accurately document attendance, conduct, performance, and operational concerns and coordinate follow-up with Command Center management when required.
• Escalation Leadership: Serve as the first point of supervisory escalation during the night shift and engage on-call leadership or other stakeholders according to established protocols.

Monitoring Operations & Incident Response

• Real-Time Monitoring: Oversee active shipment monitoring and ensure alerts, exceptions, and customer-specific requirements are reviewed and acted upon within established response times.
• Incident Triage: Assess potential theft, route deviation, prolonged stop, sensor, geofence, temperature, connectivity, and other operational exceptions; determine urgency and direct the appropriate response.
• Critical Escalations: Coordinate notifications to customers, service providers, security contacts, branches, and on-call leaders in accordance with escalation procedures.
• Operational Support: Work directly in monitoring queues during high-volume periods, critical incidents, or staffing shortages to maintain service continuity.
• Quality Control: Review monitoring actions, case notes, communications, and closure decisions for accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and compliance.
• System Oversight: Monitor the availability and effective use of Cargo Signal systems, Microsoft tools, communication channels, and customer platforms; report or escalate outages promptly.

Shift Execution & Continuous Improvement

• Workload Prioritization: Balance customer commitments, shipment risk, alert severity, and available staffing to direct the team’s work throughout the shift.
• Procedure Compliance: Ensure the team follows customer playbooks, standard operating procedures, communication standards, data-handling requirements, and internal policies.
• Shift Reporting: Prepare concise and accurate summaries of critical events, open risks, unresolved alerts, staffing issues, system problems, and required follow-up.
• Shift Handoff: Conduct a structured handoff to the incoming supervisor or lead, clearly transferring ownership of active incidents, high-risk shipments, and pending actions.
• Root-Cause Review: Identify recurring errors, missed alerts, process gaps, and avoidable escalation delays; recommend corrective actions to Command Center management.
• Process Improvement: Contribute practical ideas that improve monitoring quality, response time, documentation, customer experience, and overnight team efficiency.
• Readiness: Keep current on customer requirements, active risk conditions, procedural updates, and lessons learned from recent incidents.

Qualifications

• Personal and professional alignment with Cargo Signal culture and critical success factors.
• Demonstrated experience leading or coordinating an operations, monitoring, security, logistics, or customer service team.
• Ability to work a consistent night-shift schedule, including weekends and holidays as assigned.
• Strong judgment and composure when responding to urgent, ambiguous, or high-impact situations.
• Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple alerts, shipments, and communication channels simultaneously.
• Clear verbal and written communication skills, including concise incident documentation and shift handoffs.
• Proven customer service skills and the ability to coordinate effectively with internal teams, customers, and external service providers.
• Experience with logistics, shipment visibility, security monitoring, or business operations preferred.
• Working proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications and the ability to learn monitoring and customer platforms quickly.
• Strong coaching, organization, problem-solving, and accountability skills.

What We Offer

• A stable and professional working environment aligned with international standards
• Clear role definition and structured onboarding
• Exposure to reputable clients and cross-functional collaboration
• Opportunities for long-term career development in account management
• Competitive compensation package aligned with market standard

jobs.description:
About NORY
NORY is a leading STEM camp provider in NYC and Boston, serving over 6,000 children annually through immersive, hands-on learning. We help children ages 3-12 develop resilience, inquisitiveness, and empathy through building, experimenting, and solving meaningful problems. Learn more at nory.co http://nory.co.

The Role
We are seeking a hands-on marketing specialist with demonstrated expertise in Google Ads, Meta Ads, and SEO to grow paid registrations for NORY’s camps and enrichment programs.
You will personally manage advertising campaigns, improve organic search visibility, and connect marketing performance to actual registrations and revenue. We need someone who can explain their decisions, diagnose underperformance, and demonstrate results from work they directly owned.
Experience creating social content, boosting posts, or building AI marketing automations alone does not meet this role’s requirements.

Position Details

 - Compensation: $25–$40 per hour, based on demonstrated experience and results.

 - Hours: 5-20 hours per week.

Location: Remote.

What You’ll Own
Google Ads

 - Build, manage, and optimize campaigns that reach families actively searching for camps and enrichment programs.

 - Refine keywords, search terms, negative keywords, bidding, geographic targeting, and budget allocation.

 - Test ad copy and landing pages to improve completed registrations and acquisition efficiency.

Meta Ads

 - Build and optimize Facebook and Instagram campaigns directly in Meta Ads Manager.

 - Develop and test audiences, creative concepts, messaging, and offers.

 - Write ad copy and provide clear creative briefs to NORY’s content team, using results to guide the next round of tests.

SEO

 - Develop a prioritized SEO plan around relevant searches for summer camps, holiday camps, after-school programs, and local enrollment opportunities.

 - Conduct keyword research based on search intent and business value.

 - Improve program and location pages, including titles, headings, content, and internal linking.

 - Use Google Search Console and analytics to identify opportunities and diagnose performance changes.

 - Identify technical issues affecting crawling, indexing, and website usability; implement improvements within your access and coordinate changes requiring developer support.

 - Improve local search visibility through accurate business information and relevant location content.

 - Measure organic search performance through qualified traffic, inquiries, and registrations.

Measurement & Optimization

 - Validate conversion tracking across advertising platforms, analytics, and the registration process.

 - Reconcile platform-reported conversions with actual registrations and revenue, explaining attribution limitations and discrepancies.

 - Allocate advertising spend based on program timing, location, enrollment priorities, and remaining capacity.

 - Identify whether weak results stem from targeting, creative, landing pages, tracking, or registration friction.

 - Provide concise weekly reporting: results, changes made, lessons learned, and next actions.


Required Qualifications

 - Demonstrated hands-on experience managing both Google Ads and Meta Ads, including campaign setup, optimization, and budget decisions.

 - Proven SEO experience with specific examples of work performed and measurable outcomes.

 - Working proficiency in Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console, plus experience implementing or troubleshooting conversion tracking.

 - Strong analytical judgment: you can explain why performance changed and what evidence supports your next decision.

 - Ability to connect marketing activity to customer acquisition and revenue.

 - Clear communication, reliable follow-through, and ownership of results.

Experience with local consumer services, family programs, education, or seasonal businesses is preferred. Prior NYC parenting-market experience is helpful but not required.
AI tools and platform certifications are welcome; demonstrated execution and sound judgment carry more weight.

How We Work
We lead with purpose, use data to inform decisions, investigate root causes, and take responsibility for outcomes. We value thoughtful experimentation, honest reporting, constructive feedback, and care for the families and teammates we serve.
Explore our Ways of Being https://www.nory.co/value.

How to Apply
Email peter@nory.co with the subject:
Paid Ads & SEO Specialist Application - [Your Name]
Include:

 1. Your resume.

 2. Two brief paid campaign examples: one Google Ads campaign and one Meta Ads campaign you personally managed. Include dates, spend, objective, conversion definition, results, your exact responsibilities, and a specific optimization you made.

Concise examples are welcome; polished presentations are unnecessary. Anonymized examples and redacted supporting evidence are acceptable. Please respect client confidentiality.
Finalists will be asked to explain campaign decisions and diagnose a sample performance problem during a live discussion.

NORY, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

jobs.title: Staff Brand Designer
jobs.location: New York City, NY (Hybrid); San Francisco, CA (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
About Snorkel

Snorkel AI is the frontier AI data lab, helping teams build the data and environments behind high-performing frontier and agentic AI. We combine technology with research-driven AI data development to create datasets, benchmarks, evals, and custom solutions for real-world AI systems. Founded out of the Stanford AI Lab in 2019, Snorkel works with leading AI labs and enterprises to move from better data to better outcomes.

Excited to help us redefine how AI is built? Apply to be the newest Snorkeler!

About the Team

Snorkel's Marketing team shapes how the AI industry understands frontier data development. We're a team spanning brand, content, communications, product marketing, growth, community, and events, and we work directly with our founders and research team to turn original research into market-defining stories. Brand sits at the center of that work: it's how a data research lab earns attention from frontier labs, Fortune 500 enterprises, top researchers, and the domain experts who contribute to our work.

About the Role

We're hiring a Staff Brand Designer to own the evolution of Snorkel's brand identity. Snorkel has changed faster than its brand has. You'll close that gap: defining where the visual identity goes next, building the system that carries it, and making sure every surface, from the website to a NeurIPS booth to a benchmark leaderboard, looks like it came from the most rigorous lab in AI.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with real leverage and autonomy. You'll be hands-on in the work, and you'll also manage our design agency and a bench of freelance contractors, setting direction, reviewing work, and holding a high bar across everything they ship. This role reports to the CMO.

Responsibilities

• Own the brand identity. Lead the next evolution of Snorkel's visual identity, including logo system, typography, color, illustration, iconography, data visualization, motion, and photography direction.

• Build and govern the brand system. Create and maintain brand guidelines, Figma libraries, templates, and design artifacts that let marketing, sales, research, and recruiting produce on-brand work without a designer in the loop.

• Manage our design agency and contractors. Brief, set creative direction, run reviews, and own quality, scope, timelines, and budget across agency and freelance partners. Decide what gets built in-house versus outsourced, and build the contractor bench as needs grow.

• Design high-visibility launches. Lead creative for major moments, including funding and company announcements, research and benchmark launches, flagship events like our Frontier Data Summit, and conference presence at NeurIPS and other AI venues.

• Make research legible and beautiful. Develop a distinctive visual language for technical content: benchmark results, charts, diagrams, papers, leaderboards, and research blog posts. Partner with researchers so our ideas are as clear visually as they are rigorous.

• Raise the bar across surfaces. Partner with web, content, and product marketing on the website, campaigns, social, sales decks, and event experiences so the brand holds together end to end.

• Set the design operating model. Establish intake, prioritization, review, and approval processes, and introduce AI-assisted design workflows where they make the team faster without lowering quality.

About You

You've shaped a brand. You have strong opinions about craft and can defend them to a founder, a researcher, or an agency creative director – yet you maintain flexibility with letting the brand organically evolve in a dynamic space like AI. You're as comfortable redesigning a logo system as you are giving precise, actionable feedback. You're drawn to technical subject matter and see explaining complex ideas visually as a design problem worth solving. You move fast, you own outcomes, and you raise the standard of everyone you work with.

Requirements

• 8+ years of brand or visual design experience, including in-house brand design at a high-growth technology company.

• A portfolio showing identity or rebrand work you led end to end, plus a broad range of applications: web, campaigns, events, videos, and data visualization.

• Proven experience directing external design agencies and freelancers, including writing briefs, managing scope and budget, and holding partners to a high quality bar.

• Expert craft in typography, layout, color, and composition, with a clear point of view on where brand design for AI is heading

• Deep fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite, and experience building scalable design systems and brand guidelines others actually use.

• Track record leading ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives, influencing senior stakeholders, and making decisions without close oversight.

• Comfort translating technical and research content into clear, compelling visuals.

Bonus

• Experience at an AI, developer tools, or research-driven company.

• Hands-on use of generative AI tools in your design workflow.

jobs.title: Mechanical Simulation Engineer
jobs.description:
About SK hynix America:

At SK hynix America, we are at the forefront of semiconductor innovation. As a global leader in HBM, DRAM, and NAND flash technologies, we develop the advanced memory solutions powering everything from advanced mobile technology to massive AI data centers. With major investments in the U.S. and a leading position in the global AI revolution, we build the critical infrastructure of the digital landscape and remain committed to sustainable operations. We invite innovative minds to be part of our journey. Here, you will be part of a collaborative team pioneering the next generation of memory technologies, expanding our market footprint, and defining the future of computing.

Work Model: Onsite

Job Overview:

SK hynix America is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Mechanical Simulation Engineer to join our Advanced Packaging (PKG) R&D team. In this role, you will be at the forefront of semiconductor innovation, driving the mechanical integrity of next-generation packaging solutions (e.g., HBM, 2.5D/3D Heterogeneous Integration). You will utilize advanced numerical methods to predict and optimize the thermos-mechanical behavior of complex IC packages, ensuring high performance and structural robustness. Additionally, you will bridge the gap between package-level integrity and system-level performance, ensuring our packaging solutions are robustly integrated into data center rack architectures and consumer systems.

Responsibilities:

• Advanced FEA Modeling: Develop high-fidelity, non-linear Finite Element Analysis (FEA) models to characterize stress, strain, and warpage behavior in advanced semiconductor packages during assembly processes and reliability tests.

• Multi-Physics Analysis: Perform complex thermo-mechanical multi-physics simulations to evaluate the impact of thermal gradients on structural integrity and fatigue life.

• Design Optimization: Partner closely with package designers and process engineers to provide simulation-driven design directions, optimizing architectures for warpage control, solder joint reliability, and interfacial adhesion.

• Material Characterization: Define and implement material constitutive models (elastic, plastic, viscoelastic, etc.) for various packaging materials (EMC, Substrate, Silicon, TIM) and correlate simulation results with empirical data (e.g., Shadow Moire, DIC).

• Failure Analysis & Reliability: Predict potential failure modes (delamination, cracking, bump fatigue) and develop mitigation strategies to meet stringent industry reliability standards.

• Methodology Development: Establish and document standardized simulation workflows, advanced meshing techniques, and automation scripts to enhance simulation accuracy and throughput.

• Cross-functional Collaboration: Present technical findings and simulation-based risks to internal stakeholders and global R&D teams to influence product roadmaps and manufacturing process specs.

• System-Level Interaction Analysis: Evaluate the thermo-mechanical interactions between advanced packages and board/system-level components (e.g., Motherboard, Rack, Cooling systems), mapping system-level boundary conditions down to the package level.

Qualifications:

• Master’s degree or higher in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related field. Candidates with relevant industry experience are preferred

• Core Expertise: Deep understanding of solid mechanics, heat transfer, and strength of materials, specifically applied to semiconductor packaging.

• Simulation Tools: Extensive experience with commercial FEA software such as ABAQUS (preferred), ANSYS Mechanical, or LS-DYNA.

• Technical Knowledge: Proven knowledge of semiconductor packaging structures (Flip-chip, WLCSP, 2.5D/3D IC) and the physics of failure in electronic assemblies.

• Analytical Skills: Ability to interpret complex simulation data and translate it into actionable engineering recommendations.

• System-Level Insight: Experience or strong knowledge in mechanical simulation/testing at the system or set level, with preferred exposure to data center rack architectures, desktop form factors, or enterprise-level hardware systems.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience in Multi-scale modeling (from micro-scale TSV/micro Bumps to macro-scale Package/PCB).

• Strong scripting skills in Python to automate Abaqus workflows, including pre-processing, job submission, and customized post-processing/data extraction.

• Proficiency in statistical analysis and DOE (Design of Experiments) using tools such as JMP or Minitab to interpret simulation and experiment data.

• Knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing processes (Reflow, Molding, Bonding) and their impact on residual stress.

• Experience with CAD software (NX, Solidworks, or AutoCAD) for geometry preparation and cleaning.

• Excellent communication skills to collaborate effectively within a multidisciplinary, global R&D environment.

Benefits:

• Top Tier health insurance at no employee cost

• Paid day offs: Paid Time Off, Company Holidays, Parental Leave, Happy Fridays

• 401k Matching

• Flexible Spending Account (FSA) for Health Care & Dependent Care

• Educational reimbursement up to $10,000 per year

• Donation Matching and volunteering opportunities

• Corporate discount programs

• Free Breakfast/Lunch/Dinner provided to employees

Compensation:

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several U.S. geographic markets, and we pay differently based on those defined markets. Pay within the provided range varies by work location and may also depend on job-related skills and experience. Your Recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the job location during the hiring process.

Pay Range

$105,000—$160,000 USD

SK hynix America is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender identity, national origin, color, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws.

jobs.title: Specialty Pharmacist - Kirkland, WA
jobs.description:

jobs.description:
Company Overview (Who are we? Why should you join us?)

At ecoATM the proof of our success is in our staggering growth, extraordinary impact on protecting the planet, and providing a work culture unlike any other. We are a technology company and a pioneer of device re-commerce. Through our 7,000 automated kiosks and online marketplace Gazelle.com, we enable people all over the world to join the mobile device re-use revolution, a revolution that will get billions of used smartphones out of the e-waste cycle and into the hands of people who don’t have affordable access to the empowerment of the latest mobile technology.

At ecoATM we know our employees are our greatest strength and the key to our continued growth and success. When you join our team, you will enjoy more than just a job, you will be empowered to develop and utilize your unique talents and skills to build a rewarding career while making a lasting, positive impact on the planet.

Our Values and Leadership Behaviors

About the Role

Must be Local to the Chicago Metro Area

The In-Store Representative (ISR) manages the performance of ecoATM kiosks across a local territory of retail partner locations. You'll own the full kiosk experience — from building relationships with store management and ensuring machines run smoothly, to educating store staff, assisting customers, and serving as the face of the ecoATM brand in the field.

Kiosk Operations & Maintenance

• Build and maintain positive relationships with store and location management through training, awareness building, and proactive problem-solving to ensure site compliance and maximize kiosk profitability.

• Serve as the first point of contact at new locations — introducing ecoATM, explaining the value of hosting our kiosks, documenting placements, and escalating any issues to internal teams.

• Communicate placement issues, concerns, and recommendations to key account management and ISR leadership.

Customer Experience

• Engage with and assist ecoATM customers directly at kiosks; report customer issues and concerns to internal teams.

• Act as the "voice of the customer," sharing observations about customer experiences and impressions with internal teams.

• Participate in customer engagement events at stores or other locations as directed.

Planning & Safety

Education & Experience

• High School Diploma or equivalent required.

• 4+ years of customer-facing sales or customer service experience required.

• Hands-on experience with tools and troubleshooting mechanical issues.

• Wireless or technology retail experience is a plus.

Skills & Abilities

• Self-motivated and reliable, with strong communication, time management, and organizational skills; able to work independently with minimal supervision.

• Superior customer service skills with the ability to communicate effectively across customers, store management, technical support, and company leadership.

• Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting ability.

• Basic to intermediate understanding of computers and consumer electronics, including familiarity with technical terminology and software systems.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Outlook, Word, Teams, PowerPoint).

• Must own a smartphone.

• Valid driver's license (Real ID compliant), clean 3-year driving record, and adequately insured, registered, and reliable personal vehicle required.

• Must pass criminal background and motor vehicle record checks; subject to ongoing MVR monitoring.

Schedule

Travel

Location

jobs.title: Lead School Behavior Technician
jobs.description:
Cortica is looking for a Lead Behavior Technician – School Based Support to join its growing team!

The Lead School Behavior Technician provides direct behavior-analytic services to students with autism spectrum disorder and other neurodevelopmental differences in school settings. In addition to delivering direct student support, the Lead BT serves as the direct supervisor, providing administrative support and performance management for School Behavior Technicians, modeling best practices and offering guidance in the implementation of behavior intervention strategies. This role is essential in ensuring consistent, high-quality, neurodiversity-affirming support for students and school teams.

We are a rapidly growing healthcare company pioneering the most effective treatment methods for children with neurodevelopmental differences. Our mission is to design and deliver life-changing care – one child, one family, one community at a time. Ultimately, we envision a world that cultivates the full potential of every child. At Cortica, every team member is instrumental in helping us achieve our mission.

Our culture and values guide how we work and treat one another. Cortica celebrates diversity and fosters an inclusive environment, seeking ideas and opinions from everyone on the team. We safeguard equal rights and respect for all individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, creed, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, ancestry, veteran status or other applicable, legally protected characteristics. All Cortica employment decisions are made based on an individual’s qualifications and ability to successfully perform the job responsibilities.

What will you do?

• Provide direct implementation of behavior-analytic services to students in one-on-one and group settings within school environments.

• Lead by example in implementing individualized behavior intervention plans (BIPs) and skill acquisition programs aligned with students’ IEPs and educational goals.

• Support and mentor school-based BTs by modeling strategies, answering questions, and troubleshooting implementation challenges.

• Substitute in schools as needed to ensure continuity of services and provide high-quality support in the absence of assigned BTs.

• Collaborate with Behavior Analysts, educators, and school teams to integrate behavioral strategies into classroom routines.

• Support students' growth in communication, social interaction, emotional regulation, and adaptive skills as appropriate to the school setting.

• Utilize a strengths-based, neurodiversity-affirming approach to service delivery.

• Collect and review data to monitor student progress and support BTs in accurate data collection practices.

• Provide feedback and coaching to BTs as delegated by supervising Board Certified Behavior Analysts BCBAs).

• Participate in classroom observations, team meetings, and school-based training sessions; help facilitate training for new BTs.

• Demonstrate professionalism, flexibility, and leadership in dynamic school environments. Oversee the day-to-day administrative supervision of school behavior technicians (SBTs) in the areas of performance management, nonclinical administration, clinical accountability, leave of absence and workplace accommodations support, workers’ compensation case support, separation of employment, and time and schedule management.

• Complete daily administration of SBT time off management, SBT callout management in conjunction with scheduling department, approval of additional indirect time, approval and review of SBT serious incident reports (SIRs), SBT availability changes.

• Complete and/or assist with audits for administrative or indirect time (weekly), meal and rest break penalties – California only (per pay period), unconverted sessions (weekly). Report findings to ABA site manager and work with SBTs to rectify any discrepancies.

• Ensure SBTs have completed all compliance requirements, including required clinical training through collaboration with the site’s lead behavior technician trainers (LBTs). Responsible for ensuring that all SBTs meet compliance standards.

• Responsible for the performance management of SBTs by providing and documenting timely feedback, including synthesizing clinical feedback through collaboration with the Director of School Operations.

• Effectively manage and navigate electronic medical record (EMR) systems and Microsoft Office products to ensure accurate documentation, reporting, and communication.

• Maintain accurate and timely documentation, including session notes, incident reports, and mentoring logs as assigned.

• Adhere to all school safety protocols, including proactive behavior supports, de-escalation techniques, and mandated reporting.

• Demonstrate professionalism, flexibility, and leadership in dynamic school environments.

• Travel between school sites within the designated service area.

We’d love to hear from you if:

• You bring 1+ years of experience leading and managing direct reports.

• You bring 1+ years of experience providing ABA services in school or clinical settings.

• You can obtain assigned safety training certification within 30 days of employment.

• You can obtain and maintain Board Certified Autism Technician (BCAT) or Registered Behavior Technician (RBT) credential within 30 days of employment, where required by the district.

• You can maintain reliable transportation and travel between work sites.

jobs.description:
Please Note:

To provide the best candidate experience amidst our high application volumes, each candidate is limited to 10 applications across all open jobs within a 6-month period.

Advancing the World’s Technology Together

Our technology solutions power the tools you use every day--including smartphones, electric vehicles, hyperscale data centers, IoT devices, and so much more. Here, you’ll have an opportunity to be part of a global leader whose innovative designs are pushing the boundaries of what’s possible and powering the future.

To achieve this goal, we collaborate closely with both hardware and software engineers to identify and address the unique challenges posed by AI/ML workloads and to explore new computing abstractions that can provide a better balance between the hardware and software components of our systems. Additionally, we continuously conduct research and development in emerging technologies and trends across memory, computing, interconnect, and AI/ML, ensuring that our platforms are always equipped to handle the most demanding workloads of the future. By working together as a dedicated and passionate team, we aim to revolutionize the way AI/ML applications are deployed and executed, ultimately contributing to the advancement of AGI in an affordable and sustainable manner. Join us in our passion to shape the future of computing!

Location:  Daily onsite presence at our San Jose, CA office / U.S. headquarters in alignment with our Flexible Work policy.

What You’ll Do

• Develop and maintain highly interactive, large-scale and complex web-based visual analytics tools on AI/ML workloads.

• Build interactive data visualization (flame graphs, call trees, timeline charts) capable of fluidly rendering massive, multi-dimensional infrastructure telemetry datasets.

• Partner closely with compiler engineers and hardware architects to translate highly complex performance profiling metrics into clear, intuitive developer workflows.

• Complete other responsibilities as assigned.

• Abundant experience designing and implementing rich, interactive data visualizations and user interfaces using modern web technologies.

• Strong background or interest in creating developer tools, IDE extensions, or complex diagnostic dashboards.

• Strong track record of designing workflows specifically for technical users (software engineers, data scientists, or researchers), focusing on minimizing cognitive load and streamlining root-cause diagnosis.

• Hands-on experience with, or a strong curiosity about, systems profiling and tracing tools (e.g., Perfetto, Chrome Tracing, NVIDIA Nsight Systems/Compute, PyTorch Profiler, TensorBoard, eBPF).

• You’re collaborative, building relationships, humbly offering support and openly welcoming approaches.

jobs.title: Tech Lead, Machine Learning: Element Classification
jobs.description:
About Teleskope

Teleskope is redefining data security for the AI era with the only dedicated platform that combines precise visibility with automated remediation. Teleskope continuously scans, catalogs and classifies data in-motion and at-rest while automating policy-based actions, helping organizations proactively manage data sprawl while securely enabling AI adoption.

Following our $25 million Series A round, Teleskope is entering a high-growth phase backed by top-tier investors and exceptional product-market fit.

About the role

We're hiring a Tech Lead to own the technical direction of our element classification system, the engine that powers every customer workflow on the platform. You'll lead the engineers and data scientists building entity classification across text, documents, relational data, and OCR. You'll set the roadmap, decide where the pipeline needs to improve, and make sure our methods stay at the state of the art.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll split your time between setting direction for the team and doing the hardest technical work yourself. You'll report to the Director of Data Science and ML and work closely with annotation, QC, engineering, and product.

This is a hybrid role requiring 3+ days in-office in New York City.

What You'll Do:

 - Own the element classification roadmap: set priorities, sequence the work, and align the team and stakeholders on tradeoffs.

 - Lead the team's technical work: break large problems into scoped projects, assign and unblock work, review designs and code, and hold a high bar for quality.

 - Own evaluation strategy: build benchmarks, regression suites, and production monitoring that show where the pipeline is failing and why, so the team focuses on the gaps that matter.

 - Track new work in NLP, LLMs, and information extraction, and decide what to adopt. Run focused experiments and take the winners to production.

 - Set the standard for data quality: refine labeling guidelines, work with annotators and qc teams on label quality, and build training and eval sets that reflect real world problems.

 - Run delivery with checkpointed milestones, and keep leadership and cross-functional partners updated on progress, risks, and decisions.

 - Set engineering practices for model deployment, versioning, CI/CD, and operational monitoring.

 - Mentor and grow the team, and help with hiring as the team scales.

About you:

 - 6+ years building and deploying ML systems in production, including 1+ year as a tech lead or in a similar role guiding the technical work of others.

 - Deep experience with NLP, especially NER, entity classification, or information extraction.

 - Strong instincts for evaluation: you can build test sets that predict real-world performance and diagnose failures from metrics.

 - Hands-on experience curating datasets, including annotation guidelines, label quality control, and synthetic or weakly supervised data.

 - Up to date on current methods (LLMs, distillation, efficient inference) and able to judge them critically.

 - Still writes production code: comfortable taking work from research prototype to CI/CD and production pipelines in Python with modern ML tooling.

 - Turns ambiguity into a plan the team can execute, and communicates progress honestly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 - Leads through influence and makes the people around you better.

What you'll get:

 - Technical ownership of the system behind the core of our product.

 - A team to lead and a direct hand in shaping how ML is built at Teleskope.

 - A beautiful, well-stocked office in NYC’s Financial District.

 - Flexible vacation and work from home days.

 - Competitive salary and meaningful equity.

 - Health, vision, dental, 401k and more benefits, heavily subsidized by Teleskope.

What We Value:

At Teleskope, we value strong engineers who build real systems. We look for people who combine ML depth with pragmatic execution, take ownership of critical infrastructure, and ship reliable solutions that deliver real security and privacy outcomes.

jobs.title: Product Research Lead
jobs.description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About the role

Running a company changes with scale. At a small business, one person may handle payroll, onboarding, and IT. In the mid-market, those jobs become handoffs across teams and systems. At enterprise scale, policies, entities, and exceptions multiply. AI raises a new question across all three: which parts of the work can software take on, and where do people need to stay in control?

Product Research works before decisions are made. As Product Research Lead, you will help shape Rippling’s point of view on where the product should go next, across new products, categories, customer segments, and AI-native ways of working.

Your scope will include foundational HR systems and the realities of hourly and complex workforces. The questions will often be broad, the product direction unresolved, and the implications larger than a single feature or team.

This is a lead-level individual contributor role. You will personally lead research, develop a grounded point of view, and write for product and company leaders. You will work with product, design, engineering, and data partners to help teams choose a direction and understand the evidence behind it. This is a strategic role for someone who wants to influence company direction, define emerging product opportunities, and help determine how AI will reshape the way businesses operate.

What you will do

• Frame important questions before a solution or roadmap is defined, then design research that can change the decision.
• Learn how companies actually operate: the people, systems, rules, incentives, and workarounds behind a customer need.
• Find and recruit the people best positioned to answer or challenge the question, including participants who are hard to reach. Use sourcing and screening to learn about the market.
• Conduct rigorous qualitative research and combine it with behavioral data, market evidence, competitive context, and product knowledge when the question calls for it.
• Find patterns in messy evidence, test your interpretation against exceptions, and explain what you know, what remains uncertain, and why it matters.
• Identify which jobs matter enough for customers to change their behavior or adopt a new product. Translate that understanding into choices about which customer to serve, what opportunity to pursue, and what must be true for a solution to work.
• Write and present a clear main judgment for the audience and decision at hand. Show what you mean through concrete customer behavior, with deeper evidence ready when needed.
• Build trust with partners, challenge assumptions constructively, and stay involved as research becomes product direction.
• Strengthen the team's research practice through mentorship, critique, hiring, and your own work.

What you will need

• A record of applied research on complex products, services, or organizations, including work that influenced product direction before the solution was settled. Experience with B2B software or business operations is especially relevant.
• Strong qualitative research skills and sound judgment about when quantitative, behavioral, market, or competitive evidence would strengthen the answer.
• Inductive and systems thinking: you can move from specific observations to a useful explanation while accounting for the roles, rules, and dependencies around them.
• Product and business judgment: you can identify the question that matters, recognize a meaningful opportunity, and recommend a direction without overstating the evidence.
• Exceptional writing and storytelling: you can lead with the point, make it tangible through examples, and adjust the level of detail for product teams and senior leaders.
• The ability to build trust with demanding partners, disagree clearly, and help a team make a decision.
• Independence in an environment with limited established process. You can create a plan, recruit participants, and carry the work from an ambiguous question through a useful conclusion.
• Curiosity about where AI might change business operations, paired with judgment about where customers will trust it to act.
• A habit of learning unfamiliar domains and a willingness to make the tools you need, whether that means exploring a product hands-on, using data, prototyping, or working with AI tools.

If you don’t meet every requirement but are excited about the role, we encourage you to apply. Skills transfer in unexpected ways, and diverse perspectives often lead to the most innovative solutions.

About the team

Product Research is part of Rippling’s Product Design organization. We study questions across HR, IT, and Finance that can materially change what Rippling builds. We're a small, hands-on team working on questions that do not arrive neatly scoped. Researchers follow those questions into customer operations, product details, and data; recruit the people they need; and build tools or prototypes when useful. We challenge each other's interpretations and write clear points of view that leaders can use to make decisions.

Additional Information

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. The mission of the Brooks Run Research Lab is to create and leverage novel, scientific concepts and runner-driven product performance insights to create amazing products to help everyone run their path.
Our Run Research Lab is seeking a Master's graduate intern to work at our Seattle HQ offices. As a Run Research performance Intern, you will gain hands-on experience in product research at the leading running brand – Brooks Sports, Inc. Your primary responsibilities will be to assist in biomechanical data collection and processing for Run Research that will be used to inform product design, materials, and development.
The protocols will include but are not limited to motion capture, material mechanical properties, and metabolic testing. This information is critical for our multi-departmental infrastructure, including Development, Design, and Merchandising, to ensure that the performance integrity of our product meets the needs of our end consumers. You will also gain knowledge on how the human movement influences the design and development of athletic products at Brooks.
 
Your Impact (Responsibilities)
Understand athletic product design features and components and how they influence human movement.
Collection and processing of human subject data using Motion Analysis 3D motion capture.
Write code to analyze mechanical and biomechanical data in Python or Visual 3D.
Perform mechanical testing on material samples and full shoes (Instron).
Write scientific reports in PowerPoint and Microsoft Word. Summarize human movement and mechanical property findings for Brooks product and competitors that are delivered to product teams for use in product improvement.
Use your graduate-level research skills to conduct human movement studies that lead to innovative testing procedures and optimization of products for all who run.
Use your advanced data analytics skills to mine data in our historical dashboards to recommend product improvements based on identified opportunities.
Develop loyal, engaging relationships with our customers and the Brooks community.
Other duties as assigned
Project:
As a part of your experience as a graduate intern at Brooks, you will have the opportunity to complete a project under the support and supervision of your manager. Details of your project will be finalized once you arrive at Brooks based on your skills and the needs of the business. You will use your ever-growing analytical skillset as a graduate student to prepare a thoughtful and elevated project. During the course of this project, you will weave your learnings from your graduate courses into your work to challenge yourself, and benefit Brooks. You will present your work and findings to senior leadership at Brooks at the end of your internship, to hone in on your research, recommendation, and presentation skills.

jobs.title: Accounting Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT TRADEIFY

Tradeify is a proprietary trading firm that funds and supports traders worldwide. We're growing quickly, and we're looking for an Accounting Manager to keep our books accurate, our close fast, and our controls and audit readiness strong as we scale.




THE ROLE

As Accounting Manager, you'll run the day-to-day accounting function: the monthly close, financial reporting, technical revenue accounting, and the processes and controls behind them. Reporting to the Controller, you'll manage the accounting team, serve as a primary point of contact for external auditors, and partner with Finance, Operations, and Payments to build scalable systems for a high-volume, global business.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Accounting & Close

 - Lead the month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close, ensuring accurate and timely financial statements

 - Oversee general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll accounting, and bank and payment processor reconciliations

 - Prepare and review balance sheet reconciliations, journal entries, and flux analyses

 - Manage multi-entity and multi-currency accounting, including intercompany transactions

Revenue & ASC 606

 - Apply revenue recognition under ASC 606, including identifying performance obligations, determining transaction price, and allocating and recognizing revenue appropriately

 - Account for high-volume transactional revenue such as evaluation fees, subscriptions, and resets, including refunds, discounts, and other variable consideration

 - Prepare and maintain technical accounting memos and revenue policy documentation, and assess the accounting impact of new products, pricing changes, and contract terms

 - Maintain deferred revenue schedules and reconcile them to the general ledger and payment processor data

 - Oversee accounting for trader payouts, including accruals, liabilities, and reconciliations

Audit, Controls & Compliance

 - Serve as the primary liaison to external auditors, managing audit planning, PBC (prepared-by-client) requests, workpapers, and timelines

 - Prepare and maintain audit-ready support schedules, reconciliations, and documentation throughout the year, not just at year-end

 - Respond to auditor inquiries and resolve audit adjustments and findings, driving remediation and follow-up

 - Help design, document, and test internal controls over financial reporting, and identify and close control gaps

 - Coordinate with tax advisors and bookkeepers on tax filings and regulatory compliance

 - Develop and document accounting procedures, close checklists, and process narratives in partnership with the Controller

Team & Process

 - Support budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting with clear variance analysis

 - Identify opportunities to automate and improve accounting workflows and systems

 - Hire, coach, and develop accounting team members




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

Required

 - Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

 - 5+ years of progressive accounting experience, including 2+ years in a supervisory or management role

 - Strong knowledge of US GAAP, with hands-on experience applying ASC 606 to real transactions

 - Direct experience supporting external financial statement audits, including PBC preparation, workpapers, and auditor communication

 - Experience with month-end close processes and balance sheet reconciliations

 - Hands-on experience with an ERP or accounting platform (e.g., NetSuite, QuickBooks Online, Xero, Sage Intacct)

 - Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills

 - Experience with multi-entity consolidation and reconciling high-volume transaction data

 - Excellent attention to detail, with strong written and verbal communication

Preferred

 - CPA or equivalent certification

 - Public accounting or audit background (Big 4 or mid-tier firm)

 - Experience drafting technical accounting memos and evaluating complex revenue arrangements

 - Experience in fintech, trading, payments, e-commerce, or another high-volume digital business

 - Experience with payment processors (e.g., Stripe) and crypto or alternative payment methods

 - Familiarity with SOX-style internal controls and audit readiness

 - Experience with BI or data tools (SQL, Looker, etc.) and process automation




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Books closed within 7 business days with clean, reconciled accounts

 - Revenue recognized accurately and consistently under ASC 606, with documented policies and supporting memos

 - Smooth, on-schedule audits with minimal adjustments and timely resolution of findings

 - Documented, tested, and auditable processes and controls

 - Clear, trusted financial reporting delivered to leadership on a predictable schedule

 - A strong, engaged accounting team




WHY WORK WITH US

 - Get in on the ground floor. Tradeify is growing fast, and our finance and accounting function is growing with it. You'll join at a stage where the foundations are still being built, so your work will shape how we operate for years to come.

 - Be part of a growing team. You'll help hire and develop the people around you, and as we scale there will be room to grow into bigger responsibilities.

 - Make a visible impact. Your processes, policies, and controls won't get lost in a big organization. Leadership will see and rely on them.

 - Build it right. You'll have a real voice in choosing systems, automating workflows, and setting up a scalable, audit-ready function from the start.

 - Work on interesting problems. High-volume transactions, a global trader base, and a fast-moving industry mean the work is never routine.

jobs.title: Staff Manufacturing Engineer, Structures
jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we’re building rockets to serve today’s needs and tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

About the Team:

The Manufacturing team at Relativity Space is currently deep in manufacturing trades and process development for Terran R, our next generation, fully re-useable rocket. This team has a wide variety of responsibilities—from determining the most efficient factory floor layout, to developing and implementing complex tooling and processes, and even interfacing with the vehicle engineering team to heavily influence the design of the rocket. Unique to Relativity, you will get to work across many teams to iterate and support development of the vehicle program.

About the Role:

• Own the shop floor for one or more primary structure assembly work centers, clearing barriers and keeping production moving

• Champion process improvements across work centers, incorporating learnings from the first Terran R build

• Partner with design, manufacturing, and reliability engineers, production teams, and outside vendors to drive builds forward

• Write work instructions, specifications, and best practices for high-fidelity processes, and standardize them across the manufacturing team

• Provide Design for Manufacturing feedback to structures teams from development through the first prototype and flight builds

About You:

• Bachelor's degree in manufacturing, aerospace, mechanical, or another engineering discipline

• 8+ years related experience

• Hands-on history supporting complex assembly builds, including making risk calls to disposition issues and keep production moving

• Strong fundamentals in statics, mechanics of materials, process improvement and factory design, fastening and joining, and machining

• Working knowledge of drilling and trim ops, tooling, inspection methods, and GD&T

• Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to work across engineering and manufacturing to understand process constraints and feed back manufacturability inputs

• Self-motivated, able to prioritize and execute in a high-pressure environment

Nice to have, but not required:

• Direct experience with drill, trim, and fastening operations on aerospace products

• New product introduction of an aerospace hardware system into manufacturing, test, and production, with proven success

• Project management experience in a fast-paced environment

At Relativity Space, we are committed to transparency and fairness in our compensation practices. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

jobs.title: Partner Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
About EliseAI

At EliseAI, we're improving the industries that matter most: housing and healthcare. Everyone needs a place to live and access to quality healthcare, yet both are often harder to secure than they should be. 

By integrating AI agents deeply into existing workflows, we make them more efficient, reduce costs, and improve the experience for everyone.



 - Housing: We simplify how renters tour apartments, sign leases, submit maintenance requests, and stay connected with their property team—bringing everything they need for their home into one place.

 - Healthcare: We make it easy to schedule appointments, complete intake forms, and we help patients communicate with providers, so everyone can focus on health instead of paperwork.
   
   

With EliseAI, organizations reduce manual work, improve accessibility, and deliver a seamless experience across essential services. We recently raised a $250 million Series E round https://www.eliseai.com/blog/eliseai-raises-250m-series-e led by Andreessen Horowitz to accelerate this mission.



About The Role

As a Partner Solutions Engineer at EliseAI, you will sit at the intersection of business and engineering, owning and executing our technical strategic partnerships. This role requires both a commercial and technical mindset: you will manage a live portfolio of concurrent partner integrations—spanning utility billing, collections, water/metering, payments, and other property-tech verticals—and drive each one from scoping through go-live and into stable, long-term operation. You will work closely with both technical and business teams internally and externally to guarantee the long-term success and value of each partnership. This person will split the active partnerships book of work with our other Partner Solutions Engineer, so strong prioritization and ownership across a high volume of simultaneous workstreams is essential.



Key Responsibilities

 - Own a portfolio of concurrent integrations, end to end: At any given time you will be actively driving 10-15+ partner integrations across categories like utility billing, collections, water/metering, payments, and lease guarantee vendors. You will scope requirements, design the integration approach, drive development (internal and/or vendor-side), manage testing, and get each integration live against firm go-live dates—then keep it stable afterward

 - Be the technical point of contact for partners: You will work directly with vendor engineering and product teams to align on data needs, API usage, and implementation decisions. This includes evaluating what a partner's API can/can't do, deciding when to build vs. use a workaround, and unblocking issues that come up mid-build

 - Partner with Engineering to shape our API and integration architecture: You will identify gaps in our own API, scope and prioritize the right solutions with the integrations engineering team, and make architecture calls on how data should flow between EliseAI and partner systems

 - Document and standardize integration patterns: Rather than treating every vendor as a one-off, you will document how existing integrations work and standardize the pattern so new vendors in the same category can be onboarded faster and more consistently

 - Manage sandbox and test environments: You will create and maintain sandbox orgs and test data for each partner, using and improving our internal test data tools, so integrations can be validated before launch without manual one-off setup

 - Triage and prioritize a high-volume, deadline-driven workload: With multiple go-lives active at once, you will regularly re-prioritize across projects, flag at-risk timelines early, and escalate blockers to keep launches on track

 - Continuously improve the ecosystem: Contribute to longer-term initiatives such as partner-facing documentation, the API usage monitor, the partner certification program, and self-service vendor/sandbox tooling



Move at rocket speed, build something massive.

We’re scaling fast, solving real client problems with precision and ambition. Here, you own your impact; full autonomy, no micromanagement, no fluff. We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll ever do. If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard.



Requirements

 - 3+ years of experience in a technical role such as Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Technical Partnerships, Integrations, or Backend Engineering

 - Strong technical foundation, including understanding of system architecture fundamentals and APIs. Comfortable reading and reasoning about code (Python or similar)

 - Experience working directly with external technical stakeholders (e.g., vendor engineering teams, customer technical teams)

 - Proven ability to manage a large number of concurrent workstreams with competing deadlines—prioritizing ruthlessly without dropping balls

 - Ability to think strategically about integrations: assess tradeoffs, prioritize effectively, and make sound technical decisions, including when to push back on a partner vs. build a custom solution

 - Strong ownership mindset with the ability to manage timelines, track dependencies, escalate issues when needed, and drive work to completion under hard go-live dates

 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across both technical and non-technical teams, and comfort documenting technical workflows clearly for reuse

 - Nice to have: exposure to proptech, utility billing, collections, or payments/ledger workflows
   
   

Why Join

Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in on the ground floor of a funded (unicorn!) startup that’s scaling so fast. That means that instead of following a playbook, you’ll be writing it. Every single day you will be challenged to identify how we can scale and execute on it. You’ll learn what works when you succeed and what doesn’t when you fail. Either way, the rest of the team will be here to support you.



Benefits

In addition to the growth and impact you’ll have at EliseAI, we offer competitive salaries along with the following benefits:

 - Equity in the company

 - Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100%

 - Fully paid parental leave

 - Commuter benefits

 - 401k benefits

 - Fitness & home services stipend to cover part of your expenses so you can focus on what matters

 - A collaborative in-office environment with an open floor plan, fully stocked kitchen, and all meals covered in the office

 -  Unlimited vacation and paid holidays

 - We'll cover relocation packages and make the move exciting, not painful!


Job Compensation Range:

The salary range for this role is CAD $135,000 - $200,000 with the ability to earn overtime. EliseAI offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits & perks package. Exact compensation is determined based on a number of factors, including experience, skill level, location, and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided by our Recruiting Team during the hiring process.



EliseAI provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Employment with EliseAI is on an “at-will” basis, meaning that either the employee or the company may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, subject to applicable law.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We will also consider qualified applicants in accordance with the Austin Fair Chance Hiring Ordinance.

If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application or recruiting process due to a disability, please contact us at interview.accommodations@meetelise.com.

jobs.title: Temporary Accounting Specialist, AR & General Accounting
jobs.description:
ABOUT GOODR

We create and sell active eyewear for anyone. No Slip. No Bounce. All Polarized. All Fun. Interested in joining our team? Keep reading.

OUR VALUES: We have two core values: Fun & Authenticity.

• FUN = Being sh*tty isn’t fun. Agreed? Taking pride in your work, finding joy in being GREAT, and celebrating wins… and losses. Now, that’s fun!

• AUTHENTICITY = Focusing on being authentic over being liked. (Next-level guru stuff. Count it.)

Fun Fact: We do not allow email to be sent internally. Carrier pigeons only. JK, we use Slack.

AUTONOMY: We practice autonomy, empowerment, and accountability so that every team member can be in control of their own life.

• HYBRID WORKING: This role is required to be in our Inglewood office every Tuesday and Thursday with the occasional third day thrown in.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Are you a numbers wizard who loves bringing order to financial chaos and isn't afraid to dive headfirst into the wonderful world of Accounts Receivable? Do you live for the thrill of a perfectly balanced reconciliation, a seamless month-end close, and making sure the money flows smoothly? If you answered with a resounding "HELL YES!", then you might be the Accounting Specialist we're looking for!

This isn't your average, run-of-the-mill, snooze-fest AR role. We're looking for someone with a rock-solid accounting foundation to take total ownership of our day-to-day AR operations while flexing their general ledger muscles across month-end close, journal entries, and reconciliations. You'll also join us at a super exciting time as we level up, automate, and modernize our accounting processes. If you're proactive, detail-obsessed, and ready to make a huge impact on our Money team, pull up a chair!

**Note: This is a Full-Time TEMPORARY position from October 2026 through March 2027.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own day-to-day AR activities, including invoicing, cash application and customer account maintenance

• Monitor AR aging and proactively follow up on outstanding balances and collection items

• Research and resolve customer payment discrepancies, deductions, credits and unapplied cash

• Perform customer account reconciliations and ensure AR balances are accurate and supported

• Own AR-related month-end close activities and reconciliations

• Partner with Sales and other internal teams to resolve customer and invoicing issues

• Support the rollout and ongoing operation of our evolving deferred revenue/revenue recognition process, including monitoring customer deposits, open invoice exceptions and related reconciliations

• Support month-end close through account reconciliations, journal entries, accruals and other recurring accounting activities

• Partner closely with our Financial Reporting & Systems Accountant and progressively take ownership of recurring accounting responsibilities

• Support corporate credit card reconciliations and related expense-management processes

• Assist with GL research, account analysis and resolution of reconciling items

• Support year-end audit preparation, including schedules, reconciliations and supporting documentation

• Identify opportunities to improve, document and automate Accounting processes

• Cross-train across the Accounting team to provide additional coverage and support as needed

• This role is in the Finance team and will report directly to the Controller

• Perform other related duties as assigned

ABOUT THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

• May or may not have a degree...we don’t care (bonus points for Basset Hound Science or Dinosaur Law)

• 3+ years of progressive accounting experience, with meaningful hands-on AR experience

• Strong understanding of general accounting concepts, including journal entries, reconciliations and the month-end close process

• Experience working in an ERP environment; NetSuite experience is preferred

• Strong Excel skills, including comfort working with large datasets and reconciliations

• Excellent attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership

• Able to research discrepancies and follow an issue through to resolution rather than simply identifying it

• Organized and comfortable managing multiple priorities and deadlines

• Comfortable working cross-functionally and communicating with both Accounting and non-Accounting teams

• Curious about process improvement, systems and automation

• Has excellent multi-tasking skills

• Strong communicator who lives into collaboration

• Driven by personal growth and thrives in an environment of constant feedback

• Is proactive and an independent problem solver! (Can you google a question?)

WHAT YOU GET

• This is a Temporary position

• Start date: October 2026

• End date: March 2027

• To be involved in the most exciting sunglasses brand to hit the athletic space

• Paycheck....obviously. Pay rate: $45/hour, final offer will be made within this range based on experience

• Free sunglasses

NEXT STEPS

Here's what we expect the hiring process for this role to be, should all go well with your candidacy. We aim for this entire process to take no more than four weeks to complete and you'd be expected to start on a specific date.

• Application

• Fill out a form with basic questions

• 30 minute introductory meeting with HR member

• 60 minute virtual interview with role manager and peer

• Offer!

TO GET THE PROCESS STARTED, REVIEW & SUBMIT THE FOLLOWING:

• Review goodr's Applicant Privacy Policy. By submitting an application to goodr, you are confirming that you have read the Applicant Privacy Policy and agree to its terms. (Because nothing says “fun” like reading legal documents!)

• Resume

• Links to projects or groups you’re involved with (if you have them)

• A drawing of an octopus fighting a pirate (not joking)*

• We may ask you to enter a code. But don't worry, it's just our attempt to keep the bots at bay.

*We accept submissions using accessibility tools.

As our Field Service Technician, you will be responsible for performing calibration, testing, troubleshooting, and measurement services at customer facilities. This role is pivotal in maintaining customer confidence, ensuring measurement accuracy, and upholding the quality standards that East Coast Calibration and Accredited Labs are known for.

• Communicate findings, recommendations, and technical information to customers

jobs.title: Manager, Talent Acquisition Operations & Enablement
jobs.description:
Dive in and do the best work of your career at DigitalOcean. Journey alongside a strong community of top talent who are relentless in their drive to build the simplest scalable cloud. If you have a growth mindset, naturally like to think big and bold, and are energized by the fast-paced environment of a true industry disruptor, you’ll find your place here.  We value winning together—while learning, having fun, and making a profound difference for the dreamers and builders in the world.

DigitalOcean is looking for a Recruiting Operations & Enablement Manager to own the systems, processes, and infrastructure that power our recruiting function. This is a hands-on role: you'll manage the day-to-day health of our recruiting tech stack, build the operational rigor that lets recruiting scale cleanly as the business grows, and partner closely with recruiters and People teams to remove friction from the hiring process.

You're equally comfortable setting operational strategy and getting into the weeds of an ATS workflow, a scheduling exception, or a messy report. You build things that hold up as the company scales including the documentation and data hygiene expected of a public company.

What You'll Do

• Own the strategy and day-to-day operation of our recruiting systems, including our ATS and scheduling/coordination tooling, ensuring they're configured, adopted, and running smoothly across the recruiting org.

• Build and document repeatable, scalable processes that hold up as headcount and hiring volume grow.

• Own data hygiene and reporting across recruiting systems: clean requisition data, accurate candidate and pipeline records, and dashboards recruiting and business leaders can trust.

• Partner with recruiters to identify the biggest sources of friction and manual work, then prioritize and build solutions — whether that's a new workflow, automation, or process redesign leveraging AI and tools.

• Evaluate and implement new recruiting technology and AI-enabled tools that make the team meaningfully more effective, and manage vendor relationships with a focus on ROI.

• Work as a close partner to People Operations, Legal and Finance on shared processes such as offer letter management, background checks, and headcount approvals, ensuring clean handoffs.

• Define success metrics for recruiting operations and use data to drive continuous improvement across the candidate and interviewer experience.

• Build and maintain processes with the rigor and auditability expected of a public company, anticipating compliance needs before they're required.

What You’ll Add to DigitalOcean

• 5+ years of experience in recruiting operations, with hands-on experience in recruiting coordination, systems administration, and process design.

• 2+ years of experience managing people or leading cross-functional workstreams.

• Proven experience building and documenting processes that are repeatable and support data hygiene across recruiting systems.

• Strong command of ATS platforms (e.g., Greenhouse, Ashby, Workday) and recruiting/scheduling tools.

• A data-driven approach to program management, with experience building KPIs, dashboards, and translating insights into action.

• Comfortable experimenting with AI tools and automation (e.g., Zapier, scripts, AI-powered workflows) to reduce manual work.

• Excellent communication skills — able to earn buy-in and drive adoption across teams without relying on formal authority.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Nice to Have

• Experience in a high-growth, publicly traded tech company, particularly with SOX-related process considerations.

• Familiarity with employer branding, referral programs, or other recruiting programs work.

• Experience partnering directly with People Operations on offer management and background checks.

jobs.title: Founder’s Associate Intern
jobs.description:
DRYFT

Dryft builds intelligent systems that automate complex human decisions in manufacturing operations

We’re a small, talent-dense team with modest roots and a love for the physical world - cars, machines, planes. Our team includes graduates from Stanford, Berkeley, CDTM, TUM, winners of Stanford TreeHacks, recipients of Fulbright & Haniel scholarships, and builders of everything from robots and race cars to software with millions of downloads.

THE ROLE
