jobs.title: Senior Director of FP&A
jobs.description:
The future of aerospace and defense starts here.

Ursa Major was founded to revolutionize how America and its allies access and apply high-performance propulsion, from hypersonics to solid rocket motors, satellite maneuvering and launch. We design and deliver propulsion and defense systems that solve the most urgent and critical national security demands.

Ursa Major is scaling rapidly, transitioning key propulsion programs from development into high-rate production and expanding our commercial and defense footprint. We are seeking an accomplished Senior Director of Finance to serve as our lead business unit finance partner and build out an elite program finance and operational FP&A organization.

Reporting directly to the President, the Senior Director of Finance will own full financial cadence across all business lines and operational programs. This leader will serve as the primary strategic copilot to the President, program managers, and engineering leadership, driving program economics, long-range capacity and resource planning, EAC/ETC forecasting, and contract pricing strategy. The ideal candidate brings extensive leadership experience in defense, aerospace, or space manufacturing, uniting corporate FP&A discipline with rigorous government contracting and program finance execution.

Key Responsibilities

• Executive Partnership & Business Line Cadence: Act as the direct financial copilot to the President, translating operational, flight-test, and production milestones into clear financial targets, risks, and opportunities.

• Program Finance & Unit Economics: Establish and lead program finance across all product lines, managing program-level P&Ls, bookings, backlog conversion, revenue recognition, contract margins, and cash generation.

• Estimates at Completion (EAC / ETC): Direct the comprehensive monthly and quarterly Estimate at Completion (EAC) and Estimate to Complete (ETC) cadence across major development and production programs, identifying cost variances, labor run-rate anomalies, and supply chain impacts early.

• Earned Value Management (EVM): Partner with Program Management and Integrated Master Schedulers to implement and monitor EVM frameworks, ensuring clear alignment between technical milestones, project schedules, and cost performance index (CPI) / schedule performance index (SPI) metrics.

• Annual Operating Plans & Long-Range Planning (LRP): Lead multi-year long-range planning, capital expenditure forecasting, annual operating budgets, and dynamic scenario modeling across business units to support high-rate propulsion delivery.

• Proposals, Pricing & Contract Negotiations: Partner with Business Development and Engineering on complex proposals, pricing strategies, cost volumes, and negotiations across Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP), Cost-Plus (CPFF/CPIF), and milestone-based commercial and government contracts.

• Systems Architecture & Operations: Champion the modernization of our program finance and operational reporting infrastructure, optimizing systems such as Deltek Costpoint, SAP, Anaplan, and Power BI to automate reporting and deliver real-time operational visibility.

• Team Leadership & Scale: Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of program finance managers and business unit financial analysts, fostering a culture of technical rigor, ownership, and cross-functional transparency.

• Public Readiness & Governance: Ensure robust, auditor-ready forward-looking internal controls, GAAP/FAR/CAS compliance, and program data integrity across all business line forecasts.

Required Qualifications

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

• Experience: 15+ years of progressive finance experience with significant tenure in leadership roles, including substantial direct leadership of program finance and business unit FP&A within Aerospace, Defense, or Space hardware environments.

• Program Finance Mastery: Proven mastery of program economics, government and commercial aerospace contracting, cost accounting standards (CAS), FAR regulations, milestone billing, and EAC/ETC methodologies.

• Executive Presence: Track record of serving as a trusted advisor to C-suite and executive operational leadership, delivering candid insights and strategic clarity in high-velocity operating environments.

• Systems & Analytics: Deep hands-on experience leveraging enterprise defense/manufacturing ERPs and planning platforms (e.g., Deltek Costpoint, SAP) alongside advanced business intelligence and modeling tools (e.g., Anaplan, Power BI, Excel).

• Leadership & Team Building: Demonstrated success scaling finance teams, structuring workflows, and coaching senior managers and analysts in complex manufacturing environments.

Desired Qualifications

• Master of Business Administration (MBA) or relevant advanced technical/business degree.

• Professional certifications such as CPA, CMA, or EVM certification.

• Prior experience leading finance through production rate ramp-ups, major capital markets transactions, or within a high-growth publicly traded aerospace/defense prime.

Colorado law requires us to tell you the base compensation range of this role, which is $230,000 - $300,000, determined by your education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities. What we can’t quantify for you are the exciting challenges, supportive team, and amazing culture we enjoy.

Classification: Full-time Exempt

Benefits Include: (Please note, Interns are not eligible for benefits)

• Unlimited PTO - Vacation, Sick, Personal, and Bereavement

• Paid Parental and Adoptive Leave

• Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance

• Tax Advantage Accounts (HSA/FSA)

• Employer Paid Short and Long Term Disability, Basic Life, AD&D

• Additional Benefit Options Including Voluntary Life and Emergency Medical Transport

• EAP Program

• Retirement Savings Plan - 401k with Company Match

Interested candidates are encouraged to apply by filling out the application below and clicking "Submit Application". This position will be posted for a minimum of 3 days and will remain open until filled or adjusted based on the volume of applicants.

NOTE: Research suggests that women and BIPOC individuals may self-select out of opportunities if they don't meet 100% of the job requirements. We encourage anyone who believes they have the skills and the drive necessary to succeed here to apply for this role.

Must be a U.S. Person (this includes U.S. Citizens and Permanent Residents).

Eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. Security Clearance.

We’re an equal-opportunity employer. You will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

No outside recruiters, please.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description:
About Formlabs:

Do you want to change how the world creates?

At Formlabs, we’re building the tools that make it possible for anyone to bring their ideas to life, from cutting-edge products to life-saving medical devices. Our 3D printing technology powers innovation at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. Together, we’re helping everyone design, prototype, and manufacture faster than ever before.

We’re a team of hands-on builders, engineers, and innovators reinventing how the world makes physical things. If you’re ready to shape the future of fabrication, come build it with us.

Your Impact:

Our passion is designing and building powerful 3D printing tools. Our manufacturing team is responsible for research and development of the manufacturing processes for all of Formlabs products. They work cross functionally with mechanical design, electrical, and materials teams.

If you’re excited to help us troubleshoot processes, ramp manufacturing, and launch products,  we want you as a Manufacturing Engineer.

The Job:

• Drive manufacturing technical readiness as a critical member of NPI teams; collaborating directly with R&D teams to drive results from early prototype phases through project completion.

• Drive DFM and DFA in support of product, system, and process design.

• Establish industrialization and production readiness while collaborating globally with Formlabs teams, Contract Manufacturers, and Suppliers.

• Ensure critical product specifications are addressed through critical processes and corresponding process control points.

• Collaborate cross functionally on complex engineering and operational challenges.

• Drive process control and issue prevention; implementing tools, equipment and process methods to ensure reliability and quality.

• Drive optimization and continuous improvement using factory data to analyze process capabilities at Suppliers and Contract Manufacturers.

You:

• B.S. Degree in Engineering; mechanical, manufacturing mechatronics, systems, or related field.

• Willingness and ability to travel internationally & domestically approximately 10-20%.

• 1-3 Years experience in Design and Manufacturing Engineering roles for complex NPI product industrialization.

• 1-3 Years experience with global contract manufacturers in bringing electromechanical systems from prototype to mass production.

• Independent, self-starter with strong ability to think strategically and execute tactically with a persistent attention to details.

• Excellent presentation, written and verbal communication skills; presenting at all business levels.

Our Benefits & Perks:

• Robust equity program to build future wealth through RSUs

• Comprehensive healthcare coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)

• 401K matching and access to financial advisors

• Generous paid Parental Leave (up to 16 weeks)

• Tenure-based paid Sabbatical Leave (up to 6 weeks)

• Flexible Out of Office Plan – Take time when you need it

• Ample on-site parking & pre-tax commuter benefits

• Healthy on-site lunches, snacks, beverages, & treats

• Regular sponsored professional development opportunities

• Many opt-in culture events across our diverse community

• And of course… unlimited 3D prints

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company.  We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Even if you don't check every box, but see yourself contributing, please apply. Help us build an inclusive community that will change the face of 3D printing.

Our Candidate AI Guidelines are available here. Please give them a read.

Compensation

Every Formlabs employee receives equity because everyone contributes to building the company. You’ll have the opportunity to share financially in the value we create together, with a shared incentive to build a business that succeeds over the long term. Equity will be a significant portion of your total compensation, and will increase over time in proportion to your impact. The base pay will be determined by your skills, qualifications, experience, location, and expected impact on the organization.

$92,000—$140,000 USD

jobs.title: Director & Assistant General Counsel, Commercial
jobs.description:
About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

Millions of people across the world come to Pinterest to find new ideas every day. It’s where they get inspiration, dream about new possibilities and plan for what matters most. Our mission is to help those people find their inspiration and create a life they love. As a Pinterest employee, you’ll be challenged to take on work that upholds this mission and pushes Pinterest forward. You’ll grow as a person and leader in your field, all the while helping users make their lives better in the positive corner of the internet.

At Pinterest we pride ourselves on building connections, partnerships, and collaborations across the business. You will have an opportunity to work with business requesters across a multitude of organizations, thus allowing you the opportunity to build those business relationships and become a trusted ally with business requesters.

The Commercial Legal Team at Pinterest negotiates Pinterest’s inbound and supplier agreements. We are looking for a Senior Commercial Counsel with a strong background in negotiating complex SaaS, AI and cloud infrastructure agreements to join our team. The position will manage workloads for and relationships with several of our cross functional partners, including Engineering, Security, Privacy, Finance, Procurement and IT. This role will play an important part in supporting Pinterest’s cloud strategy across multiple platforms and helping the business efficiently scale its technology and infrastructure partnerships.

What you’ll do:

• Lead, coach and develop a team of legal professionals supporting a high volume of complex commercial and technology transactions.

• Manage hiring, onboarding, performance, development and resourcing for your team.

• Set team priorities and operating rhythms to optimize productivity, quality, stakeholder support and career development.

• Act as an escalation point for complex, contentious and unforeseen issues, and make sound decisions in ambiguous or time-sensitive situations.

• Guide negotiation strategy and legal risk assessment for SaaS, AI, cloud, infrastructure, data processing, professional services and other supplier agreements.

• Partner closely with Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, Privacy, Finance, Procurement and IT stakeholders to support strategic business initiatives and critical transactions.

• Improve how the work gets done by building scalable playbooks, templates, workflows, guidance and decision frameworks.

• Use metrics, milestones and feedback loops to drive accountability, improve execution and strengthen stakeholder experience.

• Build team and organizational capability through coaching, succession planning, exposure and stretch opportunities.

• Stay current with cloud contracting trends, emerging licensing and consumption models, and industry best practices to help Pinterest make informed, pragmatic decisions in a rapidly evolving space.

What we’re looking for:

• JD with minimum 10 years of experience in a legal environment, with significant experience negotiating complex SaaS, cloud services, technology infrastructure and commercial transactions.

• Minimum 2 years of in-house experience at a technology company preferred.

• Strong people management experience, including coaching, performance management, development and workforce planning.

• Deep experience negotiating cloud compute, SaaS, hosting, data processing, professional services and other technology supplier agreements, with comfort advising on data privacy, data security, AI and general commercial risk.

• Strong judgment and comfort making risk-based decisions in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to present clear, business-oriented solutions.

• Demonstrated ability to drive results through others, manage escalations and improve team operations.

• Track record of building team capability, holding high standards and creating an inclusive, accountable environment.

jobs.title: Senior Cost Manager - Data Center Construction
jobs.location: Washington D.C., District of Columbia, United States
jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend is seeking an experienced Senior Cost Manager / Quantity Surveyor to serve as the key day-to-day client interface on large-scale data center construction projects. This role is responsible for ensuring client objectives are achieved through the delivery of high-quality, value-added cost management services across the full project lifecycle.

The successful candidate will have extensive experience supporting complex mission-critical or advanced technology construction programs, with strong expertise in cost planning, estimating, change management, commercial negotiations, and cost control. The role requires excellent communication skills, a proactive approach, and the ability to operate confidently in a client-facing environment.

As a senior member of the team, you will provide leadership and direction while promoting Turner & Townsend's purpose, values, and vision. You will work collaboratively with clients, design teams, contractors, and stakeholders to successfully deliver data center projects from planning through closeout.

Responsibilities:

• Estimating and negotiating change orders throughout the construction lifecycle.
• Provide estimate and cost planning to include producing and presenting the final cost plan.
• Review and participate with the design services team and general contractor in the development of cost estimates.
• Reconcile changes and assist the general contractor to ensure that their data is accurate.
• Communicate or meet with the general contractor and owner of project manager to gather status information to prepare a cost estimate update.
• Prepare written comments to the general contractor’s submissions, including the executive summary.
• Coordinate all sources of cost information for cost discussions and suppliers direct from NPA, subs, quantities from A/Es.
• Inform and drive engineering priorities based on cost impact.
• Work proactively with minimal supervision to resolve scheduling issues.
• Manage cost checks and carry out valuations on larger projects. Complete timely, accurate cost checking and valuation processes.
• Participate effectively with post-contract cost variances and the change of control processes.
• Manage Cost impact / contingency management and commitment tracking logs.
• Prepare funding data presentations and coordinate VE sessions with stakeholders.
• Developing cost plans and estimates through the design phase, delivering updated cost plans at appropriate design milestones.
• Providing commercial input to design optioneering and input into value engineering exercises.
• Reviewing contractor and subcontractor pricing and leading negotiations on behalf of the client to drive fair contract prices.
• Performing quantity surveying, cost controls, and change management activities throughout the project lifecycle.
• Ensuring that post-contract cost variances and change control processes are managed effectively.
• Ensuring that cost auditing and valuation work is managed effectively and that a robust process for cost validation is in place.
• Carrying out the production of monthly cost reports for presentation to the client.

jobs.description:

jobs.description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. The Dashboards team builds the data visualization experiences that help Smartsheet customers turn raw information into clear, executive-ready insight. jobs.title: Director of Data Engineering
jobs.description:
We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!

About the role

Every board number, retail report, and marketing decision at Grüns runs through our data platform. As Director of Data Engineering, you will own that platform and lead the team that builds it. We moved fast to get here, and now we're building the foundation for an enterprise-level data function: cleaner models, less tech debt, and numbers everyone trusts.

This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL.

In this role, you will:

• Own the data roadmap and company data model, with a single source of truth for core business data

• Refactor legacy jobs and tech debt so the platform scales with the business

• Keep pipelines resilient so data stays available, accurate, and trusted across the company

• Manage warehouse and infrastructure cost as data volume grows

• Run our intake process and sprint cadence, prioritizing requests by business impact and staying flexible when priorities shift

• Lead and coach a small team through code reviews, feedback, and clear growth paths, and get hands-on when the work needs it

• Connect new enterprise systems, such as ERP, into the warehouse

• Make the team AI-native, using AI agents for development, incident investigation, and data quality

We're looking for someone who:

• Has 8+ years in data architecture or data engineering, including 3+ years leading teams

• Has built and scaled cloud data platforms (BigQuery or similar)

• Is strong in SQL, Python, and dbt or a similar modeling framework

• Has deep data modeling experience and starts from business concepts before tables

• Has built data quality, governance, and monitoring practices that teams trust

• Has run sprint-based intake and prioritization for a team serving many stakeholders

• Is comfortable with ELT tools like Fivetran, Orbitrail and enterprise systems (ERP experience is a plus)

• Comes from DTC or CPG (preferred)

Approach to the role:

• Starts with the business question, then picks the simplest technology that answers it

• Gets fundamentals right first: integrity, governance, observability

• Treats a trust problem in the data as urgent

• Prioritizes ruthlessly against their own time and everyone else's

• Stays in the weeds when needed while leading the team

• Coaches engineers to grow into senior contributors and managers

• Uses AI agents daily and teaches the team to do the same

Compensation & Benefits:

At Grüns, we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package — grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary is $200,000 plus bonus + incentive compensation depending on experience, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team.

A bit about us...

At Grüns, we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you.

Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all.

So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious.

What we care about...

Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation.

Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners.

Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most.

Compensation & Perks:

For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.

Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!

We put the human element at the center of everything: every formulation, every patient interaction, every provider partnership. We're not just a compounding pharmacy. jobs.title: Product Manager, Platform
jobs.description:
WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Understand the needs of the teams that use our platforms and the customers who depend on them. Use product data, operational feedback, and recurring quality issues to identify the highest-impact problems, and then solve them.

 - Turn recurring needs into shared services, tools, and workflows that reduce duplicated work. Exercise judgment about when to build a reusable capability, use an existing solution, or take a simpler approach.

 - Work directly with product, engineering, and operational teams to understand their workflows, identify recurring problems, and anticipate the capabilities they will need next.

 - Prioritize platform investments across new product enablement, reliability, efficiency, and technical debt. Make clear tradeoffs between near-term delivery and long-term flexibility.

 - Define and track success through business impact, reliability, cost to serve, and reduced manual work, connecting these measures to customer and business outcomes.

 - Partner closely with engineering on technical tradeoffs, build-versus-buy decisions, and rollout plans. Write clear requirements and drive delivery from problem definition through launch and iteration.


QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience owning product strategy and execution on technical products and platforms, or shared systems used by multiple teams such as billing and monetization, identity and access, developer platforms, data and experimentation, internal tooling, support, etc.

 - Strong technical fluency. You can reason about APIs, data flows, system dependencies, and failure modes, and work closely with engineers on consequential tradeoffs.

 - Strong analytical skills. You can investigate problems independently, define meaningful metrics, and evaluate the impact of platform investments.

 - Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to align teams around priorities and make difficult decisions when their needs compete.

 - High ownership and sound judgment in a fast-moving environment. You are comfortable moving between long-term strategy and hands-on execution without adding unnecessary process.

 - A focus on customer outcomes and product quality, including when your immediate users are internal teams.


WHERE THIS PERSON NEEDS TO SPIKE

 - Systems thinker, detail-oriented, problem solver. This person needs to have experience wrangling thorny, complex problems. We need someone that is excited about diving into messy workflows, reading through dozens of support tickets, thinking through edge cases no one’s thought of, assuming different behavior across platforms, proactively considering enterprise vs. consumer workflows, etc.

 - Experience working on platforms with multiple stakeholders and non-trivial tradeoffs. This person is building products simultaneously for customers, agents, and other internal employees.

 - Is “AI-native.” Can build AI products whose outputs require evaluation, safeguards, and human-in-the-loop design.

 - Strong analytical skills and experience defining metrics in ambiguity, breaking down workflows, and using quantitative and qualitative evidence to prioritize.

 - Some experience working on critical software: support platforms/agents, legal/compliance tooling, identity and account tooling, billing, fraud, trust-and safety, etc.

 - High-ownership. This person needs to feel dissatisfied by the current support flow, and hungry to do whatever it takes to clear the backlog.

Bonus Qualifications

• 1-2 years of patient triage experience in an urgent care or emergency department preferred.

Why You'll Love Working With Us

• Urgent care services at no cost to our team members and their families

jobs.title: Senior Product Owner
jobs.description:
About Us

DriveWealth is on a mission to make investing easier. We believe that everyone should have the ability to control their financial future, and that access to financial markets should not be limited by geography, wealth, or legacy systems. We are a global B2B financial technology organization dedicated to democratizing access to financial independence around the world. Our mission is realized through an API-based platform, empowering our partners to offer seamless investing and trading experiences to clients worldwide, all from their mobile devices. Our technology provides partners with a modern, extensible toolkit, enabling traditional investment workflows and innovative techniques like fractional share ownership. DriveWealth has evolved into a global platform offering trading of US equities, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income, and options.

There’s never been a better time to build a category-defining business and there has rarely been a team better positioned for this opportunity. Our culture blends the pace and agility of a fintech start-up with the impact, stability, and discipline of Wall Street. We encourage creativity and experimentation while ensuring institutional-grade execution and regulatory compliance in everything we do. Join us and help build the future of global investing!

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Owner to sit at the center of DriveWealth's capital markets ecosystem, translating complex workflows and business problems into scalable, build-ready product solutions.

In this role, you will lead high-impact initiatives across the platform, partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, Compliance, and external industry participants. You will develop a deep understanding of end-to-end workflows, define product and functional solutions, and drive execution across multiple systems, asset classes, and partner models.

This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strong capital markets or wealth domain expertise, analytical thinking, technical fluency, and product execution. You should be comfortable moving between business workflows, data analysis, APIs and system interactions, detailed requirements, and conversations with engineers and operational stakeholders.

You'll thrive in this role if you bring:

• Deep U.S. capital markets and trade processing experience, with the ability to apply it hands-on across workflows, data, APIs, and functional solution design

• A coachable attitude and a learning mindset, with comfort handling changing priorities

• Leadership and ownership in running development teams and driving work through to delivery

• Strong communication and follow-up skills

What You'll Do

• Own product solutions: take complex trade processing problems from discovery and analysis through solution design, requirements, delivery, and production readiness

• Translate business needs: convert business and product objectives into detailed functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and data definitions

• Analyze end-to-end workflows: understand upstream and downstream impacts across trading, transaction processing, positions, cash, settlement, transfers, and operational workflows

• Perform data analysis: use data and SQL to investigate workflows, validate processing logic, analyze exceptions, and support product decisions

• Design integrations: partner with Engineering on APIs, events, data models, system interfaces, and service interactions

• Manage the backlog: own and prioritize product backlog items and lead refinement sessions to ensure requirements are understood, technically feasible, and ready for development

• Solve complex problems: investigate production and processing issues, identify root causes, and develop scalable solutions rather than tactical fixes

• Drive stakeholder alignment: present solution designs and trade-offs and drive decisions across Product, Engineering, Operations, Compliance, and other stakeholders

• Partner externally: work with brokers, clearing firms, custodians, vendors, and other market participants to design and deliver integrated capabilities

You Bring

• 4+ years of experience in capital markets, brokerage, wealth management, or fintech, with significant exposure to U.S. markets

• Strong hands-on knowledge of back-office transaction processing

• Experience working with back-office platforms

• Experience within a fintech, broker-dealer, bank, clearing firm, custodian, or capital-markets technology provider

• Experience working across multiple functional areas such as trading, middle office, back office, operations, settlement, cash, positions, or data

• Demonstrated ability to understand complex end-to-end workflows spanning multiple systems and translate them into clear product and functional designs

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to investigate complex transaction scenarios and identify root causes

• Experience designing or working with REST APIs, event-driven integrations, data models, and service-based architectures

• Working knowledge of SQL or equivalent database-querying tools for analysis, reconciliation, and issue investigation

• Strong written communication skills with demonstrated ability to produce precise, build-ready functional documentation

• Ability to work effectively with Product, Engineering, Operations, Compliance, and other business teams

• Comfort operating in ambiguous, multi-system, and multi-partner environments

• Experience working with industry participants such as broker-dealers, clearing firms, custodians, banks, or financial technology vendors

Special Knowledge (Nice to Have, But Not Required)

• Account and securities transfers

jobs.title: Program Administration & Logistics Coordinator (Remote - US)
jobs.description:
Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) is a global health organization that partners locally and globally to create and scale solutions to the world’s deadliest health threats. Position Purpose:

The Program Administration & Logistics Coordinator provides high-quality administrative and logistical support to the Chief Program Officer (CPO) and Office of the CPO, helping the office operate efficiently and enabling senior program leaders to focus on their highest-priority work.

The Coordinator manages scheduling, travel and expenses, supports contracting and procurement processes, and coordinates logistics for meetings, workshops, retreats, and other in-person gatherings. Working closely with program teams and Shared Services, the role helps connect RTSL’s distributed workforce by ensuring that meetings and convenings are thoughtfully planned, efficiently executed, and a positive experience for participants.

Executive and Office Coordination

• Coordinate recurring and ad hoc meetings across multiple teams, geographies, and time zones.

• Support the Office of the CPO’s operating rhythm, including scheduling leadership reviews, program leadership meetings, team meetings, and other recurring forums.

• Anticipate administrative needs and proactively address scheduling, logistical, and coordination issues before they become barriers.

• Maintain organized records, materials, and other administrative resources for the Office of the CPO.

Travel and Expense Coordination

• Coordinate travel logistics for staff participating in program convenings, workshops, retreats, and other in-person gatherings.

• Provide clear and timely logistical information to travelers and participants and troubleshoot issues as they arise.

Meetings, Convenings, and Shared Logistics

• Coordinate end-to-end logistics for leadership meetings, Program Senior Management Team meetings, program workshops, retreats, learning events, and other gatherings, including venues, travel, catering, materials, technology, and participant support.

Contracts, Procurement, and Administrative Processes

• Support the preparation and submission of contracting and procurement requests in coordination with Shared Services, Finance, Legal, and relevant program teams.

• Track contracts, procurement requests, approvals, and other administrative processes through completion, following up with relevant stakeholders as needed.

• Maintain accurate and organized records and documentation.

• Develop a working understanding of RTSL’s administrative policies and processes and help colleagues navigate routine requirements.

• Identify opportunities to streamline recurring administrative and logistical processes and improve how work gets done.

Qualifications:

Experience & Education

• At least 5 years of experience in administrative coordination, executive support, event or meeting coordination, logistics, or a related area, ideally within a distributed or international organization.

• Demonstrated experience supporting senior leaders with complex calendar, travel, and expense management.

• Experience coordinating meetings, workshops, retreats, or other events involving multiple participants and logistical requirements.

• Experience working across teams and coordinating with internal service functions and external vendors.

• Experience supporting procurement, contracting, or other administrative workflows is desirable.

• Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

Skills & abilities

• Exceptional organizational and time-management skills, with strong attention to detail and follow-through.

• Strong coordination and project-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, deadlines, and dependencies simultaneously.

• Ability to anticipate needs, identify potential problems, and take appropriate action with limited direction.

• Ability to manage competing priorities, shifting schedules, and last-minute changes calmly and effectively.

• Strong interpersonal and service orientation, with the ability to build productive relationships with colleagues, partners, and vendors.

• Sound judgment and discretion in handling confidential or sensitive information.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate logistical information clearly and concisely.

• Ability to understand and balance the needs of multiple stakeholders.

• Diplomacy, tact, and cultural awareness when working across levels, functions, cultures, and geographies.

• Resourceful and solutions-oriented, with good judgment about when to resolve an issue independently and when to escalate it.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, calendar and virtual meeting platforms, and travel and expense systems; willingness and ability to learn new technologies, including AI-enabled productivity tools.

• Familiarity with expense, procurement, and contracting processes.

Other

Compensation and Benefits

Resolve to Save Lives prides itself on cultivating a supportive, connected remote team doing work that matters. We do everything possible to ensure our employees are connected and set up for success.

The starting salary range for this position is $70,000 to $82,000 annually. The exact offer will be determined by various factors, such as the candidate's skills and experience relative to the requirements of the role.

About Helion

We are a fusion power company based in Everett, WA, with the mission to build the world's first fusion power plant, enabling a future with unlimited clean electricity. Our vision is a world with clean, reliable, and affordable energy for everyone.

Since Helion's founding in 2013, we have raised $1.5 billion from long-time investors such as Sam Altman, Mithril, and Capricorn Investment Group as well as new investors including Thrive Capital, LightSpeed Venture Capital, SoftBank, and others to propel us forward. Our current prototype, Polaris, has reached record-breaking plasma temperatures of 150 million degrees Celsius (13 keV). Helion is continuing to iterate and on the path to the world's first fusion power plant, Orion.

This is a pivotal time to join Helion. You will tackle real-world challenges with a team that prizes urgency, rigor, ownership, and a commitment to delivering hard truths – values essential to achieving what no one has before. Together, we will change the future of energy, because the world can't wait.

Required Skills:

 - Familiarity with electrical systems and high-voltage safety practices

 - Proven ability to execute detailed test procedures safely and efficiently

jobs.title: Manager, Starlink Customer Success (Americas)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

MANAGER, STARLINK CUSTOMER SUCCESS (AMERICAS)

Starlink provides high-speed, low-latency internet to customers around the world. Our enterprise resellers bring Starlink to businesses across a wide range of markets and use cases.

As the Manager, Starlink Customer Success (Americas), you will lead the team responsible for our enterprise reseller business across the United States, Canada, and Latin America. The region includes large, established customers as well as customers expanding Starlink across new countries, sites, and use cases. You will manage Customer Success Managers, Leads, and Specialists and be accountable for the performance and growth of the existing book.

Your team is responsible for growing revenue with existing customers, expanding their use of Starlink across hardware, service, data, and other products, and maintaining strong commercial relationships. Across the Americas, this means operating across different markets, currencies, billing and tax requirements, logistics models, and customer needs while maintaining a consistent commercial strategy.

This is a player-coach role. You will set clear priorities, coach and develop your team, and hold a high bar for performance. You will also stay close to key customers and step into the most important growth opportunities, renewals, payment issues, and escalations. We expect you to know your book, understand where the next opportunities and risks are, and make sure your team follows through.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Lead, hire, and develop a team of Customer Success Managers, Leads, and Specialists across the Americas

• Grow revenue across an existing book of enterprise resellers

• Help the team identify and close opportunities for customers to expand their use of Starlink across hardware, service, data, and products

• Build hardware and service forecasts that leadership can rely on, with a clear view of what will close, what may slip, and why

• Develop a clear view of performance and growth opportunities across the United States, Canada, and Latin America while accounting for differences between markets

• Work through billing, tax, payment, capacity, logistics, and activation issues when they are blocking revenue

• Partner with Sales, Channel Sales, Finance, Tax, Engineering, Operations, Support, and Logistics to move customer opportunities forward

• Align closely with regional Sales and Channel Sales teams so resellers hear a clear and consistent message on Starlink growth priorities

• Identify recurring issues that slow growth and work with the right teams to resolve them at scale

• Stay close enough to the work to know when to coach, when to step in, and when to let the team run independently

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience

• 6+ years in customer success, account management, sales, or another commercial role for a technical product

• 3+ years owning and growing a book of existing customers, with direct responsibility for revenue, retention, or expansion

• 2+ years of direct people management

• Experience managing enterprise customers across multiple markets or countries

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

• Strong track record of growing revenue within existing enterprise accounts

• Experience managing commercial relationships across the United States, Canada, and/or Latin America

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
Infisical is the open source security infrastructure platform that engineers use for secrets management, certificates, and privileged access management. We help developers and organizations securely manage billions of secrets every month including application configuration, database credentials, certificates, and more.



We’ve raised $19M from Y Combinator, Google, and Elad Gil, and our customers include Hugging Face, OpenRouter, LG, and NVIDIA.



Join us on a mission to make security easier for all developers — starting with secrets management. We’re looking to hire exceptional talent to join us in building the open source security infrastructure stack for the AI era.



About the role 

We’re looking for an exceptional Full Stack Engineer to help us build, optimize, and expand the foundation of the platform.

 

We’ve kept our hiring standards exceptionally high since we expect engineers to tackle a broad range of challenges on a day-to-day basis. Examples of past engineering initiatives include developing strategies for secret rotation and dynamic secrets, a gateway to provide secure access to private resources, protocols like EST https://infisical.com/docs/documentation/platform/pki/est and KMIP https://infisical.com/docs/documentation/platform/kms/kmip#kmip-integration, integrations for syncing secrets across cloud providers, and entire new product lines such as Infisical PKI and Infisical PAM.

 

You’ll be working closely with our CTO and the rest of the engineering team to:

 - Develop and maintain features whilst communicating directly with enterprise customers.

 - Expand our newer Infisical PKI https://infisical.com/docs/documentation/platform/pki/overview, Infisical PAM https://infisical.com/docs/documentation/platform/ssh, and Infisical KMS https://infisical.com/docs/documentation/platform/kms/overview product lines.

Requirements

 - Deep technical mastery of the JavaScript ecosystem, particularly React.js, Node.js, and TypeScript.

 - Exceptional attention to detail and eager to learn.

 - A bias toward action—able to make decisions with incomplete information, iterate quickly, and take calculated risks.

 - Based in the Americas (US or Canada), Brazil, India, UK, or EU. Must work US hours.

 

Nice to have 

 - Expertise in Go.

 - Has some understanding of devops/developer tools.

 - Previous founder or startup experience.

 - Previous experience building in open source or developer tools in either a professional or personal setting.

 - Excellent written and oral communication skills to interact with customers directly.

 

Team, values & benefits

Our team brings experience from companies like Databricks, AWS, Red Hat, and more. We operate primarily as a remote team, but maintain a strong presence in San Francisco, where we have an office. We also get together in person throughout the year for off-sites, conferences, and team gatherings.

jobs.title: Head of Recruiting, Communications, Brand, & Marketing
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic's Communications, Brand, and Marketing teams shape how people inside the company and around the world understand AI, its risks, and its benefits. They move fast, often through moments that make headlines. We're looking for a recruiting leader to run the team that hires for them.

In this role you will lead a team of experienced recruiters and be the main recruiting partner to the leaders of these functions and their operations partners. The team is seasoned, and each recruiter brings deep context on the business. From day one you have two first priorities: the team you manage and the leaders you support. You might spend one hour coaching a recruiter through a hard search and the next working with a senior leader on how their organization needs to grow.

Key responsibilities

• Lead, coach, and retain a team of senior recruiters, with a focus on fast and timely feedback

• Build deep trust with the leaders of Communications, Brand, and Marketing. Learn what they need, raise hiring risks early, and push back when the plan and the market don't match.

• Run a tight operation. Own headcount plans, pipeline data, and reporting, and keep them accurate enough that leaders and operations partners can plan from them.

• Use data to show where each search stands, where it is stuck, and what it will take to close.

• Work with the operations partners for these teams on headcount, planning, and priorities, and treat them as true partners.

• Set one consistent process across the team: how a search runs, how interviews are structured, how data stays clean, and how recruiters use our systems and Claude workflows.

• Hire recruiters onto your own team, including specialists in communications and brand hiring.

• Partner with Compensation, Finance, People Partners, and Recruiting Operations so that candidates and hiring teams get a clear, fair process.

You may be a good fit if:

• You have managed recruiters, including senior recruiters, and maintained a strong team culture

• You have been the trusted recruiting partner to senior executives, and you can explain how you earned that trust.

• You run recruiting operations with rigor. You know your numbers, and your headcount and pipeline data hold up when someone checks them.

• You stay steady at a high pace for long stretches, and you keep your team steady too.

• You give and take direct feedback, and you handle hard conversations with care.

• You keep sensitive information confidential and use good judgment on sensitive searches.

Strong candidates may also have:

• 10+ years of recruiting experience, including 5+ years managing recruiters or recruiting managers.

• Experience leading an executive search function, or owning a recruiting portfolio for Communications, Brand, Corporate Affairs, or Marketing.

• Experience supporting leaders whose work is public and high-stakes.

• Experience scaling a recruiting team at a fast-growing company.

• Fluency with recruiting systems and AI tools, and a record of teaching recruiters to use them well.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$295,000—$375,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Assistant Center Director
jobs.description:
Planned Parenthood California Central Coast (PPCCC) is an equal opportunity employer, we welcome all applicants regardless of their race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, and all other protected categories by applicable law.
 
PPCCC is a trusted provider of high-quality, affordable reproductive health care along California’s Central Coast. Each year, PPCCC provides 28,000 people on the central coast with health care services; including sexually transmitted infection testing and treatment, birth control, breast and cervical cancer screenings, vasectomies, and safe and legal abortion care at our six health center locations. PPCCC also provides comprehensive sexuality education programs to help adults and teens make healthy decisions, prevent unintended pregnancies, and avoid sexually transmitted infection.
 


JOB SUMMARY:       
In conjunction with Center Director, implement optimal patient flow by providing or assuring flow facilitation on a daily basis that helps meet productivity performance benchmarks, reduce patient wait times (60 minutes or less) and encourages a positive patient experience at PPCCC. Provides leadership to enhance effective and efficient operations to achieve health center goals.
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
Continuously monitor and prioritize patient wait time. Ongoing triage of Health Center patient and staff workflow by utilizing patient tracking and cycle time tools.
Monitor and minimize wait times.  Constant communication with patients related to wait time.  Offering options to patients and adjusting services as necessary to facilitate excellent patient experience.
Continuously monitor and adjust staff schedules and daily assignments to ensure efficient delivery of service and adequate break/lunch times. This includes the authority to make changes in staffing patterns and/or duties to assure optimum flow and patient satisfaction.
Promote continuous communication between front, back and licensed staff to create and maintain a teamwork approach.
Assure daily communication with Call Center to expand schedules when necessary for walk-in availability and other appointment changes needed.
Incorporates EHR into effective flow management
Ensure exam rooms and supply stations are consistently well stocked
Post and communicate daily assignments.
Participate and lead daily team brief and debrief sessions.  
Support Center Director in training, monitoring, coaching and evaluating staff members. Assist the Center Director with assessment of staff training needs and evaluate staff performance.  Ensures adequate staff is trained to provide flow facilitation.
Become primary staff resource in the absence of the Center Director.
Assume any front or back office duties as necessary.
Ensure compliance with infection control, safety and emergency guidelines.
Assume responsibilities relating to revenue collection, cash handling, patient donations and end of day batch posting & reporting.
Implement policy decisions, convey information to all staff.
Be a resource and provide support to Health Center staff as necessary.
Communicate inventory needs to Center Director.
Other duties as assigned by the Center Director.
SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:
In collaboration with the Center Director provides feedback on non-licensed staff regarding competency and personnel issues. Provide direct supervision and assistance with scheduling, task delegation and coverage planning. Deliver hands-on coaching and on-the-job training to improve performance and offer constructive feedback, document employee progress toward performance goals. Handles direct supervision of ALL clinical staff in the absence of the Center Director. 
QUALIFICATIONS:               
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.  The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
2-3 years’ experience working in a Planned Parenthood health center or equivalent.
Knowledge of reproductive health care.
Skills necessary include: organization, computer skills, including Word and Excel, strong written and verbal communication skills, a sense of responsibility and high level of motivation.
Ability to maintain composure under stress.
Knowledge of community desired.
Ability to multi task, solve problems, function as a leader, work independently and as a member of a team.
Flexibility in working hours, including ability to work evenings and weekends.
Ability to travel as needed.
Must have own reliable transportation
Excellent communication and listening skills.
EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE:
High School diploma, or equivalent.
Experience with Nextgen Practice Management Application is desirable.
Excellent verbal, written, listening, and presentation skills
Ability to research and gather information
Valid California Driver’s license and appropriate insurance;
Must routinely and regularly observe Universal Precautions for blood-borne pathogens.
Other duties as requested

jobs.title: Executive Assistant, Penguin Random House Media Group, On Site North Hollywood, LA
jobs.description:
Penguin Random House seeks an Executive Assistant to support the Penguin Random House Media Group, located in North Hollywood, CA. This is an on-site, in office role.

The Executive Assistant will support the President of Development and Vice President of Development while assisting with the day-to-day development and operations of the newly formed Penguin Random House Media Group, which oversees the development and production of Penguin Random House projects for film and television.

This position requires excellent organizational and administrative skills, strong creative instincts, and a strong working knowledge of the film, television, and publishing industries, including writers, directors, producers, actors, agents, managers, studios, networks, streamers, and production companies. The ideal candidate is highly organized, resourceful, detail-oriented, and passionate about books, film, television, and adaptation. This is an opportunity to work closely with senior development executives while gaining hands-on experience across creative development, project tracking, industry research, and the broader adaptation process.

Knowledge of the publishing industry and media rights is a plus but is not necessary. Must have access to a car and the ability to be in person in the office Monday through Friday working 9:00am-5:00pm PST.

The Role:

• Manage the day-to-day administration of the office and executive desks, including heavy calendars, scheduling, meeting coordination, lunches, conference calls, incoming and outgoing phone calls, and phone logs.

• Anticipate scheduling and administrative needs, track follow-ups, and help executives prioritize competing deadlines and responsibilities.

• Read and evaluate books, comics and graphic novels, scripts, treatments, pitches, and writing samples; provide thoughtful creative feedback and coverage as needed.

• Build company and project pitch decks.

• Manage and coordinate incoming and outgoing project submissions and maintain accurate submission logs, project tracking, and related materials.

• Research writers, directors, producers, actors, and potential producing, studio, network, and streaming partners using industry trades, tracking boards, databases, and professional relationships.

• Maintain development reports, project grids, and other internal tracking documents and participate in weekly development meetings.

• Prepare executives for pitches, meetings, and calls by compiling relevant project, company, talent, and marketplace information; track follow-ups and next steps.

• Monitor industry trades, announcements, and marketplace activity and flag relevant talent, projects, buyers, partners, and trends to the development team.

• Coordinate with PRH publishers, editors, rights teams, and other internal stakeholders to obtain materials and information related to projects under consideration or in development.

• Manage guests and visitors, including providing directions and parking information and greeting guests upon arrival.

• Oversee day-to-day office operations, including coordinating vendors, maintenance and repairs, IT and audio/visual needs, parking, supplies, and facilities-related projects.

• Maintain physical and digital office libraries and files, including books, comics and graphic novels, scripts, company files, and project materials.

• Liaise with other Penguin Random House publishing imprints and divisions regarding publishing contracts, rights information, conventions, book and graphic novel supply, company events, and other internal needs.

• Run occasional business-related errands and provide additional administrative and operational support as needed.

Qualifications:

• Minimum of a year’s experience running a desk at an agency, management company, or production company.

• High level of attention to detail, skilled in managing competing priorities, and ability to produce highly accurate work.

• Strong familiarity with applications like AirTable and Canva.

• Discretion regarding confidential materials.

• Organizational skills and the capability to prioritize and navigate competing deadlines.

• Effective interpersonal communication skills.

• Resourcefulness and ability to anticipate needs.

• Strong creative judgment and the ability to articulate thoughtful opinions about books, scripts, writers, filmmakers, and other creative material.

• Strong follow-up skills and the dexterity to manage a busy inbox and multiple calendars.

• Able to work both independently and as a member of a team.

• Capability and interest in learning new applications.

• Effective written communication skills.

• An avid reader with a genuine passion for books, film, and television and a strong interest in adaptation and development.

• Must have a valid driver’s license, access to a car, and the ability to work in person at the Los Angeles office Monday through Friday.

The Penguin Random House national headquarters is located in New York City. The position is full time, in-office at our Penguin Random House Media Group offices located in North Hollywood with candidates based in the United States who can work primarily on Pacific Time from 9am-5pm PST.

The salary for this position is $55,000. All positions are currently eligible for annual profit award or bonus, subject to Company results.

Applications for this role will be accepted through September or until the role is filled. We encourage you to apply early, as we review applications on a rolling basis. Please include your resume and cover letter for consideration. Before applying for any role at Penguin Random House, we recommend you review our applicant resources page and our FAQs page.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Intern
jobs.description:
What we’re building

The marine industry supports recreation, global commerce, and national defense. And yet it runs on technology that hasn't meaningfully changed in fifty years. Until now.

Arc is on a mission to electrify the marine industry. We're rethinking powertrains, software, and vessel designs from first principles. And we're already executing. We started with consumers to develop and harden our core technology. We’re now scaling production of our flagship model with new models and sectors on the horizon. Now we’re extending our platform to commercial applications, starting with tugs, ferries, and defense, with years worth of signed contracts and a pipeline that spans every vessel type on the water.

The technology is proven, the momentum is building, and the opportunity is enormous. The marine industry is going electric and Arc is building the platform that powers it

Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for someone who’s fired up by our mission and ready to build. You’ll thrive here if you adapt quickly, take ownership, and care about the details.

You will join our Software Engineering team as a summer intern from June 14th-August 20th 2027. You will work from our headquarters in Torrance, CA. Given that we’re a startup, you will be working in a fast-moving, dynamic environment that requires adaptability.

That said, here are some responsibilities and qualifications we expect to stay relatively constant for this role.

What You'll Do

• Contributing to the boat infotainment unit, mobile app, backend, or boat firmware

• Owning a project end-to-end that meaningfully drives the business forward

• Collaborating with members of the software team as well as other stakeholders

Minimum Qualifications

• Familiarity with at least one general purpose programming language

• Strong software development fundamentals

• Productive with standard software development tools (an IDE, git, the command line, etc.)

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

• Eagerness to learn and adapt in a dynamic setting.

• Ability to effectively communicate progress and status of your work

Bonus Qualifications

• Current enrollment in a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree program in Computer Science, or a related field

• Experience with one of: Frontend or mobile development Backend development using Python or Typescript and AWS Firmware development using STM32 microcontrollers

• A track record of successful internships

• Comfortable pushing at a fast but sustainable pace

• Enthusiasm for boating and clean energy

At Arc, we encourage diversity and consider all qualified applicants equally for employment, regardless of background, identity, or status. You’re always welcome to reach out even if you don’t meet many of these qualifications. Passion and aptitude make up for a lot.

What we offer

The base pay for this role is $42 per hour.

Additionally, Arc offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

• Boat days – Yes, we actually go out on the water. A lot.

• Retirement savings — Traditional and Roth 401(k) access

• Safety support — Reimbursement for PPE, ergonomic equipment, and anything that ensures we keep our crew safe

• Relocation Assistance

• Mentorship Opportunities

• Office perks — Daily lunches, snacks, and good coffee while onsite

Our values

We move with urgency and build with care. We value these five things above all else:

• Ownership over both your work and the company’s success

• Empathy for colleagues and for customers

• Humility in problem solving and collaboration

• Pragmatism for navigating ambiguity quickly and sensibly

• Inclusion of different backgrounds, opinions, cultures, and perspectives.

We want people who share and embody these values. It is vital that our values align - we’d be happy to elaborate on any or all of these during the interview process.

Hope to hear from you soon!

The Crew at Arc

LightFeather is seeking a Senior ServiceNow Business Analyst to lead the requirements gathering and process design for our federal agency clients. In this role, you will act as the critical bridge between federal business stakeholders and our technical development teams. You will be responsible for translating complex mission requirements into scalable ServiceNow solutions, ensuring compliance with federal standards, and maintaining the highest quality of data in our backlog.. This is a Full Time, Remote Position.

• Location: Fully Remote (EST hours)

• Job Type: Full-time

• Salary: $110,000–$130,000 annually, based on experience

• Clearance Requirement: U.S. citizenship is required for this position due to federal contract requirements and the need to obtain and maintain a Secret-level security clearance

Responsibilities

• Lead client workshops and focus groups to elicit, analyze, and document business requirements, ensuring alignment with agency mission goals.

• Translate high-level business needs into comprehensive user stories, acceptance criteria (AC), and functional specifications within Agile/Scrum frameworks.

• Conduct gap analysis to identify the delta between current legacy processes and ServiceNow "Out of the Box" (OOTB) functionality.

• Collaborate directly with the Agile Coach to design, document, and distribute new Agile processes and standard operating procedures (SOPs) that support all ServiceNow delivery teams. Ensure these processes drive consistency, efficiency, and alignment across the broader program.

• Review all user stories and requirements for accuracy, completeness, and ambiguity. Ensure every story meets the team's "Definition of Ready" before it is approved for sprint planning.

• Provide guidance and mentorship to junior developers and junior analysts. Help them understand business context, federal domain constraints, and ServiceNow best practices to foster their professional growth.

• Conduct peer reviews of functional designs and test scripts to maintain high standards of quality control across the delivery team.

• Develop detailed process maps, workflows, and data models to visualize end-to-end service delivery.

• Advise government stakeholders on ServiceNow best practices, steering them away from excessive customization that creates technical debt.

• Collaborate with System Architects to ensure functional designs are technically feasible.

• Ensure all solution designs adhere to federal IT standards, including Section 508 compliance (accessibility) and FISMA/NIST security controls.

• Develop and execute User Acceptance Testing (UAT) plans, creating test scripts and coordinating testing sessions with government personnel.

• Create federal-grade deliverables, including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), User Guides, and Training Decks.

Required Qualifications and Skills:

• U.S. Citizenship

• Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret Level security clearance.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field.

• 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, with at least 3 years dedicated to the ServiceNow platform.

• Proven experience working in the federal contracting space (DoD, DHS, or Civilian agencies).

• Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment.

• Deep knowledge of ServiceNow ITSM and at least one other major workflow (e.g., ITOM, HRSD, SPM, ITAM, Custom Applications).

• Strong experience with Jira, ServiceNow Agile, or Azure DevOps for backlog management.

• Proficiency in Visio, LucidChart, or similar tools for process mapping.

• ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) - REQUIRED

Preferred:

• ITIL v4 Foundation (or higher).

• Project Management Professional (PMP) or Agile certifications (CSM, SAFe PO/PM).

Why Join LightFeather?
At LightFeather, you're not just taking a job—you're joining a purpose-driven team that delivers innovative, mission-critical solutions to make a real difference. You'll work on diverse, meaningful projects that challenge and inspire you, alongside some of the best minds in the industry.

jobs.title: Staff Product Design Engineer
jobs.description:
About ALSO.

We’re ALSO, an electric mobility company originally conceived as a part of Rivian. We’re a passionate team of builders, dreamers, doers and innovators, focused on creating entirely new (not to mention, innovative and delightful) vertically integrated, small EVs designed to meet the global mobility challenges of today and tomorrow. Our mission is to inspire everyone to ride ALSO—replacing many local car, truck and SUV miles with ones on vehicles that are more affordable, more enjoyable and 10-50x more efficient.



ALSO is looking for a Staff Product Design Engineer with expertise in wire harness design and manufacturing to design and integrate the electrical wiring, harnesses, connectors, and electromechanical components that power our next-generation light electric vehicles.

As a core member of the early team, you'll help shape vehicle architecture from the ground up on a new, clean-sheet platform, with real influence over key technical decisions as the product scales. Our development pace is rapid, so we're looking for someone who thrives on creativity and can distill complex requirements into elegant, practical design solutions.



What You'll Do

 - Own the development of vehicle-level interconnect diagrams.

 - Collaborate closely with electrical and mechanical engineering teams to define, route, and integrate harnesses into tightly packaged 3D environments.

 - Design wire harnesses using 3D CAD (ideally CATIA), ensuring proper mechanical fit, clearances, install paths, and serviceability.

 - Select appropriate conductors and connectors based on power requirements, signal integrity, and environmental targets—helping to define those targets where needed.

 - Build and modify prototype harnesses using hand tools, 3D-printed parts, and bench equipment; support rapid iteration and debugging.

 - Guide the harness from concept to production, including architecture, design, sourcing, testing, validation, and manufacturing.

 - Work with contract manufacturers to ensure proper build quality, define test protocols, and support root cause analysis of field and production issues.

What You'll Bring

 - 5+ year track record of electromechanical product development with a focus on wire harness assemblies in automotive or robotics applications.

 - Strong engineering fundamentals in the areas of mechanics, materials, thermals, and connector design.

 - Deep expertise in 3D CAD modeling, drafting, GD&T and utilizing PLM systems for doc and release control.

 - Demonstrated success launching components and assemblies with intricate high volume manufacturing processes such as injection molding, stamping, forging, etc..

 - Formal mechanical engineering education with focus on hardware design and development.

 - Experience in root cause analysis, looking at field failures, diagnosing issues.

 

The salary for this position ranges from $180,000 to $230,000 per year, depending on experience and qualifications.



Perks & Benefits

 - Robust health coverage — excellent health, dental and vision insurance covered up to 100% by ALSO with FSA & HSA options

 - One Medical membership and dedicated insurance advocates

 - Rich fertility and family building benefits with Progyny

 - Flexible time off

 - 401(k) match



Why ALSO.

We’re passionate about helping the world find a better way to get there—wherever it is you’re headed.

We’re located in the heart of Silicon Valley and have brought together a world-class team from some of the biggest brands in the technology, automotive, cycling, outdoor recreation and retail spaces. 

Together we’re working hands-on to imagine, design and build an entirely new solution to a global set of transportation challenges.
