jobs.title: Senior Manager, Performance Marketing
jobs.description:
At Evolve, we’re on a mission to make vacation rental easy for everyone. Our high-performing, customer-obsessed team runs on curiosity, communication, and accountability—working together to create exceptional experiences for our owners and guests. Whether solving big challenges, delivering outstanding results, or celebrating wins, we approach every day with purpose and passion. If you’re ready to join a mission-driven company where every teammate has the opportunity to thrive, Evolve might just be the place for you.

Why this role

As Senior Manager of Performance Marketing, you'll own Evolve's paid acquisition program end-to-end — the channel mix, the budget, the campaigns, the creative strategy, and the agency relationships — against a monthly qualified-lead target and a cost per qualified lead. You'll decide where an eight-figure annual media budget goes, and you'll be in the platforms making those decisions yourself. The timing matters; We're winding down a search agency contract and bringing that work in-house, which means you'll be rebuilding the program rather than inheriting a finished one. We're also opening channels Evolve has never run — so a meaningful part of the first year is zero-to-one work.
This is a senior individual-contributor role on a small, flat, high-ownership team. You'll lead through evidence and influence rather than headcount.

The team

Growth owns Evolve's owner-acquisition funnel from first impression to a signed agreement, across five programs: Attract, Convert, Launch, Nurture, and Foundations. This role owns Attract. It's a small team by design, which means less process, more surface area, and a direct line from your decisions to the company's number.

What you’ll do

• Channel Strategy & Budget

• Own paid channel mix and in-month allocation across paid search, paid social, programmatic, direct mail, AI search surfaces, and new test channels — strategy, campaign structure, bidding, budgets, pacing, and performance

• Monitor qualified-lead delivery against plan and forecast, diagnose what's driving it, and decide where the next dollar is most likely to generate efficient volume

• Own the monthly spend and volume inputs to the marketing forecast, and re-plan in-month when delivery moves

• Hands-On Campaign Management

• Be hands-on in the platforms. Google Ads and Meta are yours to build and optimize directly, not to review in a weekly deck

• Build audience strategy across prospecting, retargeting, customer lists, lookalikes, and Evolve's own first-party data on properties, permits, and owners

• Design and analyze structured tests across audience, creative, bidding, placement, geography, and landing destination

• New Channels & Creative

• Launch new channels from zero to one — Performance Max, connected TV, podcast, and an expanded direct mail program — with a plan for how each will be measured before it spends

• Develop paid creative strategy with our creative partners: messaging, format, testing frameworks, and the analysis that decides what scales and what gets cut

• Measurement & Partnership

• Help us build a real read on instrumentality and on the offline channels we currently can't see, and partner on the attribution work behind it

• Partner with analytics, product, and sales on the full funnel from impression to signed agreement

What makes you a great fit

• 7+ years in performance marketing or digital media buying, with hands-on ownership of paid search and paid social campaigns

• Proven experience owning and scaling paid acquisition against CAC, CPA, cost-per-qualified-lead or profitability goals at eight-figure annual media spend

• Deep platform expertise in Google Ads and/or Meta — campaign structure, bidding, budget pacing, audience management, creative testing, and optimization

• Experience setting strategy for an external media agency and holding it accountable on execution, including transitioning work in-house

• Ownership of forecasting — the monthly spend and volume inputs to a marketing plan, and the judgment to re-plan mid-month when delivery moves

• Strong analytical skills — you're comfortable in SQL and a product analytics tool, you interpret channel and funnel data yourself, and you make investment decisions

• Experience developing or executing paid creative strategy — messaging, format, testing, and analysis — in partnership with creative teams or agencies

• AI-native working style — you already use tools like Claude for analysis, creative iteration, and reporting; this is a baseline here, not a differentiator

Compensation

For this role, compensation is based on a base salary plus a department variable annual bonus. Our base salary range is $160,000–$190,000.

Location

All Evolve team members must live in one of our approved locations by their first day. We can hire from anywhere in the U.S. except D.C. and Hawaii. Some positions may also have restrictions based on compensation in the following states: California, Maryland, New York, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, and Washington. If you live in Colorado, you can work remotely anywhere in the state, at our downtown Denver office, or a hybrid of both! If you're planning to move soon, please let us know, and we'll be happy to review your application again.

California Applicant Privacy Policy | Evolve

How we reward Evolvers

We’re intentional about offering benefits that empower every Evolver to thrive both professionally and personally because they’re more than perks—they’re investments in our customer-obsessed, high-performing team.

We believe in treating others as they want to be treated, providing benefits that deliver real value, and challenging the status quo to meet the diverse needs of our team. Whether it’s helping you take care of your health, plan for the future, or celebrate life’s milestones, our offerings are designed to support you every step of the way.

• Financial Wellness: Industry-competitive pay, equity in the company, and a 401(k) with a 4% immediate vesting match.

• Family Support: 16-18 weeks of paid parental leave for birthing parents and 10 weeks for non-birthing parents, plus infertility coverage.

• Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, with 100% employer-paid dental and vision for individual coverage, a low-cost medical option, 10 free mental health visits, and pet insurance.

• Time to Recharge: Generous PTO, RTO (for full-time exempt employees), sick leave, holidays, and a personal holiday to celebrate what matters most to you.

• Travel Perks: Annual Evolve travel credit after one year and discounts on stays at all Evolve properties.

• Growth Opportunities: World-class onboarding programs, learning, and development resources to help you grow your impact.

• Connection: Employee Resource Groups celebrating our diverse communities at Evolve.

How we work together

With our core values as our guide, every Evolver helps shape the company we want to work for and the people we want to be. We’ve cultivated a culture of collaboration, care, and responsibility that we can all be proud of, and we’re excited to see what you’ll bring as your authentic self.

Still curious about who we are and what we do? Read more about our business and our culture at evolve.com.

EEO

At Evolve, we are committed to diversity and inclusion. As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified candidates will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), gender identity or gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, military service or veteran status, physical or mental disability, or any other legally protected characteristic. Evolve participates in e-Verify for all positions.

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: ServiceNow Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
LightFeather is seeking a ServiceNow Platform Engineer to own a new ServiceNow environment for a federal program. This position offers the opportunity to build an environment from the ground up (provisioning, configuration, security hardening, integration enablement, and readiness validation) within a secure federal enclave, and to serve as the platform owner supporting module implementation (including CMDB), platform upgrades, and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate is a hands-on platform expert who is comfortable taking an environment from zero to production and staying with it as it grows.

Major responsibilities include standing up, configuring, securing, and maintaining the ServiceNow platform, establishing the design and administration standards that keep the environment stable, and collaborating with security, infrastructure, and program stakeholders to deliver a compliant, production-ready platform.

• Location: Hybrid in Washington, D.C. 20036

• Job Type: Full-time

• Salary: $180,000–$200,000 annually, based on experience level.

• Clearance Requirement: U.S. citizenship is required for this position due to federal contract requirements. Top Secret clearance is required. Candidates holding an active Secret clearance are encouraged to apply, and LightFeather sponsors an upgrade to Top Secret for the right candidate.

Key Responsibilities

• Stand up and configure a new ServiceNow environment within a secure federal enclave, establishing the instance architecture, baseline configurations, and administration standards

• Install, configure, and maintain MID Servers and establish secure connectivity within the environment

• Configure authentication, authorization, and access management (LDAP/Active Directory, SSO/SAML, role-based access controls)

• Harden the platform in accordance with federal security and operational standards, including NIST and FISMA requirements and applicable DISA STIGs, and support Assessment and Authorization (ATO) activities

• Establish and maintain platform administration baselines, including system properties, plugin activation, instance security settings, and upgrade and patch management processes

• Develop and maintain integrations with enterprise systems using REST/SOAP web services and IntegrationHub, as permitted within the environment

• Support ongoing implementation and optimization of platform modules, including ITSM and CMDB, in collaboration with the broader team

• Maintain update sets, environment documentation, build procedures, and technical design records

• Utilize an Agile/Scrum methodology to manage platform and development work

• Participate in client calls and technical discussions, coordinating with security, infrastructure, and program stakeholders to resolve dependencies and design gaps early

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of hands-on experience administering, configuring, and engineering on the ServiceNow platform

• Demonstrated experience standing up new ServiceNow instances or leading instance-level builds and migrations

• Strong scripting ability (server-side and client-side JavaScript, Glide APIs, Business Rules, Script Includes)

• Experience with MID Server installation and configuration, and with platform integrations using REST/SOAP web services

• ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)

• Familiarity with federal security and compliance frameworks (NIST, FISMA, STIGs)

• Experience working on project teams that leverage Agile/Scrum

• Demonstrable ability to communicate and listen well with business and technical people, regardless of title, with good self-awareness

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior experience in federal or defense contracting environments, particularly in classified, air-gapped, or otherwise isolated networks.

• ServiceNow CAD (Certified Application Developer) or a CIS (Certified Implementation Specialist) certification.

• Hands-on experience with CMDB, ITOM, or Discovery.

• Experience with release coordination, version control, environment management, and automated testing strategies, including the ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF).

jobs.title: Shipping and Receiving Coordinator (Aldinger)
jobs.description:
Position Summary:

The Shipping and Receiving Coordinator is responsible for supporting daily shipping, receiving, packaging, inventory movement, and customer equipment handling. This role helps ensure customer equipment, parts, supplies, and internal materials are received, documented, routed, packaged, and shipped accurately and on time.

The primary focus of this position is to keep material flow organized, accurate, and efficient so office operations, customer service, and production teams can meet turnaround time and customer expectations.

Work Schedule:

This is a full-time position, Mon- Fri. The primary work location will be in the office in Dallas, TX.

Key Responsibilities:

• Receive incoming customer equipment, parts, supplies, and materials.

• Inspect incoming shipments for damage, missing items, or documentation issues.

• Accurately document received items in the appropriate system or tracking log.

• Route received equipment and materials to the correct department, technician, or location.

• Package and prepare outgoing shipments according to company and customer requirements.

• Create shipping labels, packing slips, and related shipment documentation.

• Coordinate daily carrier pickups and deliveries.

• Communicate shipment issues, delays, damages, or missing information to the appropriate manager or team member.

• Help maintain accurate tracking of customer equipment from receipt through shipment.

• Support basic inventory control, material staging, and internal movement of equipment.

• Follow company procedures for handling customer property and sensitive equipment.

• Maintain a clean, safe, and organized work area.

• Assist with other operational support tasks as needed.

Required Qualifications:

• Prior shipping, receiving, warehouse, inventory, or logistics experience preferred.

• Ability to accurately handle paperwork, labels, packing slips, and tracking information.

• Strong attention to detail and organization.

• Ability to lift, move, package, and stage equipment safely.

• Basic computer skills, including email, data entry, and shipment tracking systems.

• Ability to communicate clearly with internal teams, carriers, and customers when needed.

• Reliable transportation.

• Ability to work independently and manage daily priorities.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience working in a calibration lab, manufacturing, aerospace, quality, metrology, or technical service environment.

• Experience handling customer-owned equipment.

• Familiarity with UPS, FedEx, DHL, or other shipping platforms.

• Forklift or pallet jack experience preferred but not required.

• Experience with ERP, CRM, inventory, or service management systems.

Physical Requirements:

• Ability to lift and carry packages or equipment as required.

• Ability to stand, walk, bend, reach, and move materials throughout the workday.

• Ability to safely package and move sensitive or customer-owned equipment.

• Ability to work in warehouse, lab, and office environments.

About Us:

Accredited Labs is a trusted provider of accredited calibration services. Our expertise in precision calibration is marked by innovation, quality, and our dedication to customer satisfaction.

Upon completion of the program and certification, if no ASM or otherwise qualified role is available AND the ST is meeting performance standards, the employee may remain in the ST role up to 12-months OR until an ASM or another qualified role is available (whichever comes first).

If promotion to the role of ACCOUNT SALES MANAGER (or other role) does not happen prior to the expiration of the 12-mos completion period, the SALES TRAINEE role will be vacated due to end of assignment unless an exception applies.

For exception, based on continued high performance, no open roles and certification completion, a manager may extend the 12-month completion period an additional 6-months.

jobs.title: Hardware Test Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a hardware test engineer to design and run tests that ensure our hardware systems perform reliably under real-world conditions. You will be responsible for building and automating test setups, analyzing results, and sharing findings in a clear, useful way. This role is ideal for someone who’s hands-on, detail-oriented, and comfortable working across mechanical, electrical, and software domains.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Drive a wide spectrum of validation efforts—including electrical, mechanical, and reliability to ensure our hardware meets and exceeds engineering and reliability requirements

 - Design and build tests by designing mechanical fixtures and PCBAs, sourcing power supplies, sensors, and other test equipment and automating test equipment, environmental chambers, and DAQ systems

 - Lead root cause and failure analysis on hardware issues to produce actionable test findings

 - Work with large amounts of test data and automate data analysis and anomaly detection

 - Distill complex technical results into high-signal reports that drive critical design decisions across the engineering organization.
   
   


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Electrical Engineering and/or Mechanical Engineering work experience with 2+ years of hands-on experience in test engineering of electromechanical products which run embedded firmware

 - Proficient with Data Acquisition (DAQ) systems, including sensor selection, signal conditioning, and troubleshooting.

 - A proven track record of designing and executing tests that define the limits of mechanical, electrical, and reliability performance.

 - Strong programming skills in Python and/or LabVIEW for instrument control, test sequencing, and data analysis.

 - Uncompromising standards for documentation; you take pride in producing clear, actionable test reports that tell a story with data.




ABOUT THE TEAM

The Hardware Reliability and Test team ensures our equipment exceeds engineering and reliability standards through rigorous mechanical, electrical, and environmental testing at the component, sub-assembly, and system levels. When we find failure points, we leverage data-driven insights to identify root causes and provide actionable improvements and mitigations. We act as a tight feedback loop for the design team, accelerating product maturity and ensuring we deliver a stellar experience for our members.



Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

 - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

 - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.
   
   


DO THE BEST WORK OF YOUR LIFE AT BASE.

jobs.title: CX Operations Manager
jobs.description:
We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!

About the role

Grüns is scaling fast, and our customer experience has to scale with it. As CX Operations Manager, you'll own the systems behind how our support team learns, performs, and improves: the knowledge base, training, QA, and the data that shows us where to act next. You'll partner with our BPO leadership and our AI Lead to make every agent sharper and every customer interaction faster and better.

This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a quarterly basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL.

In this role, you will:

• Own our knowledge base as the single source of truth: accurate, organized, easy to use, and audited on a recurring cadence

• Design and facilitate CX onboarding, training, and continuing education for new and tenured agents, including virtual sessions across time zones, built for every learning style

• Dig into CSAT, NPS, QA, FCR, and AHT data to find gaps in workflows and knowledge, then turn them into specific fixes

• Partner with our internal QA team and BPO leadership on calibrations, 1:1 coaching, and performance improvement plans, serving as the liaison between support leadership and agents

• Build and maintain FAQs and agent macros that drive self-service and agent efficiency

• Work with our AI Lead to identify automation and deflection opportunities, and implement internal tools that improve resolution times and CSAT

We're looking for someone who:

• Has 5+ years in Customer Experience, Support Operations, CX Ops, QA, Training, or Knowledge Management

• Has 2+ years in a managerial role, or an equivalent independent-contributor role with real ownership

• Has worked directly with BPO teams

• Has created and maintained documentation (SOPs, macros, help articles, templates) that a frontline team actually uses

• Has mastered analyzing CX performance reporting: CSAT, quality scoring, contact drivers, first response time, and resolution quality

• Is hands-on with a support platform (Gladly, Zendesk, Gorgias, Intercom, Salesforce Service Cloud, or similar), a knowledge tool (Notion, Confluence, Guru, or similar), and QA workflows (scorecards, sampling, calibration)

• Is strong in Google Workspace and builds trackers and reporting in Sheets with ease (pivot tables, filters, structured logs)

• Bonus: has used AI tools or built AI agents (Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code)

Approach to the role:

• Runs a regimented cadence: sets the rhythm, hits deadlines, and keeps programs moving without reminders

• Obsesses over clarity: writes things so anyone can execute them and removes ambiguity wherever it hides

• Thinks in patterns: spots repeat issues fast, tags them consistently, and turns them into fixes

• Balances customer-first with policy discipline: empathetic and flexible, but grounded in what we can promise and deliver

• Collaborates without creating drag: brings solutions, not noise

• Leads virtual training with a flexible schedule across time zones, and isn't afraid to take an escalation call when it counts

• Owns the outcome with extreme ownership, with no micromanagement needed and always ten steps ahead

Compensation & Benefits

At Grüns, we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package—grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary range is between $100,000 – $110,000 plus bonus depending on experience.

Beyond base salary, we offer competitive equity packages and a comprehensive set of benefits designed to support the well-being, growth, and balance of our team.

A bit about us...

At Grüns, we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you.

Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all.

So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious.

What we care about...

Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation.

Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners.

Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most.

Compensation & Perks:

For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.

Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, AI Agents
jobs.description:
About the Role

Clutch is building a portfolio of AI agents for credit unions — collections (Emma, already sold and live with multiple credit unions), plus new agents in origination, fraud, engagement, and activation. This role owns one of those agents end to end: discovery with members and credit union executives, the first implementations, and the roadmap that follows.

This is not a traditional product management role. You will spend a large share of your time in front of customers — often on site — shaping products that don’t fully exist yet, then staying with them through the first implementations until they actually work in production. The next year is deliberately an experimentation year: listening, prototyping, and learning what credit unions will really adopt.

You will also help decide where each agent lands. Our largest partners will eventually run several agents, each with a different internal owner (a VP of Collections buys very differently than a VP of Lending). Part of the job is judging which agent goes live with which credit union, in what sequence, in collaboration with the other AI PMs — rather than pushing your own agent into every account.



About the Team

You’ll join a small, senior AI product group inside Clutch that operates like a seed stage startup within the company, working shoulder to shoulder with a dedicated AI engineering team and a growing bench of AI engineers.

The team is unusually close to the commercial side. You’ll have a commercial counterpart with more influence on your roadmap than a PM is typically used to, because the way we land and expand these agents is still being invented. You’ll also work alongside AI Ops Managers, who take an agent to scale once it is defined and live with the first one or two customers.

It is a high-ownership, low-process environment: strongly opinionated people, fast decisions, and a lot of ambiguity that you are expected to resolve rather than escalate.



What You’ll Do

Within 1 month, you will:

 - Ramp on the agent portfolio and on the credit unions that matter most over the next six months

 - Rapidly prototype and live trial different agents and use cases.

 - Take ownership of one agent and its roadmap, and build a working relationship with your engineering and commercial counterparts

 - Join customer conversations and go to atleast 2 on-site visits, and start forming your own view of the customer and the product

 - Meet the internal buyers’ counterparts at our largest partners and understand who owns what inside a credit union

Within 3 months, you will:

 - Own discovery for your agent: run customer sessions on site, and turn what you hear into a sequenced roadmap with clear business outcomes. Goal is to ship an agent every 4-6 weeks in production

 - Ship the first version of the integrations your agent depends on (core, loan origination system, CRM), designed to be reused rather than rebuilt per customer

 - Drive at least one net-new product go-live, making key decisions and clarifications that unblock it

 - Work with the other AI PMs to decide which credit unions your agent should launch with, and which should wait

Within 6 months, you will:

 - Have your agent live with multiple credit unions, with data you can show partners to prove it is working

 - Expand the business outcomes your agent is accountable for, beyond the initial use case

 - Hand scaled rollout to AI Ops with documentation and a repeatable integration pattern, while you keep the product roadmap

 - Be trusted to walk into a partner executive conversation alongside commercial counterparts and come out with a decision

What You’ll Bring

In rough priority order:

 - Product sense above all. You have strong product judgement, taste and customer intuition

 - B2B product experience. You have directly managed enterprise customers, negotiated scope, and pushed implementations to completion.

 - AI-forward. You have built something with AI yourself and can demo it. Deep AI research experience is welcome but not required; curiosity plus shipped work is

 - Customer presence. You can run a room with a credit union’s leadership team, on your own, and sell a direction before the product exists

 - Willingness to travel. Expect roughly 20% on average, with stretches of 50% during critical windows. Being on site measurably increases how fast we close customers with direct product coverage and how fast we launch

 - Relentless forward motion. You need to be persuasive and comfortable pushing without authority

 - Top-notch communication, written and live. Fast, clear, high-quality customer responses

 - 7+ years in product management in a fast-paced environment, preferably in B2B SaaS and/or Fintech, Founding backgrounds are strongly welcome

 - Nice to have: financial services or fintech background; experience in or alongside a forward-deployed engineering or product function; hands-on integration work with core banking, LOS, or CRM systems



What’s In It For You?

 - Remote Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of remote work from anywhere, balancing life and career seamlessly.

 - Unforgettable Off-Sites: Twice a year, bond with colleagues in exciting destinations, fostering teamwork and fresh ideas.

 - Paid Time Off: Enjoy flexible PTO days yearly for relaxation and rejuvenation.

 - Stock Options: Joining us means having a stake in our success, so you'll receive stock options as part of your compensation package.

 - Home Office Setup: Create your ideal workspace with a dedicated budget for home office essentials.

 - Work Trip Budget: Grow personally and professionally with a budget for work-related trips and co-working.

 - Health Coverage: Prioritize your well-being with comprehensive health and dental insurance plans.

About Us

Clutch is a revolutionary vertical SaaS company, proudly backed by Andreessen Horowitz (A16z), aimed at revolutionizing the way Credit Unions engage and change the lives of their members. As a champion of financial well-being, we address the urgent need for affordable lending solutions in an era where the average American grapples with over $155,000 in household debt.  Unlike traditional financial institutions, Clutch develops software to turn Credit Unions into FinTech lenders and leverage their balance sheets to responsibly lend to over 130M Americans. Our mission extends beyond mere financial transactions; we strive to fundamentally enhance the way credit unions interact with their members. By integrating cutting-edge technologies and user-centric designs, we help credit unions provide seamless digital experiences that are on par with leading tech companies. This approach not only preserves but revitalizes the longstanding tradition of community and member-focused service inherent to credit unions.

Clutch is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Our organization participates in E-Verify. Click here https://www.e-verify.gov/about-e-verify/what-is-e-verify to learn about E-Verify.

A Note About AI at Clutch
We love AI. We use it often and encourage our team to creatively and effectively leverage AI tools in their work. If you join Clutch, we hope you'll bring the same enthusiasm for exploring how AI can amplify impact, productivity, and innovation.

That said, during the interview process, we want to hear your thoughts. Please approach interviews without the use of AI tools—our goal is to get to know how you think, solve problems, and communicate. Once you're in the seat, bring on the prompts!

jobs.title: Principal Security Engineer, Product & Platform
jobs.description:
Gradial is the marketing operations system of work that helps marketers and creatives move from idea to execution faster. Our platform orchestrates across martech stacks, workflows, and people to automate marketing execution, cutting execution time, so marketers focus on the work only humans can do: shaping brands, understanding customers, and creating the work that moves people.

Backed by leading investors, we’re building software that adapts to the user, not the other way around. We move with urgency, operate with ownership, and solve hard problems from first principles. If you want to do ambitious work, take real responsibility, and help define the future of AI-native content operations, you’ll do your best work here.

The Role

Gradial builds agentic workflow products that operate across complex enterprise environments for Fortune 500 companies. As our first dedicated security engineer, you’ll own product and platform security end to end, shaping how we design, build and operate secure agentic systems at scale. This is a deeply hands-on Principal IC role where you’ll set the technical direction for security, build the systems and controls that matter most and partner closely with engineering as our platform and customer base grow. You’ll work alongside our IT and compliance lead, who owns GRC and corporate IT, and have significant autonomy to determine where security investment will have the greatest impact.

What You’ll Own

• Define and drive Gradial’s product and platform security strategy, prioritizing investments against the risks that matter most as we scale.

• Lead threat modeling for our agentic platform and design protections across agent behavior, permissions, isolation, customer data and platform boundaries.

• Harden our application and cloud infrastructure across production access, IAM, secrets management and the CI/CD supply chain.

• Partner with engineering to build secure-by-default patterns into how agents, services and infrastructure are designed and shipped.

• Own security detection and incident response for the platform, including logging standards, detection coverage and response processes.

• Represent technical security in enterprise customer reviews and architecture discussions, translating our approach clearly to customer security teams.

• Own the technical controls that support SOC 2 in partnership with our IT and compliance lead, ensuring controls are effective in practice as our systems evolve.

• Help shape the future of security at Gradial, including identifying where we need additional capabilities and helping hire future security team members.

What We Need

• 10+ years of experience in security engineering, including Principal or Staff-level ownership across complex production systems.

• Deep product security experience across threat modeling, secure architecture, authentication and authorization and multi-tenant systems.

• Strong hands-on experience with cloud security, Kubernetes, IAM and infrastructure as code.

• A strong technical point of view on securing LLM and agent-based systems, with the ability to reason about emerging risks from first principles.

• Experience leading security incident response for production services and improving systems based on what you learn.

• A track record of writing and shipping production code, security tooling or infrastructure, not just reviewing the work of others.

• Strong judgment and comfort making pragmatic security tradeoffs in fast-moving environments without an established playbook.

• Clear communication with engineers, company leadership and enterprise customer security teams.

Nice to Have

• Experience as an early security hire at a high-growth B2B SaaS, AI or infrastructure company.

• Experience building security detections, telemetry and logging pipelines in cloud environments.

• Experience implementing technical controls for SOC 2 or ISO 27001, or contributing to AI security research, standards or open-source security tooling.

The salary range for this position is $180,000 – $240,000 annually. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, skills, and qualifications.

What we offer

• Performance-based annual bonus

• Meaningful equity awards

• Medical, dental & vision (fully covered for employees with 75% for dependents)

• Fertility & family-planning support

• 401k plan

• Unlimited PTO

• A beautiful Seattle office with a gym, sauna, and bike parking

• Free lunch three days a week in our HQ

• A front-row seat to building category-defining AI infrastructure

You'll thrive here if you

• Learn quickly, actively seek out new challenges, and regularly reconsider “how it’s always been done.”

• Want to have real impact with zero bureaucracy.

• Have an innate drive for being 1% better than the day before, building towards greatness.

• Embrace AI as a core tool for problem-solving, innovation, and scale.

• Show customer-obsession (internal or external), high ownership/accountability, and bias for action.

• Communicate clearly, directly, with curiosity, and assuming good intentions.

• Thrive in fast-paced, hyper-growth environments where building better > maintaining status quo.

AI Literacy & Interviewing Tools

As an AI-first company, we prioritize AI literacy as a core competency in our hiring decisions. We’re excited by candidates who thoughtfully apply AI tools in their work, but during interviews we’re focused on you. This is your opportunity to show how you think, communicate, and solve problems. Over-reliance on AI-generated responses during the interview process (especially when it obscures your own voice) will result in disqualification. We want to understand your unique perspective and how you approach challenges, both with and without AI.

Gradial is dedicated to creating an environment where diverse perspectives are valued and all team members can grow. We offer competitive compensation, equity, flexible work hours, comprehensive benefits, and a collaborative culture focused on learning and impact.

The Role

We're looking for a Research Associate who can find out anything about anything. Leadership will come to you with questions — size this market, map the players in this category, who's funding what, what the landscape looks like for XYZ — and you'll come back with an answer that's clear, well-sourced, and actually useful.

Some weeks that means building a competitive matrix across 40 companies. Some weeks it means a deep dive into a single obscure question nobody has written about yet. The projects change, the subject matter changes, and the volume varies week to week.

You'll be exposed to a lot of different projects and ideas, and work directly with a highly accomplished leader and team. If you're the kind of person who reads everything, asks a lot of questions, and wants to be in the room with people operating at a very high level, this is built for you.

What You'll Do

 - Run open-ended research projects using the internet as your primary tool: markets, products, companies, funding activity, competitive landscapes, people, technologies, regulation — whatever the question requires.

 - Turn messy findings into clean outputs: matrices, comparison tables, briefs, landscape maps, one-pagers.

 - Go deep enough to have a point of view, not just a link dump — flag what matters, what's uncertain, and what you'd look at next.

 - Use AI tools aggressively to move faster and go wider than a person could alone.

 - Build lightweight tools, scrapers, or trackers when a project calls for it.

 - Juggle several unrelated requests at once and reprioritize when things shift.

What We're Looking For

 - 0–2 years of experience and a bachelor's degree — a recent grad with strong internship experience and real drive, or 1–2 years into your career and looking for a bigger scope than you have today.

 - Brain power: sharp, curious, and able to reason through a question you've never seen before.

 - AI-native: You live in AI tools — Claude and Cowork, ChatGPT, Gemini, Hugging Face, whatever's newest. Ideally you can vibe code your way to a working script or prototype without waiting on an engineer. Bonus points if you've hit your usage limit more than once.

 - Comfortable in ambiguity: Vague briefs don't paralyze you. You take a first pass, come back with questions, and iterate.

 - Self-directed but coachable: You think independently, but you want to learn from people far ahead of you and take direction well.

 - Startup-minded: You're not looking for a corporate ladder. You want interesting problems, smart people, and range.

 - A strong writer: Your research is only as good as your ability to communicate it in a page or less.

Compensation & Benefits

 - Salary: The anticipated base salary range for this position is $80,000-$110,000. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, level, and location.

 - Benefits: Generous benefits package including medical, dental, and vision, 401(k) matching

 - Location: Can be remote in the US, with significant travel to Los Angeles

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

We are a private design studio that builds and supports a portfolio of companies and projects across software, hardware, hospitality, and more. Some of what we build stays in house; some spins out. We also run an early-stage investment fund and an accompanying cohort program for founders. This company is not Expa, but is an affiliate of Expa's.

The Role

We are looking for an Operations Manager who treats operations as a product rather than a back office — someone who builds the infrastructure that lets a small team and a changing set of projects move quickly without breaking things.

The role is weighted toward our fund and cohort program, which will take roughly 60% of your time. The other 40% supports the rest of the portfolio: reviewing the monthly financials, keeping budgets honest, handling insurance and registrations, routing work between legal, finance, and engineering, and making sure each project gets set up properly and stays ahead of what it owes. Most of our project leads are engineers, and designers focused on their product. You are the person who notices the insurance renewal, the registration deadline, or the contract that never got countersigned — and gets it handled.

This is a mid-senior, self-directed seat. You will own the operations function rather than staff it. We are a small team and we are not going to hand you a queue — we are looking for someone who sets the priorities, makes most of the calls themselves, and has the judgment to know which decisions to make and move on, which to make and then tell us about, and which to bring to us first.

What You’ll Do

 - Fund and program operations: Support the fundraising process operationally, maintain investor tracking and the program budget, and manage payment milestones for participating companies.

 - Founder support: Help early-stage companies get spun up and hold them accountable to their timelines and milestones.

 - Financial review and budget: Review monthly financials with our outside accountants and keep budgets current across the studio and each project — flagging variances early rather than at quarter end. Update opex based on monthly trends.

 - Insurance: Own insurance end to end for each new project and entity — applications, quote review, underwriting, renewals, and certificates — working directly with our broker.

 - Operating rhythm: Own agendas, inputs, and follow-ups for the weekly operations meeting, pipeline review, and monthly business review.

 - Project onboarding and offboarding: Get new teams set up with the tools, accounts, and administrative support they need on day one, and support clean close-outs when a project ends.

 - Legal coordination: Coordinate between project teams and outside counsel on trademarks, patents, terms and privacy policies, consulting agreements, and NDAs — and track each to completion.

 - Entity and vendor setup: Registrations, compliance agents, and third-party services across entities and project websites.

 - Check-ins and escalation: Meet regularly with each project lead, track open threads to closure, and surface to leadership what they need to see with enough context to act on.

 - First point of contact: Be the default person teams come to — answering, or pointing to the right owner.

 - Events and programming: Plan and run events and professional development programming.

What We’re Looking For

 - 4-8+ years of experience in operations, chief of staff, or program management roles, with meaningful time inside a venture fund, private equity firm, accelerator, or startup. We care more about how you operate than about the number — what matters is having built the judgment to move things forward without being told to.

 - Independent operator: You run your own function. You do not need a queue handed to you, and you are comfortable being the one who decides when nobody else is going to.

 - Good judgment about the decision ladder: You can tell the difference between a call to make and move on, a call to make and then tell us about, and a call to bring to us first — and you get that right most of the time.

 - Thrives in ambiguity: Comfortable starting before the process exists, writing the manual rather than waiting for one, and rewriting it when the portfolio changes shape.

 - Financial fluency: You can read a monthly P&L, hold outside accountants to a close calendar, build and maintain budgets, and spot the number that looks wrong.

 - Fund and entity administration: Comfort with entity setup, insurance, registrations, and working alongside outside counsel and accountants.

 - An instinct for other people’s blind spots: You notice what is about to be missed, what is coming around the corner, and raise it early.

 - Tech savvy and fluent in Mac OS and Google Suite (Calendar/Drive/Sheets/Docs).

 - Trustworthy and discreet: A clear understanding of confidentiality and how to carry it in every setting. This matters to us more than most things.

 - Professional and personable: Excellent verbal communication and the ability to build relationships across very different teams.

Compensation & Benefits

 - Salary: The anticipated base salary range for this position is $170,000-$225,000. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, level, and location.

 - Benefits: Generous benefits package including medical, dental, and vision, 401(k) matching

 - Location: Can be remote in the US, with significant travel to Los Angeles

jobs.title: Field Reliability Technician
jobs.description:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

When hardware fails in the field, it comes back to you. You'll open it up, run the tests, and help engineers  figure out exactly what broke and why. Your findings feed directly into design changes, firmware fixes, and line improvements on a product that's already deployed in thousands of homes.

 

This is hands-on work in a lab that moves fast. You'll build the tools and processes that make failure analysis faster and more reliable, and you'll be the person who keeps that lab running safely and well.

 
 

What You’ll Do

 

 - Hardware Testing: Test field-returned hardware and assist engineers with root cause analysis to figure out why the hardware failed and how it can be improved.

 - Build and maintain tooling: Make improvements to processes and test equipment used to triage field returns. Own the process and make it better.

 - Safety and Cleanliness of space: Ensure the lab environment is safe. Maintain and enforce a clean and organized workspace.

 - Project Coordination: Help track testing throughput, results, and flag new quality issues to engineers. Ensure the engineering team has the necessary context they need to prioritize changes or process improvements in firmware, on the product, or on or the line.

 

What You'll Bring

 

 - High School diploma or equivalent required - prefer associates degree or higher in Engineering Technology, Industrial Technology, or a related field.

 - Experience in an engineering or technical environment, providing hands-on support for design, testing, and assembly of equipment. Experience working with multimeters and power supplies is a must.

 - Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks.

 - Proficiency with office software (Microsoft Office Suite, Google Workspace) and basic IT troubleshooting.

 - Experience with tools and equipment used in an engineering lab or workshop.

 - Good communication skills, with the ability to work well with engineers, vendors, and other office staff.

 - Strong attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem-solving and task management.

 - Curiosity about how things work and a desire to deeply understand the hardware you are testing.

 

About this Team



The Hardware Reliability and Test team ensures our equipment exceeds engineering and reliability standards through rigorous mechanical, electrical, and environmental testing at the component, sub-assembly, and system levels. When we find failure points, we leverage data-driven insights to identify root causes and provide actionable improvements and mitigations. We act as a tight feedback loop for the design team, accelerating product maturity and ensuring we deliver a stellar experience for our members.



Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

 - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

 - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.
   
   


DO THE BEST WORK OF YOUR LIFE AT BASE.

jobs.title: Aerothermal Engineer I
jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we’re building rockets to serve today’s needs and tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

About the Team:

Relativity’s Integrated Performance teams ensure that our products work across all systems and disciplines, from trajectory design to aerodynamics to reliability analysis and beyond. Our groups size the Terran R rocket, design its missions for customer success, reliability, and reusability, and ensure that every system on the rocket and ground is engineered correctly for the demanding environments of launch and entry. Recently, we completed the preliminary design and analysis of Terran R including Relativity’s first-ever work on launch vehicle reusability, spanning advanced trajectory simulations, wind tunnel testing, and structures analysis, among many other projects.

About the Role:

• Develop and execute computational fluid dynamics (CFD) analyses to solve novel challenges in vehicle entry heating and supersonic retropropulsion

• Drive the design of major Terran R system elements – like fins, flaps, heat shields, and primary structure – to meet criteria for temperature and heating

• Guide and mentor responsible hardware engineers to ensure hardware meets aerothermal requirements

• Scope and develop aerothermal databases for ascent and entry, including uncertainty quantification, from multiple sources like CFD, empirical methods, and wind tunnel testing

• Size thermal protection systems (TPS) for flight

• Support re-usable TPS material development and testing

• Mature Relativity’s tools for developing and communicating aerothermal data, including custom and commercial code, databases, and data processing tools

To be successful in this role, you should be self-motivated, adaptable, and able to contribute significantly to a fast-paced, integrated vehicle program. You should also be able to resolve ambiguity and drive projects to completion. Ideally, you have significant compressible flow, CFD, thermal analysis, and conjugate heat transfer experience as well as a proven track record completing projects successfully in a highly collaborative environment.

On a weekly basis, you will be performing analysis, developing software tools, and supporting design teams. You will also use your strong organizational skills to properly manage the documentation and communication of your actions, recommendations, and decisions.

About You:

• Undergraduate degree in engineering or related field

• 2+ years relevant experience

• Proficiency in compressible flow and thermal analysis, preferably on entry vehicles

• Experience executing CFD workflows for external flow, preferably including engine plume simulation

• Experience solving cross-disciplinary design problems on integrated vehicles

• Proficiency in Python and industry-standard CFD tools like FUN3D and Star-CCM+, including use of HPC clusters

Nice to Haves, but Not Required:

• Graduate degree in engineering or related field

• 5+ years relevant experience across 1 or more program lifecycles

• Experience with thermal protection system sizing & analysis using standard tools like FIAT, CHAR, MINIVER, or LAURA

• Exposure to aerothermal instrumentation, wind tunnel and flight testing

At Relativity Space, we are committed to transparency and fairness in our compensation practices. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

Compensation is only one part of our total rewards package. Relativity Space offers competitive salary and equity, a generous PTO and sick leave policy, parental leave, an annual learning and development stipend, and more! To see some of the benefits & perks we offer, please visit here.

$90,000—$136,000 USD

jobs.title: Deployment & Training Manager, Commercial
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Team

Anduril's Air Defense team builds robots that find other robots and knock them out of the sky. At a time when air superiority can no longer be taken for granted, we provide mission critical capabilities to warfighters. From detection to tracking, identification, deterrence, and defeat, our family of networked sensors and effectors enables our customers to rapidly close the kill chain against a broad range of UAS threats. Working across product, engineering, sales, logistics, operations, and mission success, the Air Defense team develops, tests, deploys, and sustains our Family of Systems (FoS) in challenging operational environments worldwide.

About the Job

As a Deployment and Training Lead on the Air Defense team, you are responsible for delivering, training, and sustaining a capability that meets our customers' mission requirements and exceeds their expectations. You own the full lifecycle of a deployment — from planning and installation through new equipment training, sustainment, and continuous improvement. You fulfill this responsibility through rigorous operational execution, detail orientation, proactive communication, deep mission understanding, and hard-won product expertise.

You feel ownership over the health and performance of all assets and technologies deployed to your customers and users, and ensure that the system delivers when they need it most. You are equally invested in ensuring that end users are trained, confident, and proficient in employing the capability. You deliver world-class New Equipment Training (NET) and sustainment training programs that let our customers organically grow and maintain proficiency long after the initial fielding. You identify knowledge gaps and build solutions that drive user proficiency and enduring operational readiness.

You represent Anduril to our customers, building their confidence and trust through your professionalism and commitment to excellence. You also represent our customers back to Anduril, communicating user feedback and lessons learned to continuously improve our product and our team in response to evolving mission needs. Above all, you set the standard for what good looks like for your deployment, and you rally your Anduril teammates to meet that standard every single day.

In this role, you will manage deployments and the associated training enterprise for Anduril's Air Defense products across a region, ensuring mission readiness in support of national security infrastructure. Collaborating closely with the Program Manager and Program Operations Manager, you will play a crucial role in developing long-term deployment, training, and sustainment operations aligned with customer priorities. As a key team member, you will engage across multiple business lines and facilitate customer interactions, making flexibility, humility, and a collaborative mindset essential qualities for success.

What You'll Do

• Deployment planning and execution: We execute hundreds of deployment events each year, including site installations, test and evaluation exercises, demonstrations, and training and maintenance visits. You will orchestrate these events, leading a cross-functional team that spans hardware supply, logistics, engineering, and more to do whatever it takes to achieve mission success for Anduril and our customers. Meticulous, resourceful, and detail-oriented, you will manage every step of the deployment process, from site survey to testing, pack-out, installation, training, and sustainment. No job is too small. You consistently demonstrate extraordinary judgment, grit, and composure in high-pressure situations. You anticipate every contingency, build lightweight processes, soberly assess and mitigate risk, and deliberately learn from your experiences to continuously improve.

• New Equipment Training (NET) delivery: You own the NET mission for your deployments. You resource, develop and deliver the initial fielding training that takes customers from zero to operational proficiency on the Anduril Air Defense Family of Systems — building programs of instruction, training schedules, and hands-on individual and collective events tailored to each customer's mission and skill baseline. You ensure every customer that receives our capability is ready to employ it from day one.

• Sustainment training and readiness: Beyond initial fielding, you build and run the recurring sustainment training that keeps proficiency high as personnel rotate, threats evolve, and product capabilities advance. You establish training gates, proficiency standards, and refresh cycles; you plan and resource realistic sustainment events; and you measure your success by the enduring operational readiness of the forces you support.

• Relationship management: Build trust with customers, industry partners, users, and Anduril teammates through effective communication, positive attitude, and follow-through. With careful listening and observation, you internalize your counterpart's priorities and requirements. With empathy and responsiveness, you quickly build rapport, trust, and confidence in our capability. You develop relationships across the organization and communicate honestly and directly. You are committed to giving and receiving feedback well. Your partners always know what you expect from them, and know exactly what to expect from you.

• Mission expertise: Develop a deep knowledge of your customer's mission requirements, including the nature of the threats they face, regulatory challenges, resource constraints, rules of engagement, and more. You will become a subject matter expert and the voice of the customer, capable of effectively communicating requirements and CONOPS to Anduril engineers so they can continue to enhance our capability to meet evolving mission needs. You serve as the counter unmanned systems (cUAS) subject matter expert for your customers, helping them resource realistic training and manage all hardware and software configurations for cUAS-peculiar equipment. You are deeply motivated to shape the future of air defense.

• Product expertise: Develop a thorough understanding of the capabilities and limitations of Anduril's Family of Systems. You are innately curious about the technology underpinning our capability, and are not satisfied with a superficial understanding of how and why it works. You are constantly educating yourself about the strengths and weaknesses of different sensor modalities, the challenges of sensor fusion, power and networking requirements, and more. You will become an opinionated power user who can reliably forecast how our capability will perform against a broad range of threat profiles, environmental conditions, and mission constraints.

Required Qualifications

• Advanced degree or 5+ years of experience in a technical field, preferably in the defense, national security, or aerospace domain

• Proven experience planning and delivering technical training programs, including new equipment training (NET) and sustainment training

• Highly organized creative problem-solver with proven project management skills

• Experienced in the creation and upkeep of documentation for new or developing processes, including training curricula and programs of instruction

• Proven experience leading tech-enabled teams of peers while building a culture of influence through relationships

• Deep interest in national security issues and defense technologies, with a commitment to lifelong learning

• Experience translating technical concepts into operational requirements, performance specifications, and training materials

• Ownership mentality with strong initiative in managing your own work in potentially remote environments

• Comfort communicating complex concepts simply across various methods of communication and tools

• Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize tasks effectively

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance; Top Secret preferred

• Willing to travel up to 50% of the time, primarily regional travel across assigned deployment and training sites

Preferred Qualifications

• Operational experience delivering defense technology solutions to USG customers

• Prior military experience, particularly in Air Defense, Fires, or related operational roles

• Project Management Professional Certification

• Experience designing Train-the-Trainer or instructor-certification programs that build customer self-sufficiency

• Active U.S. Top Secret security clearance

US Salary Range

$146,000—$194,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager (Enterprise)
jobs.description:
The Role

The Senior Project Manager leads some of Plexus' most complex and strategically important initiatives, translating business priorities into actionable plans and guiding cross-functional teams from initial strategy through implementation and measurable results. This role manages scope, schedule, budget, resources, quality, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and change while maintaining clear accountability across the project team.

As a Senior Project Manager, you will work directly with executive sponsors and business leaders to bring structure to ambiguous challenges, influence key decisions, and maintain alignment across functions and markets. You will have the ownership and visibility to shape how critical initiatives are delivered, strengthen EPMO practices, and mentor other project professionals.

Employee Value Proposition

This is an opportunity for an accomplished project leader who wants to move beyond managing individual project plans and have a broader influence on how the organization delivers its most important priorities. You will lead complex, highly visible initiatives, partner directly with senior leaders, and help turn strategy into disciplined execution. The role offers meaningful ownership, broad cross-functional exposure, and the opportunity to strengthen enterprise project management capabilities while delivering measurable business outcomes.

Key Performance Objectives

• Establish credibility and ownership within the first 90 days by learning the business, understanding priority initiatives, building relationships with executive sponsors and project teams, and creating clear visibility into project health.

• Create disciplined and predictable project execution through clear scope, deliverable-based schedules, decision rights, governance, risk management, and consistent reporting.

• Deliver priority initiatives from planning through implementation and closeout while achieving approved business objectives, success measures, and readiness requirements.

• Build strong relationships with stakeholders across departments, markets, and organizational levels while resolving competing priorities and maintaining alignment.

• Strengthen EPMO capabilities by applying consistent standards, recommending practical improvements, and mentoring project professionals in effective delivery practices.

Performance Accountabilities

End-to-End Project Delivery

• Manage all aspects of project delivery, including scope, schedule, budget, resources, quality, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, change requests, and stakeholder communications.

• Build and maintain detailed, deliverable-based project schedules with clear baselines, dependencies, critical paths, resource constraints, milestones, and recovery plans.

• Establish clear roles, responsibilities, decision rights, and accountability while leading planning sessions, working meetings, status reviews, steering meetings, readiness reviews, go-live activities, retrospectives, and lessons-learned sessions.

Risk, Change & Executive Governance

• Maintain accurate and current project documentation, including schedules, status reports, financial information, risk and issue registers, decision logs, action items, and change requests.

• Identify risks and issues early, assign accountable owners, develop mitigation and contingency strategies, and escalate matters requiring leadership action or decisions.

• Evaluate proposed changes to scope, schedule, budget, resources, or expected outcomes; facilitate the change-control process; and provide concise, decision-ready updates on project health, milestones, financial considerations, resource constraints, and required decisions.

Stakeholder, Vendor & Implementation Readiness

• Manage stakeholder relationships across departments, markets, and organizational levels while resolving competing priorities and partnering with business, digital product, technology, operations, finance, legal, compliance, marketing, sales, and other functions.

• Coordinate third-party vendors and external partners to keep contractual deliverables, timelines, costs, dependencies, and performance expectations aligned with the project plan.

• Incorporate business processes, communications, training, operational support, transition requirements, acceptance criteria, executive approvals, and readiness activities into implementation and go-live plans.

• Measure project results against approved objectives and success metrics, complete post-launch closeout, and transition outstanding actions to accountable business owners before closure.

EPMO Leadership & Continuous Improvement

• Apply EPMO methodologies, governance standards, templates, tools, and reporting requirements consistently while recommending improvements based on project experience and organizational needs.

• Contribute to portfolio planning, process improvement, governance development, and other strategic initiatives that advance enterprise project management capabilities.

• Mentor Project Managers, Project Specialists, and other team members through coaching, knowledge sharing, and reinforcement of best practices while fostering collaboration, accountability, transparency, and mutual respect.

Performance Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s degree in project management, Business Management, or related field.

Experience: 5-6 years of demonstrated project management experience, including ownership of complex, cross-functional initiatives from initiation through implementation and closeout.

Certifications: A PMP is required

Schedule Management: Demonstrated ability to build and manage detailed, deliverable-based schedules, including baselines, dependencies, critical paths, resource constraints, and recovery plans.

Implementation & Go-Live: Experience leading implementation readiness and go-live activities, including acceptance criteria, executive approvals, communications, training, operational transition, and post-launch closeout.

Delivery Approaches: Working knowledge of predictive, Agile, Scrum, and hybrid approaches, with the judgment to select the right delivery method for the initiative.

Enterprise Execution: Experience managing multiple concurrent initiatives across scope, schedule, budget, resources, risks, issues, quality, decisions, and change.

Executive Communication & Influence: Ability to convert complex information into concise, decision-ready updates, influence without direct authority, hold partners accountable, resolve competing priorities, and escalate appropriately.

Risk Management: Evidence of proactively anticipating problems, assigning accountable owners, developing mitigation and contingency plans, and addressing risks before they affect delivery.

Availability: Willingness to support occasional evening, weekend, or holiday implementations when business needs require it.

About Plexus

Founded in gut health. Experts in microbiome. Plexus Worldwide®, headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, is a renowned direct-selling company recognized as a top employer. Over the past 18 years, Plexus has dedicated itself to promoting hope, health, and happiness through its scientifically backed, innovative dietary supplements, weight management products, and personal care products, sold primarily through Plexus Brand Ambassadors. As a six-time Best Places to Work awardee, Blue Zone-approved employer, and an AZ Most Admired Company, Plexus prides itself on its robust organizational culture and commitment to community support and philanthropy. Our team is driven by a shared mission to empower individuals to achieve their health and wellness goals while offering additional income through the sale of products. Join us to be part of a team that values people, innovation, wellness, and community impact.

Benefits

• Highly rated and competitive medical plans.

• 401 (k) with company match and immediate vesting.

• 1-on-1, personalized health coaching.

• Many other voluntary benefits.

To learn more about Plexus Worldwide, please review our careers page at www.plexusworldwide.com/careers.

Learn more about our One Plexus culture. Watch this short video to see how our values, people, and purpose come together to make Plexus a great place to grow and make an impact. https://plexusworldwide-1.wistia.com/medias/zhfpm3vi4o.

Thank you for taking the time to apply for an opportunity with our One Plexus team! If you had any issues during the application process, please get in touch with us directly at careers@plexusworldwide.com.

We are committed to protecting the privacy and security of your information. Visit our Candidate Privacy Notice for additional information.
