jobs.title: Sr. Customer Success Manager - Government
jobs.description:
Propelus® simplifies workforce compliance management across healthcare. Our innovative technology and strategic partnerships empower millions of professionals, their employers, and regulators to work together, creating a connected and efficient healthcare ecosystem.

As a trusted leader for over 20 years, Propelus has focused on bringing more good into the lives of the people and organizations serving healthcare. We deliver seamless compliance solutions to millions. We leverage market-leading technology and essential data to simplify complex operations, reduce risk, and champion a safer, healthier, and happier workforce.



The Senior Customer Success Manager (Government) is a strategic role designed for an expert navigator of the public sector where your work will make an a huge difference in nurses. You will act as the primary, strategic partner for our most complex clients, including government regulatory boards, regulators, departments of health, state agencies, and associations. This will require creating the tactics and adapting your approach to match the needs and goals of your stakeholders. 

Success is defined by how effectively our technology supports the mission-critical mandates of public safety and professional integrity. You will take end-to-end ownership of the customer lifecycle, align our platform with agency missions, drive measurable compliance outcomes, and ensure sustained value realization across your portfolio..

 

What You’ll Do

 - Strategic Relationship Management: Serve as the primary owner for a portfolio of government regulatory boards and state agencies, building trusted relationships with Executive Directors and state officials to ensure long-term stability.

 - Mission-Aligned Strategy: Develop the plans that align our technology with the specific agency mandates, Department of Health regulations, and public-sector risk management priorities.

 - Regulatory Enablement: Lead customized training programs that empower staff within regulators and associations to fully utilize the platform for audit readiness and governance excellence.

 - Health & Usage Monitoring: Take end-to-end ownership of monitoring engagement metrics, translating data into "State of the Agency" insights that demonstrate sustained value and support long-term retention, and identify any potential problems that our solutions will help avoid. 

 - Complex Issue Triage: Act as the lead problem-solver for complex account hurdles, collaborating with internal product and government affairs teams, navigating the unique requirements of the ever changing government landscape.

 - Business Reviews: Conduct high-level strategic reviews to assess progress, identifying opportunities to deepen the partnership and improve compliance outcomes for regulators and boards.

 

We'd Love It If You Had: 

 - SaaS Government Expertise: 5+ years of B2B SaaS Customer Success or Account Management experience 
   
   - Specifically managing government, regulatory, or public health accounts
   
   - You understand the red tape, the RFP cycles, and the unique stakeholders of the public sector

 - Direct experience with healthcare compliance, state departments of health, or professional licensing is strongly preferred
   
   - You are comfortable speaking the language of regulators and state officials

 - A self-sufficient professional who thrives in a remote environment
   
   - You will be taking over a complex book of business and navigating multi-layered organizations with limited oversight

 - Exceptional ability to communicate with non-technical government leaders. 
   
   - You can distill complex software capabilities into a clear vision that aligns with public policy goals.

 - A problem-solver who can identify a potential churn risk a year in advance and build the strategic rapport necessary to save the relationship.

It Would Be Great If You Had: 

 - Experience mentioning team members and external stakeholders 

 - Familiarity with Gainsight and HubSpot and Omni

 - Comfortably with change and ability to navigate from one priority to the next seamlessly, without finalized playbooks to help direct your approach

If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. We're building the best team in healthcare and are focused on hiring individuals with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to support us in doing good, what’s human, and making a difference.

 - Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA): We support personal well-being by offering an annual lifestyle spending account that you can use for what matters most to you—whether it’s a gym membership, a meditation app, WFH equipment, or fresh produce delivered to your door. Think of it as a bonus for the expenses and experiences you value most.

A remote first company, global and distributed, with two office locations for those nearby who want a change of scenery.

jobs.title: Electrical Hardware Engineering Intern
jobs.description:
What we’re building

The marine industry supports recreation, global commerce, and national defense. And yet it runs on technology that hasn't meaningfully changed in fifty years. Until now.

Arc is on a mission to electrify the marine industry. We're rethinking powertrains, software, and vessel designs from first principles. And we're already executing. We started with consumers to develop and harden our core technology. We’re now scaling production of our flagship model with new models and sectors on the horizon. Now we’re extending our platform to commercial applications, starting with tugs, ferries, and defense, with years worth of signed contracts and a pipeline that spans every vessel type on the water.

The technology is proven, the momentum is building, and the opportunity is enormous. The marine industry is going electric and Arc is building the platform that powers it

Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for someone who’s fired up by our mission and ready to build. You’ll thrive here if you adapt quickly, take ownership, and care about the details.

You will join our Electrical Engineering team as a summer intern from June 14th-August 20th 2027. You will work from our headquarters in Torrance, CA. Given that we’re a startup, you will be working in a fast-moving, dynamic environment that requires adaptability. That said, here are some responsibilities and qualifications we expect to stay relatively constant for this role.

What You'll Do

• Supporting schematic capture, PCB layout, and design documentation for new and existing hardware.

• Testing and validating electrical assemblies through bench bring-up, measurements, and troubleshooting.

• Collaborating with engineers to prototype, debug, and iterate on circuit designs and system integrations.

Minimum Qualifications

• Current enrollment in a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree program in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field. Targeting graduation in Summer 2028 or earlier.

• Strong electrical engineering fundamentals.

• Familiarity with circuit design and simulation tools (e.g., Altium, KiCad, LTspice, or similar).

• Hands-on experience with electronics testing tools such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, and power supplies.

• Proven analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

• Eagerness to learn and adapt in a dynamic setting.

• Ability to effectively communicate progress and status of your work

Bonus Qualifications

• Experience with one or more of the following:

• A track record of successful internships

• Enthusiasm for boating and clean energy

• Comfortable pushing a fast but sustainable pace

At Arc, we encourage diversity and consider all qualified applicants equally for employment, regardless of background, identity, or status. You’re always welcome to reach out even if you don’t meet many of these qualifications. Passion and aptitude make up for a lot.

What we offer

The base pay for this role is $40 per hour.

Additionally, Arc offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

• Boat days – Yes, we actually go out on the water. A lot.

• Retirement savings — Traditional and Roth 401(k) access

• Safety support — Reimbursement for PPE, ergonomic equipment, and anything that ensures we keep our crew safe

• Relocation Assistance

• Mentorship Opportunities

• Office perks — Daily lunches, snacks, and good coffee while onsite

Our values

We move with urgency and build with care. We value these five things above all else:

• Ownership over both your work and the company’s success

• Empathy for colleagues and for customers

• Humility in problem solving and collaboration

• Pragmatism for navigating ambiguity quickly and sensibly

• Inclusion of different backgrounds, opinions, cultures, and perspectives.

We want people who share and embody these values. It is vital that our values align - we’d be happy to elaborate on any or all of these during the interview process.

As we continue to grow and seek to impact more lives, we’re building a diverse, driven and empathetic team, while working hard to cultivate an environment where everyone can thrive.

• Continuous learning during weekly Clinical Rounds and through other modalities

• Ongoing collaboration with in-office teammates via daily huddles, as well as with virtual clinical teams

• Utilization of your specific clinical training and opportunities to perform in-office procedures

Education, licenses, and experiences required for this role:

Taking care of you today

Our Acute Behavioral Services (ABS) group homes support individuals with complex mental health and behavioral needs. jobs.title: Information System Security Engineer (ISSE)
jobs.description:
Dark Wolf is seeking a Senior Cybersecurity Engineer to join a collaborative team to develop, manage, and maintain the security posture within a series of secure, air-gapped development enclaves with a focus on continuous exposure management, RMF lifecycle management, and Authorization to Operate (ATO) support. The successful candidate will support your team and customer through advanced technical evaluations, security controls development and implementation, and comprehensive ATO management ensuring high standards of security and compliance. This position requires TS/SCI eligibility and will be based out of the Omaha, Nebraska area with a full-time on-site requirement at Offutt AFB. Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

• Designing, testing, and implementing secure operating systems, networks, security monitoring, tuning and management of IT security systems and applications, incident response, digital forensics, loss prevention, and eDiscovery actions.

• Conducting risk and vulnerability assessment at the network, system and application level.

• Leveraging AI-assisted RMF tools to ingest system documentation and post-deployment playbooks to rapidly identify compliance gaps, accelerating the ATO process.

• Supporting continuous exposure management and ATO workflows to maintain real-time system authorization.

• Coordinating proper security control implementation with system administrators and engineers.

• Developing and implementing security controls and formulating operational risk mitigations along with assisting in security awareness programs.

• Involved in a wide range of security issues including architectures, firewalls, electronic data traffic, and network access.

• Performing analyses to validate established security requirements and recommending additional security requirements and safeguards.

• Supporting the formal Security Test and Evaluation (ST&E) required by each government accrediting authority through pre-test preparations, participation in the tests, analysis of the results, and preparation of required reports.

• Periodically conducting a review of each system's audits and monitoring corrective actions until all actions are closed.

• Supporting cyber metrics development, maintenance and reporting.

• Providing briefings to senior staff.

Required Qualifications

• 7+ years of relevant experience in Cybersecurity

• 7+ years of experience validating security controls within systems by utilizing scanning tools, configuration reviews, and manual testing

• 7+ years of experience utilizing the Risk Management Framework in support of obtaining a Authority to Operate

• Proficiency in drafting and auditing System Security Plans (SSPs) and Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms) that clearly explain risk to non-technical stakeholders

• Ability to "translate" between the developers (who have the data) and the formal cybersecurity leadership (who needs the data).

• Experience translating technical configurations into "audit-ready" evidence for Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) tools like eMASS or ServiceNow.

• Hands-on with eGRC tools like: eMASS, XACTA, RSA Archer, etc.

• Ability to clearly articulate ideas for executive level consumption

• Ability to use prior experience and knowledge to address new situations; especially during interactions with clients

• Ability to use prior experience and knowledge to seamlessly incorporate new knowledge or information during client interactions

• Must have IAT II Certification

• B.A. or B.S. Information Security, Computer Science or related discipline

• US Citizenship and Top Secret Security Clearance with SCI eligibility

This position will be an on-site based out of Omaha. NE. The salary range for this position is estimated to be between 130,000.00 - $155,000.00, commensurate on experience and technical skillset.

We are strictly looking for direct, full-time W2 employees. We do not engage with third-party staffing agencies, C2C, or 1099 independent contractors for this role.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager, Payors
jobs.description:
About the Company:

Octave is a modern behavioral health practice creating a new standard for care delivery that’s both high-quality and accessible. With in-person and virtual clinics in multiple states, the company offers evidence-based individual, couples, and family therapy, while pioneering relationships with payers to make care more affordable through insurance. By raising the bar on how care is delivered and how providers are supported, we are building a sustainable system that values equity, affordability, and effectiveness.

About the Role:

Octave is seeking a Sr. Product Manager, Payers to join our distributed Product team, focused on driving success for key enterprise insurance payer relationships. This role will be central to strengthening the enterprise buyer experience, improving conversion growth, and scaling strategic partnerships that expand access to Octave’s mental health services. The ideal candidate brings deep experience working in client-facing or enterprise partnership environments and can translate those insights into a clear, actionable product roadmap. You’ll partner closely with Business Development, Engineering, Design, Operations, and Client Success to deliver products and experiences that enhance engagement, demonstrate measurable financial impact, and align to payer and organizational goals. If you thrive at the intersection of business strategy, client partnership, and product innovation—and are motivated by improving access to quality mental health care—this is an opportunity to make a significant impact in a fast-growing, mission-driven company.

Duties/Responsibilities:

• Drive the end-to-end strategy and execution for payer vertical initiatives, ensuring product investments drive measurable business outcomes and improved enterprise client experience.

• Partner closely with Business Development and payer stakeholders to understand partner needs, pain points, and opportunities, translating them into clear product requirements and priorities.

• Collaborate across product squads to inform related roadmaps, ensuring alignment between payer-facing products and Octave’s broader platform strategy.

• Define and maintain a prioritized roadmap that balances near-term delivery with long-term scalability and efficiency.

• Lead discovery and validation efforts to evaluate new opportunities, ensuring initiatives are grounded in data, user insights, and business impact.

• Develop and communicate business cases for product investments, articulating expected ROI and alignment with enterprise strategy.

• Drive cross-functional execution with Engineering, Design, Operations, and Client Success to deliver on key milestones and ensure smooth partner implementations.

• Analyze product performance and client feedback to identify optimization opportunities; run experiments and iterate based on data.

• Represent the voice of the payer partner throughout the product lifecycle, advocating for an exceptional enterprise buyer experience.

• Foster strong communication and collaboration across teams to ensure clarity, accountability, and consistent progress toward goals.

Required Skills:

• Proficiency with rapid hypothesis-driven experimentation and analysis

• Operational mindset

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across technical and non-technical audiences

• Analytical and data-informed approach to decision-making, with comfort presenting ROI and financial impact

• Passion for Octave’s mission to expand access to high-quality mental health care

• Comfort working in fast-paced and dynamic startup environment

• Comfort collaborating with a distributed team

• Passion for our mission

Education & Experience

• 5+ years of experience in Product Management, ideally in a B2B or enterprise SaaS environment

• Proven success leading complex, cross-functional initiatives with measurable business or financial outcomes

• Strong client-facing experience, with the ability to translate business needs and feedback into product strategy

• Demonstrated ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution

• Experience collaborating across distributed teams and dynamic environments

Physical Requirements:

• Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

• Must be able to frequently communicate with others through virtual meeting applications such as Zoom and Google Meet.

• Must be able to observe and communicate information on company provided laptop.

• Move up to 10 pounds on occasion.

• Must be eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship now or in the future.

Octave's Company Values:

The below values drive our day-to-day operations.

• We’re human beings first. We operate with empathy and kindness – with our clients, with our collaborators, and with ourselves.

• People deserve better than status quo. We’re willing to tackle the intractable problems, no matter how big, because someone should. We ask big questions, we craft big solutions, and we challenge ourselves and others to make it happen.

• No bystanders. No stars. No tourists. Each person has been selected to be here, and with that comes a responsibility to bring your expertise, share your ideas, and help make this company better.

• Partnership paves the path ahead. We don’t operate in a silo, internally or externally. To transform the system, we believe in working with others to create something bigger, better, and stronger.

• Quality is crucial at scale. Quality is core to our business, and we refuse to sacrifice it as we grow.

• Progress is a process. In the pursuit of progress, we iterate, reflect, learn, adjust – and always leave things better than we found them.

• There are people behind every data point. We recognize that numbers tell only one part of the story, and we also do the work to understand impacts at the individual level.

Compensation:

Octave is committed to pay equity. To maintain our commitment to pay equity, Octave will follow Pay Transparency regulations on all open job postings. Current Pay Transparency laws require companies to include a position's salary or hourly wage range (not including bonuses or equity-based compensation) in any internal or external job posting. This requirement extends to job postings published by a third party at an employer's request.

Octave will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with Octave’s legal duty to furnish information.

Starting pay for qualified applicants will depend on a combination of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected salary range for this role is set forth below and this range may be modified in the future.

The salary range for zone 1 (all states, excluding those in zone 2 or zone 3, and D.C.) is $132,100 - $153,100.

The salary range for zone 2 (CO, HI, MD, RI) is $145,300 - $168,400.

The salary range for zone 3 (AK, CA, CT, MA, NJ, NY, WA) is $152,000 - $176,000.

jobs.title: Parachute Systems Engineer II
jobs.description:
Advanced Reentry Technologies

Who We Are:

Inversion is an aerospace and defense company pioneering advanced reentry technology to enable next-generation capabilities from space. By combining high-performance materials, precision aerodynamics, and mission-driven autonomy, Inversion is transforming reentry into an operational capability for an entirely new class of missions.

The company’s highly maneuverable reentry spacecraft, Arc, is designed for rapid global cargo delivery, hypersonic testing, and other national security missions that require precise, controlled flight through the atmosphere. Arc creates an entirely new transportation domain, unlocking unprecedented speed and global reach.

Headquartered in Los Angeles, Inversion designs, manufactures, and integrates its spacecraft under one roof, enabling the company to move rapidly from concept to flight. The company is backed by leading investors including Y Combinator, Spark Capital, and Lockheed Martin Ventures, with customers across the U.S. government and commercial space industry.

What You’ll Do:

As a Parachute Engineer II at Inversion, you will play a critical role in the design, functionality, and performance of our next-generation reentry vehicles. This is a unique opportunity to work on the early stages of vehicle design, including defining vehicle architecture and creatively solving new design challenges. You will be a key member of the Accurate Landing Team, reporting directly to the Director of Engineering, Accurate Landing. In this role, you will:

• Develop and own a variety of parachute systems from concept to manufacture.

• Work with customers to develop and satisfy design requirements.

• Support testing and design of Arc’s parachute and deployment systems.

• Lead and support a variety of parachute and parachute-adjacent hardware, mechanisms, and/or systems.

Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, a related field, or equivalent experience.

• Typically, 2+ years of parachute design experience with significant project ownership.

• Strong engineering design fundamentals.

• Experienced in relevant textile design, including sewing, rigging, and hardware testing.

• Demonstrated excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Capable of working in a dynamic, fast-paced startup environment.

• Must have the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government Secret/Top Secret security clearance.

Desired Qualifications:

• Experience with relevant CAD and design software (may include GliderPlan, Openglider, LEparagliding, AutoCAD, NX, etc.).

• Experience organizing and executing drop tests or other types of tests.

• Active US security clearance or the ability to obtain security clearance

• USPA Class A Sport Parachute license or equivalent.

• FAA Senior Rigger Certification.

• Mechanical and/or pyrotechnic system design experience.

• Joint precision airdrop system (JPADS) design and testing experience.

• Knowledge of simulation-based wing modeling, Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), and/or wind tunnel testing.

Our office headquarters is located in Playa Vista, CA. This position requires in office presence.

jobs.title: Associate Scientist/Scientist I,  Molecular Function
jobs.description:
Profluent is the frontier AI lab for biology. Profluent builds powerful foundation models for all of life's molecules, unlocking solutions that transform medicine, agriculture, and beyond. Founded in 2022 and headquartered in Emeryville, CA, Profluent is backed by leading investors including Altimeter Capital, Bezos Expeditions, Spark Capital, Insight Partners, Air Street Capital, AIX Ventures, and Convergent Ventures and has raised over $150M to date.

The Role

Profluent is scaling the discovery engines that supply data for AI-driven antibody and protein design. We're hiring an experienced protein engineer to lead display campaigns and build high-throughput platforms for measuring protein-protein interactions (PPI) at scale.

This is primarily a bench role. You'll run your own campaigns, build and validate assays, and set the controls and QC that turn raw screening output into model-ready datasets, working closely with ML, protein design, automation, and bioinformatics colleagues.

Responsibilities

• Build the founding high-throughput platforms for identifying and measuring protein-protein interactions.

• Lead phage display campaigns end-to-end, from library construction through panning, NGS, and hit validation.

• Design and troubleshoot selection strategies, including antigen selection, library QC, and stringency selections.

• Plan campaigns with ML and protein design scientists (targets, assays, readouts) and define what makes binding data fit for model training and evaluation.

Qualifications

• MS (3 + years industry experience) or PhD in (0- 2 years industry experience), Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Protein Engineering, Biophysics, Immunology, or a related discipline.

• Deep hands-on experience with phage display and antibody discovery (required).

• Strong molecular biology skills for library construction.

• Solid understanding of NGS-based screening and how to turn sequencing data into quantitative measurements.

• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with careful attention to detail and record-keeping.

Preferences

• Experience in therapeutic antibody optimization: affinity maturation, developability, and format engineering.

• Experience in measuring binding kinetics and affinity by SPR or BLI/Octet, and epitope mapping.

• Familiarity with other display systems (yeast, mammalian, ribosome, or mRNA).

• Familiarity with lab automation platforms such as Hamilton or Tecan.

• Moving a new assay or platform into routine use; familiarity with LIMS and data/metadata schemas.

What We Offer

• High-growth opportunity with meaningful impact on the future of protein design

• Competitive compensation package with equity participation

• 401(k) with a strong employer match

• Comprehensive benefits including health/dental/vision insurance

• Generous PTO policy and commitment to work-life balance

• Professional development opportunities in a cutting-edge field at the intersection of AI and biology

jobs.title: Recruiting Operations and Transformation Lead
jobs.location: Denver, CO - Hybrid; New York, NY - Hybrid; San Francisco, CA - Hybrid
jobs.description:
About Gusto

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role

We're looking for a strategic and execution-oriented Lead, Recruiting Process Transformation to lead the evolution of our recruiting ecosystem. This leader will identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and automate Recruiting processes while ensuring operational excellence across our Recruiting Operations and Candidate Experience teams.

Reporting into the People Operations, Services & Technology (POST) organization, this role sits at the intersection of strategy, technology, and operations. You'll partner across Recruiting, People Tech, Legal, and business leaders to redesign how hiring gets done — from requisition to offer to onboarding handoff — creating scalable experiences for candidates, hiring teams, and Recruiting partners.

In addition to leading enterprise process transformation initiatives for recruiting, you'll oversee the teams responsible for executing our core Recruiting workflows, including Recruiting Operations and Candidate Experience.

What You'll Do

Lead Recruiting Process Transformation

• Develop and execute a multi-year strategy for transforming recruiting processes.

• Analyze end-to-end candidate and hiring lifecycle workflows; from requisition intake through offer and onboarding handoff; to identify friction, inefficiencies, redundancies, and opportunities for simplification.

• Redesign processes using Lean, service design, and automation principles.

• Consult with technical partners to understand how tooling, AI, and agentic solutions (e.g., InviteOS) can support improved recruiting efficiency.

• Build business cases that quantify operational impact, candidate/hiring team experience improvements, and ROI.

• Prioritize transformation initiatives based on organizational impact, scalability, and strategic objectives.

• Partner with Recruiting leadership to define, track, and report on recruiting metrics

• Diagnose root causes behind unmet KPIs and drive them to resolution, launching transformation initiatives where applicable.

Drive Technology-Enabled Improvements

• Partner closely with People Technology to implement technology solutions that improve recruiting operational efficiency, including AI-native recruiting platforms such as InviteOS, our custom recruiting tool.

• Evaluate opportunities to leverage workflow automation, AI, integrations, self-service capabilities, and system enhancements (Greenhouse, sourcing tools, scheduling tools) to drive prioritization for recruiting technology.

• Ensure process design and technology decisions work together to create sustainable solutions.

• Balance configuration, workflow redesign, and policy changes to achieve desired outcomes.

Lead Operational Excellence

Provide leadership for:

Recruiter Operations

• Own transformation of core recruiting workflows, requisition management, and interview/offer processing.

• Ensure operational accuracy, compliance, and service level achievement across the hiring pipeline.

• Continuously improve throughput, quality, and controls across sourcing-to-offer stages.

Candidate Experience

• Lead the team responsible for candidate-facing support and experience across the hiring journey.

• Partner with People Tech to evaluate and deploy modern technology solutions or replace current solutions where needed.

• Improve service delivery through knowledge management, self-service, case management optimization, and interview/scheduling process improvements.

• Develop candidate experience metrics and continuously improve satisfaction and time-to-fill outcomes.

Establish Operational Governance

• Define operational standards, process ownership, documentation, and governance across Recruiting operations.

• Create KPI dashboards measuring efficiency, quality, service levels, cycle times, automation adoption, and candidate experience.

• Build mechanisms to continuously identify improvement opportunities through operational data (e.g., Greenhouse reporting, PHC-style ticket analysis) and candidate/hiring manager feedback.

Lead and Develop Teams

• Lead and coach managers and individual contributors across Recruiting Operations and Candidate Experience.

• Foster a culture of continuous improvement, operational excellence, and candidate-centric thinking.

• Build organizational capability in process improvement methodologies and change management.

Partner Across the Business

• Influence senior stakeholders across Recruiting leadership, People Tech, Finance, IT, Security, and Legal.

• Translate business hiring priorities into operational improvements.

• Lead cross-functional initiatives requiring alignment across multiple organizations.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

• 10+ years of experience in Recruiting Operations, Talent Acquisition Operations, Business Operations, Process Excellence, Consulting, or related fields.

• 5+ years leading managers and operational teams.

• Demonstrated success leading enterprise-scale process transformation initiatives.

• Experience managing recruiting operations, candidate experience/support, or similar service organizations.

• Strong understanding of recruiting technology ecosystems (Greenhouse or comparable ATS, sourcing tools, scheduling/case management platforms).

• Experience applying Lean, Six Sigma, business process management, or operational excellence methodologies.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to use operational metrics (time-to-fill, pipeline conversion, candidate satisfaction) to drive decisions.

• Proven ability to influence senior leaders without direct authority.

• Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in high-growth technology companies.

• Experience implementing recruiting technology or enterprise workflow platforms.

• Familiarity with AI-enabled recruiting automation and candidate support technologies.

• Lean Six Sigma certification or equivalent operational excellence training.

• Experience leading organizational change and large cross-functional programs.

Success in This Role

Within your first year, you will have:

• Established a transformation roadmap for Recruiting operations.

• Identified and delivered measurable improvements in key candidate and hiring lifecycle processes.

• Reduced manual work through workflow redesign and automation.

• Improved candidate experience effectiveness and satisfaction.

• Increased operational visibility through standardized metrics and dashboards.

• Built a culture where continuous improvement becomes part of day-to-day recruiting operations.

Leadership Competencies

This leader excels at:

• Strategic systems thinking

• Operational excellence

• Candidate obsession

• Data-driven decision making

• Organizational influence

• Change leadership

• Developing high-performing teams

• Balancing innovation with operational rigor

Compensation

Our cash compensation amount for this role is $147,000/yr to $190,000/yr in Denver & most major metro locations, and $173,000/yr to $225,000/yr for San Francisco & New York. jobs.title: Sr. Crane Operator
jobs.description:
Ingram Marine Group is looking for a Crane Operator in the Ashland City, TN area.

The Sr. Crane Operator is responsible for safely and efficiently operating friction cranes and material handlers to transport materials and perform various tasks at a river terminal. The operator will  assist in loading/unloading cargo, managing inventory, and maintaining a smooth workflow in the terminal. The operator will serve as a subject matter expert for crane operations in the terminal, providing mentorship, training, and technical guidance while ensuring safe and efficient cargo handling. The operator will also train other associates on how to operate friction cranes and material  handlers while ensuring compliance with all company regulatory requirements.

What you will be doing:

• Operate friction cranes and material handler to load and unload cargo efficiently and safely.
• Effectively train other personnel in the operation of all forms of cranes and material handlers to load and unload cargo materials such as grain, coal, steel coils, salt or other terminal goods.
• Leads by example with safe work practices and operational excellence.
• Serves as a mentor and coach to crane operators and terminal associates.
• Assists management with evaluating and onboarding new operators.
• Demonstrates proficiency in evaluating operator competency and providing constructive feedback
• Assist in the loading and unloading of cargo from vessels, trucks, and rail cars.
• Operate and maintain terminal equipment such as conveyors, and door gun, barge loader spout, and hard car probe at all terminal facilities.
• Ensure that cargo is properly secured and organized for transport or storage.
• Assist with opening and closing barge cover access doors, and/or removing and resetting barge cover tops.
• Monitor and communicate with barge drafter or crane operator.
• Monitor and communicate barge drafts loader or crane operator.
• Perform routine checks on equipment and report any malfunctions or maintenance needs.
• Follow safety protocols and ensure compliance with safety regulations and company policies.
• Maintain a clean and safe work area, including dock areas, warehouse spaces, and cargo storage areas.
• Communicate effectively with supervisors, coworkers, and vessel crew members to ensure smooth operations.
• Troubleshoots operational equipment issues and assists maintenance personnel in identifying root causes.
• Maintains detailed equipment inspection and operational records.
• Recognized as the terminal expert on friction crane operations and specialized lifting activities.
• Assist with inventory, including tracking cargo and reporting discrepancies.
• Perform general labor tasks such as cleaning, sorting, and organizing goods, tools, and supplies.
• Cleaning product from pits, barge decks and barge covers, and other areas as necessary.
• Work in varying weather conditions and maintain physical stamina throughout shifts.
• Perform any other reasonable task as requested.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

• Physical activities that are essentials to daily functions include but are not limited to: 1) regularly lifting loads up to 50lbs unassisted and occasionally up to 75lbs. 20 Climbing of ladders over 20’ of vertical height while using fall protection. 30 Frequently carrying, dragging, and pulling of wires, lines and railcar door opener equipment. 4) Frequent bending, twisting, kneeling and reaching. 5) Frequent shoveling and sweeping and strenuous sledgehammering of railcars. Familiarity with safety protocols and ability to follow instructions.
• Proven experience operating friction cranes and material handlers, preferably in a river terminal or maritime environment.
• Strong knowledge of safety regulations and best practices in crane operations.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced, outdoor environment in varying weather conditions.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with a team.
• Physical fitness to handle the demands of the job, including lifting and climbing

Education & Experience Preferences/Requirements:

• High School or GED required
• 4-5 Years experience as a Crane Operator required
• Certification Required: First Aid & CPR

Working Environment and Conditions:

• Outdoor/indoor working environment with exposure to loud noises, dust, and potentially hazardous materials
• Shift work may be required, including weekends or holidays, depending on the operation schedule
• Will be required to wear personal protective equipment (PPE), such as safety vests, hard hats, gloves, and steel-toe boots

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

• A competitive compensation package
• Comprehensive benefits including Medical/Prescription Drug plans, HSA, Vision, Dental and Health Care FSA.
• Generous paid time off benefits
• 401K match
• Life and AD&D, Employee Assistant programs, Group Legal, & more
• Associate growth and development encouraged through internal training and tuition reimbursement program

About Us

Ennoble Care is a mobile primary care, palliative care, and hospice service provider with patients in New York, New Jersey, Maryland, DC, Virginia, Oklahoma, Kansas, Pennsylvania, Texas, Florida, and Georgia. Ennoble Care’s clinicians go to the home of the patient, providing continuum of care for those with chronic conditions and limited mobility. Ennoble Care offers a variety of programs including, remote patient monitoring, behavioral health management, and chronic care management, to ensure that our patients receive the highest quality of care by a team they know and trust. We seek individuals who are driven to make a difference and embody our motto, “To Care is an Honor.” Join Ennoble Care today!

Position Summary

The Clinical Liaison serves as the first point of contact for hospitalized patients and their families who may benefit from Ennoble Care’s services. This role is responsible for educating patients, families, and healthcare partners about Ennoble Care’s programs, supporting informed decision-making, and facilitating smooth transitions of care. The Clinical Liaison collaborates closely with physicians, interdisciplinary team members, and acute care partners to develop and initiate individualized, goal-aligned care plans.

Key Responsibilities

• Serve as the primary liaison between Ennoble Care and acute care facilities, identifying patients appropriate for hospice or palliative care services.

• Introduce and educate patients and families on Ennoble Care’s hospice and palliative care philosophy, services, and benefits.

• Provide emotional support and guidance to patients and families during care transitions.

• Collaborate with patients, families, physicians, and the interdisciplinary team to develop care plans aligned with patient goals and wishes.

• Conduct nursing assessments and make clinical judgments based on patient needs and eligibility criteria.

• Initiate care plans and coordinate discharge planning in collaboration with Ennoble Care’s hospice and palliative care medical consultants.

• Communicate patient goals, clinical status, and treatment plans effectively with interdisciplinary team members.

• Promote Ennoble Care’s hospice and palliative care programs within hospitals, skilled nursing facilities, and other referral sources.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with facility leadership and staff through education, in-service trainings, and community outreach.

• Minimum of one (1) year of experience in a comparable clinical setting or unit.

jobs.title: Senior Field Enablement Manager, Mid-Enterprise
jobs.description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

 

We are looking for a Senior Field Enablement Manager to turn our field enablement strategy into repeatable, field-facing execution for the Mid-Enterprise Sales organization. This role owns the day-to-day delivery of onboarding, coaching, and content programs that help Mid-Enterprise sellers execute complex, multi-stakeholder sales motions from discovery through close.

You will work closely with the Field Enablement and Onboarding Leader, who owns portfolio strategy and leadership alignment. Your role is to keep delivery moving: build and maintain approved assets, run defined workstreams, manage handoffs to specialist partners, and close the loop with adoption data and field feedback.

This is an execution-oriented role for an experienced seller and enablement practitioner who has firsthand knowledge of Mid-Enterprise sales cycles, account strategy, technical validation, champion development, multithreading, forecasting, negotiation, and executive-level value communication.



What You'll Do

Onboarding execution and program delivery

 - Own the delivery plan for assigned Mid-Enterprise workstreams, surfacing risks, dependencies, and capacity implications.

 - Own the operational delivery of Mid-Enterprise sales onboarding programs, including cohort planning, learner communications, completion tracking, content refreshes, and manager-led reinforcement.

 - Contribute an equitable share of responsibilities for recurring sales bootcamp programming as part of the role’s onboarding execution scope. This may include supporting planning and logistics, coordinating invitations and communications, contributing to content, and presenting selected content during bootcamp sessions.

 - Attend each monthly sales bootcamp in person and support the broader Enablement organization through shared bootcamp delivery responsibilities. Because this role is remote, travel is required to attend bootcamp in person.

 - Build and operate role-based programs that develop proficiency in complex discovery, account planning, mutual action plans, technical validation, business-case development, multithreading, and deal progression.

 - Serve as program manager or workstream lead for high-impact cross-functional programs after scope and stakeholder model are established.

Field coaching

 - Own recurring call-review and coaching operations for Mid-Enterprise sellers and frontline managers.

 - Curate strong call and deal examples, facilitate routine coaching sessions, identify performance patterns, and report actionable insights to sales leadership.

 - Coach and reinforce seller behaviors across executive discovery, value articulation, 3 WHYs or comparable qualification, technical and security stakeholder engagement, competitive positioning, mutual close plans, and forecast discipline.

 - Support Gong scorecard rollout and reporting in partnership with the Field Enablement and Onboarding Leader, Head of Global Enablement, and Enablement Ops.

Content and asset maintenance

 - Draft field inputs, coordinate reviews, QA, publish, and maintain Mid-Enterprise enablement assets, including account-planning guides, discovery frameworks, value messaging, talk tracks, battlecards, proof-point libraries, onboarding materials, and manager guides.

 - Partner with Product Marketing, Technical Enablement, and Deal Desk stakeholders to keep field assets aligned to the Mid-Enterprise sales motion.

 - Lead scoped efforts such as Partner 101 for AEs coordination, tech-enablement discovery, and Deal Desk module requirements gathering.

 - Own contained content updates, tool-module coordination, and specialist follow-up so leaders are not the default builders or first responders.

Request intake, routing, and measurement

 - Validate incoming requests, gather missing inputs, maintain the backlog, and prepare routing recommendations.

 - Before routing approved work to specialists, prepare a clear brief covering the business problem, audience, desired seller behavior, priority, deadline, SME and approver, source materials, and definition of done.

 - Route instructional-design work to Spencer McKee, technology and platform work to Katie Lopes, and technical-product work to Merys Raymer, then manage projects through launch.

 - Maintain feedback collection, post-launch reviews, adoption reporting, and monthly status updates for assigned workstreams.



What success looks like

Within the first 90 days, you will have:

 - Taken ownership of Mid-Enterprise onboarding execution, bootcamp contribution planning, call-review operations, backlog hygiene, content-refresh coordination, and stakeholder status updates.

 - Assessed the Mid-Enterprise sales motion and established an enablement plan for the highest-impact seller behaviors, including discovery, account strategy, qualification, value articulation, and deal progression.

 - Established a reliable operating rhythm for onboarding, recurring bootcamp contribution, routine coaching, content maintenance, learner communications, and adoption reporting.

 - Launched scoped modules through specialist partners, supported the Gong scorecard pilot, and built a quarterly refresh calendar with clear ownership across priority work.



What You’ll Bring

 - Sales experience path: 5+ years of quota-carrying B2B sales experience, including at least 3 years as a Mid-Market, Mid-Enterprise, Enterprise, or Strategic Account Executive, plus 2+ years of experience in sales enablement, sales leadership, program management, sales operations, or a related field, including managing multiple timelines, dependencies, and stakeholders.

 - Sales enablement experience path: 7+ years of sales enablement experience supporting Mid-Market and Enterprise sellers, with demonstrated ownership and delivery of onboarding, coaching, content, or other field enablement programs.

 - Demonstrated success selling complex SaaS, cybersecurity, or technical solutions with multiple buyer personas, longer sales cycles, and six-figure or larger deal sizes, or equivalent experience enabling teams that sell these solutions.

 - Firsthand experience leading complex sales motions, including account planning, executive discovery, champion development, multithreading, technical validation, business-case development, negotiation, and forecasting, or demonstrated experience enabling these capabilities.

 - Strong field-facing facilitation and deal-coaching skills, with the credibility to coach experienced Mid-Enterprise sellers and managers.

 - Experience partnering with sales leaders to translate win/loss patterns, pipeline needs, and sales-process gaps into practical enablement programs.

 - Ability to coordinate work clearly across Enablement, Revenue Operations, Marketing, and other relevant stakeholders while protecting field relevance and adoption.

 - Comfort operating without formal authority, building trust, managing handoffs, and escalating risks or decisions appropriately.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including clear briefs, status updates, coaching feedback, and executive-ready seller messaging.



What sets you apart?

 - Experience as a sales manager, player-coach, field enablement leader, or mentor for Mid-Enterprise or Enterprise AE teams.

 - Experience running call-review, deal-review, or coaching programs using Gong or a comparable conversation-intelligence platform.

 - Experience operating onboarding programs, including cohort administration, completion tracking, and content-refresh cycles.

 - Familiarity with sales tooling such as Gong, ZoomInfo, DealHub, Salesforce, or a comparable CRM and enablement stack.



Travel Required

This job may require up to 20% of travel to be successful.



Perks of Horizon3

 - Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

 - Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

 - Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

 - Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.



Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

 - Base salary range $142,000 - $160,000 annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

 - Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.



You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.
