jobs.title: Construction Lead
jobs.description:
Mission:

We are the technology company for construction, redefining the entire life cycle of the build so we can usher in a new era of abundance and beauty in the physical world. Over the past fifty years, the West’s ability to design and build large scale infrastructure has atrophied, and the entire industry has become less productive. With decaying infrastructure, power shortages, and an aging workforce, the only way through is to hyper-scale development with technology at a rate never before seen.

 

Our team believes that this is the most important work of our lives, and there’s no more significant place to spend our time than on solving these problems. We believe in the sacrifices that we must make to achieve our mission and build a world of abundance. We believe the future can be amazing, but only if we work gut-wrenchingly hard to make it so. Our work is bigger than all of us, and our obsession with manifesting is what drives us. Roughly 50% of our team are former founders, and we strive for technical excellence, but quell our egos to ensure that the best ideas always win.

 

We acknowledge the long and arduous path ahead to achieve our ambitions; that many of the most difficult challenges have yet to even be revealed to us; that the chance of failure is not only possible, but likely. Most of all, we believe that there is no other option: we will either revolutionize how humanity builds or die trying.

 

The role:

We're hiring our first construction lead. We already serve as Engineer of Record on gigawatts of utility-scale energy projects, but we don't want to stop at designing them. We are going to build them. This person will define how we do that.

 

On our first projects, you'll find the right EPC/GC to build with and manage them closely enough that the project moves at our pace, not the industry's. This is a very hands-on role. We expect you to be deep in the weeds on every project, defining our build culture as you go: how we organize ourselves to build, what we own directly, and where we partner.

 

Most construction today is run as contract management: the owner hires an EPC, the EPC hires subs, everyone prices risk into their scope, and the job becomes moving paper between them. Nobody is paid to go faster, so nobody does. We're building the opposite: small, highly competent teams who own the outcome end to end; engineering, procurement, and construction on one plan and one schedule; decisions made in hours by the people closest to the work, not through change-order cycles; and risk taken deliberately when it buys schedule.

 

We are early. There is no construction department and no playbook, and we're not looking for someone to import one from a large EPC. Anything repetitive in this job should be a candidate for automation with AI.

 

This role is in-person in San Francisco, CA or Texas and will include significant time on job sites.

 

What we're looking for:

 - You've been the responsible leader on multiple large capital projects that actually got built, from groundbreaking through energization

 - An engineer by background

 - A builder at heart: you lead from the front, you're on site, and you're hands-on when it counts

 - You're frustrated by how slowly this industry builds and how much bureaucracy sits between a decision and steel in the ground

 - You know how EPCs and GCs actually operate, so you can pick the right partner and hold them to the schedule

 - Mission alignment and desire to build a future of abundance

 

Experience: Responsible leadership on multiple large capital projects (utility-scale energy, gas generation, data centers, or comparable heavy industrial work).

 

This is probably not the role for you if:

 - You think the way this industry builds today is basically fine

 - You'd rather manage from an office than lead from the field

 - You solve schedule risk with more process and more paperwork

 - You need a large construction organization around you to be effective

 

Bonus:

 - Utility-scale gas generation projects: simple cycle, combined cycle, or reciprocating engines

jobs.title: Supply Chain Lead
jobs.description:
Mission:

We are automating construction end to end to usher in a new era of abundance and beauty in the physical world in the coming decades. Over the past fifty years, the West’s ability to design and build large scale infrastructure has atrophied, and the entire industry has become less productive. With decaying infrastructure, power shortages, and an aging workforce, the only way through is to hyper-scale development with technology at a rate never before seen.

 

Our team believes that this is the most important work of our lives, and there’s no more significant place to spend our time than on solving these problems. We believe in the sacrifices that we must make to achieve our mission and build a world of abundance. We believe the future can be amazing, but only if we work gut-wrenchingly hard to make it so. Our work is bigger than all of us, and our obsession with manifesting is what drives us. Roughly 50% of our team are former founders, and we strive for technical excellence, but quell our egos to ensure that the best ideas always win.

 

We acknowledge the long and arduous path ahead to achieve our ambitions; that many of the most difficult challenges have yet to even be revealed to us; that the chance of failure is not only possible, but likely. Most of all, we believe that there is no other option: we will either revolutionize how humanity builds or die trying.

 

The role:

We're hiring our first full-time supply chain team member. We already serve as Engineer of Record on roughly $10B of capital projects across utility-scale energy and data center infrastructure, and that number is growing fast. Every one of those projects depends on transformers, switchgear, inverters, structural steel, cable, and the factories that make them. This person will lead our engagement with that supply chain.

 

This isn't procurement the way an EPC does it: put out RFPs, collect bids, place orders, chase everyone onto the same page. We think about it the way the best high-growth product companies do, as a supply chain we build, foster, and actively work to improve. There's no silver bullet. It's a thousand lead bullets: deep relationships built on trust, being the best customer our partners have, and constantly finding ways to move faster together.

 

Most manufacturers in this industry are built for today's pace. The projects we design will ask for far more, far faster. The job is to make sure our suppliers understand the scale of demand that is coming and get ready for it. You'll work closely with our engineering team, understand what they need, and help our suppliers optimize around rate so they can deliver capacity well beyond what they're used to.

 

We are early. There is no procurement department and no established process, and we're not looking for someone to build a bureaucracy. Anything repetitive in this job should be aggressively automated with AI, and we'll expect you to drive a lot of that (after we ramp you up on the building blocks).

 

This role is in-person in San Francisco, CA and will include travel to suppliers, factories, and job sites.

 

What we're looking for:

 - You've led supply chains for complex industrial equipment and systems, ideally in energy or construction

 - You understand how a factory actually works: capacity, throughput, lead times, and what it really takes to add a line or a shift

 - You think about rate, not just the next order. You've helped a supplier, or your own operation, scale output well past where it started

 - Suppliers trust you. They pick up when you call, and they tell you the truth about their constraints

 - A translator: you can turn what our engineers need into something a factory can build, and turn what a factory can build into something our engineers can design around

 - An AI bull: you already automate everything repetitive with AI, or you're clearly on that ramp and can show it

 - Mission alignment and desire to build a future of abundance

 

Experience: 5 to 20 years in supply chain, sourcing, procurement, or manufacturing operations for energy, construction, or other complex industrial systems. An engineering background is a plus.

 

This is probably not the role for you if:

 - You see supply chain as purchase orders, expediting, and negotiating on price

 - You'd rather manage a process from a desk than walk a factory floor

 - You need a large procurement team and established systems around you to be effective

 - You want a 9-to-5

 

Bonus:

 - Existing relationships with manufacturers of transformers, switchgear, inverters, trackers, or other long-lead energy equipment

 - Experience standing up or scaling manufacturing capacity, at a supplier or an OEM

 - Supply chain experience at a fast-scaling hardware product company (automotive, aerospace, robotics, or similar)

jobs.title: Field Operations Manager, Commercial
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Air Defense team builds robots that find other robots and knock them out of the sky. At a time when air superiority can no longer be taken for granted, the Air Defense team provides mission critical capabilities to warfighters. From detection to tracking, identification, deterrence, and defeat, our family of networked sensors and effectors enables our customers to rapidly close the kill chain against a broad range of UAS threats. Working across product, engineering, business development, logistics, operations, and mission success, the Air Defense team develops, tests, deploys, and sustains the Anduril Air Defense Family of Systems in challenging operational environments worldwide.

ABOUT THE JOB

In your role as a Field Operations Deployment Manager on the Air Defense team, you are responsible for delivering and sustaining large-scale, fixed-site counter-UAS capability that protects our customers' most critical installations and infrastructure. You own the end-to-end execution of persistent, multi-sensor, multi-effector deployments across expansive site footprints — and you ensure the system delivers when our customers need it most.

You fulfill this responsibility through rigorous operational execution, detail orientation, proactive communication, deep mission understanding, and hard-won product expertise. Because fixed-site deployments are enduring rather than transient, you build repeatable, playbook-driven methodology that turns each installation into a standardized, auditable, and continuously improving process — not a one-off. You feel ownership over the health and performance of all assets and technologies deployed to your sites, and you coordinate tightly with on-site security organizations and facility stakeholders to integrate our capability into the site's broader security posture.

You represent Anduril to our customers, building their confidence and trust through your professionalism and commitment to excellence. You also represent our customers back to Anduril, communicating user feedback and lessons learned to continuously improve our product and our team in response to evolving mission needs. Above all, you set the standard for what good looks like for your deployment team, and you rally your Anduril teammates to meet that standard every single day.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Deployment planning and execution: You will orchestrate large-scale, persistent C-UAS installations — leading a cross-functional team that spans hardware supply, logistics, engineering, and more to achieve mission success for Anduril and our customers. Meticulous, resourceful, and detail-oriented, you will manage every step of the deployment lifecycle across an expansive site footprint: site survey, RF and power planning, sensor and effector siting, coverage modeling, pack-out, installation, integration, test, training, and long-term sustainment. You consistently demonstrate extraordinary judgment, grit, and composure in high-pressure situations. You anticipate every contingency, soberly assess and mitigate risk, and deliberately learn from your experiences to continuously improve.

• Playbook-driven deployment methodology: You will build and own the standardized playbooks, SOPs, and installation templates that make fixed-site deployments repeatable at scale. You codify the site survey, siting, integration, acceptance-test, and sustainment procedures into lightweight, disciplined processes that any deployment team can execute consistently across sites. You treat each deployment as an opportunity to refine the playbook — capturing lessons learned, closing gaps, and driving the methodology toward a predictable, auditable standard.

• Site security coordination: You will serve as Anduril's primary interface to on-site security teams, facility management, and installation stakeholders. You integrate our capability into the site's existing physical security and force-protection posture — deconflicting sensor and effector placement, coordinating installation access and escorts, aligning on rules of engagement and response protocols, and ensuring our system reinforces rather than complicates the site's concept of security. You build the trust and shared operating picture that let Anduril and site security operate as one team.

• Relationship management: Build trust with customers, industry partners, users, and Anduril teammates through effective communication, positive attitude, and follow-through. With careful listening and observation, you internalize your counterpart's priorities and requirements. With empathy and responsiveness, you quickly build rapport, trust, and confidence in our capability. You develop relationships across the organization and communicate honestly and directly. You are committed to giving and receiving feedback well. Your partners always know what you expect from them, and know exactly what to expect from you.

• Mission expertise: Develop a deep knowledge of your customer's mission requirements, including the nature of the threats they face, airspace and regulatory challenges, resource constraints, rules of engagement, and the specific demands of defending fixed, high-value sites. You will become a subject matter expert and the voice of the customer, capable of effectively communicating requirements and CONOPS to Anduril engineers so they can continue to enhance our capability to meet evolving mission needs. You are deeply motivated to shape the future of air defense.

• Product expertise: Develop a thorough understanding of the capabilities and limitations of Anduril's Family of Systems. You are innately curious about the technology underpinning our capability, and are not satisfied with a superficial understanding of how and why it works. You are constantly educating yourself about the strengths and weaknesses of different sensor modalities, the challenges of sensor fusion, power and networking requirements, and more. You will become an opinionated power user who can reliably forecast how our capability will perform against a broad range of threat profiles, environmental conditions, and mission constraints.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Advanced degree or 4-6+ years experience in a technical field, preferably in the defense, national security, or aerospace domain

• Highly organized creative problem-solver with proven project management skills

• Experience planning and executing large-scale, fixed-site installations or infrastructure deployments, ideally involving integrated sensors, effectors, power, and networking

• Demonstrated ability to build and maintain deployment playbooks, SOPs, and installation documentation that drive repeatable execution at scale

• Experience coordinating with site security, physical security, or force-protection organizations and integrating capabilities into an existing security posture

• Experienced in the creation and upkeep of documentation for new or developing processes

• Proven experience leading tech-enabled teams of peers while building a culture of influence through relationships

• Deep interest in national security issues and defense technologies, with a commitment to lifelong learning

• Experience translating technical concepts into operational requirements and performance specifications

• Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize tasks effectively

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

• Willing to travel up to 50% of the time

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience with Networking, cUAS, and/or Air and Missile Defense

US Salary Range

$146,000—$194,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Account Executive, Education (Richmond, VA)
jobs.description:
At Yondr, we believe in the power of presence. Our mission is to create phone-free spaces that deepen human connection and elevate shared experiences. We partner with artists, educators, and visionaries to design environments that put people, not devices, at the center.



Yondr’s business segments span numerous industries, primarily across education and live events. Yondr supports schools through cell phone-free programs. Our education programs facilitate the successful implementation of phone-free school environments by providing administrators and teachers with education, training, and development resources, along with all necessary equipment. In addition, Yondr supports top artists in music and comedy by creating phone-free shows, allowing performers and audience members to enjoy live performances without the distraction of phones.



POSITION SUMMARY

The Account Executive, Education is responsible for driving new business growth by developing partnerships with K–12 schools and school districts throughout an assigned territory. This role is responsible for generating new sales opportunities, managing the full sales cycle, and building trusted relationships with education leaders to advance Yondr's mission of creating phone-free learning environments.

Reporting to the Education Sales leadership team, the Account Executive serves as a consultative partner to prospective customers, identifying their needs and delivering tailored solutions that improve student engagement and learning outcomes. The ideal candidate is a proactive, relationship-driven sales professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys building meaningful connections, and is passionate about helping schools create distraction-free spaces where students can thrive.

 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Business Development & Sales

 - Develop and execute a territory sales strategy to generate new business opportunities with K–12 schools and school districts.

 - Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline through outbound prospecting, cold calling, referrals, networking, and lead generation activities.

 - Conduct in-person meetings, virtual presentations, phone calls, and email outreach to establish relationships with school administrators and district decision-makers.

 - Meet or exceed established sales goals through effective pipeline management and disciplined sales execution.

 - Identify and respond to Requests for Proposals (RFPs) and other competitive bid opportunities.

 - Negotiate pricing, contracts, and partnership agreements with prospective customers.

Relationship Management

 - Develop trusted relationships with school leaders, administrators, and district stakeholders throughout the sales process.

 - Deliver compelling presentations and product demonstrations that clearly communicate the value and impact of Yondr's solutions.

 - Collaborate with existing customers to identify referral opportunities and expand regional market presence.

 - Represent Yondr with professionalism while serving as a trusted advisor to prospective education partners.

Sales Operations & Collaboration

 - Maintain accurate customer records, pipeline activity, forecasts, and sales documentation within the company's CRM platform.

 - Partner closely with Implementation, Customer Success, and Account Management teams to ensure seamless customer onboarding and successful handoffs following contract execution.

 - Participate in ongoing sales training, professional development, and product education to strengthen sales effectiveness and industry knowledge.

 - Represent Yondr at regional and national education conferences, trade shows, and industry events to generate awareness and new business opportunities.

 - Perform additional duties and special projects as assigned in support of departmental and organizational objectives.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required Qualifications

 - Five (5) or more years of professional sales experience with demonstrated success meeting or exceeding sales goals.

 - Experience in outbound prospecting, cold calling, lead generation, and pipeline development.

 - Ability to travel up to 60% to support customer meetings, conferences, and business development activities.

 - Valid U.S. driver's license and ability to travel throughout assigned territory.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

 - Consultative, relationship-focused approach to selling with a strong customer-first mindset.

 - Excellent interpersonal, communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.

 - Ability to build trust and credibility with school administrators and executive-level decision-makers.

 - Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.

 - Self-motivated and highly autonomous with excellent follow-through and accountability.

 - Comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced, and rapidly evolving environment.

 - Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to adapt solutions to customer needs.

 - Proficiency with CRM systems and standard business productivity applications.

 - Passion for Yondr's mission of creating distraction-free environments that promote meaningful human connection.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience selling into the K–12 education market.

 - Experience presenting to school boards, district leadership teams, or educational organizations.

 - Familiarity with public sector purchasing processes and RFP responses.

 - Previous experience representing an organization at conferences, trade shows, or industry events.

 - Experience in solution-based or consultative B2B sales.

 - Physical Requirements

 - Ability to remain stationary for extended periods while working at a computer.

 - Ability to communicate effectively in person, virtually, and by telephone.

 - Ability to travel up to 60% of the time, including occasional evenings and weekends for conferences and customer events.

 - Ability to transport sales materials, displays, and equipment weighing up to 25 pounds.

JOB LOCATION

 - Remote position

 - Although this position is remote, the candidate must be located in the Richmond, VA area.

COMPENSATION

 - Expected OTE = $155,000 - $165,000 w/a base range of $90k - $100k

YONDR BENIFITS

 - 100% paid medical coverage plan option for employees and access to 15+ plan types, including PPO, HMO and HDHP

 - Dental and vision and ancillary benefits such as short-term disability, long-term disability and life insurance

 - Generous PTO for rest and recharge throughout the year

 - 12 weeks of paid parental leave

 - 1 week paid holiday break at the end of December, for a company-wide closure + 11 additional nationally recognized holidays

 - 401(k) offering

 - Tech tool preference, including choice of PC or Mac.

 - Hybrid employees receive catered lunch twice a week.

Yondr is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate in its hiring of employees based on race, religion, gender, or sexual orientation.

jobs.title: Mission Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Spacecraft represent the most pressing unmet need across the entire aerospace industry. As more launch vehicles come online and the cost to orbit decreases, more companies launching payloads to space continue to emerge.

For the first time in history, this influx of payload companies combined with reduced launch costs has resulted in a massive increase in need for commercial spacecraft platforms, known as satellite buses. These buses hold the payloads of our customers and are flown on launch vehicles.

Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more.

We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet. 




ABOUT THE ROLE

In this position, you will own or contribute to the authorization posture of two systems: a space vehicle and a classified cloud mission operations environment. You will contribute to cyber engineering and produce RMF authorization documentation, build and sustain authorization packages, own the plan of action and milestones day to day, and run continuous monitoring. This is mission systems work throughout, not traditional enterprise IT security.

We are open to candidates from ISSE, SSE, ISSM, or ISSO backgrounds, and are hiring across levels: from new and recent graduates through senior engineering, officer, and manager experience.

Responsibilities:
May include any or all of the following:

Authorization Ownership

 - Build and sustain authorization packages for both boundaries: system description, boundary definition, categorization, control selection and tailoring rationale, implementation statements, assessment coordination, and the residual risk picture carried to the AO.

 - Get assessors engaged early on our evidence-generation approach so generated artifacts are trusted before a package depends on them.

 - Own the POA&M.

 - Maintain the authorization system of record (eMASS or equivalent).

Space Vehicle Segment

 - Own the authorization boundary determination for the flight segment and the rationale that survives assessor scrutiny.

 - Categorize under CNSSI 1253 and defend overlay selection, treating the Space Platform Overlay as the starting place it is rather than a finished answer — pushing back where our onboard security capability exceeds what the published tailoring assumes.

 - Tailor the control baseline with per-control rationale, using Aerospace's Space Segment Cybersecurity Profile (TOR-2023-02161 Rev A) and SPARTA-linked tailoring, including arguing controls back in where our onboard capability exceeds what those baselines assumed.

 - Define the type-authorization for the bus and design how each vehicle off the line generates its own conformance evidence so fleet growth does not mean linear growth in assessment labor.

 - Derive verifiable security requirements from threat using SPARTA TTPs as the traceability key, owned by the software and mission integration engineers who will build and test against them.

 - Translate verification and production artifacts into assessment evidence and tell engineering early when what they produce will not satisfy an assessor.

 - Own the continuous monitoring story for a fielded fleet: security audit downlinked across contact windows, configuration drift across vehicles, and on-orbit software update as a recurring authorization event.

Classified Cloud Mission Operations Environment

 - Define and document the authorization boundary for mission systems in classified cloud (AWS, Azure classified regions, or equivalent), including impact-level scoping and the seam with ground stations and the RF edge.

 - Own the control and evidence story for operator command authority: identity, role separation, least privilege, two-person integrity, non-repudiation, and complete audit of every command that reaches the vehicle.

 - Build and defend the control inheritance model and prove the customer-responsible set with live evidence rather than assertion, validating what the cloud service provider and the platform satisfy versus what remains customer responsibility for the mission-unique applications.

 - Implement controls as code, so infrastructure-as-code, policy-as-code, and pipeline configuration serve as the implementation and the evidence at once.

 - Make change control and continuous monitoring work at operations tempo, never putting a contact window at risk, positioned for the DoD transition toward the Cybersecurity Risk Management Construct (CSRMC) and continuous authorization.

 - Manage security incident reporting and coordination for the boundary.

Automation and Generation

 - Define what evidence you need and in what form.

 - Design the OSCAL-based evidence data model and the mapping layer that resolves a property assertion to control identifiers across 800-53, CNSSI 1253 baselines, overlays, and program-unique control sets.

 - Build the pipeline that renders SSP sections, assessment evidence, POA&M items, and continuous monitoring reports deterministically from pinned evidence snapshots.

 - Integrate with the authorization system of record (eMASS or equivalent) programmatically, so generated artifacts land where assessors actually look.

 - Use AI-assisted drafting and crosswalk tooling for control narratives, framework mappings, and monitoring summaries, with human review on anything an AO reads and full traceability from every statement to a source record.

 - Push toward controls whose satisfaction is demonstrated by system state rather than by narrative.

Required Qualifications

At Every Level

 - U.S. Citizenship (must possess the ability to access export-controlled data)

 - Active Top Secret clearance with SCI access and SAP eligibility strongly preferred

 - Experience with technical tooling: reading pipeline output, querying an API, interpreting scanner and configuration state

Entry Level (1–3+ Years)

 - Bachelor's, master's, or PhD in systems engineering, computer science, cybersecurity, aerospace, or a related field

 - Clear experience with hands-on building via coursework, internships, research code, personal projects, CTFs, a co-op, or an early role and/or some exposure to RMF, security compliance, cloud, or software engineering

 - Willingness to learn RMF from the ground up, with a demonstrated ability to pick up a complicated technical domain quickly and hold a lot of detail without losing the thread

Senior Level (5–10+ Years)

 - Strong experience in embedded/space systems or cloud infrastructure

 - Multiple systems taken to authorization in national security or DoD environments, with fluency in RMF as practiced: categorization under CNSSI 1253, overlay selection, tailoring rationale, assessment coordination, POA&M management, continuous monitoring, and reauthorization triggers

jobs.title: Account Executive, Education (Atlanta, GA)
jobs.description:
At Yondr, we believe in the power of presence. Our mission is to create phone-free spaces that deepen human connection and elevate shared experiences. We partner with artists, educators, and visionaries to design environments that put people, not devices, at the center.



Yondr’s business segments span numerous industries, primarily across education and live events. Yondr supports schools through cell phone-free programs. Our education programs facilitate the successful implementation of phone-free school environments by providing administrators and teachers with education, training, and development resources, along with all necessary equipment. In addition, Yondr supports top artists in music and comedy by creating phone-free shows, allowing performers and audience members to enjoy live performances without the distraction of phones.



POSITION SUMMARY

The Account Executive, Education is responsible for driving new business growth by developing partnerships with K–12 schools and school districts throughout an assigned territory. This role is responsible for generating new sales opportunities, managing the full sales cycle, and building trusted relationships with education leaders to advance Yondr's mission of creating phone-free learning environments.

Reporting to the Education Sales leadership team, the Account Executive serves as a consultative partner to prospective customers, identifying their needs and delivering tailored solutions that improve student engagement and learning outcomes. The ideal candidate is a proactive, relationship-driven sales professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys building meaningful connections, and is passionate about helping schools create distraction-free spaces where students can thrive.

 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Business Development & Sales

 - Develop and execute a territory sales strategy to generate new business opportunities with K–12 schools and school districts.

 - Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline through outbound prospecting, cold calling, referrals, networking, and lead generation activities.

 - Conduct in-person meetings, virtual presentations, phone calls, and email outreach to establish relationships with school administrators and district decision-makers.

 - Meet or exceed established sales goals through effective pipeline management and disciplined sales execution.

 - Identify and respond to Requests for Proposals (RFPs) and other competitive bid opportunities.

 - Negotiate pricing, contracts, and partnership agreements with prospective customers.

Relationship Management

 - Develop trusted relationships with school leaders, administrators, and district stakeholders throughout the sales process.

 - Deliver compelling presentations and product demonstrations that clearly communicate the value and impact of Yondr's solutions.

 - Collaborate with existing customers to identify referral opportunities and expand regional market presence.

 - Represent Yondr with professionalism while serving as a trusted advisor to prospective education partners.

Sales Operations & Collaboration

 - Maintain accurate customer records, pipeline activity, forecasts, and sales documentation within the company's CRM platform.

 - Partner closely with Implementation, Customer Success, and Account Management teams to ensure seamless customer onboarding and successful handoffs following contract execution.

 - Participate in ongoing sales training, professional development, and product education to strengthen sales effectiveness and industry knowledge.

 - Represent Yondr at regional and national education conferences, trade shows, and industry events to generate awareness and new business opportunities.

 - Perform additional duties and special projects as assigned in support of departmental and organizational objectives.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required Qualifications

 - Five (5) or more years of professional sales experience with demonstrated success meeting or exceeding sales goals.

 - Experience in outbound prospecting, cold calling, lead generation, and pipeline development.

 - Ability to travel up to 60% to support customer meetings, conferences, and business development activities.

 - Valid U.S. driver's license and ability to travel throughout assigned territory.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

 - Consultative, relationship-focused approach to selling with a strong customer-first mindset.

 - Excellent interpersonal, communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.

 - Ability to build trust and credibility with school administrators and executive-level decision-makers.

 - Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.

 - Self-motivated and highly autonomous with excellent follow-through and accountability.

 - Comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced, and rapidly evolving environment.

 - Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to adapt solutions to customer needs.

 - Proficiency with CRM systems and standard business productivity applications.

 - Passion for Yondr's mission of creating distraction-free environments that promote meaningful human connection.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience selling into the K–12 education market.

 - Experience presenting to school boards, district leadership teams, or educational organizations.

 - Familiarity with public sector purchasing processes and RFP responses.

 - Previous experience representing an organization at conferences, trade shows, or industry events.

 - Experience in solution-based or consultative B2B sales.

 - Physical Requirements

 - Ability to remain stationary for extended periods while working at a computer.

 - Ability to communicate effectively in person, virtually, and by telephone.

 - Ability to travel up to 60% of the time, including occasional evenings and weekends for conferences and customer events.

 - Ability to transport sales materials, displays, and equipment weighing up to 25 pounds.

JOB LOCATION

 - Remote position

 - Although this position is remote, this person must be located in the Atlanta area.

COMPENSATION

 - Expected OTE = $155,000 - $165,000 w/a base range of $90k - $100k

YONDR BENIFITS

 - 100% paid medical coverage plan option for employees and access to 15+ plan types, including PPO, HMO and HDHP

 - Dental and vision and ancillary benefits such as short-term disability, long-term disability and life insurance

jobs.title: Senior Director, Production, Marcom (US)
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
About Code and Theory

At Code and Theory, we thrive at the intersection of creativity and technology. We build brands through big ideas, bold storytelling, and content that actually moves people. Our teams don't just execute work. They shape it. Through a culture of invention, we turn ambitious concepts into memorable experiences that resonate across every channel.

Production is the engine that drives creative work forward at Code and Theory. Our producers are equal parts creative partner and operational powerhouse: planning, scoping, pricing, challenging, and innovating to bring structure to the chaos so the best work can thrive.

Sr. Directors are the senior leaders who own the health and growth of a defined portfolio of client partnerships. They build the teams, develop the talent, and create the conditions for great work to happen consistently and at scale. They are trusted by clients at the highest levels, relied on by their teams as true leaders, and operate with the kind of autonomy that comes from deep experience and sound judgment.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Own delivery, financial health, and client relationships across a defined cluster of accounts, maintaining full portfolio visibility and leadership direction

• Lead and develop a team of Directors, Associate Directors, and Producers, owning development plans and building a culture that retains strong talent

• Serve as senior delivery partner to top-tier clients, building executive relationships and sustaining partnerships through consistent communication and delivery

• Strengthen production processes across the portfolio, enforcing standards, identifying efficiencies, and increasing team agility on every account

• Lead pitch and proposal efforts for assigned accounts, developing scope, staffing plans, and budgets, and building the case for what great work requires

• Build and maintain institutional knowledge across the account cluster, including client businesses, teams, and agency history

• Forecast portfolio needs, including resourcing, coverage, and team capacity, keeping Resource Management informed ahead of gaps

• Champion growth across the full pod, fostering a culture of learning, feedback, and continuous improvement

• Identify and pursue opportunities to grow client partnerships and expand scope of work across accounts

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

• 12+ years of experience across integrated production: campaign, content, video, digital, experiential, and brand work

• Proven track record managing managers, including team-building, director development, performance management, hiring, and personnel decisions

• Fluency in portfolio-level financial management, including P&L ownership across multiple accounts, margin risk identification, and resourcing decisions

• Executive-level client relationship experience, including senior representation in high-stakes conversations

• Demonstrated ability to build self-sustaining operations through systems and people, not personal hours

• Experience building and maintaining relationships with external production partners, with judgment on selection, timing, and scale

• Experience owning business development at scale, including scoping multi-workstream engagements and building business cases

• Genuine enthusiasm for the craft and for developing the people around it

• High EQ and ability to build trust quickly across clients, teams, and leadership

• Sound judgment operating autonomously, including knowing when to escalate and bringing a point of view, not just status

About Us

Born in 2001, Code and Theory is a digital-first creative agency that sits at the center of creativity and technology. We pride ourselves on not only solving consumer and business problems, but also helping to establish new capabilities for our clients. With a global client roster of Fortune 100s and start-ups alike, we crave the hardest problems to solve. With a remote-first approach to our people, we have teams distributed across North America, South America, Europe, and Asia. The Code and Theory global network of agencies is growing and includes Kettle, Instrument, Left Field Labs, Current, and TrueLogic.

Striving never to be pigeonholed, we work across every major category: from tech to CPG, financial services to travel & hospitality, government and education to media and publishing. We value the collaboration with our client partners, including but not limited to Adidas, Amazon, Con Edison, Diageo, EY, J.P. Morgan Chase, Lenovo, Marriott, Mars, Microsoft, Thomson Reuters, and TikTok.

The Code and Theory network is comprised of nearly 2,000 people with 50% engineers and 50% creative talent. We're always on the lookout for smart, driven, and forward-thinking people to join our team.

The base compensation range for this role is $190,000-$230,000 and spans multiple levels. We're open to hiring at the level that best matches the right candidate's experience. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, budget, and location.

jobs.title: Senior Administrative Assistant
jobs.description:
The Senior Administrative Assistant provides advanced, high-judgment administrative and operational support to the Vice President, Global Business Platforms, and their broader leadership team within a large, matrixed, global application development organization spanning Commercial IT. This organization is a substantial application development function across Commercial IT, operating a shared services model that supports tens of thousands of internal and external customers, a team of 200+ employees and 1,000+ non-employees, and a combined operating and capital budget of more than $100 million. Given the scale, complexity, and executive visibility of this organization, the Senior Administrative Assistant serves as a critical enabler of leadership productivity - managing complex calendars across multiple senior stakeholders, leading logistics for large-scale organizational events, administering key collaboration systems, and executing select financial and procurement processing - all while maintaining composure, discretion, and professionalism in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment with diverse executive stakeholders across Commercial Operations and Business Unit IT.

This position demands superior organizational abilities, sound judgment under pressure, and the capability to collaborate effectively with senior executives, Business Unit IT leaders, and external vendors to ensure smooth calendar management, event execution, and operational efficiency across a large, complex, global organization. The successful candidate will be responsible for cultivating and maintaining professional relationships across a diverse and matrixed stakeholder base to support leadership priorities and keep operations running seamlessly.

Ideal candidates will demonstrate the ability to build rapport and communicate professionally, be highly organized, self-motivated, and driven to anticipate needs before they arise. The role requires the ability to navigate between high-level executive support and detailed operational tactics within a fast-moving technology organization. The individual must possess composure and grace under pressure, discretion in handling sensitive and confidential information, and a strong professional presence when interfacing with executive leadership and external partners.

Responsibilities:

Calendar and Executive Support:

• Manage and proactively prioritize the VP's calendar, along with calendars for other senior leaders across the organization as needed; anticipate and resolve scheduling conflicts across a heavily matrixed stakeholder base before they escalate.
• Monitor and triage executive correspondence (email, calls) from a diverse set of internal executive stakeholders, Business Unit IT leaders, and external technology vendors/partners, draft responses, and flag priority actions.
• When necessary, coordinate meeting logistics, compile briefing/meeting materials, and prepare or revise presentations and business documents to support governance reviews, portfolio updates, and executive stakeholder communications.

Travel and Expense Management:

• Book and coordinate complex domestic and international travel arrangements for the VP and other senior leaders, reflecting the organization's global footprint across geographies and business units.
• Process related expense reports accurately and in a timely manner, ensuring compliance with company travel policy.

Event and Engagement Logistics:

• Plan and execute large-scale organizational events (e.g., Global Town Halls, leadership offsites, all-hands meetings for a 1,200+ person organization), including vendor sourcing, contracting, budget tracking, on-site logistics, and post-event follow-up.
• Own logistics for team building and engagement activities (e.g., summer picnics, holiday events) that foster a culture of inclusion, agility, innovation, and continuous improvement across a large, globally distributed team.
• Foster and facilitate departmental reviews, town halls, and cultural/social activities in partnership with organizational leaders and Business Unit IT partners.

Systems and Information Administration:

• Administer SharePoint sites for the organization from a user-access perspective - managing permissions, onboarding/offboarding users across a large employee and non-employee population and maintaining site structure in line with governance policies.
• Maintain departmental files and confidential/business-sensitive information (including matters related to budget, vendor contracts, and organizational strategy) in compliance with corporate and legal guidelines.
• Support new employee and contractor office setup and onboarding, reflecting the scale of the organization's employee and non-employee workforce.

Financial and Procurement Processing:

• Process financial transactions as needed, including creating purchase orders, routing/paying invoices, and reconciling related records in compliance with company purchasing policies — supporting an organization managing significant operating and capital budgets and a broad landscape of technology vendor and professional services contracts.
• Manage procurement of office supplies and stationery for the organization, tracking inventory and vendor relationships.
• Identify and proactively flag cost-saving or process-efficiency opportunities in day-to-day office operations, aligned with the organization's broader focus on total cost of ownership and productivity.

Communication and Liaison:

• Serve as a trusted point of contact for the VP and leadership team, ensuring effective communication and coordination among Commercial Operations executives, Business Unit IT leaders, and cross-functional partners.
• Build and maintain relationships with technology vendors, external partners, facilities, IT, and cross-functional teams to ensure seamless execution of events and operational needs.

Required:

• High school diploma
• Minimum 3–5 years of administrative experience, including supporting senior/executive-level leaders (VP or above).
• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to build trust, listen, and manage competing expectations/demands across a diverse and matrixed stakeholder base.
• Demonstrated experience planning and executing large-scale events with multiple external vendors.
• Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills; ability to manage multiple competing priorities under deadline pressure in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment.
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Excel) and corporate travel/expense systems.
• Proven track record of reliable execution. Keeps calm and executes while self-managing time and priorities.
• Demonstrated resilience and composure in high-stress, fast-changing situations, sound judgment under pressure.
• Be proactive and always think, act, and communicate in advance.

Preferred:

• Associate's or Bachelor's Degree a plus.
• Experience supporting multiple leaders concurrently preferred.
• Experience with purchase order creation, invoice/AP processing, or procurement systems (e.g., SAP, Ariba, Concur) strongly preferred.
• Working knowledge of SharePoint administration (site/user management) preferred.
• Familiarity with procurement processes and internal controls/governance standards.
• Experience coordinating with facilities, catering, and event vendors.
• Understanding of the pharmaceutical/biopharmaceutical business environment and/or exposure to a technology/IT organization.
• Experience supporting leaders who operate in large, global, matrixed organizations with diverse executive stakeholders.

​Applicable only to applicants applying to a position in any location with pay disclosure requirements under state or local law: ​

• The compensation range described below is the range of possible base pay compensation that the Company believes in good faith it will pay for this role at the time of this posting based on the job grade for this position. Individual compensation paid within this range will depend on many factors including geographic location, and we may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. ​
• We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off (vacation, holidays, sick), medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.​
• This job is eligible to participate in our short-term incentive programs. ​

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of  any bonus, commission, incentive, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole and absolute discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole and absolute discretion, consistent with applicable law.

jobs.title: RN Nurse Manager- Senior Living Home Care
jobs.description:
BAYADA Home Health Care is seeking a Registered Nurse (RN) to fill the position of Nurse Manager for our Wilmington, MA Medicare Certified Senior Living office. This office provides best-in-class care to adult and geriatric clients throughout the North Boston area territory.

This is an exceptional opportunity for an experienced Home Health or VNA nurse leader who is passionate about clinical excellence, team development, and delivering outstanding patient outcomes. We are seeking a strong clinician with case management experience and proven leadership skills who is ready to make a broader impact by mentoring staff, driving quality initiatives, and helping shape the future of our growing Senior Living practice.

At BAYADA, you'll join one of the nation's leading home health care organizations, recognized for its commitment to quality, innovation, and employee experience. Founded on The BAYADA Way, our mission-driven culture empowers leaders to focus on what matters most: providing exceptional care to clients while supporting and developing outstanding clinicians. BAYADA has earned national recognition as a Top Workplace and continues to be a trusted leader in home health care across the country.

Details:

• Location: Wilmington, MA

• Schedule: Monday - Friday 8:30 AM - 5:00 PM

• Competitive compensation package Base Salary: $95,000 - $100,000 annually, depending on qualifications Bonus Potential: Quarterly bonus incentives eligible to earn up to $3,000 per quarter

BAYADA offers a comprehensive benefits plan that includes the following:

• Paid holidays, vacation, and sick leave

• Vision, dental, and medical health plans

• Employer-paid life insurance, 401(k) with company match, direct deposit, and employee assistance program

• Field mileage reimbursement

• Career advancement opportunities within a nationally recognized healthcare organization

• Clinical and leadership development programs designed to support long-term professional growth

As a HHMC Nurse Manager, your day may look like this!

• Build strong partnerships with referral sources, clients, families, and community stakeholders.

If you're a Registered Nurse (RN) with the following skills, this could be your dream job!

• 3+ years of experience as an RN in Home Health, Visiting Nurse Association (VNA), or community-based healthcare.

• 2+ years of leadership, supervisory, Clinical Manager, Patient Care Manager, or Nurse Manager experience.

• Strong knowledge of home health policies, procedures, regulatory requirements, and documentation standards.

jobs.title: Legal Operations Manager
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA; San Jose, CA
jobs.description:
Fastly helps people stay better connected with the things they love. Fastly’s edge cloud platform enables customers to create great digital experiences quickly, securely, and reliably by processing, serving, and securing our customers’ applications as close to their end-users as possible — at the edge of the Internet. The platform is designed to take advantage of the modern internet, to be programmable, and to support agile software development. Fastly’s customers include many of the world’s most prominent companies, including GitHub, Yelp, Paramount, and JetBlue.

We're building a more trustworthy Internet. Come join us.

Posting Open Date: 10/1/26

Anticipated Posting Close Date*: 1/1/27

*Job posting may close early due to the volume of applicants.

Legal Operations Manager

Fastly's global edge cloud platform helps the world's most popular digital businesses deliver fast, secure, and reliable experiences to their customers. Our Legal team moves at the speed of the business, and we're looking for a Senior Legal Operations Manager to help us do it even better. In this role, you'll help develop and manage the systems, processes, and relationships that keep Legal running efficiently, with a particular emphasis on how we thoughtfully put AI to work across the department. You'll partner directly with the Legal team (including the Chief Legal and Administrative Officer), Finance, IT, Business Systems, and Security to continue turning legal operations into a real competitive advantage. This is an individual contributor role that will report to the Director of Legal Operations, with room to grow within the Legal Operations organization.

What You'll Do:

Contract Lifecycle Management

• Serve as the key administrator of Ironclad, owning templates, workflows, repository design, system configuration, and technical integrations (e.g., Salesforce, Claude, GitHub).

• Help establish standardized, automated, efficient, and scalable contracting processes across business and legal teams, including intake, routing, review, approval, execution, and post-signature processes in close partnership with Legal, Sales, Finance, Procurement, IT, and other business stakeholders.

• Strong focus on leveraging AI to strengthen the post-signature contract repository, powering smarter search, extraction, classification, risk identification, and obligation management on a foundation of clean, well-structured contract data.

• Develop and maintain detailed process documentation and training materials that you will use to drive change management and adoption across the Legal team and relevant cross-functional partners.

Financial Management, E-Billing & Vendor Management

• Manage the strategic use of Onit's Unity (aka SimpleLegal) for e-billing and spend management, including using AI-assisted invoice review and spend-analysis tools to enforce billing guidelines, flag exceptions, and surface spend trends.

• Help manage outside counsel and legal service provider relationships, including the implementation and and management of outside counsel guidelines.

• Help manage the legal technology vendor lifecycle in partnership with Procurement and IT, including evaluations, renewals, licensing, and SOWs.

• Assist in building and maintaining the Legal team's annual budget and forecast, tracking spend against plan and flagging variances early.

• Assist in the development of data-driven reporting on legal spend, matter volume, and operational KPIs for Legal leadership.

• Develop and maintain detailed process documentation and training materials to drive change management and adoption across the legal team and relevant cross-functional partners.

Knowledge Management

• Maintain and improve the Legal team's knowledge management repositories in Google Drive and Confluence, including how templates, policies, memoranda, playbooks, and other work product are organized and accessed by the Legal team and business partners.

• Partner with subject-matter owners across the department to ensure the team's playbooks, training materials, policies, and knowledge base content are kept current.

• Leverage AI to take inventory of repository materials and identify outdated, incomplete, and/or missing content on an ongoing basis.

eDiscovery

• Assist in managing legal holds, data preservations, data collections, and document reviews using the Reveal ecosystem (Reveal Hold, Onna, and Logikcull).

• Develop and maintain detailed process documentation and training materials to drive change management and adoption across the legal team and relevant cross-functional partners.

Program Management and Operational Excellence

• Serve as a central program management partner across Legal department initiatives, managing project plans, timelines, workstreams, dependencies, prioritization, and delivery.

• Assist in program management of Legal department calendar and department-wide meetings such as leadership team meetings, all-hands, quarterly priority updates, etc.

• Partner with Legal and cross-functional stakeholders to conduct discovery, understand business requirements, and translate needs into actionable programs and solutions.

• Help develop and execute change-management strategies for new processes, technologies, and AI capabilities, driving adoption through communication, training, and feedback loops.

AI Innovation

• Partner with Legal and cross functional teams to support the Legal Department's AI and innovation roadmap.

• Leverage AI to build intelligent intake, triage, workflow, and knowledge systems that resolve routine legal questions quickly and consistently while directing the hardest problems to the right people.

• Help evaluate, pilot, and scale AI-powered legal tools, defining success criteria, testing against manual legal work, and making clear go/no-go calls before rolling anything out broadly.

• Partner with IT, Information Security, and Privacy to ensure AI tools are deployed and used responsibly, with appropriate governance, risk review, and human oversight of AI output.

• Build and deploy AI-enabled workflows that meaningfully increase the leverage of every person on the Legal team.

What We're Looking For:

• 7+ years of experience in legal operations, business/program operations, or a related function, ideally within a technology, SaaS, AI, or other high-growth and fast-paced environment.

• Hands-on experience administering Ironclad (CLM), SimpleLegal/Unity (matter management and e-billing), and eDiscovery management platforms.

• Significant experience using and deploying generative AI tools (e.g., Claude and Gemini) and agents to drive efficiency in legal and legal operations work.

• Experience building and managing knowledge management systems and playbooks/templates used across a legal team.

• Demonstrated experience managing legal spend and supporting legal budgeting, forecasting, and accrual processes in partnership with Finance.

• Track record of leading complex, cross-functional programs from strategy through execution, and of driving adoption of new tools and processes with sophisticated stakeholders, including attorneys.

• Strong analytical and process improvement skills, with the ability to turn data into clear, actionable insights for legal and business leadership.

• Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across all levels and functions without direct authority.

• A hyper-organized and detail-oriented project manager with the ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities in a fast-paced, distributed environment.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

We'll be super impressed if you have experience in any of these:

• Experience with eDiscovery, legal hold, or data governance platforms such as Reveal Hold, Onna, or Logikcull.

• Experience designing and evaluating AI pilots with defined success criteria and attorney oversight of AI output.

• Experience with trade compliance or export screening workflows and tools such as Descartes.

• Experience supporting a legal department at a public technology company.

• Project management or process improvement credentials (e.g., PMP, Lean, Six Sigma).

• Active participation in the legal operations community (e.g., CLOC, ACC Legal Operations).

Work Hours:

The standard working hours for this role are during core business hours, Monday through Friday. However, flexibility is required to work outside of these hours on occasion to support business needs, accommodate different time zones, or meet project deadlines.

Work Location(s) & Travel Requirements:

This position has one opening and can be hired in the following preferred office location:

• San Francisco, CA

Fastly currently embraces a largely hybrid model for most roles which allows employees flexibility to split their time between the office and home.

This position may require travel as required by your role or requested by your manager.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Salary:

The estimated salary range for this position is $143,860.00 to $172,632.00.

Starting salary may vary based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, and location.

This role may be eligible to participate in Fastly's equity and discretionary bonus programs.

Benefits:

We care about you. Fastly works hard to create a positive environment for our employees, and we think your life outside of work is important too. We support our teams with great benefits that start on the first day of your employment with Fastly. Curious about our offerings?

We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance. Family planning, mental health support along with Employee Assistance Program, Insurance (Life, Disability, and Accident), a Flexible Vacation policy and up to 18 days of accrued paid sick leave are there to help support our employees. We also offer 401(k) (including company match) and an Employee Stock Purchase Program. For 2026, we offer 12 paid local holidays, 12 paid company wellness days.

Why Fastly?

Not only do our customers have a tremendous user base, but we also support a growing number of open source projects and initiatives. Outside of code, employees are encouraged to share causes close to their heart with others so we can help lend a supportive hand.

We’re always looking for humble, sharp, and creative folks to join the Fastly team. If you think you might be a fit please apply! A fully completed application and resume or CV are required when applying.

jobs.title: GCP Cloud/DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
Washington D.C. Pay Range:

$120,000 - $140,000 USD

LightFeather is seeking a GCP Cloud/DevOps Engineer who will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and maintaining cloud infrastructure solutions within Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This role requires expertise in infrastructure automation, cloud security, networking, and CI/CD pipeline development. The ideal candidate will work closely with cross-functional teams to drive cloud optimization and automation efforts in a high-security government environment.

This role offers an exciting opportunity to shape cloud automation and infrastructure strategies in a high-impact government environment.

• Location: In-Person (5 days/week) in Washington, DC

• Job Type: Full Time

• Clearance Requirement: U.S. citizenship is required for this position due to federal contract requirements and the need to obtain and maintain a Top Secret-level security clearance

Key Responsibilities

• Design, implement, and manage secure and scalable cloud infrastructure using GCP.

• Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code (IaC) using Terraform, Deployment Manager, or similar tools.

• Support CI/CD pipeline automation, integration, and management.

• Collaborate with software engineers, security personnel, and government stakeholders to support development and deployment workflows.

• Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and ensure cloud services meet SLAs.

• Implement cloud best practices and ensure compliance with federal security standards (e.g., FedRAMP, NIST).

• Provide documentation and knowledge sharing with the broader engineering team.

Required Qualifications

• Willing to obtain a security clearance.

• 4+ years of experience in cloud engineering, with at least 2 years on GCP.

• Hands-on experience with GCP services such as Compute Engine, Cloud Functions, VPC, IAM, GKE, and BigQuery.

• Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools like Terraform, Ansible, or Deployment Manager.

• Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as GitLab CI, Jenkins, or Cloud Build.

• Solid understanding of Linux systems, networking, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).

jobs.title: Revenue Enablement Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT HANDSHAKE

Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.

In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to ~$1B run rate and pay ~$60M to over 30K individuals every month.

Why join Handshake now:

 - Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel

 - Partner hand-in-hand with world-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions

 - Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders

 - Build a massive, fast-growing business with billions in revenue

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

Handshake is building the enablement function that helps our revenue teams sell, retain, and grow customers more effectively. As Revenue Enablement Manager, you'll design and run the training, content, tools, and onboarding programs that equip our Account Executives, Account Managers, and CSMs to execute consistently against our go-to-market motion. This is a new, high-visibility role where you'll partner with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to tie enablement directly to pipeline, retention, and revenue outcomes.

In this role, you will:

 - Design onboarding programs, ramp plans, certifications, and role-play practice that get new AEs, AMs, and CSMs to productivity faster

 - Build playbooks, battlecards, objection-handling guides, and talk tracks with Product Marketing and Sales leadership to improve win rates and keep messaging consistent

 - Partner with Revenue Operations to analyze Salesforce and Gong data, pinpoint skill gaps, and launch targeted coaching that lifts quota attainment

 - Own the enablement calendar and tooling (Salesforce, Nooks, Gainsight, Gong, LMS/content hub) to keep the field current on releases, positioning, and process, and able to find the right resource at every deal stage

 


DESIRED CAPABILITIES

 - 2–5+ years in sales enablement, revenue enablement, sales training, RevOps, or a related GTM role, ideally in B2B SaaS (client-facing experience counts toward this)

 - Track record designing and running onboarding, certification, or ongoing training for sales or CS teams

 - Experience developing playbooks, battlecards, talk tracks, and case studies with product marketing or sales leadership

 - Hands-on CRM proficiency (Salesforce preferred)

 - Familiarity with conversation-intelligence and sales engagement platforms (Gong, Outreach, Nooks)

 - Comfort pulling and interpreting enablement and pipeline metrics to show program impact and reprioritize

 - Strong facilitator and communicator who can run live and virtual sessions and execute projects independently

 - Operator mindset: you tie every program to a metric (ramp time, win rate, retention)

 - Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

 


EXTRA CREDIT

 - Experience supporting both new-business (AE) and post-sale (AM/CSM) motions

 - Prior experience standing up an enablement function or program from the ground up

 - Enablement certifications (e.g., CSTM, Sales Enablement PRO)

jobs.title: Transform Mental Health with Daybreak Health
jobs.description:
Sacramento Clinicians Welcome

Make a Real Difference — On Your Terms, On Your Schedule

At Daybreak Health, we believe quality mental healthcare should be within reach for every person who needs it — from teens to adults. Through our partnerships with 60+ school districts and Kaiser Permanente, we're already reaching over a million students nationwide, and we're growing fast — now extending therapy to adults through our Kaiser program too.

This is a season of real opportunity, and we'd love for you to be part of it. Join a clinician community that hands you a steady, reliable stream of referrals, a caseload that fills itself (our clinicians average a 96% caseload fill rate — set 10 slots, and expect roughly 9 filled quickly), and the freedom to build a practice that actually fits your life — fully remote, on your own terms.

Who We're Looking For

Fully licensed California clinicians (LCSW, LPCC, LMFT, or LP) ready to do meaningful, high-quality teletherapy work. You bring your clinical strengths; we let you choose how to use them — working with youth and young adults (ages 11–24), adults (18–60), or a blend of both, whatever energizes your practice most.

Associate and provisionally licensed clinicians aren't eligible for this role.

Compensation & Benefits — Designed to Let You Thrive

• $75–$95 per session, plus guaranteed pay for no-shows and late cancellations

• Onboarding stipend to help you start strong from day one

• Paid clinical consultation, malpractice insurance provided, and free CE credits year-round

• 1099 independent contractor flexibility — no commute, no minimum office hours, just a schedule that flows around your life

Flexibility That Actually Works For You

• Fully remote — work from anywhere in the U.S.

• Set your own hours, Monday–Sunday, 8am–8pm PT (weekends optional)

• Just 5 sessions/week minimum, no cap — we do the heavy lifting of matching and booking your initial sessions directly into your availability, so you spend less time chasing referrals and more time doing what you love: being in the room with clients

• We handle your initial intake scheduling, so your energy stays where it belongs — on care, not chasing referrals

What You'll Do

• Build strong, trusting therapeutic relationships across age groups

• Provide evidence-based individual teletherapy to clients ages 11–24 or 18–60 with mild-to-moderate mental health needs

• Offer psychoeducation to parents/caregivers when working with younger clients

What You Bring

• Active LCSW, LPCC, LMFT, or LP license in the State of California

• A genuine passion for mental health care, with a commitment to culturally responsive, equitable practice

• Experience providing individual therapy to youth and/or adults

• Comfort and prior experience with telehealth service delivery

Ready to build a practice that gives back as much as you give? We'd love to hear from you. 🌱
