jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.



We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.



We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.



If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.



About This Role:

Join Crusoe as a Safety Engineer supporting the design, manufacturing, and deployment of modular integrated electronics buildings and power distribution equipment. In this role, you will serve as the safety subject matter expert embedded across engineering and manufacturing, ensuring that electrical safety, machine safety, and process safety are built into our products and facilities from the earliest design stages through field deployment.

This position requires an engineer who can bridge technical design and safety compliance — working closely with Mechanical Design Engineers and Manufacturing Engineers to identify hazards, drive design improvements, and ensure our low voltage switchboards, medium voltage switchgear, and critical power distribution equipment meet applicable safety codes and standards.



What You’ll Be Working On:

 - Design Team Safety Representation: Serve as the dedicated safety representative on design teams, reviewing 3D models, drawings, and specifications for modular buildings and power distribution equipment to identify potential hazards early in the design cycle

 - Technical Safety Program Ownership: Act as subject matter expert for technical safety programs, including electrical safety, Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), and machine safety

 - Safety Analysis: Conduct hazard identification, risk assessments (e.g., FMEA, FTA), and failure mode analysis on products, equipment, and facility systems

 - Documentation: Develop and maintain safety documentation, including safety cases, hazard logs, and compliance reports

 - Code Compliance: Ensure designs and facilities comply with applicable safety codes, regulatory requirements, and engineering standards (e.g., OSHA, NFPA 70E, IEC, UL listings)

 - Process Safety: Support Process Safety Management (PSM) program elements as they apply to facility operations and equipment

 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Mechanical Design, Manufacturing, Quality, and Operations teams to integrate safety requirements throughout the product lifecycle

 - Site Support: Support safety assessments, walkthroughs, and equipment inspections at company facilities and customer sites

 - Reporting: Prepare and present safety reports to management, regulatory bodies, or customers as needed



What You’ll Bring to the Team:

 - Education: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related discipline

 - Technical Foundation: Strong understanding of engineering principles as they relate to electrical and mechanical system safety

 - Standards Knowledge: Familiarity with relevant safety standards and regulatory requirements (e.g., OSHA, NFPA 70E, IEC, ISO)

 - Technical Literacy: Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, schematics, and specifications for electrical and mechanical systems

 - First Principles: Ability to solve safety-related engineering problems utilizing a first principles approach

 - Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with meticulous attention to detail

 - Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical safety findings for varied audiences



Bonus Points:

 - Experience with functional safety standards (e.g., IEC 61508, ISO 26262, IEC 60204)

 - Experience with Process Safety Management (PSM) programs

 - Experience with data centers, power distribution equipment, or complex electrical systems

 - Engineer in Training (EIT) and/or Professional Engineer (PE) License



Benefits:

 - Restricted Stock Units

 - Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

 - Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

 - Employer contributions to HSA account

 - Paid parental leave

 - Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

 - Professional development & tuition reimbursement

 - Mental health & wellness support

 - Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

 - Cell phone stipend

 - 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

 - Volunteer time off

 - Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

 - Daily meals allowance

 - Additional perks & programs specific to location



Compensation:

Compensation will be paid in the range of $115,000 - $150,000. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. (#INDCORP)

jobs.title: Manager, Events & Operations
jobs.description:
Manager, Events & Operations

About Praxis

Praxis began in 2011 with a desire to support and equip Christian entrepreneurs and has grown steadily into a 35+ global team, headquartered in NYC, advancing the redemptive quests of founders, funders, and innovators motivated by their faith to address the major issues of our time. As a $15M+/year nonprofit with ambitious growth plans, we’re expanding our venture-building work globally, organizing around the major issues of our time, and building media and more to activate the redemptive potential of Christians around the world. We see our team as the first carriers of the mission, building an organization that is great to work at, excellent in its craft, and redemptive in its finances as well as its programs.

The Role

Loom from Direct Supervisor

At Praxis, we believe gathering people well is an act of service. Praxis gathers a global community of redemptive entrepreneurs, investors, and leaders through a portfolio of events — Redemptive Imagination Summit, Accelerator gatherings, ORI Forums, Global Regional Gatherings, and more. Every detail, from the first invitation to the final debrief, is a chance to extend hospitality and make room for the people we serve to do their best work.

This role reports to the Director, Events & Community.  The Manager, Events and Operations helps Praxis translate program vision into excellent, hospitable, and operationally sound experiences. The Manager holds two things at once. First, they own a portfolio of events as the event lead, serving as the Program team's primary operational partner from discovery through debrief. Second, partnering closely with the Director to keep the full events portfolio moving with clarity, foresight, and consistent planning practices.

Maintain a rolling 18-month calendar view while aligning milestone decisions, location sourcing, and delivery schedules across the portfolio. You will support event leads in establishing structured, reliable execution boards, while partnering alongside the Director and Systems Manager to advance our Event Operating System—guiding product feature roadmaps, the live attendee mobile app, team workflow tools, and centralizing organizational knowledge in Notion.

This role is for someone who enjoys moving between hands-on event leadership and big-picture portfolio coordination. One day you're executing logistics and designing thoughtful attendee experiences. The next you're stepping back with the Director to align timelines, staffing, and priorities across the full calendar. Above all, we're looking for a strong events operator: someone who runs a tight plan so that everyone in the room can simply feel welcomed.

Key Areas of Responsibility

Event Operations Lead (50%)

Event Portfolio: US Business, US Non-Profit, APAC, and Africa Accelerator Events

• Partner around program vision and experience. Work with each program team to shape the event experience design and agenda. Join key program-content design meetings and working groups, bringing an operator's perspective to what the program hopes to create.

• Turn program decisions into next steps. Translate decisions into assigned work. Keep Asana, Notion, and other event systems current.

• Set up the planning process. Launch the Asana project, Notion Execution Guide, and planning calendar. Schedule kickoffs, working groups, milestone reviews, table reads, and action plan reads.

• Make sure the work is covered for assigned events. Ensure every event function has a named owner and clear responsibilities. Bring staffing needs, timing conflicts, and recommended adjustments to the Director.

• Keep the master agenda aligned. Maintain an accurate agenda in Airtable. Carry changes into assignments, communications, production, and vendor plans.

• Support teammates in their functions. Help each Events team member see how their work fits the full event. Review plans against the master agenda and flag gaps early.

• Care for invitations and attendee communications. Draft copy and activate MixMax. Build registration pages and RSVP tracking, keeping attendee data accurate.

• Coordinate assigned event functions. Guide print production, venue management, vendors, supplies and inventory, rentals, decor, transportation, F&B, and AVL production.

• Coordinate decks, scripts, and event systems. Lead the deck management process and assign script and deck content tasks. Set up event resources in Notion.

• Keep shared planning resources useful. Maintain project timelines, supply lists, and action plans.

• Prepare the team for onsite execution. Build function plans into the Host Team Action Plan and check workloads. Lead operational reads and coordinate training.

• Help recruit, train, and manage seasonal the onsite Host Team (event support). Lead the onsite Host Team. Guide the team with clarity, warmth, and attention to detail.

• Learn together and improve. Gather feedback with Program and Community and lead the operational debrief. Update the Event Playbook, Execution Guide, and Asana template.

• Apprentice the Summit Executive Producer and function as an Assistant Producer

• Support other events in our portfolio as assigned to specific support functions.

Events Capability Project Manager (30%)

Praxis hosts approximately 40 events each year, spanning a range of sizes and complexity. As an integrator alongside the Director, you'll help set the pace for planning and project development across the portfolio.

• Hold the portfolio calendar. Maintain a single view of where every event sits in the planning framework. Flag events drifting behind their planning stage early.

• Coordinating venue research projects to secure locations up to two years in advance.

• Help the team launch event projects. Schedule and help run kickoff calls. Confirm the Asana project board is built with assigned function owners.

• Plan 18 months out. Maintain a rolling 18-month view of the event calendar with the Director. Surface staffing pressure and overlapping build periods while there is time to adjust.

• Hold the quality bar on Asana. Audit event boards against Events Capability best practices and the organizing model. Check structure, assignments, dates, dependencies, and anything missing.

• Enable other Event Team Leads. Be the first stop for questions about how something should be set up. Offer templates and working sessions rather than corrections after the fact.

• Log what keeps coming up. Keep a running record of recurring gaps and friction points across events. Bring patterns to the Director as candidates for the capability roadmap.

• Support team administration. Help maintain meeting frequencies, rhythms, and agendas for the Events team.

Event Operating Systems & Knowledge Infrastructure (20%)

• Help project manage the operating system roadmap.

• Assist with other event systems like attendee in-take forms and registration pages.

• Keep Airtable clean. Maintain data accuracy and consistency across event records.

• Support testing and adoption of EventOS. Coordinate testing across events and program teams, and gather feedback from live events.

• Build out the Notion teamspace. Ensure the Events Capability Teamspace is actively developed and current. Cover playbooks and SOPs for major functions like Vendor Management, Venue Research & Sourcing, etc.

• Create uniformity across function documentation. Partner with events’ team specialist leaders to capture their process. Hold a consistent structure and naming convention so every function hub is built the same way.

Who You Are

This role is for someone energized by the health of a system, not only the success of a single event. You read a project board and immediately see what's missing. You'd rather build the template than repeat the work. And you take quiet pride in a team that arrives onsite already knowing what to do.

Above all, you're a team player. You genuinely love supporting other people's work and find real satisfaction in making a teammate's job easier. You lead as an enabler, offering help before it's asked for and measuring your success by how well the people around you are set up to succeed. You believe that the care behind the scenes is what makes hospitality possible in the room.

Expected Competencies

• 4+ years in event design and operations, production, or project management, including ownership of multi-day events for 100+ attendees.

• Demonstrated fluency with project management tooling — Asana strongly preferred — including building and maintaining templates, not just working inside them.

• Demonstrated fluency with Notion, Airtable, or comparable systems, with an instinct for structure and naming that holds up as things scale.

• Comfort holding long horizons: the ability to work an 18-month calendar and a same-week deadline without losing either.

• Strong oral and written communication, especially in attendee-facing copy and internal documentation.

• Willingness to travel and to work the hours an event requires while it is live.

• Alignment with Praxis's mission and a genuine interest in serving redemptive entrepreneurs and the community we gather.

Additional Details

• Location: New York City, NY (Praxis HQ at Coram Deo) required

• Travel: 30-45 days annually for events and gatherings outside NYC (all business travel covered). Includes Summit in Napa, Redemptive Imagination Forums, Accelerators, Nonprofit Showcase, and select regional events.

• Reports to: Director, Summit & Community

• Range: $85k - $105k based on experience and location (HQ-based candidates are paid more).

• For all Praxis roles, we are open to candidates who are ‘outside of range’. That is to say, growth-minded applicants at an earlier stage of career and comp, or candidates with experience above the highest end of the job description and compensation range, are welcome & encouraged to apply.

• Benefits: Comprehensive package, including fully paid health insurance premiums for employees & their dependents, 5% 401k match, flexible vacation policy

Cultural Alignment

Praxis finds its theological identity most clearly stated in the Lausanne Covenant (1974) and the Cape Town Commitment (2010). All Praxis staff and program participants are asked to affirm The Apostles’ Creed as a statement of their own beliefs. The ideal candidate will demonstrate alignment with the above, as well as our mission to advance redemptive entrepreneurship. We're seeking a leader who combines operational excellence with a spirit of humility and service, contributing to our vision of building an organization that embodies redemptive principles in all aspects of its work and culture, which includes shared rhythms such as daily team prayer and a company-wide weekly Sabbath, as detailed in our Rule of Life for Redemptive Entrepreneurs (rule.praxislabs.org).

jobs.title: Staff Technical Marketing Writer
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Video is 90% of the world's data. Most of it is invisible to machines.
TwelveLabs builds the intelligence layer to change that. Our multimodal AI models understand video the way humans do — across sight, sound, and motion — and power production-scale AI workloads across media, entertainment, sports, security, and government.


We have raised more than $210 million from NEA, Radical Ventures, Amazon, NVIDIA, Snowflake, Databricks, Index Ventures, NAVER Ventures, Korea Investment Partners, Quadrille Capital, Red Bull Ventures, and AI pioneers including Fei-Fei Li, Silvio Savarese, and Alexandr Wang.


We are a global company, headquartered in San Francisco with offices in Seoul, New York, and London, and employees around the world. We believe the differences in our cultural, educational, and life experiences make our products stronger. Building technology that understands the world in all its complexity requires people who see it from every angle. We are looking for individuals who are driven by hard problems and want their work to matter. Come build it with us!




ABOUT THE ROLE

TwelveLabs is looking for a Technical Marketing Writer who can take our video AI technology, Marengo and Pegasus, and turn it into content that a wide range of people actually want to read and use. This isn't a documentation role. You won't be writing API references or product manuals. You'll be the person who makes our technology feel approachable across audiences, whether that's a developer building with our API, a creator or AI-native builder using our models through Claude, ChatGPT, or an MCP server, or a marketer trying to understand what's possible.

You're comfortable enough with code and APIs to follow along with a technical implementation, but your real skill is translation. You can take something complex, like multimodal video embeddings or video-to-text reasoning, and shape it into whatever form fits the audience: a step-by-step tutorial for a developer, a plain-language explainer for someone using our models through a chat interface, or a forum post that sparks a conversation.

Candidates must be able to travel up to 10% of the time annually to attend conferences, off-site meetings, and other business-related events as required by the role. This role may require participation in on-site interviews and/or completion of in-person onboarding processes.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Write blog posts, guides, video outlines, and tutorials that help a range of audiences, from developers to creators to AI-native builders, understand and start using TwelveLabs' products

 - Own SEO and on-page optimization for content, working with external SEO and web dev support to make sure what you write actually gets found

 - Create educational resources (explainers, how-tos, conceptual overviews) that lower the barrier to understanding video AI for both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Write technical articles for external placement on developer forums, industry publications, and news sites

 - Support email and social copy when technical accuracy or product nuance matters

 - Partner with product, engineering, and partner marketing to stay current on what TwelveLabs can do and where it's headed, including how our models show up in tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and MCP servers

 - Keep a pulse on how competitors and the broader video AI space talk about their own technology, and use that to sharpen how we talk about ours





YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU HAVE

 - Experience writing technical or product content for a mix of audiences, ideally including both developers and less technical end users

 - A portfolio that shows you can simplify a complex technical concept without dumbing it down, and that you can adjust register depending on who's reading

 - Enough technical fluency to read documentation, follow a code sample, or sit in on an engineering conversation and come away with something to write

 - Working knowledge of SEO fundamentals (you don't need to be an SEO specialist, but you should know how content and search intersect)

 - Strong instincts for structure: you know how to build a guide or tutorial that someone can actually follow, not just read

 - Comfort moving between formats: long-form guides one day, a tight forum post or social caption the next





PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Familiarity with video, multimodal AI, or computer vision concepts

 - Experience writing about or using AI tools like Claude, ChatGPT, or MCP servers, especially explaining them to non-technical audiences

 - Experience writing for developer communities (forums, Dev.to http://Dev.to, Hacker News, Reddit)

 - Basic comfort with Git, APIs, or SDKs, enough to test something out yourself before writing about it




BENEFITS AND PERKS

🤝 An open and inclusive culture and work environment

🚀 Work closely with a collaborative, mission-driven team on cutting-edge AI technology

🏥 Full health, dental, and vision benefits

🌴 Extremely flexible PTO and parental leave policy. Office closed the week of Christmas and New Years

💪 Monthly wellness stipend

📚 Annual Learning & Development stipend to invest in your growth

💼 Global offices in San Francisco and Seoul, and coworking office memberships for remote team members

🛂 VISA support where applicable

🚆 Transportation stipend (SF onsite only)

🍲 Daily lunch & dinner provided (SF onsite only)

jobs.title: Senior Audience Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience.  Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide.

Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves.

We are looking for a Senior Audience Marketing Manager to own the audience strategy for an assigned industry vertical — across both net-new prospect accounts and Five9's existing customer base — and to be the connection between marketing investment and pipeline outcomes. Reporting to the Senior Director of N. America Demand Generation, this person is accountable for how well Five9 understands its target accounts in the vertical, how consistently marketing and sales work from the same plan, and how effectively the company's platform story lands with the specific buying committee in that industry, whether that account is being won for the first time or grown after the sale.

The specific vertical this role owns — Healthcare, Financial Services and Insurance, or another priority industry — is based on business need and may shift over time. Whatever the assignment, the job is the same: build the audience plan for the full account base in that vertical, run the campaigns that plan calls for, and manage the budget behind it, end to end.

The right candidate treats campaign execution as a means to a pipeline outcome, not an end in itself. They build, run, and optimize the campaigns their vertical needs, while partnering with Sales, Sales Development, Customer Success/Account Management, Solution Consulting, Product Marketing, and Brand to align that execution with go-to-market priorities rather than running a parallel plan. And they can defend the plan in front of leadership with pipeline logic, not vanity metrics.

Key Responsibilities

Audience Strategy & Measurement

• Own and communicate the audience marketing strategy for an assigned industry vertical tied directly to Five9's account-based go-to-market model, spanning the entire lifecycle from net-new prospect to customer advocate.

• Establish the measurement model connecting audience activity to business outcomes — new and expansion pipeline creation, account engagement, and progression through the funnel.

• Present vertical performance and investment cases to marketing and sales leadership with a clear line from spend to outcome.

Pipeline & Revenue Partnership

• Own the marketing contribution to the vertical's pipeline in direct partnership with the Sales, Sales Development, and Customer Success/Account Management teams working the same account list.

• Build and run marketing programs into the vertical's existing customer base, driving engagement, expansion, and cross-sell with the same rigor applied to net-new pipeline.

• Participate in the vertical's pipeline cadence, reporting progress and gaps alongside the sales and customer success counterparts who own the same accounts.

Persona & Positioning Strategy

• Adapt Five9's core platform positioning to the buying committee inside the vertical, translating a horizontal narrative into an industry-specific pitch.

• Equip Sales, Sales Development, and Customer Success/Account Management with vertical-specific messaging, proof points, and objection handling while staying current on the industry's regulatory and competitive context as assignments shift.

• Know which competitors matter most for the vertical — build that differentiation into campaign messaging proactively, ensuring the marketing itself makes the case rather than leaving differentiation to be argued deal-by-deal in Sales conversations.

Budget & Program Execution

• Manage the marketing budget for the vertical — making deliberate trade-offs across prospect accounts, customer accounts, events, campaigns, and content.

Candidate Requirements and Experience

• 6+ years of experience in B2B marketing, with direct accountability for pipeline or revenue outcomes.

• Experience designing and executing account-based, vertical, or industry-specific marketing programs.

• Track record partnering directly with sales organizations against a shared account list and shared pipeline targets.

• Demonstrated ability to tie marketing programs to pipeline and revenue outcomes, not activity metrics.

• Deep understanding of B2B SaaS buying processes and multi-persona buying committees, and experience owning and defending a marketing budget.

• Working fluency across the full demand marketing mix — field, digital, email, content, and events — with a clear point of view on how each channel contributes to, converts, and reinforces the others inside one integrated plan. This role is built for a well-rounded demand marketer, not a single-channel specialist.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt core positioning for different personas and industries, and comfort working consistently from shared frameworks and proof points rather than developing messaging independently.

• Experience marketing into a regulated or compliance-heavy B2B industry — financial services, healthcare, government, or similar — is highly recommended.

• Experience in contact center, CCaaS, UCaaS, or adjacent technology industries is highly recommended, along with familiarity with account scoring/ICP models, ABM platforms (e.g., 6sense, Demandbase), and Salesforce or marketing analytics tools.

• Hands-on proficiency with modern AI tools and a clear point of view on their application to audience and demand marketing — including practical experience using AI to accelerate campaign development, research, and content production.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

Work Location: This role is fully remote for candidates who reside outside the 30 mile radius of one of our offices.  For candidates who reside within a 30 mile radius of one of our offices, this role is Hybrid and would require 3 days a week (T, W, TH) in office.

As part of our continued commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion, Five9 supports pay transparency during the entire recruitment process.  Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate including, but not limited to: skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the job across the United States. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation package during your hiring process.

Additionally, the total compensation package for this position may also include an annual performance bonus, stock, and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans.

Our total reward package also includes:

• Health, dental, and vision coverage, beginning on the first day of employment. Five9 covers 100% of the employee portion of the health, dental and vision coverage and shares a high portion of the dependent cost. We also offer Short & Long-Term Disability, Basic Life Insurance, and a 401k saving plan with employer matching.

• Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.

• Generous employee stock purchase plan.

• Paid Time Off, Company paid holidays, paid volunteer hours and 12 weeks paid parental leave.

All compensation and benefits are subject to the requirements and restrictions set forth in the applicable plan documents and any written agreements between the parties.

The US base salary range for this role is below.

$82,300—$229,500 USD

Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.  The more inclusive we are, the better we are.  Five9 is an equal opportunity employer.

Five9 is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and interview process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@five9.com to request an accommodation. Requests will be handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable law.

View our privacy policy, including our privacy notice to California residents here: https://www.five9.com/pt-pt/legal.

Note: Five9 will never request that an applicant send money as a prerequisite for commencing employment with Five9.

jobs.title: Production Test Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril’s Manufacturing team is seeking a Production Test Engineering Manager to join our team. The EW Manufacturing Team is responsible for rapidly iterating and building cutting-edge defense hardware for Electromagnetic Warfare.

We aim to develop and deploy critically needed capabilities that address our customers’ most pressing national security requirements. As the Production Test Engineering Manager, your role encompasses the strategic oversight and tactical management of production systems to support high-volume products across the portfolio. You are charged with ensuring rigorous testing protocols are in place, resulting in the consistent delivery of superior quality products to our customers. Furthermore, your leadership guarantees the fulfillment of manufacturing's test throughput requirements. This position demands an innovative approach to resolving complex testing challenges, advancing scalability, and enhancing our automation, throughput, user interfaces, and data analytics methodologies.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Direct the manufacturing test engineering team, set objectives, guide initiatives, and assess team outcomes.

• Oversee and consistently contribute improvements of the manufacturing test strategy for each product to ensure scalable operations across Anduril, transitioning from pre-production to full-scale output.

• Collaborate with product SEIT and development engineering for design testability, ensuring seamless production integration.

• Strategize and implement advancements in manufacturing testing, focusing on automation, uniformity, and operational streamlining.

• Maintain test capabilities of multiple products across their respective manufacturing value stream - from system level checkouts and acceptance testing to key component level in process validation.

• Evaluate test data, compile findings, and identify opportunities for product and process enhancements.

• Communicate strategic visions to key stakeholders, guiding the scaling of platforms from pre-production (LRIP) through to mass production (FRP).

• Lead the procurement and implementation of new test equipment, performing cost-benefit and ROI analyses as needed.

• Champion initiatives that enhance safety, reduce costs, improve quality, and increase productivity through testing.

• Cultivate a culture focused on innovation, collaboration, and accountability in the engineering department.

• Act as the go-to technical authority for manufacturing test matters, advising on and troubleshooting complex issues.

• Design proactive maintenance and calibration protocols for manufacturing test equipment.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 8+ years of relevant industry experience with emphasis on manufacturing test and product sustainment.

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical/Electronics, Computer, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.

• Minimum of 2+ years as a people manager leading manufacturing test engineering or relevant adjacent fields.

• Experienced in Linux, C#, Python, NixOS, LabView, or other forms of test automation.

• Experience with computer hardware communication protocols: USB, Ethernet, RS232, RS485, PCIe, HDMI, CAN, etc.

• Solid experience with PCBA/electronic assembly testing and knowledge of testing standards including and not limited to: acceptance testing, EOL testing, and ESS testing.

• Proficiency in using electronic and RF test equipment.

• Strong analytical skills for root cause analysis of non-conforming electro-mechanical hardware

• Familiar with Test Execution Systems (TES), Product Life Cycle (PLM) systems, Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems.

• Experience in managing projects that integrate electrical, mechanical, and software/firmware systems.

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Demonstrated ability to lead the development of manufacturing test systems and teams.

• Proficiency in LabVIEW, MATLAB, and test automation.

• Knowledge of PCBA design and mechanical design

• Familiarity with various hardware communication protocols.

• Experience with designing HASS & ESS-related tests (Thermal, Vibration, etc.).

• Familiarity in using AI tools

US Salary Range

$146,000—$194,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Spacecraft represent the most pressing unmet need across the entire aerospace industry. As more launch vehicles come online and the cost to orbit decreases, more companies launching payloads to space continue to emerge.

For the first time in history, this influx of payload companies combined with reduced launch costs has resulted in a massive increase in need for commercial spacecraft platforms, known as satellite buses. These buses hold the payloads of our customers and are flown on launch vehicles.

Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more.

We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet. 




ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Embedded Software Engineer on Apex's Flight Software team, you will write the software that runs on the custom avionics hardware powering our satellite buses. You will work closely with avionics, GNC, propulsion, and hardware engineers to design and deliver the software for the components that make up the spacecraft, owning that software from the design phase all the way through flight. You will contribute across the full breadth of development, from architecting new systems and prototyping early ideas to writing the mission critical code that ultimately flies.

We are looking for motivated engineers who are eager to solve complex problems with a focus on practicality and scalability, and who thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.





RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Develop the low level software that configures and drives the processor peripherals and communication interfaces on our avionics.

 - Write and debug the device drivers for the sensors, actuators, and components across the bus.

 - Implement onboard algorithms, including closed loop control and the logic that detects and responds to faults such as failed sensors or radiation upsets.

 - Write quick, iterative code to support bench and development testing, along with the rigorous, reviewed, and tested code that ships to manufacturing and flight.

 - Provide embedded software input into new system and hardware designs.

 - Support commissioning of spacecraft during launch and early operations, ensuring software systems remain functional during critical operations.




REQUIREMENTS

 - U.S. Person status is required as this position needs to access export controlled data.

 - Bachelor's degree in CS, EE or equivalent, or equivalent professional experience.

 - 3+ years writing C/C++ for embedded systems, ideally on spacecraft, robotics, automotive, or other hardware that interacts with the physical world.

 - Experience developing firmware for microcontrollers, either bare-metal or on an RTOS.

 - Experience writing and debugging low level device drivers over interfaces such as SPI, I2C, UART, Ethernet, and CAN.

 - Comfort with hardware/software integration, including reading schematics and using tools like oscilloscopes and logic analyzers to bring up new hardware.

 - A solid understanding of microcontroller and microprocessor architecture, including memory, buses, and DMA.





PREFERRED REQUIREMENTS

 - 1+ year of flight software experience

 - FPGA development experience.

 - Experience bringing up new avionics or flight hardware from first power-on.

 - Experience with satellite attitude control systems (ACS), including reaction wheels, magnetorquers, and small thrusters.

 - Experience driving motors and power electronics or reading feedback sensors such as encoders and current monitors.

 - Familiarity with satellite systems and protocols, such as CCSDS and ECSS.



#LI-AB1


WHY JOIN APEX?

Apex believes in creating a work environment that you look forward to embracing every day. Our employees love working at Apex, and we want you to love it too. We're a fast-growing startup that has raised more than $500M in funding, and we invest heavily in our people from day one.




WHAT WE OFFER FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES:

 - Shared upside: Receive equity in Apex, letting you benefit from the work you create

 - Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents, plus $100k life insurance at no cost

 - Comprehensive PTO package to reset and recharge - starting at 15 days vacation, growing to 20+ days annually, plus 10 paid holidays

 - Competitive 401(k) plan with generous matching - 100% match on first 3%, 50% on next 2%

 - 8 weeks paid parental leave plus childcare reimbursement up to $350/day for work-related travel

 - Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks to keep you fueled throughout the day

 - Vibrant community: Monthly office socials, pickleball tournaments, run club, and gatherings for you and your family

 - Your dream desk setup and all the tools you need to be your most productive self

 - World-class Playa Vista office with the benefit of in-person collaboration with amazing coworkers and flexibility to integrate work and life

 - Real impact opportunity: Work alongside experts from aerospace, new space, and other cutting-edge industries to make a lasting difference




ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: 

Compensation ranges are set by role, level, location, and alignment with market data. A candidate's specific level and base pay are determined case by case and may vary with job-related skills, education, experience, technical capabilities, and internal equity. Beyond base salary, full-time hires are also eligible for long-term incentives in the form of stock options, along with medical, dental, and vision coverage and a 401(k) retirement plan.




ITAR REQUIREMENTS

Apex's work is governed by U.S. export control laws, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). To be eligible for this role, applicants must either (1) qualify as a U.S. Person, meaning a U.S. citizen or national, a lawful permanent resident (green card holder), a refugee admitted under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or an individual granted asylum under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or (2) be able to obtain the required export authorizations from the U.S. Department of State, the U.S. Department of Commerce, or another applicable U.S. government agency. You can learn more about ITAR here https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Apex Technology, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Candidates and employees are always evaluated based on merit, qualifications, and performance. We will never discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, national origin, ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability, or any other legally protected status.

About Us

Ennoble Care is a mobile primary care, palliative care, and hospice service provider with patients in New York, New Jersey, Maryland, DC, Virginia, Oklahoma, Kansas, Pennsylvania, Texas, Florida, and Georgia. Ennoble Care’s clinicians go to the home of the patient, providing continuum of care for those with chronic conditions and limited mobility. Ennoble Care offers a variety of programs including, remote patient monitoring, behavioral health management, and chronic care management, to ensure that our patients receive the highest quality of care by a team they know and trust. We seek individuals who are driven to make a difference and embody our motto, “To Care is an Honor.” Join Ennoble Care today!

Job Summary:

Ennoble Care is seeking a full-time, experienced Housecalls Community Liaisons for our San Antonio, TX markets. This role involves engaging with the community to promote our services, build relationships, and enhance brand awareness.

Responsibilities:

• Analyze the potential of the company's service area to determine target markets.

• Visit Doctor' offices, hospitals, Assisted Living facilities, Skilled Nursing Facilities and other possible sources of referrals to present Agency credentials and obtain patient referrals.

• Analyze the company's organization to determine its strengths and weaknesses.

• Analyze past and current marketing data.

• Complete an analysis of the company's "product" line.

• Analyze patient/company relationships.

• Develop sales/marketing objectives and sales projections.

• Develop a marketing plan, identifying priorities and sets a reasonable timetable.

• Implement marketing plan staying within established timetable.

• Review and evaluate the analyses and plan on an established basis.

• Attend IDG meetings, as appropriate.

• Assist office staff as needed with going to updates, etc.

• Provide community outreach and education.

Qualifications:

• At least 3 years experience in marketing, nursing or social work interacting with health agencies/professionals.

• Must be organized and detail oriented.

• Must be able to communicate effectively orally and in writing.

• Must be a licensed driver with an insured automobile in good working order.

jobs.title: Project Services Manager
jobs.description:
Fortera is transforming one of the world’s largest industries by reinventing how cement is made. Headquartered in Silicon Valley, Fortera has developed next-generation cement technology that delivers high performance while reducing CO₂ emissions by up to ~70%. By mineralizing CO₂ and turning it into a productive feedstock, Fortera converts emissions into a valuable building material, creating a more sustainable path for modern construction.

With our commercial ReCarb® plant operating in Redding, California, and a growing global project pipeline, Fortera is moving from first-of-a-kind deployment to scaled commercialization. Our technology is already being used in real-world infrastructure applications, bringing next-generation cement into use today while expanding toward broader adoption.

At Fortera, you’ll work alongside scientists, engineers, operators, and industry experts who are turning cutting-edge materials science into real-world impact. We’re looking for curious thinkers, builders, and problem-solvers who want to help tackle one of the biggest challenges facing our planet.

This is more than a job. It’s an opportunity to help shape the future of sustainable construction.

Build What’s Next.

Visit www.forteraglobal.com to learn more.

POSITION OVERVIEW:

The Capital Projects Team develops, coordinates, and directs the design and construction of processing plants utilizing Fortera's proprietary technologies, typically located at existing cement or lime facilities. We internally drive projects to successful completion while engaging engineering, purchasing and sourcing equipment, and construction partners to execute large-scale industrial facilities.

We are currently looking for a Project Services Manager to join our team. Reporting functionally to the Project Delivery Manager, this role leads the integrated project-services function across planning and scheduling, cost control, forecasting, information management, progress measurement, risk, change control, and management reporting.

A key expectation of this role is to develop and build out AI-enabled project delivery capabilities. The ideal candidate will be highly proficient in applying AI, automation, and data integration to project execution, including the ability to design, build, and deploy AI agents and workflows that automate routine activities, connect project information across systems, identify emerging risks and trends, improve forecasting, accelerate reporting, and provide actionable recommendations to support the project team and leadership in decision making.

The successful candidate will combine strong capital-project controls experience with advanced digital capability, transforming complex project data into reliable forecasts, early warning, clear management action, and an increasingly automated and scalable project-services operating model.

Travel: Up to 25% travel is required.

READY TO BUILD WHAT’S NEXT?

Do you want to turn ambitious ideas into reality as part of a team that designs, buys, builds, tests, and runs its own facilities?

Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where priorities evolve, challenges change, and you are willing to adapt, step into gaps, solve problems, and do what is needed to help the team deliver?

Do you take ownership, contribute to decisions, act with urgency, and stay accountable through to the outcome?

Do you believe in building collective strength through collaboration, sharing knowledge, supporting others, and putting the success of the team ahead of individual boundaries?

Are you motivated to work at the forefront of innovation, push what is possible, bring ideas to life, and use technology, AI, and continuous improvement to deliver better performance and results?

If this sounds like you, we’d like to hear from you.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Lead Project Services across planning, cost, forecasting, information management, progress, risk, change, and reporting.

• Establish and maintain the integrated project controls framework, including common structures, baselines, reporting cycles, data governance, and control standards.

• Assure schedule, cost, commitments, cash flow, progress, risk, change, procurement, completions, and information are integrated and aligned to the approved project baseline.

• Lead Planning / Scheduling, Cost Control, and Project Information Management, setting priorities, standards, and performance expectations.

• Own project reporting and provide clear visibility of current status, forecast outcomes, critical issues, emerging risks, required decisions, and corrective actions.

• Provide early warning by challenging incomplete, inconsistent, or unsupported forecasts and requiring accountable recovery plans.

• Own integrated risk, opportunity, and change-control processes while maintaining clear approval and accountability boundaries.

• Build and deploy reusable AI agents, automated workflows, data integrations, and digital standards that improve forecasting, reporting, risk identification, information retrieval, and decision support while increasing scalability, consistency, and execution efficiency across Fortera projects.

• Establish the data structure and governance required for reliable AI-enabled project services, including source traceability, validation, access control, and human review.

• Identify and automate high-value project-services activities, reducing manual effort and shifting the organization toward exception-based management.

• Support investment, engineering, procurement, construction, completions/ commissioning, startup, handover, and closeout decisions with verified project information.

• Maintain clear Project Manager visibility of cost, schedule, commitments, critical interfaces, cash requirements, information constraints, and project exposure.

• Perform other related duties as assigned.

SUCCESS IN THE ROLE:

Success means the Project Manager and functional leaders operate from one trusted view of scope, schedule, cost, cash, progress, risk, change, and information status. Forecasts are credible, emerging impacts are identified early, and decisions are supported by verified data.

The successful candidate is flexible and adaptive to the needs of the team, stepping into gaps, adjusting priorities, and improving how project information is integrated and used. Corrective actions are identified and assigned early, before cost or schedule pressures become embedded, while technology, automation, and AI are applied where they improve visibility, efficiency, and decision-making.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Controls, Finance, Information Management, Data/Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

• 10+ years of relevant experience supporting or leading large-scale capital projects.

• Proven project-services or project-controls leadership experience across engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and startup.

• Demonstrated hands-on experience designing, building, deploying, and orchestrating AI agents and multi-agent workflows, with strong technical understanding of agent architecture, system integration, data connectivity, validation, traceability, access controls, and human-in-the-loop governance.

• Demonstrated experience applying AI and automation to improve data integration, analysis, forecasting, reporting, information retrieval, workflow efficiency, or decision support.

• Strong command of planning, cost control, forecasting, progress measurement, risk, change, information management, and executive reporting.

• Strong working knowledge of critical-path scheduling, project baselines, commitments, accruals, Estimate at Completion, cash flow, contingency, earned value, and change control.

• Advanced capability with Primavera P6, Excel, Power BI, ERP systems, document-management, completions, and related project platforms.

• Proven ability to analyze complex and conflicting information, challenge assumptions, and develop credible forward-looking forecasts.

• Strong analytical, commercial, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.

• Flexible and adaptive working style, with a demonstrated ability to shift priorities, learn quickly, work across functions, and contribute beyond traditional role boundaries when needed.

• Experience with owner-led, EPC, EPCM, or multi-contract industrial delivery models preferred.

Fortera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other status protected by applicable law. Diverse candidates are encouraged to apply.

jobs.location: Remote - California, Colorado, Georgia, Illinois, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, New York, North Carolina, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Texas, Utah
jobs.description:
About the job

At Go Nimbly, we want to be a global thought leader in the RevOps space by developing a badass brand built through innovative work created by individuals with growth mindsets. As a member of the Delivery team, you will help our clients drive more revenue by creating a buying experience that’s both frictionless and human. You will move these high-growth companies towards a more operationally efficient organization.

As a RevOps Solutions Architect at Go Nimbly, you'll collaborate with a team of RevOps Consultants, Program Managers, Developers, and Analysts to build best-in-class solutions and impactful technology roadmaps. You will act as a subject matter expert on the process of scoping, discovery, solutioning, and leading the team through solution and architecture decisions by considering scalability, trade-offs, best practice, and the latest technology trends, including where generative AI can accelerate or improve general operations and go-to-market motions.

*Remote: Location Requirements

We’re a fully remote company. At this time, we are only able to hire candidates who reside in the following locations due to payroll, tax, and compliance requirements:

U.S. states: California, Colorado, Georgia, Illinois, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, New York, North Carolina, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Texas, Utah.

Countries: Argentina, Colombia, Uruguay, Mexico, Brazil

On a given day, a RevOps Solutions Architect will spend time:

 - Defining architecture principles and standards. A RevOps Solutions Architect owns communication and justification of design decisions with our internal team and directly with the client, including executive stakeholders.

 - Building connections between GTM systems that drive real value and outcomes, whether that's through custom code, integrations, or an iPaaS/automation platform like Workato, Make, or n8n. The tool matters less than knowing which one fits the problem.

 - Finding where AI and agents can add value, then building workflows that turn GTM data into actionable insights and automate work. You identify and propose when AI should own the process versus when a human needs to stay involved, all while respecting data privacy, security, and compliance.

 - Diagnosing where GTM systems are broken or fragmented, duplicate sources of truth, manual handoffs, data that doesn't reconcile, and owning the fix from root cause through to a shipped solution, not just flagging the gap.

 - Designing solutions for complex workstreams, advising clients on when to buy an existing tool versus build a custom solution, and presenting these solutions to client teams in a way that builds trust and makes the case for scalability and best practice.

 - Actively participating in up-leveling the team through ad hoc coaching and mentoring on solutions, and championing a diligent, no corners cut delivery through strong enablement and rollout.

 - Senior members of Go Nimbly act as an ambassador within the Revenue Operations space and keep a pulse on the latest releases and technology trends, including generative AI and its growing role in RevOps architecture, to help form a point of view on how releases and changes will impact teams and customers.

What’s in it for you?

 - Flexible working environment: our entire team works remotely, and we have no plans to change this!

 - Tiered incentive program (in addition to base salary) to reward high performers.

 - Gain exposure to several high-growth companies looking to scale and invest in their revenue operations function.

 - Be a part of a dynamic team and collaborate with top industry professionals. Many of our alumni have gone on to become leaders and executives at high-growth companies!

 - Annual camp: we have a yearly offsite to bring the team together, celebrate our successes, and plan the year.

 - Dedicated to employee development and career paths aimed at fostering your growth and your career.

 - 100% paid premiums for US employees’ insurance coverage.

About you

 - You have 8+ years of experience in at least one core discipline (Marketing Ops, Sales Ops, or Business Systems) and working fluency across the others, including systems architecture and administration (Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, or similar), data modeling and integration design across the tech stack.

 - You work with senior stakeholders to uncover business requirements, diagnose gaps and pains, and design scalable technical solutions to resolve them, including advising clients on when to buy versus build.

 - Extensive knowledge of Salesforce platform capabilities and core features, with a perspective on when to use out of the box features, declarative automation, or code, and comfort building connections across custom code, integrations, or an iPaaS platform like Clay, Workato, Make, or n8n.

 - A track record of diagnosing fragmented or broken GTM systems, duplicate sources of truth, manual handoffs, data that doesn't reconcile, and owning the fix through to a shipped solution, not just flagging the problem.

 - Ability to influence and lead internal and external teams, communicating with technical and non technical audiences, and you can hold your own in front of executive stakeholders.

 - A genuine point of view on AI and agents in RevOps: judgment on where AI should own delivery versus where a person needs to stay in the loop, and mindful of data governance, PII, and compliance boundaries.

 - Bonus: if you have a Certified Salesforce Application Architect or Systems Architect certification, or are on the path to achieving one of these certifications.

About Us

As a remote first team, we rely on video calls to stay connected, make decisions, and work directly with clients, so being comfortable on camera and engaged in that setting is part of how we operate day to day.

 - Be a Leader. Leadership at Go Nimbly isn't about title, it's showing up with a point of view, saying the hard thing clearly, and making sure what you started actually lands.

 - Show Your Work. We love a finished product, but how you got there matters too. Clear communication and proactive updates are part of the job.

 - Value Long-Term Over Short-Term. The fast answer and the right answer aren't always the same. We're committed to building things that scale, even when that means slowing down.

 - Take It to the Finish Line. We don't hand things off and hope for the best. When you own something here, you own it all the way through.

 - Customer-Obsessed. When our clients win, we win. We genuinely understand their business and show up as trusted advisors, as invested in their outcomes as they are.

 - Gotchu Energy. The best teammates make the people around them feel like they've got backup, leaning into hard moments instead of away from them.



What’s next?

Apply! Rest assured, while AI might feel like it’s taking over the world, we have a human on the other end of the computer personally reviewing each application. Our Talent Acquisition team will reach out if we’d like to speak further about the role. And if not, we promise to let you know because let’s be honest, who enjoys being ghosted when applying for a job? Not only are we committed to getting back to you but we also provide clear feedback.

During the first call with our Talent team, we will lay out the steps in the interview process since it’s unique to each role but typically includes a couple of rounds. We value your time and ours, so we plan to make the best use of our interviews to learn if we are a good fit for you and vice versa.

The base salary range for this role is $140,000 to $160,000 USD. In addition to a base salary, this role is eligible for a performance bonus plan.

Initial placement within the range depends on geographic location, experience, and skillset, with most hires landing at or near the midpoint, leaving room for growth and future impact. The top of the range is generally reserved for those who are performing at a high level and impact here at Go Nimbly. Final offer amounts will vary based on leveling, and will be adjusted based on geographical location and the candidate's applicable experience and skillset.

U.S. states: California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, New York, North Carolina, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Texas, Utah.

PACE & ONBOARDING EXPECTATIONS

This role moves fast, in an exciting way. In your first 1–2 days, we’ll get you fully set up with systems access across Go Nimbly and Gong. By the end of week one, you’ll complete the Gong Program Manager Certification. Then you’ll spend the next four weeks leveling up on Gong implementation methodology across Foundations, Forecast, and Engage including four mock calls per product to sharpen your chops. Our goal: you’re ready to take on your first client within 3–6 weeks (depending on your prior Gong product experience).

 


WHY YOU’LL THRIVE HERE

We set a high bar and we don’t expect you to clear it alone. Go Nimbly is a team of collaborative experts who share knowledge early and often, solve hard problems together, and measure success as a team.

 - Team of collaborative experts: You’ll work alongside specialists who are generous with context, templates, and documentation.

 - A true culture of learning: We invest in enablement, peer coaching, and continuous improvement. Questions are welcomed, and sharing learnings is part of the job.

 - We win together: You’ll have support from delivery leadership and peers to help unblock and accelerate outcomes, especially during your ramp.
   
    


ON A GIVEN DAY, A SENIOR REVOPS CONSULTANT WILL SPEND TIME:

 - Leading multiple concurrent Gong implementations (8–12 at a time), keeping scope, timelines, and quality on track.

 - Guiding clients by presenting options, discerning trade-offs, and providing recommendations.

 - Owning implementation discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, and documentation.

 - Configuring and delivering solutions within Gong products (including Foundations, Forecast, and Engage) and driving successful adoption.

 - Documenting requirements and workstream plans.

ABOUT US

jobs.title: Head of Partnerships
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Roboflow is on a mission to give software the sense of sight.

Our platform makes it easier for developers and organizations to build, deploy, and manage computer vision applications. More than 1 million developers have used Roboflow, and our customers range from startups to some of the largest companies in the world.

As computer vision moves from experimentation into production, the ecosystem around Roboflow is becoming increasingly important. Customers don't deploy computer vision in isolation — they work with consulting partners, integrate with software platforms, and deploy onto cameras, edge devices, and other hardware.

We're looking for a Head of Partnerships to build the ecosystem that helps Roboflow reach more customers and bring more computer vision applications into production.




THE OPPORTUNITY

Partnerships at Roboflow has the potential to become a significant growth engine for the business.

We're looking for someone to own that opportunity end-to-end — identifying where partnerships can create leverage, developing the relationships, structuring the commercial model, launching joint initiatives, and ultimately turning those partnerships into measurable business results.

You'll build across three critical parts of our ecosystem: consulting and systems integration partners, hardware partners, and software/technology partners.

This is a senior individual contributor role today. You won't inherit a large partnerships organization or a mature playbook. You'll be the person building it.

That means personally sourcing partners, developing relationships, negotiating agreements, figuring out what makes the partnership valuable to both sides, enabling partners, working alongside Sales on opportunities, and creating the systems that eventually allow the function to scale.

As the ecosystem grows, you'll have the opportunity to shape what the Partnerships organization becomes.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Build Roboflow's partnership strategy. Determine where partnerships can create the greatest leverage across distribution, customer acquisition, deployment, product adoption, and expansion — and translate that strategy into action.

Build our consulting and SI ecosystem. Develop relationships with consulting firms, systems integrators, and implementation partners that can identify computer vision opportunities, bring Roboflow into customer engagements, and help deploy solutions at scale.

Develop strategic hardware partnerships. Build relationships across the hardware ecosystem — including cameras, edge compute, sensors, and other infrastructure our customers use to bring computer vision into the physical world.

Build software and technology partnerships. Identify platforms where integrations, co-selling, co-marketing, or broader strategic relationships can make Roboflow more valuable and expand our reach.

Personally take partnerships from idea to revenue. Source opportunities, develop the business case, build executive relationships, negotiate agreements, launch the partnership, and stay involved until it's producing meaningful results.

Create partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline. Work closely with Sales to turn partnerships into real customer opportunities rather than relationships that exist primarily on paper.

Build joint go-to-market motions. Develop co-selling, referral, marketplace, integration, and co-marketing motions based on what makes sense for each partner and ecosystem.

Enable partners to successfully sell and deploy Roboflow. Work with Sales, Marketing, Product, Solutions Architects, and Delivery to give partners the technical and commercial knowledge they need to identify opportunities and successfully bring Roboflow to customers.

Develop the operating system for Partnerships. Establish how we prioritize partners, measure performance, manage pipeline, allocate internal resources, and determine when to invest more deeply in a relationship.

Build enablement and onboarding programs for Partners. Develop the onboarding and enablement programs that set our partners up for success in our ecosystem.

Be the internal voice of the ecosystem. Bring what you're learning from partners back into Product, Engineering, Marketing, and GTM to help shape our strategy.




WHO YOU ARE

 - You've personally built and owned strategic partnerships in a high-growth technology company.

 - You have meaningful experience across consulting/SI partnerships, hardware partnerships, and software/technology partnerships.

 - You understand that those ecosystems operate differently and have personally developed partnerships within each.

 - You're a builder. You're excited by the opportunity to start with a relatively blank page rather than inherit a mature partner program.

 - You're comfortable operating as a senior IC and personally doing the work — sourcing partners, making introductions, building business cases, negotiating agreements, and driving joint opportunities.

 - You have a strong commercial orientation and can connect partnership activity directly to revenue and customer outcomes.

 - You know the difference between signing a partnership and building one that actually works.

 - You're comfortable navigating relationships from individual contributors through senior executives.

 - You can move fluidly between strategy and execution.

 - You're highly cross-functional and know how to mobilize Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Delivery around the right partnership opportunities.

 - You thrive in ambiguity and have strong judgment about where to spend your time.


WE'D BE ESPECIALLY EXCITED IF

 - You've built a partner ecosystem from an early stage rather than only operating within an established program.

 - You have experience with AI/ML, developer tools, infrastructure, data platforms, robotics, computer vision, or another technical platform.

 - You've built partnerships involving technology deployed into the physical world.

 - You've worked directly with global consulting firms or systems integrators and understand how to activate them beyond signing an agreement.

 - You have a strong partner network already that you bring with you.

 - You've built hardware relationships involving cameras, edge devices, compute, sensors, or adjacent infrastructure.

 - You've created meaningful revenue through partner-sourced or partner-influenced opportunities.

 - You've helped turn an early partnerships motion into something repeatable enough to eventually build a team around.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Within your first year, Roboflow has a clear partnership strategy and a focused portfolio of high-value relationships across consulting, hardware, and software.

Our strongest partners aren't simply names on a webpage. They're bringing Roboflow into customer conversations, building alongside us, integrating with our platform, helping customers deploy, and creating measurable pipeline and revenue.

You've established repeatable ways to identify, evaluate, launch, and grow partnerships — giving us a foundation we can scale.

And you've demonstrated where additional investment can create leverage, helping define what the next version of Roboflow's Partnerships organization should look like.




WHY ROBOFLOW

Computer vision is inherently an ecosystem problem.

The software has to connect to cameras, compute, existing technology stacks, physical environments, and the people who design and implement those systems.

That creates an enormous opportunity for partnerships.

Rather than inheriting a mature program, you'll have the chance to decide which relationships matter, build them from the ground up, and create an ecosystem that can meaningfully expand how Roboflow reaches customers and how quickly those customers can bring visual AI into production.
