jobs.title: VP, Human Resources
jobs.description:
Vice President, Human Resources

At Rectangle Health, we believe that our team members are our most important asset. We grow our team by hiring best-in-class talent. We encourage all employees to contribute their individual talents and ideas to strengthen our team, our brand, and our services. We promote a culture that empowers and motivates employees beyond standard corporate rhetoric. Employees understand their individual roles in serving our customers, and this clarity of purpose encourages high job performance.

Position Overview:

The Vice President, Human Resources serves as the senior Human Resources leader for Rectangle Health and is responsible for developing and executing the Company’s HR strategy in support of business objectives, organizational performance, and growth. Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, this role provides strategic leadership and operational oversight for Human Resources, including employee relations, talent acquisition, compensation and benefits, HR operations, employment compliance, performance management, organizational development, and workforce planning.

The VP of Human Resources partners closely with the executive leadership team and business leaders to ensure the Company attracts, develops, retains, and effectively manages talent while maintaining consistent employment practices and compliance with applicable laws and Company policies. This leader serves as a trusted advisor on workforce matters, organizational design, leadership effectiveness, and employment risk.

Primary Job Duties:

Human Resources Leadership & Strategy

• Assist with developing and executing the Company’s Human Resources strategy in alignment with business objectives, operating priorities, and growth plans.
• Serve as a strategic advisor to the Chief Operating Officer, executive leadership team, and business leaders on workforce planning, talent management, and employment matters.
• Establish HR priorities, operating plans, policies, service standards, metrics, and governance practices.
• Provide clear and timely reporting on employee relations, recruiting, workforce trends, compliance, leaves of absence, and other material HR matters.
• Lead the Human Resources team and ensure consistent, responsive, and accountable support across the organization.

Employee Relations & HR Business Partnership

• Lead employee relations strategy and oversee investigations, complaints, conflict resolution, corrective actions, performance concerns, and terminations.
• Advise leaders on employee conduct, performance management, policy interpretation, and workforce decisions.
• Ensure employee matters are addressed promptly, consistently, confidentially, and with appropriate documentation.
• Partner with Legal on sensitive employment matters and risk mitigation.
• Identify recurring employee relations trends and recommend corrective or preventative actions.

Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning

• Directly manage, coach, and develop the recruiting team, establishing clear priorities, performance expectations, service standards, and accountability.
• Ensure recruiting activity aligns with approved headcount, budget, organizational priorities, and established approval processes.
• Partner with leaders to define role requirements, assess talent needs, and build succession and talent pipelines.
• Oversee recruiting performance, candidate experience, external recruiting partners, and hiring metrics.
• Drive disciplined and consistent selection, offer, and pre-employment processes.

Compensation, Benefits & Total Rewards

• Lead compensation strategy, salary administration, incentive programs, and annual compensation planning.
• Oversee employee benefits, retirement programs, leave-related benefits, vendor relationships, renewals, and plan administration.
• Partner with Finance and executive leadership on workforce costs, compensation budgets, and program design.
• Assess market competitiveness and recommend sustainable programs that support attraction and retention.
• Ensure accurate, compliant, and effective administration of total rewards programs.

HR Operations, Compliance & Employee Lifecycle

• Oversee the full employee lifecycle, including onboarding, employee records, HRIS administration, status changes, leave administration, accommodations, and offboarding.
• Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local employment laws and regulatory requirements across applicable jurisdictions.
• Maintain the employee handbook, Human Resources policies, employment documentation, and required notices and records.
• Lead employment-related audits, reporting, and compliance initiatives.
• Establish scalable HR processes, controls, documentation standards, and service-level expectations.

Talent Management & Organizational Development

• Lead performance management, talent reviews, succession planning, leadership development, and employee development practices.
• Partner with leaders on team effectiveness and change management.
• Coach leaders on people management, accountability, communication, and team effectiveness.
• Identify workforce capability gaps and recommend development or talent solutions.
• Build consistent management practices that strengthen organizational performance.

Cross-Functional Partnership

• Collaborate with all cross functional teams and business leaders on workforce programs and operational requirements.
• Ensure HR requirements are incorporated into business changes, systems initiatives, office operations, and organizational programs.
• Support executive leadership reporting related to workforce, talent, recruiting, and organizational metrics.

Team Leadership & Department Management

• Lead, coach, and develop the Human Resources team.
• Define roles, responsibilities, goals, performance expectations, and escalation protocols.
• Manage the Human Resources budget, vendors, technology, and departmental resources.
• Track and report key HR metrics and use data to drive decisions and continuous improvement.
• Foster a culture of professionalism, sound judgment, confidentiality, accountability, and service.

Success Measures

• Timely, consistent, and well-documented resolution of employee relations matters.
• Effective talent acquisition and workforce planning aligned with approved headcount and business priorities.
• Accurate, efficient, and scalable HR operations across the employee lifecycle.
• Strong compliance practices and reduced employment-related risk.
• Competitive and sustainable compensation and benefits programs.
• Effective performance management, succession planning, and leadership development practices.
• High leadership confidence in Human Resources partnership, judgment, responsiveness, and execution.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.

• 12+ years of progressive Human Resources experience, including significant leadership responsibility across multiple HR disciplines.

• 5+ years leading an HR function or serving in a senior HR leadership role.

• Demonstrated expertise in employee relations, employment law, talent acquisition, compensation, benefits, HR operations, and talent management.

• Experience supporting executive leadership and advising on complex, sensitive, and high-risk employment matters.

• Experience leading HR in a multi-state organization and building scalable processes in a growing company.

• Strong business acumen, executive presence, communication, judgment, and change leadership skills.

• Ability to balance strategic leadership with hands-on operational execution.

• SHRM-SCP, SPHR, or similar certification preferred.

• Experience within SaaS, fintech, healthcare technology, payments, or private equity-backed organizations preferred.

Compensation & Benefit Profile:

• $200,000 – $250,000 annual total compensation (commensurate with experience)

• Competitive Medical Health Plans, Low, Mid, High. Employer Paid Low Medical Plan for Employee & Dependents (HSA Eligible) Employer Paid Dental & Vision for Employee Employer Paid Life Insurance for Employee Employer Paid Long-term Disability for Employee Employer Paid Hospital Confinement for Employee ~ (If enrolled in Medical) + Voluntary Supplemental Insurance Coverage Options

Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.



We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.



About This Role: 

Crusoe is seeking a Staff Electrical Engineer to join our Power Systems organization. This role is a high-level technical position responsible for the design, construction, commissioning, and long-term operational success of our power plant facilities across the USA. You will serve as the primary subject matter expert for power generation assets, bridging the gap between front-end design and field execution.

 

What You’ll Be Working On:

 - Engineering & Design: Lead front-end engineering for capital projects, including the layout and sizing of power systems. Review one-lines, wiring diagrams, schematics, electrical studies, and control narratives to ensure they meet company design specifications.

 - QA/QC Oversight: Review vendor drawings, check wiring diagrams against schematics, and ensure all design deliverables from consultants meet project specifications.

 - Project Execution: Provide technical guidance during the construction and commissioning of power plant assets. Support and provide input to field teams and third-party consultants on complex electrical issues.

 - Operational Support: Partner with Field Operations to troubleshoot electrical failures, perform root-cause analysis, and optimize existing power infrastructure for maximum uptime.

 - Technical System Integration: Apply deep technical expertise across power generation assets, including generator physics and operations. Specify and integrate high and medium voltage equipment such as 34.5 kV GIS (Gas Insulated Switchgear) indoor units, GSU (Generator Step-Up) Transformers, and MV/LV Switchgear and MCCs (Motor Control Centers).

 - Advanced Controls: Utilize working knowledge of Governor and AVR (Automatic Voltage Regulator) controls.

 - Modern Protocols & Studies: Implement the IEC 61850 standard, including GOOSE & MMS protocols. Conduct Protection & Control coordination studies and fault analysis.

 

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

 - Education & Experience: Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering (BSEE) and a minimum of 6+ years in industrial electrical engineering.

 - Standards & Compliance: Expert working knowledge of NEC application to industrial installations.

 - Communication Skills: Ability to work effectively with both engineers and operations personnel.

 - Travel: Ability to travel approximately 20% to project sites.

 - Technical Expertise: Comprehensive understanding of generator physics and operations. Proficiency in Protection & Control coordination studies and fault analysis. Knowledge of the IEC 61850 standard.

 - Company Values: Embody the Company values.

 

Bonus Points:

 - Experience with Simple and Combined Cycle Turbine Generators (10 MW – 600 MW) and Reciprocating Engines (3 MW – 20 MW).

 - Experience in implementation and management of Microgrid Controllers.

 - Knowledge of best practices for the synchronization of islanded electrical systems.

 - Experience with power modeling software (e.g., ETAP or SKM).

jobs.title: Regulatory Affairs Advisor
jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Title: Regulatory Advisor - FDA Pharma & IVDR

Natera is a clinical genetic testing company specializing in non-invasive, cell-free DNA (cfDNA) and liquid biopsy testing. The Regulatory Advisor plays a key role in developing and driving regulatory strategy on behalf of the regulatory affairs (RA) team, specifically focusing on FDA Pharma and IVDR initiatives. At Natera, we remember there is a person behind every sample. This role combines strong technical knowledge and an understanding of regulatory requirements (US FDA, CAP/CLIA/NYS, EU, or Japan) to support the approval and registration of products that proactively inform disease management.

You will represent the RA team to internal and external stakeholders through written and verbal communication. This role maintains product registrations, change assessments, post-market surveillance reports, and records of communication with regulatory authorities. You will support the overall effectiveness of the RA team through contributions to staff development, process improvements, and maintaining a deep understanding of current regulatory requirements in the evolving diagnostics landscape.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Represent the regulatory function on designated cross-functional teams.

• Conduct business interactions with customers and regulatory authorities regarding regulatory pathways, performance claims, supporting data, and labeling in the context of submissions or registrations.

• Build and execute bold, practical regulatory strategies for complex regulatory affairs programs, with a heavy emphasis on FDA Pharma, IVDR, and In Vitro Diagnostic (IVD) systems.

• Advocate for the least burdensome approaches to product clearance and approval while strictly interpreting and adhering to regulatory requirements.

• Coordinate and prepare regulatory submissions with minimal supervision, including EU/IVD/IVDR Technical Documentation, classification requests, pre-submissions, 510(k) premarket notifications, investigational device exemptions, NYS DoH submissions, and critical worldwide registrations.

• Mentor regulatory associates and support their career advancement.

• Deliver training on regulatory topics across internal teams.

• Lead cross-functional teams to address major regulatory changes, compliance with new registration requirements, or process improvements.

• Contribute to setting individual and departmental annual goals aligned with business objectives.

• Review and ensure regulatory compliance of advertising, promotion, and labeling across a common product line.

• Take personal accountability for identifying gaps in processes and proactively build data-driven solutions to improve them.

• Evaluate product changes for global regulatory submission impact.

• May lead small teams.

• Other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s degree in a life science field (biology, microbiology, chemistry, engineering, medical technology, regulatory science, etc.) or equivalent. Advanced degree in life sciences (MS, PhD, etc.) and/or MBA preferred.

• Regulatory Affairs Certification (RAC) preferred.

• Minimum of 8+ years of direct applicable regulatory experience in medical devices, laboratory-developed tests (LDTs), or pharma.

• Direct experience with FDA Pharma and IVDR submissions is highly preferred.

• Experience in Organ Health or Women's Health diagnostics is ideal and strongly preferred.

• In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD) and Companion Diagnostics (CDx) experience is a plus.

• PMA experience preferred.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

• Working knowledge of U.S. and EU Medical Device/IVD/IVDR, FDA Pharma, and/or laboratory developed test regulatory requirements.

• Proactive, self-directed, and highly engaged.

• Emphasis on talent development and team building.

• Use sound scientific judgment to solve problems and make decisions even when rigid policies do not exist.

• Manage multiple projects with urgency, staying organized and focused on delivering results.

• Demonstrated ability to effectively formulate and drive change.

• Experienced in continuous improvement projects, project management, and product development processes.

• Thrive in ambiguity by navigating rapid change and actively building structure and standard operating procedures where they are missing.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate across cultures, work effectively with technical and scientific personnel, and negotiate clearly with Regulators.

• Computer literacy (PC, Microsoft Word/Excel/PowerPoint).

The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.

Remote USA

jobs.title: 2027 Summer Intern, Perception - Evaluation
jobs.description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

The Perception team builds the system which learns the spatial-temporal representation and their semantic meanings of the surrounding environment of the self-driving car, i.e., the system that “perceives” the world around the car. We work jointly with downstream teams on the optimization and integration into the Waymo Driver. We conduct our own research to address real-world problems and collaborate with research teams at Alphabet.  We have access to millions of miles of driving data from a diverse set of sensors, enabling engineers like you to (1) develop methods for efficiently and continuously learning from large scale real-world data, to (2) develop models and model training at scale, to (3) analyze real-world behavior and develop systems for handling the complexities of interacting with the real-world, and (4) optimize models for our onboard and offboard hardware.

Waymo interns work with leaders in the industry on projects that deliver significant impact to the company. We believe learning is a two-way street: applying your knowledge while providing you with opportunities to expand your skillset. Interns are an important part of our culture and our recruiting pipeline. Join us at Waymo for a fun and rewarding internship!

This internship will be based on-site at our headquarters in Mountain View, CA.

You will:

• Improve signal quality in large scale perception evaluation workflows using generative AI (LLM/VLM)

• Expand the capabilities of discovery evaluation system to cover a broader range of perception signals

• Contribute to design and development of frameworks and methods for evaluating multi-task perception models

• Collaborate with ML and infra engineers to integrate new signals to end-to-end model launch evaluation

• Evaluate the impact of improvements on evaluation quality, focusing on precision, recall, and reliability

You have:

• Proficiency with coding in Python or C++ and navigating large codebases

• Experience with building and/or evaluating machine learning models

• Experience with data analysis and statistical evaluation

• Enrolled in a Masters or PhD program in Computer Science, Robotics, or a similar technical field of study

We prefer:

• Multi-year C++ experience with contributions to large code bases or open source projects

• Familiarity with perception models, in particular with object generation and semantics tasks

• Experience in utilizing AI-powered workflows for data analysis or model evaluation

• Experience in applying machine learning concepts and evaluation methodologies

• Proven experience in building data and evaluation pipelines and processing large-scale datasets

Note: This will be a hybrid onsite internship position. We will accept resumes on a rolling basis until the role is filled. To be in consideration for multiple roles, you will need to apply to each one individually - please apply to the top 3 roles you are interested in.

jobs.title: Head of Delivery
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Roboflow is on a mission to give software the sense of sight.

Our platform makes it easier for developers and organizations to build, deploy, and manage computer vision applications. More than 1 million developers have used Roboflow, and our customers range from startups to some of the largest companies in the world.

As computer vision moves from experimentation into production, we're helping companies deploy visual AI into the physical world - across manufacturing, logistics, healthcare, retail, and countless other industries.

We're looking for a Head of Delivery to own and scale how we take our most complex customers from vision to production.




THE OPPORTUNITY

Our customers come to Roboflow with ambitious problems: automating quality inspection, monitoring infrastructure, understanding physical environments, improving operational workflows, and building entirely new products powered by computer vision.

Getting those applications into production often requires much more than handing a customer software.

Our Delivery organization, including Implementation Engineering and Forward Deployed Engineering, works alongside customers to turn those ideas into real, production-ready systems.

We're looking for a leader who can build this function for the next stage of Roboflow's growth.

You'll own the teams, operating model, and customer delivery strategy, while remaining deeply involved in the work yourself. This is not a role for someone who wants to manage delivery from a distance. We expect you to understand our customers' problems, get into the technical details with your team, join critical customer conversations, and help solve the hardest deployments.

You'll be both the architect of the organization and an active participant in the work.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Lead and scale our Delivery organization. Own our Implementation Engineering and Forward Deployed Engineering teams and continue building the organizational structure, roles, processes, and operating cadence required as Roboflow scales.

Get hands-on with our hardest deployments. Work directly with customers and your team on complex implementations. You'll be comfortable jumping into an architecture discussion, helping scope a deployment, troubleshooting an implementation, or joining an executive customer conversation when needed.

Build the playbook. Create repeatable frameworks for scoping, implementation, deployment, escalation, and handoff without forcing every customer into the same model.

Own the path from sale to production. Partner closely with Sales and Solutions Architects before contracts are signed to ensure we're setting customers and our own teams up for successful deployments.

Drive customer outcomes and success. Establish clear definitions of implementation success, time-to-value, deployment health, and customer outcomes, and build the systems needed to measure and improve them.

Make the organization more scalable. Identify where we should solve a problem through people, process, product, documentation, tooling, or automation. The goal isn't simply to add more Delivery headcount as customers grow.

Develop exceptional technical talent. Hire, coach, and develop Implementation Engineers and Forward Deployed Engineers who combine technical depth with strong customer instincts and high ownership.

Create tight feedback loops with Product and Engineering. Delivery will see some of our customers' hardest technical problems firsthand. You'll ensure those learnings make their way back into our product and influence where we invest.

Partner across GTM. Work closely with Sales, Solutions Architects, Support, and Partnerships to create a seamless customer experience from initial discovery through production deployment and expansion.




WHO YOU ARE

 - You've built or led a customer-facing technical delivery, forward deployed engineering, implementation engineering, professional services, or similar organization in a technical software company.

 - You're deeply technical and comfortable working alongside engineers on complex customer problems.

 - You're a hands-on leader. Managing a team doesn't mean stepping away from the work.

 - You've personally worked with customers on complex implementations and understand what it takes to move from a promising proof of concept to a production system.

 - You know how to balance customer-specific needs with the need to build a scalable product and organization.

 - You're an excellent people leader who can attract, develop, and retain highly technical, high-agency talent.

 - You can operate comfortably across technical and business audiences — from engineers working through an architecture problem to executives discussing business outcomes.

 - You have strong judgment around prioritization and resource allocation, particularly when multiple important customers need support at the same time.

 - You thrive in environments where the playbook is still being written.


WE'D BE ESPECIALLY EXCITED IF

 - You've built a Delivery or Forward Deployed Engineering function from an earlier stage.

 - You've worked in developer tools, infrastructure, AI/ML, data platforms, robotics, computer vision, or another deeply technical product environment.

 - You've supported deployments involving both software and the physical world.

 - You have experience working with enterprise customers on complex, multi-stakeholder deployments.

 - You've built systems that meaningfully improved time-to-value or made a services-heavy motion more repeatable and scalable.

 - You’ve owned the entire customer success process.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Within your first year, you've built a clear operating model across Implementation Engineering and Forward Deployed Engineering, created stronger consistency in how we scope and execute customer deployments, and developed a team capable of supporting increasingly complex customers.

Our largest customers are getting to production faster and with greater predictability. Sales, Product, Engineering, and Delivery have clear feedback loops and ownership boundaries.

And as the organization has grown, you've remained close enough to the work that when an important customer hits a difficult technical problem, you're someone the team wants in the room.




WHY ROBOFLOW

Computer vision is moving from research and experimentation into the real world.

The companies that successfully deploy it won't just need great models. They'll need to integrate visual AI into existing systems, hardware, workflows, and physical environments.

Delivery sits directly at that intersection.

You'll have the opportunity to build the organization that helps some of the world's most ambitious companies turn computer vision from an idea into something running in production — while helping Roboflow learn how to make that process dramatically easier for every customer that follows.

jobs.title: Change Management Consultant
jobs.description:
Change Management Consultant

Location: Houston, Texas | Practice Area: Business Consulting | Type: Permanent

Help clients turn complex transformation into change that people can understand, adopt, and sustain.

The Role

At Capco, we help our clients navigate complex business and technology transformations. Our consultants work alongside client teams to solve critical challenges, enable meaningful change, and deliver sustainable business outcomes.

As a Change Management Consultant, you’ll work at the intersection of people, process, and technology, supporting organizations as they prepare for, adopt, and sustain change across large-scale transformation initiatives.

You’ll take ownership of defined change management activities and deliverables, build trusted relationships with client stakeholders, and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams in a fast-paced consulting environment. Your work may span digital and technology implementations, operating model change, process improvement, organizational redesign, mergers and acquisitions, and workforce transformation.

What You’ll Do

• Develop and execute change management strategies and plans for complex business and technology transformation initiatives, applying Prosci methodologies and the ADKAR model where appropriate.

• Conduct stakeholder, change impact and readiness assessments, translating findings into practical engagement and mitigation strategies.

• Develop targeted communications, training and enablement activities that build awareness, understanding, commitment and adoption across impacted stakeholder groups.

• Partner with client leaders, managers, project teams and subject matter experts to identify change risks, address resistance and strengthen leadership alignment.

• Facilitate workshops, interviews and working sessions, while defining and tracking change readiness, engagement, adoption and effectiveness measures.

What We’re Looking For

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Organizational Development, Human Resources, Psychology, Communications or a related field, together with Prosci Change Management Certification.

• 2–5 years of experience in change management, organizational effectiveness, business transformation, management consulting or a related discipline.

• Experience supporting enterprise-wide transformations or technology implementations, with practical knowledge of stakeholder engagement, change impact assessment, communications, training, readiness and adoption.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, written, verbal, presentation and facilitation skills, with the ability to turn complex business challenges into actionable change strategies.

• Ability to build effective relationships across organizational levels, manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work in a client-facing environment, including client-site work and travel as required.

Bonus Points For

• Experience within a management consulting or professional services environment.

• Experience supporting ERP, CRM, cloud, AI, digital, operating model or workforce transformation initiatives.

• Experience working within Financial Services, Energy, Healthcare, Retail or Public Sector organizations.

• Knowledge of Agile delivery and project management methodologies and experience supporting complex cross-functional business and technology programs.

• Additional relevant certifications such as PMP, CCMP, Agile, Scrum or Lean Six Sigma.

Why Join Capco

• Work on complex business and technology transformations with leading organizations.

• Collaborate in a flat, entrepreneurial consulting culture where different perspectives are valued.

• Build your consulting and change management capabilities through challenging client engagements.

• Work alongside experienced consultants and client leaders across multidisciplinary transformation teams.

• Make an impact by helping organizations successfully adopt and sustain meaningful change.

Benefits

We offer a competitive, people-first benefits package designed to support every aspect of your life:

• Medical, dental and vision coverage.

• 401(k) match and HSA/FSA options.

• Maternity and paternity leave and dependent care benefits.

• Tuition reimbursement and wellness reimbursement.

• Commuter benefits and access to Working Advantage, a discounted marketplace.

Inclusion at Capco

We’re committed to making our recruitment process accessible and straightforward for everyone. If you need any adjustments at any stage, just let us know – we’ll be happy to help. We value each person’s unique perspective and contribution. At Capco, we believe that being yourself is your greatest strength. Our #BeYourselfAtWork culture encourages individuality and collaboration – a mindset that shapes how we work with clients and each other every day.

Use of Artificial Intelligence in Talent Acquisition

At Capco, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support and enhance several parts of talent acquisition. This includes using AI-enabled features within LinkedIn to help source potential candidates, speeding up routine recruitment communications such as emails and creating compelling and brand-aligned job postings that accurately reflect role requirements, and AI-scheduling applications to improve the efficiency of interview coordination.

AI is used as a support tool only. All hiring decisions are made by talent acquisition and hiring teams.

jobs.title: Sr. Product & Design Operations Manager
jobs.description:
PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE: PD) is the global leader in AI-first digital operations. By automatically detecting, diagnosing, and remediating issues, the PagerDuty Platform orchestrates AI agents and automated workflows with context from over 750 integrations. Trusted by approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100 and nearly half of the Fortune 500, PagerDuty is the industry standard for organizations scaling resilient, autonomous operations. Notable customers include Chipotle, Cloudflare, Docusign, Fox, Nvidia, Salesforce, Spotify, Zoom and more. We are growing rapidly and hiring top talent with leading AI skills across engineering, sales, product, marketing, and beyond as we build the leading digital operations platform.

PagerDuty is seeking an AI-Forward Sr. Product & Design Operations Manager to join our diverse, customer-focused team! As Product & Design Operations Manager, you will be a strategic partner to Product and Design Leadership, building the operating system that lets both functions plan with rigor, launch with confidence, and improve continuously.

In this pivotal role, you will define how product work is scoped, planned, prioritized, tracked, and released — establishing the planning discipline, cross-functional launch mechanisms, and customer feedback loops that turn intent into delivered outcomes. You will partner with Engineering, Finance, and Customer Success to bring structure to how significant changes reach our customers, and you will use agentic tools to build intelligent workflows, and custom AI skills.

This is an exciting opportunity to transform how PagerDuty's product organization operates, innovates, and delivers business value in the age of AI. The ideal candidate is a forward-thinking operator with expertise in product operations, working knowledge of design and research practices, and a proven track record of building products and processes for teams.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Serve as the primary liaison for Product and Design on the Product Development AI Transformation initiative, driving team enablement by building custom Claude skills, and operationalizing AI best-practice workflows across both organizations

• Define the Product Operations function at PagerDuty — establishing the planning discipline that ensures product work enters execution with clear scope, articulated requirements, defined success metrics, and the data to support prioritization

• Build cross-functional workflows for launching significant customer-facing changes — coordinating Product, Design, Engineering, Marketing, Support, Legal, and Customer Success through a repeatable readiness process

• Own the process and evidence trail for capitalizable R&D work in partnership with Finance — establishing clear classification criteria, and making it easy for product and engineering to consistently and defensibly categorize their work

• Partner with Customer Success on a closed-loop process for product feedback with accountability for capturing clear customer needs and delivering rapid responses and regular updates

• Automate the operating rhythms of the Product and Design teams, including planning cadence, design sprints, cross-functional workshops, and office hours

• Lead vendor management, tooling budget oversight, and administration for Product and Design

• Enable research operations through agentic workflows, including insights management and the mechanisms that make customer research reusable across teams

• Define, track, and report on key performance indicators for product and design effectiveness — planning accuracy, launch readiness, cycle time, intake responsiveness, and feedback loop speed

• Create and maintain comprehensive onboarding programs for new Product and Design team members

• Partner with Product and Design leadership to establish operational vision and strategic priorities, and proactively identify opportunities for operational improvement

• Foster a collaborative, high-performance culture across Product and Design through team-building initiatives and cross-functional partnerships

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

• 5+ years of experience in Product Operations, Design Operations, Business Operations, or a similar role

• Demonstrated experience establishing planning and prioritization processes across a product organization

• Experience coordinating cross-functional launches or releases involving Engineering, Marketing, Support, and Customer Success

• Strong project management and organizational skills, with a track record of building processes that run without their author

• Experience creating and maintaining operational documentation, guidelines, and standards

• Demonstrated ability to work autonomously and drive initiatives independently across teams you do not own

• Experience building agentic AI workflows with Claude or similar tools

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience partnering with Finance on software capitalization, cost classification, or R&D accounting requirements

• Experience designing customer feedback (“Voice of Customer”) or request intake systems, including closed-loop notification back to customers

• Experience working for enterprise software companies, ideally B2B SaaS

• Familiarity with design systems, component libraries, and UX research methodologies

• Experience developing and implementing onboarding programs

• Track record of implementing measurable process improvements and KPIs

• Experience in change management and organizational transformation

This is a hybrid position and is expected to work from the Atlanta office 2 days a week.

The base salary range for this position is 140,000 - 235,400 USD. This role may also be eligible for bonus, commission, equity, and/or benefits.

The range, which is subject to change based on primary work location, reflects the minimum and maximum base salary we expect to pay newly hired employees for the position. Within the range, we determine pay for an individual based on a number of factors including market location, job-related knowledge, skills/competencies and experience.

Each dimension has three associated competencies to give leaders a shared language for guiding their development, career, promotion, and succession planning discussions. Our Manager Expectations serve as a practical guide for managers to understand their responsibilities, prioritize their efforts, and drive engagement and performance.

What we offer

About PagerDuty

PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE:PD) is a global leader in digital operations management. Trusted by nearly half of both the Fortune 500 and the Forbes AI 50, as well as approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100, PagerDuty is essential for delivering always-on digital experiences to modern businesses

PagerDuty is Great Place to Work-certified™, a Fortune Best Workplace for Millennials, a Fortune Best Medium Workplace, a Fortune Best Workplace in Technology, and a top rated product on TrustRadius and G2.

jobs.title: Commissioning Engineer (Electrical) - Memphis
jobs.description:
SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are seeking an Electrical Commissioning Engineer to execute the buildout, startup, and handover of electrical systems for SpaceXAI's high-performance data centers. This is a hands-on role where you will commission, test, troubleshoot, and turn over critical systems that support next-generation AI supercomputing infrastructure.

You will work closely with construction, engineering, operations, EPC contractors, and OEM vendors to deliver safe, reliable, and high-quality electrical systems. This is a full-time, onsite role with travel to SpaceXAI data center construction sites across the United States.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Execute all electrical commissioning activities for MV/LV switchgear, generators, UPS systems, PDUs, ATS/STS, transformers, relays, busway, and associated controls in hyperscale data center environments.

• Execute functional performance testing, pre-functional testing, site acceptance testing, load-bank testing, protection-relay testing, integrated system testing, and system turnover to operations.

• Troubleshoot and resolve complex electrical, controls, and process issues during pre-commissioning, commissioning, and startup phases.

• Develop and review detailed commissioning test procedures, scripts, checklists, and documentation in alignment with project specifications, industry standards, and SpaceXAI requirements.

• Coordinate with EPC contractors, OEM vendors, design engineers, and SpaceXAI stakeholders for system energization, startup sequences, and integrated system validation.

• Champion safety by enforcing strict adherence to LOTO, NFPA, OSHA, and SpaceXAI safety protocols; participate in daily safety briefings and job hazard analyses.

• Maintain comprehensive as-built documentation, test records, issue logs, and final commissioning reports.

• Support and deliver training programs for operations and maintenance teams on commissioned systems.

• Participate in constructability reviews, design feedback sessions, and lessons-learned meetings to continuously improve installation quality and future project execution.

• Support commissioning schedules and punch-list resolution to meet aggressive project timelines.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering.

• 5+ years of experience in commissioning for electrical systems.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Working knowledge of commissioning test equipment (power analyzers, insulation testers, hipot testers, torque tools, IR cameras, load banks, relay test sets, etc.), or demonstrated aptitude to learn it in the field.

• Familiarity with relevant codes and standards (NEC, NFPA 70/70B/70E, IEEE, NETA, NESC, Uptime Institute).

• Ability to read, interpret, and redline electrical drawings, one-lines, three-lines, control schematics, and sequence of operations; update as-built models after commissioning.

• Experience coordinating with multi-discipline teams, contractors, and vendors in construction environments.

• Ability to work safely in industrial construction environments and follow LOTO, NFPA, OSHA, and SpaceXAI safety protocols.

• Commissioning experience, including functional performance testing, pre-functional testing, site acceptance testing, load-bank testing, protection-relay testing, integrated system testing, and system turnover.

• Data center systems and prior work on mission-critical projects

• Hands-on experience with EPMS, BMS/BAS, and power-system controls troubleshooting and integration (Modbus, BACnet, etc.).

• Knowledge of refrigerant systems, direct liquid cooling, and advanced heat rejection technologies.

• Current OSHA 30 certification or equivalent.

• Proficiency with commissioning management platforms (CxPro, Procore, PlanGrid, or similar).

• Experience implementing integrated systems testing, owner’s project requirements verification, and feeding as-built data back into the sitewide power model (load flow, short-circuit, coordination, arc-flash).

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Willingness to travel extensively and work extended hours, nights, and weekends during critical commissioning and startup windows.

• Ability to travel extensively to SpaceXAI construction sites and remain onsite for extended periods during peak commissioning phases.

• Physical capability to work in industrial environments, climb ladders/stairs, lift moderate loads (up to 50 lbs), and wear full PPE for long durations.

• Valid driver’s license and ability to meet SpaceXAI's driver eligibility requirements.

SpaceXAI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our Recruitment Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Radio Frequency Test Engineer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril’s Manufacturing team is seeking a RF Test Engineer to join our Electromagnetic Warfare team. The EW Manufacturing Team is responsible for rapidly iterating and building cutting-edge defense hardware for Electromagnetic Warfare. This responsibility includes everything in the manufacturing value-chain, including, but not limited to, Design for Manufacturability work, tool design & selection, process creation & optimization, vendor sourcing & interaction, quality planning, and work documentation associated with the hardware that the Manufacturing Engineer owns.

ABOUT THE JOB

As a RF Manufacturing Test Engineer within EW, you will you will be responsible for ensuring that we are testing our systems to stringent standards ensuring that we are consistently shipping the highest quality products to our customers. Additionally you will ensure that we are able to meet the required throughput requirements of production. In this role you’ll need to think creatively and come up with solutions to solve difficult testing problems and push to continuously improve our methods of automation, throughput, user interfaces, and data analytics.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Maintain ownership of test activities in production and ensuring production test flow. Provide hands-on troubleshooting efforts and resolve complex electrical issues found during testing.

• Maintain test capabilities across the manufacturing value stream - from system level checkouts and acceptance testing to key component level in process validation.

• Improve and sustain existing test systems to improve automation, consistency, total cycle time, and test coverage (DfM).

• Generate test work instructions that can be easily followed by technician team in MES. Train technicians on equipment use as required.

• Develop library of common failure modes with troubleshooting guide/diagrams for fast issue resolution.

• Determine root cause of product failures and recommend appropriate corrective actions (RCCA).

• Work with Design, Quality and Manufacturing Engineering teams to support customer returns and failure analysis.

• Contribute feedback to early-stage test design for test processes supporting early-stage products (NPI).

• Analyze test data, document results, and provide detailed reports to identify defects and areas for improvement.

• Collaborate with design engineers to provide feedback and recommendations for product enhancements based on test outcomes.

• Optimize test strategies for efficiency and effectiveness, reducing test time without compromising quality.

• Maintain and calibrate test equipment to ensure precision and reliability.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance testing processes and methodologies.

• Execute testing as required.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical/Electronics, Computer, Mechanical Engineering, or related fields

• 5+ years of relevant industry experience with emphasis on manufacturing test and product sustainment.

• Familiarity with Linux, Ubuntu, LabVIEW, and NixOS.

• Experience with contract manufacturers in the testing of PCBA/electronic assemblies. Thorough knowledge of PCBA testing standards and methods.

• Familiarity with electronics test equipment such as power supplies, electronic loads, oscilloscope, function generators, spectrum analyzers, data acquisition and measurement sensors.

• Strong root cause analysis skills of non-conforming hardware.

• Excellent written, verbal, interpersonal and communication skills.

• Familiar with Product Life Cycle (PLM) systems, Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), and Test Execution Systems (TES)

• Experience working on projects that involve the integration of electrical, mechanical, and software/firmware systems.

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

US Salary Range

$129,000—$171,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

jobs.title: Sr. Solutions Consultant
jobs.description:
Insurance touches people during some of the most challenging moments in their lives. Hi Marley is on a mission to transform how the P&C industry communicates, making those moments faster, easier, and more empathetic for carriers and the customers they serve. We build AI-powered software that keeps everyone in the claims conversation informed and connected. If you believe insurance can combine operational excellence and automation with a human touch, we’d love to meet you.

As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a Sr. Solutions Consultant to partner on  strategic and complex opportunities. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys tackling complex problems and influencing high-stakes deals. You’ll be deeply embedded in enterprise opportunities, engaging with senior stakeholders and helping align technology, business value, and customer outcomes.

Teamwork and shared enthusiasm are a core part of our culture, which is why this role involves joining us in the Boston office for 3 days each week.

What You’ll Do:

• Partner with Account Executives and Account Managers to advance new business and expansion opportunities.

• Lead discovery with insurance business and technology stakeholders to understand workflows, uncover challenges, and establish requirements and measurable success criteria.

• Create reusable demo content, discovery guides, and value-selling resources and provide guidance and best practices across teams.

• Deliver tailored demonstrations and solution presentations that connect Hi Marley’s capabilities to customer priorities.

• Independently lead pilot engagements from scoping through evaluation, aligning customer and internal teams on objectives, timelines, and success criteria, coordinating execution, and presenting results to inform purchase and expansion decisions.

• Build business cases and ROI models using customer data and clearly defined assumptions to demonstrate operational and financial impact.

• Support RFPs, proposals, competitive positioning, and objection handling, collaborating with internal experts to validate solution fit and address customer requirements.

• Help customers evaluate AI-enabled capabilities, explaining their applications, limitations, and implications for insurance workflows.

• Partner with Product, Implementation, and Customer Success to communicate customer needs, surface solution gaps, and transfer agreed requirements and success criteria.

What We’re Looking For:

• 5–7+ years of experience in customer-facing consulting, solutions consulting, or sales engineering roles, including at least 3 years working in or advising the insurance industry (P&C strongly preferred; familiarity with claims, service, or digital operations a plus).

• Demonstrated ability to lead discovery, translate business needs into solution recommendations, and deliver compelling demonstrations and presentations.

• Strong analytical skills, including the ability to interpret customer data, develop business cases, and explain the assumptions behind projected value.

• Experience engaging executive, business, and technical stakeholders and translating complex concepts into clear business value.

• Working knowledge of SaaS applications, integrations, APIs, and data flows sufficient to discuss solution fit and collaborate effectively with technical specialists.

• A genuine curiosity about AI and emerging technologies, paired with the judgment to apply them thoughtfully and responsibly

• Experience working with or positioning AI-enabled software, with the ability to explain relevant use cases and limitations.

• Strong written communication and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple opportunities and coordinate contributions across teams.

• Comfort taking ownership and adapting to changing priorities in a growing company.

• Ability to travel up to 50%.

Compensation, Benefits & Perks:
At Hi Marley, we are committed to fair and transparent pay practices. The annual base salary for this role is expected to fall within the range of [$117,000–$218,000], depending on experience, skills, qualifications, and location. Offers are determined based on these factors as well as internal peer equity. It’s most common for new hires to start near the midpoint of the range, allowing room for growth as employees develop in their role. In addition to base pay, this role includes a variable compensation component. Total earnings will vary based on individual and/or team performance.

In addition to base pay, we offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports both your wellbeing and professional growth, including:

• A 4% matching 401(k) program

• Medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage for employees working 30+ hours per week

• Monthly wellness stipend

• Paid parental leave

• A flexible vacation policy - we all work hard and take time when we need it

Who We Are:
At Hi Marley, our culture is built on three core values that every employee embodies:

• Max Courage – We encourage our team, our customers, and their customers to dream big, try new ideas, and maximize impact by measuring risk.

• Be Humble – We lead with appreciation and promote a culture of humility, compassion, and openness to learn from anyone, anywhere.

• Ubuntu (“I am because we are”) – We believe true success is much bigger than any single individual or company. By aligning our individual aims behind a shared purpose, we can achieve our fullest potential — together.

Life at Hi Marley:

Life at Hi Marley is shaped by collaboration, learning, and genuine connection. We’re proud to foster an environment where people can do their best work, feel supported, and grow alongside a team that celebrates both individuality and shared purpose.

We celebrate diversity and do not discriminate based on gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, race, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. jobs.title: Laboratory Technician
jobs.description:
The Laboratory Technician is primarily responsible for performing laboratory tests and analyses under the direction of a lab supervisor or scientist including specimen management, specimen pipetting, instrument operation/maintenance, data entry and specimen storage with a high degree of proficiency. Follow Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Ensure all laboratory equipment and work areas are clean, sterile, and in proper working order. May be responsible for calibration of instruments. Conducts routine tasks as directed. Closely supervised with little latitude for independent judgment.

Laboratory Technician Duties Include but are not Limited to the Following:

• Examine samples for validity and other requirements (sample type, volume, etc.)
• Perform sample preparation steps which may include specimen pipetting with a high degree of accuracy and precision
• Operate, calibrate and maintain all assigned laboratory equipment and instruments according to standard operating procedures to ensure quality results
• Perform reagents and materials preparation for testing
• Maintain adequate inventory of supplies, reagents and materials needed for testing
• Document remedial action, troubleshooting, quality assurance activities and instrument maintenance
• Adhere to established processing timelines
• Perform data entry into the Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS)
• Label samples and deliver them to proper area(s)
• Retrieve and re-file samples for testing
• Properly store specimens for short term and long term storage
• Aid laboratory personnel in cleaning duties
• Adhere to all quality and safety standards, as well as ensuring compliance with all applicable regulatory agencies
• Adhere to policies and protocols in the lab
• Work closely and communicate with other lab associates to complete daily activities efficiently
• Represent department and the organization favorably and in accordance with established Company standards and associate attributes at all times
• Other duties as assigned by management

Basic Minimum Education Qualifications:

• BS or BA in Biological, Physical, or Chemical Science
• OR BS or BA degree in related science fields with 16 hours in Biology, 16 hours in Chemistry and 3 hours of Mathematics

Basic Minimum Work Requirements:

• Minimum 1 year data entry experience preferred
• Previous clinical laboratory experienence preferred
• Experience or formal training in working with potentially infectious human blood bodily fluids preferred
• Ability to work with automated and manual platforms
• Must possess skills required for aseptic techniques
• Intermediate level of proficiency with PC based software programs
• Ability to read, interpret, and comply with documents such as internal SOPs, operating and maintenance instructions, and company policies
• Position may require evening and weekend hours
• Goal oriented, with excellent time management and organizational skills
• Excellent interpersonal skills, with ability to interact effectively and work efficiently with people at all levels in the organization
• Excellent verbal & written communication skills
• Keenly attentive to detail
• Ability to keep sensitive information confidential
• Intermediate level of proficiency with PC based software programs, with database skills
• Authorization to work in the United States indefinitely without restriction or sponsorship.

Physical Requirements:

• Physical dexterity sufficient to use hands, arms, and shoulders repetitively to operate a keyboard and other office equipment, use a telephone, access file cabinets and other items stored at various levels, including overhead
• Ability to speak and hear well enough to communicate clearly and understandably with sufficient volume to ensure an accurate exchange of information in normal conversational distance, over the telephone, and in a group setting
• Ability to stand for extended periods of time as necessary in the laboratory (4 or more hours)
• Ability to lift and move items weighing up to 15 pounds
• Physical dexterity sufficient to move body frequently around laboratory equipment and instrumentation
• Ability to continuously operate a personal computer for extended periods of time (4 or more hours)
• Mental acuity sufficient to collect and interpret data, evaluate, reason, define problems, establish facts, draw valid conclusions, make valid judgments and decisions

The essential physical and mental requirements described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Position is full-time working Tuesday - Saturday, 2:00pm - 10:30pm, additional hours as needed. Candidates currently living within a commutable distance of Lenexa, KS are encouraged to apply.

• Excellent full-time benefits including comprehensive medical coverage, dental, and vision options
• Life and disability insurance
• 401(k) with company match
• Paid vacation and holidays

jobs.location: Cincinnati, Ohio, United States; Dallas, Texas, United States; Indianapolis, Indiana, United States
jobs.description:
About Allworth Financial

Allworth Financial (www.allworthfinancial.com) is an independent investment advisory firm providing full-context wealth planning solutions. The firm brings together investment, tax, retirement, estate, and other financial considerations to help clients evaluate decisions in the context of their whole financial lives.

Founded in Sacramento, California, in 1993, Allworth Financial is a high-growth, private equity-backed, multibranch registered investment adviser. Allworth is primarily a fee-based fiduciary advisory firm that emphasizes client well-being and education. The firm continues to expand through acquisitions and organic growth.

Allworth is a great place to work and build a career. The firm ranks among the top 15 on Barron’s Top 100 RIA Firms list, has a historical client retention rate of 97%, and is a National Business Research Institute (NBRI) Circle of Excellence Award winner. Learn more at AllworthFinancial.com.

SUMMARY:

This role has two functions: options management and equity trading. This person will be responsible for structuring, executing, and monitoring the firm's options strategies. Additionally, they will explain strategy rationale and risk and reward in plain language to advisors and clients, maintain accurate position records and supporting models, and cross-train with the team to provide depth and continuity across the organization.

This person’s equity trading role includes being part of Allworth's in-house equity team and will have discretion and decision-making authority related to trading and rebalancing modeled client portfolios. This involves exercising judgment on tax-aware gain and loss realization, cash deployment, and position trimming, within the equity team's framework.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Options Management (approximately 75%)

• Understand, structure, and execute a range of options strategies, including covered calls, protective puts, collars, and spreads, in line with firm objectives and risk parameters.

• Monitor open positions and adjust or roll strategies as market conditions, expirations, and assignment risk warrant, applying working knowledge of options mechanics.

• Explain strategy rationale, mechanics, and risk and reward in plain language to advisors and clients.

• Maintain detailed and accurate trade records, position records, and supporting models in Excel.

• Confirm account-level eligibility prior to trading, including account type, option approval level, and any restrictions applicable to the underlying position.

Equity Trading and Portfolio Implementation (approximately 25%)

• Execute account-level rebalancing to target models, exercising judgment on tax-aware gain and loss realization and position trimming.

• Determine the best place to invest or raise cash according to the model, considering factors such as sector allocation and security selection.

• Review and approve tactical rebalances in the firm's portfolio management and rebalancing platform, supplementing with manual analysis where system logic falls short.

• Maintain account-level trading notes, restrictions, and goals with a high level of accuracy.

• Support onboarding of new accounts into flexible models, including documentation of tax budgets, restrictions, exclusions, and cash targets.

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Three to seven years of experience with options strategies, including equity, index, or related derivatives.

• Ability to explain options strategies and their risk and reward clearly to a non-technical audience.

• Familiarity with multi-leg strategies such as collars, protective puts, and put spreads, and with the mechanics of exercise, assignment, and settlement.

• Ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities against expiration-driven and market-hours deadlines.

• Able to demonstrate judgment in trade decision-making, beyond order entry or rules-based execution.

• Understanding of tax-aware trading considerations, including gain and loss realization, cost basis, and wash sales.

• Ability to work independently while operating within team governance.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, and comfortable working as part of a small, cross-trained team.

• Advanced Excel skills and strong attention to detail.

• Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, accounting, mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

• Series 65 or equivalent licensing preferred, or the ability to obtain it.

You’ll own core platform systems at scale, design the frameworks other teams build on, and set the technical standards for how data moves through Chime. High autonomy, real architectural trade-offs, production impact from day one. We’re hiring multiple engineers into this role at the senior level.

In this role, you can expect to

jobs.title: Staff HR Business Partner
jobs.location: Santa Clara, California, United States; Singapore; Toronto, Ontario, Canada
jobs.description:
Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.

Tenstorrent is growing fast, and our leaders keep having to change how they operate to keep up. As a Staff HR Business Partner, you'll work directly with senior leaders across our North America teams on the people side of that growth: org design, leveling, performance and calibration, sensitive employee matters, and the hard conversations in between. You'll join a small HRBP team with no layers of specialists behind it. You'll own problems from start to finish and help build how this function works as you go.

This role is remote, based anywhere in the United States or Canada.

We welcome candidates at various experience levels for this role. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting.

Who You Are

• An HRBP who has partnered directly with VP-level leaders and supported a full function or large org, ideally at a company somewhere between a few hundred and a few thousand people.

• Hands-on. You've run investigations, calibration cycles, reorgs and sensitive exits yourself rather than handing them to a specialist team.

• Willing to tell a senior leader something hard about their org, or about them, and then stay to help them act on it.

• Curious about technical work. You can explain what your client org builds and why it's hard, and that understanding shows up in your people decisions. Experience supporting sales, go-to-market or operations teams is a plus.

What We Need

• Get to the real cause of people problems. When leaders are frustrated with each other, find what's underneath (a missing role, an unowned handoff, unclear decision rights) and fix that.

• Help leaders change how they work as the company grows, including on issues that cross into orgs you don't directly support.

• Make org design, leveling, performance and promotion calls that are fair and hold up when they're challenged.

• Get leaders who want different things to a decision they'll all carry out, and put the broader team's outcome ahead of any one client group.

What You Will Learn

• How a company building open AI and RISC-V compute actually runs, from silicon and software to supply chain and go-to-market.

• How to scale a People function while it's still being built, with real say in the systems and practices that come out of it.

• How to partner with leaders through repeated stages of growth, where what worked last year often has to change.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Test Engineer, Electronic Warfare
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril’s Manufacturing team is seeking a Manufacturing Test Engineer to join our Electromagnetic Warfare team. The EW Manufacturing Team is responsible for rapidly iterating and building cutting-edge defense hardware for Electromagnetic Warfare. This responsibility includes everything in the manufacturing value-chain, including, but not limited to, Design for Manufacturability work, tool design & selection, process creation & optimization, vendor sourcing & interaction, quality planning, and work documentation associated with the hardware that the Manufacturing Engineer owns.

ABOUT THE JOB

As a Manufacturing Test Engineer within EW, you will you will be responsible for ensuring that we are testing our systems to stringent standards ensuring that we are consistently shipping the highest quality products to our customers. Additionally you will ensure that we are able to meet the required throughput requirements of production. In this role you’ll need to think creatively and come up with solutions to solve difficult testing problems and push to continuously improve our methods of automation, throughput, user interfaces, and data analytics.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Maintain ownership of test activities in production and ensuring production test flow. Provide hands-on troubleshooting efforts and resolve complex electrical issues found during testing.

• Maintain test capabilities across the manufacturing value stream - from system level checkouts and acceptance testing to key component level in process validation.

• Improve and sustain existing test systems to improve automation, consistency, total cycle time, and test coverage (DfM).

• Generate test work instructions that can be easily followed by technician team in MES. Train technicians on equipment use as required.

• Develop library of common failure modes with troubleshooting guide/diagrams for fast issue resolution.

• Determine root cause of product failures and recommend appropriate corrective actions (RCCA).

• Work with Design, Quality and Manufacturing Engineering teams to support customer returns and failure analysis.

• Contribute feedback to early-stage test design for test processes supporting early-stage products (NPI).

• Analyze test data, document results, and provide detailed reports to identify defects and areas for improvement.

• Collaborate with design engineers to provide feedback and recommendations for product enhancements based on test outcomes.

• Optimize test strategies for efficiency and effectiveness, reducing test time without compromising quality.

• Maintain and calibrate test equipment to ensure precision and reliability.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance testing processes and methodologies.

• Execute testing as required.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical/Electronics, Computer, Mechanical Engineering, or related fields

• 5+ years of relevant industry experience with emphasis on manufacturing test and product sustainment.

• Familiarity with Linux, Ubuntu, LabVIEW, and NixOS.

• Experience with contract manufacturers in the testing of PCBA/electronic assemblies. Thorough knowledge of PCBA testing standards and methods.

• Familiarity with electronics test equipment such as power supplies, electronic loads, oscilloscope, function generators, spectrum analyzers, data acquisition and measurement sensors.

• Strong root cause analysis skills of non-conforming hardware.

• Excellent written, verbal, interpersonal and communication skills.

• Familiar with Product Life Cycle (PLM) systems, Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), and Test Execution Systems (TES)

• Experience working on projects that involve the integration of electrical, mechanical, and software/firmware systems.

• Ability to obtain and maintain US DoD clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 8+ years of relevant industry experience.

• Pursuing a Master’s of Science in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science or related field.

• Familiarity with Python, LabVIEW and/or MATLAB for data parsing and data visualization.

• Experience with test automation, PCBA design, and mechanical design.

• Experience with computer hardware communication protocols: USB, Ethernet, RS232, RS485, PCIe, HDMI, CAN, etc.

• Experience with ESS-related testing (Thermal, Vibration, etc.)

• Active Security Clearance or ability to obtain one.

US Salary Range

$129,000—$171,000 USD

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.
