jobs.title: Senior Manager, Public Relations
jobs.description:
Senior Manager, Public Relations – Factor

Location: Hybrid position to the New York City HelloFresh Headquarters

About Factor

At Factor, we’re on a mission to make real food the new standard for how the world eats.

We believe convenience should never come at the expense of quality. That’s why every Factor meal is chef-crafted with premium ingredients, thoughtfully prepared in our kitchens, and ready to enjoy in just two minutes.

As one of the dominant food brands in America, we’re redefining convenient eating through better ingredients, better nutrition, and a brand that’s challenging the status quo. From partnerships with Serena Williams and Hyrox to premium ingredient innovation and breakthrough creative, we’re building a modern food brand at the intersection of food, wellness, fitness, and culture.

We’re looking for a Senior Manager of Public Relations who can help make Factor impossible to ignore.

The Opportunity

This isn’t a traditional PR role.

We’re looking for someone who knows how to create buzz, earn attention, and get people talking—not just secure coverage.

As Senior Manager, Public Relations, you’ll help shape how consumers, media, creators, and industry leaders experience Factor. You’ll develop ideas and communications strategies built to travel across earned media, social, creators, partnerships, and culture.

You’ll bring a social-first mindset to PR: identifying the stories, moments, conversations, talent, and creative ideas that can break through in feeds first and then expand into broader earned attention.

You’ll own day-to-day public relations strategy, lead our agency partner, launch innovative products, amplify major brand partnerships, and find unexpected ways to put Factor into the cultural conversation.

The goal is simple: create more moments people notice, share, talk about, and remember.

Working across Brand Marketing, Creative, Organic Social, Growth, Culinary, Nutrition, Commercial, Legal, and Corporate Communications, you’ll play a critical role in building one of the most relevant and talked-about food brands in America.

What You’ll Do

Create Buzz & Cultural Relevance

• Develop ideas designed to generate conversation, earned attention, social sharing, and cultural relevance.

• Identify emerging trends, conversations, memes, creators, events, and cultural moments Factor can credibly participate in.

• Create proactive PR moments rather than relying primarily on traditional announcements and press releases.

• Partner with Creative and Organic Social to develop ideas that can live across earned, owned, creator, and social channels.

• Continuously ask: What would make people actually talk about this?

• Find unexpected ways to put Factor into conversations happening across food, wellness, fitness, sports, and culture.

Lead With a Social-First Mindset

• Approach communications through the lens of how stories will travel across social platforms, creators, media, and culture.

• Work closely with Organic Social to identify real-time opportunities and turn cultural conversations into brand moments.

• Help develop PR ideas with strong visual, video, creator, and social storytelling potential.

• Identify opportunities for executives, chefs, nutrition experts, athletes, partners, and other brand voices to show up credibly in social conversations.

• Think beyond the headline to how every major PR moment can generate content, conversation, and amplification.

Develop Brand Communications Strategy

• Develop and execute integrated communications strategies aligned with Factor’s business and brand priorities.

• Create compelling narratives that reinforce Factor’s leadership in real food, nutrition, and convenient healthy eating.

• Build annual and seasonal communications plans supporting major marketing campaigns, product launches, partnerships, cultural moments, and business milestones.

• Identify proactive storytelling opportunities that earn attention beyond traditional product announcements.

• Ensure PR, social, creators, partnerships, and brand storytelling work together as one connected system.

Drive Earned Media

• Build and maintain strong relationships with national business, consumer, lifestyle, food, health, wellness, fitness, and marketing media.

• Develop distinctive, timely media angles that generate high-quality earned coverage.

• Build stories editors and journalists genuinely want to cover—not simply stories we want to tell.

• Write press releases, media pitches, briefing documents, talking points, FAQs, and other communications materials.

• Manage inbound media inquiries and coordinate interview opportunities.

• Pursue quality, relevance, and conversation—not impressions for impressions’ sake.

Lead Product & Innovation Communications

• Develop breakthrough communications strategies for menu innovations, seasonal launches, premium ingredients, and new product initiatives.

• Translate sourcing, culinary craftsmanship, nutrition expertise, and product innovation into stories consumers, creators, and media care about.

• Find the provocative insight, cultural tension, or creative idea that can turn a product launch into a broader brand moment.

• Partner closely with Culinary, Nutrition, Product Marketing, Brand, Social, and Creative teams to identify newsworthy moments throughout the year.

Amplify Brand Partnerships & Activations

• Lead communications planning for strategic partnerships, sponsorships, talent, and major brand moments.

• Maximize earned and social conversation surrounding athlete partnerships, experiential activations, and integrated marketing campaigns.

• Develop creative ideas that extend partnerships beyond traditional announcements and sponsorship visibility.

• Collaborate with talent, creators, internal teams, and agency partners to create moments with the potential to break through culturally.

• Ensure every major partnership has an amplification strategy across earned media, social, creators, and content.

Elevate Executive Visibility

• Partner with senior leaders to build distinctive thought leadership platforms.

• Identify media interviews, awards, podcasts, social platforms, and executive profile opportunities.

• Develop clear points of view that executives can credibly own.

• Create messaging, briefing materials, talking points, and interview preparation.

• Help position Factor leaders as provocative, credible voices across food, nutrition, wellness, culture, and marketing.

Lead the PR Agency

• Lead the day-to-day relationship with Factor’s public relations agency.

• Set a high bar for creativity, proactivity, speed, and cultural awareness.

• Establish priorities, objectives, budgets, timelines, and performance expectations.

• Push agency partners to bring proactive ideas—not simply execute briefs.

• Hold partners accountable for generating meaningful attention, conversation, and business impact—not simply media impressions.

• Build an always-on pipeline of stories, cultural opportunities, and breakthrough ideas.

Protect & Strengthen the Brand

• Monitor brand sentiment, media conversations, and social dialogue to identify reputational risks and opportunities.

• Help ensure consistent messaging across all external communications.

• Move quickly and thoughtfully when conversations around the brand change.

What You’ll Bring

• Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Marketing, or a related field.

• 6–9 years of public relations, brand communications, social, or integrated communications experience.

• Experience working with high-growth consumer brands, preferably within food, CPG, wellness, lifestyle, fitness, sports, or consumer technology.

• A track record of creating ideas or moments that generated meaningful buzz, earned attention, social conversation, or cultural relevance.

• A strong understanding of how PR, social, creators, content, and culture increasingly work together.

• Proven success developing integrated communications strategies that generate high-quality earned media.

• Strong media relationships across national consumer, lifestyle, business, and trade outlets.

• Experience managing external agencies and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Outstanding writing, storytelling, presentation, and communication skills.

• Strong creative instincts and an ability to recognize what will—or won’t—break through.

• Exceptional project management skills and attention to detail.

• Ability to operate with speed, curiosity, and good judgment in a fast-moving environment.

• Experience working with celebrity talent, athletes, creators, or major partnerships

• Experience creating social-first or culturally driven brand moments.

• Passion for food, nutrition, wellness, fitness, and sports.

Success in This Role

In your first year, you’ll:

• Make Factor a more talked-about and culturally relevant brand.

• Create a consistent pipeline of buzz-worthy ideas and moments that generate earned and social conversation.

• Increase the quality, consistency, and impact of earned media coverage.

• Establish a proactive, social-first communications calendar that consistently creates newsworthy moments.

• Deliver standout communications around major brand campaigns, partnerships, product launches, and cultural moments.

• Build stronger integration across PR, Organic Social, Creative, creators, and partnerships.

• Build reporting that demonstrates the impact of communications on brand health, awareness, conversation, and business outcomes.

• Become a trusted strategic and creative partner across Brand Marketing and the broader organization.

You’ll get… (do not edit this list)

• Competitive salary, 401k with company match that vests immediately upon participation

• Generous PTO and parental leave of up to 16 weeks

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits with options at $0 monthly, effective first day of employment

• Tuition reimbursement for continuing education (upon 2 years of service)

• Up to 85% discount on subscriptions to HelloFresh meal plans (HelloFresh, Green Chef, Everyplate, and Factor_)

• Access to Employee Resource Groups that are open to all employees, including those pertaining to BIPOC, women, veterans, parents, and LGBTQ+

• Inclusive, collaborative, and dynamic work environment within a fast-paced, mission-driven company that is disrupting the traditional food supply chain

This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the responsibilities. However, the Company reserves the right to adjust, modify, or reassign work tasks and responsibilities as needed to meet changing business needs, operational requirements, or other factors.

jobs.title: Technical Product Owner
jobs.description:
ABOUT LINXUP, LLC

If you are looking for “the right opportunity” with a fast-growing company, with great people, doing great work, look no further. Linxup offers products and solutions that help thousands of field service fleets solve real business problems. If you’re looking for an opportunity to help make a difference for small businesses, you’re in the right place. Linxup helps businesses get more out of the vehicles, equipment, tools, and workers in the field through its robust, easy to use tracking and dash cam solutions. Linxup delivers class-leading reliability, flexibility, and live, US-based onboarding, support, and coaching to ensure customers get the most out of their investment. That’s why more than 30,000 businesses trust Linxup to help them improve the safety, security, productivity, and efficiency of every vehicle, asset, tool, and worker in the field. Founded in 2004 and based in St. Louis, MO, Linxup serves customers in a wide range of industries, including field service, construction, trucking, transportation, and other enterprises that rely on mobile workers and equipment to get the job done.

ABOUT THE POSITION

This is the product role for someone who likes the layer where software meets hardware.

You’ll own the parts of Linxup that customers rarely see but depend on completely: our public API and the partner

integrations built on it, the pipeline that ingests telemetry from a quarter-million devices in the field, and the OTA

firmware and device management tooling we use to configure, update, and troubleshoot that hardware at scale.

You’ll also own initiatives in our core web and mobile products, so you stay close to the end customer and the day-to-

day experience — this is not a pure infrastructure role, and the mix is part of what makes it interesting.

Your engineering team is technical, and so are many of your customers: partner developers reading your API docs,

integration engineers at ERP and dispatch vendors, and internal teams who need visibility into a fleet of devices. Your

job is to understand what they actually need, decide what gets built and in what order, and write requirements

precise enough that engineers don’t have to guess.

You don’t need to write production code. You do need to be the kind of product owner who reads the API response,

runs the query, and looks at the device logs before forming an opinion.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS – RESPONSIBILITIES:

APIs & Partner Integrations:

• Own the roadmap for our public API and the partner ecosystem built on it — requirements definition, endpoint and payload design, authentication, rate limits, versioning, and deprecation
• Work directly with partner developers and integration engineers to scope, launch, and unblock integrations
• Treat developer experience as a product surface: clear documentation, predictable payloads, useful error messages, sandbox access, and sensible defaults

Device Data & Telemetry:

• Own product requirements for ingesting data from GPS trackers, dash cams, and asset and equipment trackers deployed in the field
• Partner with engineering on how device data is normalized, enriched, stored, and exposed — both to customers and to downstream features and reports
• Work through the real-world messiness of field hardware: intermittent cellular coverage, buffered and out-of- order messages, power and duty-cycle tradeoffs, and data that is missing or ambiguous
• Define the reporting, alerting, and rules behaviors that customers rely on that data to drive
• Help build the operational visibility the business needs into device state, connectivity, and firmware versions across an installed base of 250,000+ devices

Core Product & Agile Execution:

• Own initiatives in our core web and mobile products alongside the platform work — the features customers touch every day
• Write clear user stories and acceptance criteria, own and prioritize the backlog, and run refinement and sprint ceremonies with your engineering team
• Partner with QA to define test cases and validate solutions against real device and API behavior
• Make the call on scope and sequencing — and explain the tradeoff credibly to both an engineer and an executive

Cross-functional & Customer Work:

• Serve as the internal subject-matter expert on our API, device data, and firmware capabilities
• Talk to customers and partners regularly — including technical ones — and turn what you hear into prioritized, well-defined work
• Stay current on competitive software and hardware to keep our solutions market-ready

QUALIFICATIONS

Experience:

• 2–5 years as a technical product owner or product manager, business analyst, or software engineer — ideally on API, platform, integration, or connected-device products
• A track record shipping technical products where the customer was a developer, a partner system, or a device —not only a screen
• Experience working with software engineering teams in an agile process, and alongside hardware teams
• Proven experience managing a product through all stages of its lifecycle

Technical Depth:

• Hands-on comfort with REST APIs and webhooks: you can read a spec, exercise an endpoint in Postman or curl, and tell good payload design from bad
• Working knowledge of SQL and enough data fluency to answer your own questions
• Solid grasp of the SDLC, cloud infrastructure, and how data moves through a system end to end
• Enough comfort with logs and observability tooling to narrow down whether a problem is the device, the network, the ingestion pipeline, or the application

What Will Make You Stand Out:

• IoT or connected-hardware experience: telemetry ingestion, OTA update campaigns, MQTT or similar protocols
• Familiarity with cellular connectivity in the field
• Experience owning a public or partner-facing API, including deprecation decisions with real customers
• Familiarity with event streaming or message queues (Kafka, MQTT, SQS, or similar)

How You Work:

• You go to the primary source — the payload, the log, the query, the customer call — before you form a view
• You understand that good software delivers on ease of use and makes complicated things feel simple
• You translate complex technical concepts for non-technical audiences without losing what matters, and you write with precision
• You can hold several parallel workstreams without losing the thread on any of them
• You’re comfortable with ambiguity and with hardware realities you don’t fully control
• You have a keen sense of UX and genuine empathy for customers

WORK ENVIRONMENT

• A vibrant, fun office atmosphere with teams that work cross-functionally in a hybrid environment
• A fast-paced environment with real ownership, and opportunities for growth and reward
• We promote work/life balance to achieve maximum performance professionally and personally

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

• We value hard work and on-the-job-excellence and offer competitive compensation and benefits packages:
• Position offers a Base Salary
• Medical, Dental, Vision, Life and 401(k) benefits are offered
• Flexible Time Off (FTO)

You're a self-starter who excels at working both independently and collaboratively. You have a keen eye for detail and hold yourself to a high standard for quality and brand consistency.

This is a hybrid role that requires a minimum of three (3) days a week in our NYC office, with a focus on Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday.

What you'll do

Lead production across multiple shows & productions

• Stay informed on emerging podcast and video production trends and integrate best practices.

Manage and develop producers

• Delegate tasks effectively and support professional growth.

• Collaborate across teams to ensure smooth workflows and clear communication.

Minimum qualifications

In this role, you bring applied expertise and the ability to own components of a project or workstream end-to-end. You work with cross-functional partners, manage project-level milestones and risk, and contribute to budget planning.

• Experience: 5+ years of combined experience in video-forward editorial production, editing, and content development, including proven experience running or producing a podcast end to end, from pitch to publish.

Strategy, execution, and data

• Domain expertise: Demonstrated proficiency in audio and video recording and editing, with deep knowledge of podcast and video formats, styles, and genres — particularly parenting, lifestyle, and narrative storytelling content — and experience producing content for parenting, family, or lifestyle audiences. Experience with Descript, Premiere, or Riverside.

• Strategic thinking and execution: You own production of assigned episodes and projects end to end, applying editorial and visual guidelines consistently and flagging broader opportunities to the Director of Content Development.

• Project management: Strong background in content production management with a focus on timely, high-quality delivery, using project management tools to plan and track work across multiple productions.

• Data and analytics: You use audience and platform data to develop insights and inform decisions on assigned episodes and projects.

Communication, collaboration, and technology fluency

• Communication: Strong writing and editing skills, with a talent for storytelling that connects with audiences on a personal, human level, and the ability to communicate clearly with teammates, your manager, and cross-functional partners.

• AI fluency: Working knowledge of AI tools in content production — from scripting and editing to analytics and audience insights — applied to specific tasks within your work, following company guidelines for responsible use.

• Collaboration and ways of working: Self-starter who works effectively both independently and collaboratively, with a keen eye for detail and a high standard for quality and brand consistency — proactively identifying and flagging workflow improvements within your work.

Chamberlain University is seeking a highly strategic Director of Finance to lead financial planning, investment analysis, performance management, and executive decision support for two of the institution's most important growth platforms: Campus Expansion and Strategic Partnerships.

The Director of Finance will help determine where Chamberlain invests, expands, and partners by developing sophisticated financial models, business cases, ROI analyses, and strategic recommendations. This is a highly visible opportunity that combines analytical rigor with executive-level influence and business partnership.

The successful candidate will be equally comfortable building complex financial models, evaluating strategic growth investments, and presenting actionable recommendations to senior leadership. They will operate as a trusted advisor, helping guide decisions that shape the future growth of Chamberlain University and Covista’ s healthcare workforce mission.

jobs.title: Senior iOS Engineer
jobs.description:
At Range, we’re building towards a world where anyone can live the financial life they imagine for themselves. If that sounds like a mission you want to be a part of, let’s create it together.

We’re building AI-powered wealth management. Investments, taxes, retirement, estate planning, all in one platform instead of scattered across different advisors and apps. We're backed by Google's Gradient Ventures, Cathay Innovation, Scale Venture Partners, and more. We’re growing fast while still small enough that everyone's work is visible and impactful.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Senior iOS Engineer to own and evolve the Range iOS experience. You'll shape how members interact with their financial life on mobile. This is a high-ownership role on a small, fast-moving team where what you build ships to members quickly and visibly.

You'll work closely with product, design, and other engineers to define what mobile-first wealth management looks like. You won't just implement specs. You'll challenge them, improve them, and push the craft of iOS development forward at Range.




WHO YOU ARE

A builder. You care about shipping real things to real people. You don't wait for perfect requirements. You dig in, figure it out, and make it better along the way.

Craft-obsessed. You sweat the details that most engineers skip. Animations, transitions, scroll performance, accessibility. You know these things are the difference between an app people tolerate and one they love.

A product thinker. You think beyond the code to how a feature feels in someone's hands. You push back on designs that won't work well on device and propose alternatives that are better for the member.

A leader by example. You raise the bar through the quality of your own work, the clarity of your code reviews, and the way you help other engineers grow. You don't need a title to lead.

Obsessed with the member. Our members trust us with their financial lives. You take that seriously. Every interaction, every animation, every edge case matters because trust is built in the details.




HOW YOU LEAD AT THIS LEVEL

You own major product surfaces on iOS end-to-end. You're the person the team looks to for how things should be built on mobile, from architecture decisions to interaction patterns. You drive technical direction for the iOS codebase, shape the conventions other engineers follow, and make sure what we ship feels as good as what we designed. You partner directly with product and design to influence what gets built, not just how. When something is ambiguous, you bring clarity. When something isn't good enough, you say so.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of mobile development experience, with meaningful time spent building and shipping consumer-facing apps

 - Expertise in Swift and SwiftUI

 - Experience architecting modular, testable iOS applications

 - Track record of mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar on a team

 - Excellent communication skills. You can articulate technical tradeoffs to engineers and non-engineers alike




WHAT WILL SET YOU APART

 - 0 to 1 mobile product experience

 - Excellent product instincts. You think about users first, not the cleverest technical solution

 - Ability to solve ambiguous problems without being told exactly what to do

 - Security engineering experience

 - Fintech experience

 - Startup experience




NOT FOR YOU IF

 - You need a defined process before you can start working.

 - You think mobile is just a smaller screen for the same experience.

 - You'd rather wait for a spec than shape the product yourself.

 - You optimize for consensus over conviction.

 - You think "move fast" means lower the bar.




COMPENSATION

Base salary range: $150,000 – $250,000

This is the base salary range we expect in good faith to pay for this role at the time of posting. Where an offer lands within the range depends on the scope and complexity of work the candidate can own independently and demonstrated depth at this level.

 


OTHER COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

The range above reflects base salary only. Our offer packages also include equity in the form of stock options, so total compensation for this role will exceed the base salary range. 

We do not ask for or consider salary history. You are welcome to ask questions about compensation at any point in the process.




BENEFITS

 - Health & Wellness: 100% employer-covered medical insurance for employees (75% for dependents), plus dental and vision coverage

 - 401(k): Retirement savings program to support your future

 - Paid Time Off: time to reset and recharge + most federal holidays

 - Parental Leave: Comprehensive leave policy for growing families

 - Meals: Select meals covered throughout the week

 - Fitness: Monthly movement stipend

 - Equity & Career Growth: Early exercise eligibility and a strong focus on professional development

 - Annual Compensation Reviews: Salary and equity refreshes based on performance

 - Boomerang Program: After two years at Range, you can take time away to start your own company. We’ll hold your spot for 6 months - and pause your equity vesting, which resumes if you return

OnePay is the consumer fintech trusted by millions of Americans to make money better.

Our financial system is broken. High fees, low rates, and too few ways to actually grow your money. We’re fixing it. And we’re moving fast.

We’re an all-in-one financial services platform that brings together banking, high-yield savings, credit cards, point-of-sale lending, investing, and crypto in one place. We also partner with employers, HCM providers, gig platforms, and others to deliver embedded financial services to millions of employees and frontline workers.

We’re backed by Walmart, the world’s largest retailer, and Ribbit Capital, one of fintech’s most respected investors, giving us rare scale, distribution, and the opportunity to build something truly category-defining.

But what really sets OnePay apart is how we move. Our customers don’t have time to wait… and neither do we. This place moves fast, and we’re looking for people who are:

 - Ready to run

 - Hungry and driven by urgency

 - Exceptional at what they do, with low ego

 - Comfortable operating in motion




THE ROLE

As a Quality Platform Engineer at OnePay, your work will directly shape how confidently every engineering team ships to production, building the internal tooling that catches problems before they reach customers of a financial platform millions of people trust. You will:

 - Design and own shared automation frameworks used by engineering teams across web, mobile, and backend services

 - Build and maintain infrastructure that runs automated suites reliably at scale, including flaky-test detection and triage tooling

 - Partner with engineering teams to raise coverage and testing maturity, embedding quality practices into the development workflow rather than bolting them on afterward

 - Develop platform for test environment provisioning, data management, and parallelized execution to keep feedback loops fast

 - Define quality standards, provide observability (coverage, pass rates, run times), and maintain documentation and best practices to help engineers write and maintain effective automated tests


YOU BRING

 - 5+ years of professional experience in frontend/backend/platform engineering with a strong testing focus

 - Proficiency in TypeScript/Node.js or similar languages, with experience architecting test frameworks rather than just writing test cases

 - Experience with cloud-native infrastructure (Kubernetes, AWS) and containerized test environments

 - Familiarity with testing across the stack: API/integration testing, end-to-end testing for web and mobile (e.g., React Native)

 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence testing practices across multiple engineering teams

 - Drive and proactivity - everyone here is a builder and executor


TOOLS WE USE

We use Node and TypeScript on the server, leveraging the NestJS framework within a microservice-oriented architecture running on Kubernetes and AWS. On the client side, we build and ship product features for iOS, Android, and web platforms using React Native. We also embrace AI-assisted development, so engineers have their choice of Claude Code or Cursor to fit their workflow. While you don't need experience with our exact stack, familiarity with modern software engineering practices will help you ramp up quickly.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive base salary, stock options, and health benefits from Day 1

 - 401(k) plan with company match

 - Remote-friendly (US), flexible time off (FTO), and opportunities for growth

 - A high-growth, mission-driven, inclusive culture where your work has real impact






STANDARD INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our process varies by role. Most candidates go through:

 - AI-assisted initial screen

 - Interview with Talent Partner

 - Technical or Hiring Manager Interview

 - Team Interview

 - Executive Interview

 - Offer!




EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us at talent@onepay.com.

jobs.title: Staff DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
When thousands of hotels, resorts, and casinos around the world open their revenue tools, they expect them to just work. As our Staff DevOps Engineer, you'll be the person who makes that happen: designing the AWS infrastructure behind our platform, shaping architecture decisions alongside engineers, and building the automation and tools that help the whole team move faster.

What Makes Us Different?
Duetto is the hospitality industry's leading revenue management platform, founded in 2012 by former Wynn Resorts executives who knew the industry needed better technology. We built the world's first Revenue & Profit Operating System — a suite of tools (GameChanger, ScoreBoard, BlockBuster, Advance and more) that goes beyond room pricing to give hotels, resorts and casinos a complete picture of their revenue and profitability. Trusted by clients ranging from independent boutique hotels to global chains, we've been named the #1 Revenue Management Software by HotelTechAwards four years running and the #1 Best Place to Work in Hotel Tech in 2025. Backed by GrowthCurve Capital since 2024, we're accelerating our investment in AI, and we're genuinely passionate about the industry we serve. We build products we're proud of, for customers we care about.

What You'll Be Doing

• Design and build scalable, secure, highly available AWS infrastructure for our critical systems, with automation at the center and uptime and reliability as the goal.

• Partner with developers on architecture decisions to improve the reliability, performance, scalability, and security of our servers and applications.

• Keep us secure by default: tackle vulnerabilities early and raise our cybersecurity readiness.

• Be the last line of support for services our customers depend on 24/7. You'll troubleshoot on-call incidents, join a weekly on-call rotation, and lead Root Cause Analysis so the same problem doesn't come back.

• Build the tools and automation other engineers use every day, and mentor DevOps engineers and teams across the company.

• Help us bring AI into our DevOps and SRE workflows. We're redesigning how every role works with AI, and this one is no exception.

What We're Looking For
You may be a good fit if you have the following:

• 7+ years in an Ops, DevOps, or SRE role, with real system design and architecture experience

• Hands-on AWS experience (IAM, VPC, EC2, ELB, RDS, S3, Lambda, API Gateway, Secrets Manager, KMS, CloudWatch, CloudTrail), including multi-account management, permissions structures, and SSO. Azure or GCP experience is welcome too.

• Engineer-level knowledge of networking and security, plus a solid grasp of load balancing fundamentals

• Strong infrastructure-as-code skills with Terraform, working as part of a multi-user infrastructure team

• Experience with CI/CD and build/deploy automation tooling (GitHub, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, JFrog Artifactory, GitOps)

• Experience running enterprise monitoring tools like Prometheus, Grafana, or DataDog

• A track record of resolving complex on-call incidents and leading RCAs that lead to lasting fixes

• Comfort reading Java, Ruby, Bash/Zsh, HCL, Python, and JavaScript

• A service reliability mindset, and the ability to work independently and as part of a team

Strong candidates may also have:

• Layer 7 load balancing experience

• Container orchestration experience (ECS/EKS)

• Chef or Puppet configuration management experience

• SOC2 compliance experience

• Curiosity about our stack: Java, Python, NoSQL, MongoDB, Postgres, React, Terraform/Terragrunt, Chef, DataDog, and Prometheus

Why Duetto?

• Hospitality is in our DNA. Your work directly helps hoteliers grow revenue and profit, and you'll see the impact on real customers around the world.

• We play to win. Duetto speed is real. We act with urgency when we spot an opportunity or a challenge, and you'll have room to help set direction and architecture.

• AI is how we work. We're actively redesigning how every role operates with AI, and you'll be equipped and encouraged to use cutting-edge tools in your day-to-day, in DevOps and SRE workflows included.

• We build partnerships. We succeed as one team, across technical and non-technical functions, and we honour our commitments to each other and our customers.

• Come as you are. We value diverse perspectives, welcome healthy debate, and keep the atmosphere casual, flexible, collaborative, and fun. We take our fun seriously.

The Details

• Location: Remote, US or Canada

• Work model: Remote

• On-call: Weekly on-call rotation

• Visa sponsorship: Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

Duetto is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Sound like you?
If this sounds like the kind of work you want to be doing, we'd love to hear from you! You don't need to tick every single box to apply. If you're excited about building reliable systems for an industry we love, come say hello.

jobs.title: RN Clinical Navigator
jobs.description:
About Hone

Hone is an online medical clinic at the forefront of transforming healthcare and enhancing longevity. We use cutting-edge scientific advancements to empower men and women to take control of their health and unlock their full potential. Our people are the heart of everything we do and drive our success. We approach every project through our brand values:

• Fight for the Customer

• Execute Ruthlessly

• Communicate Candidly, Clearly, and Kindly

• Collaborate Selflessly

• Practice Calculated Risk-Taking

• Maximize Joy and Gratitude

Hone has been fully virtual from day one and will continue to be a remote-first employer.

Our Ideal Candidate

Our ideal candidate is a mission-driven, motivated multi-tasker who is invested in work that is fulfilling and impactful. They embrace change and tackle challenges with enthusiasm. They have an “all-in” disposition towards work, understanding that we are a fast-paced, high-growth organization with evolving priorities. They can excel at both independent tasks and collaborative work, leading with clear and candid communication. They exhibit humble leadership—the ability to drive initiatives forward while remaining excited about continuous learning and development opportunities. They feel strongly about being part of a team that advocates for people to live longer and better lives.

The Role

Hone is looking for a RN Clinical Navigator to join our team. As someone with a clinical background, you are responsible for supporting doctors and their patients with their medical care. You will review, triage, and escalate physician and patient issues in collaboration with the customer service, clinical, and operations teams so that patients have the best experience with Hone. You must thrive in a fast-paced environment that requires excelling in an unstructured setting and using clinical judgment to make decisions. We are currently seeking a compassionate and reliable nurse to join our clinical team.

Hone offers virtual care for both men and women seeking support for hormone replacement therapy, weight loss, thyroid concerns, cardiac health and longevity medicine. Clinical experience in these areas is not required, however we are seeking candidates who are passionate about helping patients live long, healthy lives.

Primary Responsibilities

Key responsibilities for this role include (but are not limited to) the following:

• Manage communications between patients and doctors and associated documentation as required, e.g. FSA-related letters, medical referrals, etc.

• Work with the clinical and operations team to make sure the patient receives fast resolution to any concerns.

• Collaborate with our Customer Service team in troubleshooting any patient requests pertaining to physician requirements/tasks supporting their treatment

• Provide clinical feedback in response to patient inquiries involving medication, lab, side effects, and anything clinically related in collaboration with clinical operations

• Support physicians to ensure any patient care issues are resolved in a timely manner.

• Follow established protocols and processes, with an eye towards improving operational processes to provide the best patient experience.

• Be willing to take on additional clinical projects or responsibilities when necessary.

Qualifications

In order to qualify for this role, candidates must meet the following criteria:

• Licensed RN - must hold a compact state license or live in an eligible state

• Ability to multitask, prioritize, and adhere to deadlines while maintaining attention to detail and quality

• Comfortable in a fast-paced, frequently changing environment

• Creative problem-solving skills with a results-driven mindset

• Can quickly learn new technology systems and communication tools

• Ability to work autonomously and collaboratively

• 3+ year(s) experience working with physicians and/or patients in a healthcare setting preferred, ideally in a telemedicine environment.

• Very comfortable using common technology platforms (e.g. Gmail, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google Meet, Slack)

• Effective and compassionate communicator (written and verbal)

• Must be a self-starter who looks for opportunities for improvement regularly

Compensation Range

$65,000-$75,000 annually

Benefits*

Hone wants our team to be in the best condition of their lives, so we offer a range of benefits including:

• A remote-first work environment

• Competitive compensation and equity options

• Health, dental, and vision insurance coverage

• Short-term disability and basic life coverage

• Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)

• Lifestyle Spending Accounts (LSAs)

• We follow federal holidays and have uncapped time off for exempt employees

• Budget for the technology tools you need (laptop, monitor, and/or special software)

• A focus on company-sponsored activities to foster engagement (both virtual and in-person)

• Waived membership fees for any Hone team members utilizing Hone products

*These benefits are available to full-time, regular employees, and not to independent contractors, part-time employees, temporary employees, or interns.

We are proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace committed to building a team culture that celebrates diversity and inclusion. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions. Please contact us to request accommodation.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At Range, we’re building towards a world where anyone can live the financial life they imagine for themselves. If that sounds like a mission you want to be a part of, let’s create it together.

We’re building AI-powered wealth management. Investments, taxes, retirement, estate planning, all in one platform instead of scattered across different advisors and apps. We're backed by Google's Gradient Ventures, Cathay Innovation, Scale Venture Partners, and more. We’re growing fast while still small enough that everyone's work is visible and impactful.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a software engineer who understands the user's problem, architects a solution, and ships it. Sometimes the same day. Your work lives in production, not in a design doc.

At this stage, every IC engineer at Range can operate as a 10x IC. There is very little stopping you from building.

You'll use AI workflows to move faster alongside the team and customers, bringing the best solutions to life. We think really big and ship fast, without lowering the bar on quality. You'll define how engineering operates here by figuring out what's actually possible when a great engineer leans all the way into AI.

Your architecture and your code will be how this company scales. When you build something that works, we move. Engineers at Range are catalysts, turning ideas into real products and creating momentum. That's how we lead. Ship fast, learn, iterate.




WHO YOU ARE

A builder. You go from problem to prototype to production. You don't wait for a perfectly scoped ticket or a sprint planning meeting. You see the gap and you close it.

Craft-obsessed. You've studied how the best companies build software and have real opinions about what makes it great. Your standards are high. What you ship is clean, secure, and considered, even when you ship it fast.

Intuition-driven. You've done enough reps to trust your gut on architecture decisions, move quickly, and be right far more often than you're wrong. When the requirements aren't clear, you use judgement to evaluate tradeoffs. Always finding a way to move.

AI-native. You're already using AI every day as core infrastructure. You see it as the thing that turns one engineer into ten.

Full-stack by instinct. Frontend, backend, infrastructure. You go wherever the problem is. React, TypeScript, Node, AWS are your tools, not your identity. You pick up whatever's needed.

You care about outcomes. Every endpoint, every interaction, every system is built around how your customers will actually experience the product.




WHERE YOU OPERATE AT THIS LEVEL

You produce high-quality, impactful work that drives team success. You take full ownership — proactively identifying and addressing challenges while staying focused on solutions. You lead by example with positivity, reframing setbacks as opportunities to learn and grow. You collaborate openly through radical transparency, ensuring alignment and trust among teammates and stakeholders.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Deep expertise in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, or other programming languages

 - Extensive experience designing, building, and operating production systems on AWS or similar cloud platforms (EC2, ECS, RDS, DynamoDB, S3, CloudWatch)

 - Proven ability to work across the stack — frontend, backend, infrastructure — and make sound tradeoffs between them

 - Track record of leading technical projects that span multiple services or systems

 - Experience defining technical direction for a team, including architecture decisions, tooling choices, and engineering standards

 - Proven ability to architect, debug, and ship using AI development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) — not just prompting, but knowing when the output is wrong, why, and how to fix it

 - Strong communication skills — you can align engineers and stakeholders around a technical approach




WHAT WILL SET YOU APART

 - Experience designing scalable, high-availability distributed systems

 - Experience building and maintaining complex web applications with React and TypeScript at scale

 - Excellent product instincts — you partner with product and design to shape what gets built, not just how

 - Ability to take a loosely defined business problem and drive it to a well-scoped technical solution

 - Track record of raising the bar for engineering quality across a team (testing practices, observability, incident response)

 - Security engineering experience

 - Fintech experience

 - Startup experience




NOT FOR YOU IF

 - You need a fully scoped PRD before you can start working

 - You're offended by the idea that AI changes everything about this job

 - You'd rather debate architecture than ship and iterate

 - You optimize for consensus over conviction

 - You think "move fast" means lower the bar




COMPENSATION

Base salary range: $150,000 – $250,000

This is the base salary range we expect in good faith to pay for this role at the time of posting. Where an offer lands within the range depends on the scope and complexity of work the candidate can own independently and demonstrated depth at this level.

 


OTHER COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

The range above reflects base salary only. Our offer packages also include equity in the form of stock options, so total compensation for this role will exceed the base salary range. 

We do not ask for or consider salary history. You are welcome to ask questions about compensation at any point in the process.




BENEFITS

 - Health & Wellness: 100% employer-covered medical insurance for employees (75% for dependents), plus dental and vision coverage

 - 401(k): Retirement savings program to support your future

 - Paid Time Off: time to reset and recharge + most federal holidays

 - Parental Leave: Comprehensive leave policy for growing families

 - Meals: Select meals covered throughout the week

 - Fitness: Monthly movement stipend

 - Equity & Career Growth: Early exercise eligibility and a strong focus on professional development

 - Annual Compensation Reviews: Salary and equity refreshes based on performance

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Caffe Operations - Eataly Corporate
jobs.description:
The Senior Manager, Operations – Eataly Caffè is a hands-on, field-based leader responsible for driving operational excellence, guest experience, team performance, and financial results across assigned Caffè locations. Spending the majority of their time in the operation, this role leads from the floor through direct observation, coaching, and accountability, ensuring locations are properly staffed, operationally ready, financially on target, and consistently executing Eataly standards. The Senior Manager develops management teams, improves operational processes, protects brand standards, and partners cross-functionally to drive business performance and exceptional guest experiences.

• Directs the day-to-day operations of assigned Eataly Caffè locations, maintaining a visible presence on the floor, observing service, coaching employees and managers, and stepping into the operation during peak periods, staffing challenges, openings, closings, or other business needs.

• Ensures consistent execution of opening, closing, shift-change, cash handling, security, cleanliness, food safety, health and safety, and other operational procedures and Eataly standards.

• Leads and develops the Caffè management team by setting clear expectations, providing coaching and feedback, recognizing strong performance, addressing performance issues, and developing talent and succession plans.

• Holds managers accountable for team performance, guest experience, staffing, training, service execution, and financial and operational results.

• Owns operational and financial performance for assigned Caffè locations, including revenue, labor, cost of goods, waste, inventory, productivity, and EBITDA; reviews results regularly, identifies performance gaps, and implements corrective actions.

• Manages labor deployment, scheduling, inventory, ordering, product availability, waste, cash controls, and other store-level resources to achieve operational and financial targets.

• Conducts regular operational walks and observations to identify deficiencies and opportunities related to hospitality, service, product quality, cleanliness, food safety, health and safety, and regulatory compliance; establishes corrective actions and follows through to resolution.

• Uses direct guest interaction, employee feedback, guest feedback, and business performance data to identify opportunities and improve the overall customer experience and operational performance.

• Ensures approved products, recipes, pricing, displays, and merchandising standards are consistently executed and escalates issues or opportunities to the appropriate functional leaders.

• Identifies operational challenges and implements practical improvements to procedures, workflows, labor deployment, training, and store-level controls in partnership with the management team.

• Partners with Talent & Culture and other functional leaders on recruitment, staffing, training, performance management, operational processes, and business initiatives while maintaining accountability for execution in the field.

• Supports new Caffè openings and operational readiness, including staffing, training, inventory, opening and closing procedures, standards validation, and post-opening stabilization.

• Communicates operational performance, business risks, priorities, and corrective actions clearly to the VP of Operations and appropriate cross-functional partners.

• Performs other duties as required or assigned.

• 7+ years of progressive management experience in a high-volume hospitality, quick-service, café, or restaurant environment, including responsibility for a full store or multi-unit operation.

• At least 3 years of multi-unit experience, or experience directly managing managers and leading day-to-day restaurant, café, or hospitality operations.

• Demonstrated experience leading customer-facing operations and consistently delivering strong hospitality and guest experience standards.

• Proven people leadership experience, including hiring, coaching, performance management, team development, and managing through other leaders.

• Strong financial acumen with the ability to understand and act on a P&L and location-level KPIs, including revenue, EBITDA, labor, cost of goods, and inventory.

• Demonstrated success improving processes and operating results through direct observation, disciplined follow-through, and cross-functional partnership.

• Ability and willingness to work as a hands-on operator in the store and step into day-to-day operations as business needs require.

• Clear communication, sound judgment, strong organization, and a high level of accountability.

• Passion for hospitality, Italian food and beverage, and the Eataly brand.

• Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

Job Requirements:

• Works on site daily at Eataly Caffè; this is not a remote or primarily office-based role.

• Ability to work a flexible schedule based on business needs, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, holidays, openings, and closings.

• Travel as needed to Eataly Caffè and Eataly North America locations, including U.S. and international locations.

Annual Salary Range: $125,000 - $135,000

Benefits and Perks

• Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance
• Paid Time Off
• Paid Parental Leave
• 401K with match or RRSP
• Bonus program
• Free family meal daily
• Discounts at Eataly
• Classes on products and Italian cuisine
• Referral bonus program
• and more!

Eataly is an equal employment opportunity employer. It is the Company’s policy to not unlawfully discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, sex, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability or any other characteristic made unlawful to consider by applicable federal, state, or local laws. Eataly also prohibits harassment of applicants and employees based on any of these protected categories. It is also Eataly’s policy to comply with all applicable federal, state and local laws regarding consideration of unemployment status, salary history, credit/bankruptcy history and criminal background/conviction history in making hiring decisions.  If contacted for an employment opportunity, please advise Human Resources if you require accommodation.

jobs.title: Club Restaurant Bar Captain - Soho Beach House Miami
jobs.location: Soho Beach House Miami, 4385 Collins Ave, Miami Beach, FL 33140
jobs.description:
The role…

At Soho House, the Bar Captain responsible for representing the highest standard of service and respected example for their peers to look to for support. As the Bar Captain, you are an extension of the management team and supervise staff during the shift and ensure cocktails, coffees, juices, & wine are sent out to the floor and served at the bar in accordance to standards set for service and quality control.

A Bar Captain requires high levels of organization, problem-solving and communication skills. You may also be responsible for supervising multiple aspects of supplying, running, and operating the bar. Ultimately, your main responsibility is to ensure that the bar staff provides positive experiences!

Main Duties

• Act as extension of management team and maintain the following programs: house-made syrups, fresh juices, batching, barrel aged cocktails, bespoke coffee, hot beverages and any specialty cocktails

• Ensure cleanliness of the bar including underneath bar top, the sink basins, speed rails, storage areas, floors and drains below the wells, back bar bottles, glassware shelves, all metal surfaces on low boys and espresso machine

• Maintain a safe and clean workstation as well as update Side Work Sheets to be up to date while communicating any inventory and purchase orders required to efficiently and effectively operate the bar

• Represent Soho House ethos & standards and the philosophy of House Tonic program while influencing sales to generate revenue

• Complete, delegate and support management by carrying out any opening and closing bar duties and ensure the bar is set-up to Health Department and Soho House standards

• Assist and participate in the development of seasonal menu implementations for the beverage program, including new product tasting with suppliers

• Support and participate in product and skill educational opportunities and the development of the beverage training program for all staff

• Well-versed and knowledgeable about all menu items (food and drink), pairing opportunities and upselling to provide optimal guest / member experience

• Follow service standards, mixture of ingredients to craft a Soho cocktail and collection of payment through MIROS (or similar POS)

• Check identification of customers to make sure they meet age requirements for purchase of alcohol and tobacco products as well as determine when a customer has had too much alcohol

• Performs other duties as assigned by supervisor/manager

Required Skills/Qualifications

• 5+ years of bar experience and proven leader with exceptional skills to influence others behind the bar

• Strong communication and people skills while also cognizant of the bottom line and generating revenue

• Ability to multitask and work in a fast-paced and demanding environment that doesn’t sacrifice quality with quantity

• Flexible schedule

• Tips certified.

• Micros knowledge a plus.

Physical Requirements

• Must be able to seize, grasp, turn and hold objects with hands.

• Must be able to work on your feet for at least 8 hours.

• Fast paced movements are required to go from one part of the club to others.

• Must be able to move, pull, carry or lift at least 40 pounds.

• Occasionally kneel, bend, crouch and climb as required.

Why work with us...

Soho House offers competitive compensation packages that feature global benefits and perks. Whether you’re seeking entry-level employment or a new opportunity to expand your profession, we offer training to develop the technical and managerial skills necessary to enhance your career.

• Health Care + 401K: Full time employees are eligible for full benefits; Medical, Dental & Vision as well as Retirement fund with a 2% match

• Paid Time Off: Full- Time Employees have sick day's + vacation days

• Career Development: Soho House can progress your career domestically or internationally as well as managerially or technically

• Soho Impact: Empowering the Soho House Community to make positive change, through mentoring, apprenticeship, local outreach and sustainability

• Learning & Development: An extensive range of internally and externally run courses are available for all employees.

• Cookhouse & House Tonic: Celebrating our passion for food and drink. Check out our monthly calendars and get involved in trips, training's and events. Available to all.

• Team Events: From fitness sessions to cinema screenings and art classes, each month we hold a series of fun events which you can sign up to.

• Team Meal: Whilst on duty in our Houses & Restaurants you will be provided with a substantial meal free of charge.

jobs.title: People Generalist (Onsite) - Evening shift
jobs.description:
**Internal Job Posting**
This posting is intended for current Vital Farms employees. If you are not an employee, please visit our careers page to view available opportunities and follow the appropriate application process.

Vital Farms - People Generalist (ECS)

• Generalist 2: M-F 12 - 8:30pm or anywhere in between that and 1 - 9:30pm

Finding the right place to grow your career isn’t (over) easy, so we’re here to help by sharing a few reasons why the grass is greener at Vital Farms. We think you’ll appreciate our focus on Conscious Capitalism, which drives business decisions that benefit all our stakeholders (leading to even better business results). You might be drawn to our innovative approach and refusal to settle for the “way things have always been done.” Or you could find it exciting to grow your skills while working for an industry-leading brand. Whether you’re into our values, our brand, or our egg-cellent puns, we hope you’ll join our Crew and help us change the world 108 square feet at a time!

At Vital Farms, we’re proud of the diverse communities we serve and the stakeholders who help bring our purpose to life. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive and collaborative environment where every crew member feels valued. We see this as one of our greatest strengths - and your role is key to helping us build on it.

Your Role:

At Vital Farms, we believe in cultivating a people-first experience grounded in integrity, transparency, and operational excellence. The People Generalist plays a key role in delivering exceptional HR support to our crew and the People Team. This role is responsible for executing core HR processes and providing timely, accurate support related to attendance, payroll assistance, onboarding, systems upkeep, and employment documentation.  As the first point of contact for People-related system inquiries, this role ensures smooth operations and a positive crew experience by managing the Vital HR email inbox and supporting a wide range of administrative and systems-based HR functions.

What You'll Do:

• - Maintain a consistent, highly visible presence on the plant floor across shifts. Spend the majority of working time close to crew members and operations, proactively building relationships, observing needs firsthand, and addressing questions and opportunities at the source.

• - Provide employee relations support by responding to routine concerns, coaching supervisors on policy application and next steps, supporting corrective action documentation, assisting with investigations, and coordinating termination and offboarding processes when needed.

• - Provide significant onsite learning and development support by assessing local needs and designing, coordinating, and facilitating practical training, orientation content, policy rollouts, and crew education across shifts.

• - Serve as an accessible leadership coach for supervisors and managers, providing real-time coaching, reinforcing effective people leadership practices, and helping leaders translate learning into consistent actions on the plant floor.

• - Use regular plant-floor engagement to identify emerging crew, leadership, learning, and operational needs; turn those observations into timely coaching, practical solutions, and innovative improvements.

• - Manage HRIS administration in UKG, including new hire setup, employee record maintenance, E-Verify completion, status changes, transfers, department moves, reporting structure updates, timeclock assignments, onboarding activities, and basic system troubleshooting.

• - Run routine and ad hoc reports, including attendance, headcount, turnover, staffing, labor, workforce maintenance, and other reports requested by leaders or the People Team.

• - Review attendance reports and point balances, audit attendance accuracy, support attendance point administration, and guide supervisors through attendance discipline levels and policy application.

• - Assist with payroll preparation, payroll audits, timekeeping review, missed punches, punch exceptions, and timekeeping discrepancies, including support during regular payroll cycles and holiday weeks.

• - Manage unemployment claims and documentation by gathering supporting records, coordinating responses, and partnering with leadership and the People Team on hearings and claim follow-up.

• - Complete employee verification requests accurately and confidentially, and maintain personnel files, HR documentation, and records in alignment with retention and compliance expectations.

• - Partner closely with Talent Acquisition partners and site leaders to support workforce planning, recruiting, and staffing needs.

• - Assist with escalated Talent Acquisition and crew member concerns that require People Team support, including rehire eligibility reviews, and availability verification.

• - Support crew engagement activities, recognition programs, communication, event execution, and other employee experience initiatives as needed.

• - Think innovatively about crew engagement, leader development, and People processes; identify practical improvements, test new approaches, and contribute to SOP creation, documentation, team meetings, and local People Team support.

What You Bring to the Table:

• - At least 3–5 years of experience in human resources, employee relations, People operations, payroll, or a related People function.

• - Experience supporting a manufacturing or other high-volume worksite preferred.

• - Bachelor’s degree in human resources, business, or a related field preferred, or equivalent work experience.

• - Working knowledge of employee relations practices, People policies, corrective action, investigations, and documentation expectations.

• - Experience supporting HRIS, payroll, timekeeping, reporting, onboarding, E-Verify, unemployment, and personnel recordkeeping processes; UKG experience preferred.

• - Demonstrated experience facilitating onsite learning, coaching frontline leaders, and delivering crew-facing training and communication in a practical, engaging, and approachable way.

• - Strong desire and demonstrated ability to work primarily onsite and on the plant floor, with the flexibility to build relationships and support crew members and leaders across shifts.

• - Ability to flex work hours to support business needs, including nights, weekends, and holidays as needed.

• - Strong customer-service mindset with the ability to support crew members and leaders with professionalism, confidentiality, and follow-through.

• - Excellent attention to detail, organization, prioritization, and ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

• - Strong communication skills and the ability to build trusted relationships across shifts, departments, supervisors, managers, and People Team partners.

• - Proactive, dependable, and comfortable working independently while knowing when to escalate sensitive or complex situations.

• - Strong computer skills and ability to use applications such as Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, and HR systems.

• - Ability to travel 10–20% of the time for company meetings, team offsites, or training sessions.

• - You’re no hero – You know the power of teamwork and celebrate the work of others before your own.

• - You give a sh*t – You believe in acting like an owner and making Vital Farms a place to be proud of.

• - You raise the standards – You know growth can be hard, but you strive to improve yourself and others each day.

• - You can walk in someone else’s boots – You seek to understand other’s viewpoints and think that you get to better answers by sitting on the same side of the table.

• - You don’t walk on eggshells – You’re not afraid to leave the bullsh*t behind and have honest conversations.

What We Bring to the Table:

• - A fast-paced, energetic, remote environment with passionate people who are leading a movement to bring ethically produced food to the table.

• - Competitive pay and benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision, and Paid Parental Leave, just to name a few).

• - Generous retirement contributions: 401(k) + 3% Contribution from Day 1.

• - Free eggs and butter (yes, really!), along with friends and family discounts.

• - Fun team SWAG that will make you the talk of the town.

• - Professional development opportunities and an amazing team dedicated to your growth.

At Vital Farms, compensation decisions are dependent upon a variety of factors, which may include, but are not limited to, skill level, experience, education, training, market demands, and business needs. A reasonable estimate of the current starting annual base salary for this position is $80,000 - $95,000. Please keep in mind that hiring at the maximum end of the range would not be typical in order to allow for potential continued future salary growth.

Who We Are:

Vital Farms, a Certified B Corporation, offers a range of ethically produced foods nationwide. Started on a single farm in Austin, Texas, in 2007, Vital Farms became a national consumer brand that works with 600 family farms and is the leading U.S. brand of pasture-raised eggs by retail dollar sales. Vital Farms’ products, including shell eggs, butter, hard-boiled eggs, and liquid whole eggs, are sold in over 24,000 stores nationwide.

Vital Farms’ ethics are exemplified by its focus on the humane treatment of farm animals and sustainable farming practices. In addition, as a Delaware Public Benefit Corporation, Vital Farms prioritizes the long-term benefits of each of its stakeholders, including farmers and suppliers, customers and consumers, communities and the environment, crew members, and stockholders. In short, we exist to improve the lives of people, animals, and our planet through food.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

To fulfill Vital Farms mission of bringing ethically produced food to the table, we’re committed to building teams that reflect diverse perspectives and lived experiences. We believe that when all crew members feel valued and respected, they bring their best ideas forward - fueling innovation, belonging, and shared success. We strive to create a welcoming environment rooted in equal opportunity and encourage individuals from all backgrounds and experiences to apply.

To that end, we make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Vital Farms does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender and gender identity, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, marital status, age, national origin, citizenship status, military or veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Ready to Join Us?

Together, we’re cultivating an environment where every Crew member can thrive, grow, and know they’re part of something bigger - improving lives through ethical food.

If this role sounds like the right fit for you, we’d love to hear from you! Even if you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply - you might be exactly what we need!

Next Steps:

Shortly after you complete your application, you'll receive a follow-up email elaborating on any potential next steps in our process. If you don't immediately receive said follow-up email, we would highly encourage you to check your spam filter!

In order to fulfill Vital Farms mission to “bring ethically produced food to the table,” we seek to build teams that leverage diverse perspectives to create a welcoming and innovative environment that is committed to the principles of equal employment opportunities.

To that end, we make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Staying Safe During Your Job Search

At Vital Farms, we care deeply about the people interested in joining our Crew. That includes helping protect candidates from fraudulent recruiting activity and creating a hiring experience that is safe, respectful, and transparent.

Unfortunately, job scams are becoming increasingly common. We encourage all applicants to stay vigilant throughout the hiring process and verify opportunities directly through our official careers page.

Vital Farms recruiters will only contact candidates through official company channels, including email addresses ending in @vitalfarms.com. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or personal banking information during the hiring process. We also do not extend job offers without a formal interview process.

If you receive suspicious communication claiming to represent Vital Farms, we encourage you to avoid engaging and report it to us at info@vitalfarms.com.

We are committed to treating every candidate with fairness and respect and to creating a hiring experience worthy of your trust.

California Applicants:

Please see our California Employment Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we collect, use, retain, and disclose personal information as part of our recruitment and hiring process.

jobs.title: Client Service Representative
jobs.description:
Paychex is reimagining how businesses manage their workforce by bringing payroll, HR, benefits, and advisory services together into a single connected HCM platform. As Paychex and Paycor come together, we're combining innovative technology, data-driven insights, AI, and human expertise to help organizations work smarter, support their people, and achieve better business outcomes. This is an exciting time to join our team as we continue to invest in innovation, simplify client experiences, and shape the future of work. At Paychex, you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, make a meaningful impact, and be part of something bigger as One Paychex.

Overview

Under a significant level of guidance and direction, provides customer service for one or more Paychex products. Uses prescribed guidelines to ensure good customer relations are maintained and customer claims and complaints are resolved fairly, effectively, and in accordance with Paychex policies and procedures.

Responsibilities

• Delivers quality service to Paychex clients via phone, email, chat, and other avenues
• Follows up on outstanding items to issue completion in compliance with established Service Level Agreements
• Uses systems and software packages, which may include HRIS, Salesforce, Flex, Core Advanced, and ORS
• Develops and maintains a basic working knowledge of one or more Paychex products
• Performs data input, maintaining strong prioritization and organization
• Documents all client interactions

Qualifications

• Bachelor's Degree - Preferred

Compensation

In the spirit of pay transparency, we are excited to share that the starting base pay range for this position is $20.00 - $22.00 hourly. Please keep in mind that this range is the base pay only and does not consider other components that make up the total rewards package for the position. If you are hired at Paychex, your overall compensation will be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, and/or experience which may result in total compensation outside of this range.

Live the Paychex Values

• Act with uncompromising integrity.

• Provide outstanding service and build trusted relationships.

• Drive innovation in our products and services and continually improve our processes.

• Work in partnership and support each other.

• Be personally accountable and deliver on commitments.

• Treat each other with respect and dignity.
What's in it for you?
