jobs.title: Senior Associate, Strategy Specialist
jobs.description:
About Baron Capital

Baron Capital is a leading asset management firm founded in 1982. We believe that hiring, retaining, and nurturing talented individuals who share our passion for excellence, integrity, and innovation is the key to our success. This means creating a welcoming, inclusive, and inspiring environment for all, as well as providing the resources and support our employees need to succeed. We take pride in our exceptionally low turnover and consider it a testament to our culture of collaboration and open communication. If you are looking for a career where you are part of a dynamic team where you can truly make a difference, we invite you to consider joining us.

About the Team

Portfolio Analytics, one of the three core teams within the Portfolio, Risk & Data Analytics (PR&DA) group, is responsible for performance and portfolio analytics for Baron’s Portfolio Strategies and investment products. Members of Portfolio Analytics meet regularly with Portfolio Managers (PMs) to discuss market trends and drivers of absolute and relative performance. The team also maintains databases used to perform custom analytics, analyzes performance dispersion across portfolios, and systematically tracks trends in different metrics and fundamental KPIs. In addition, the team supports the Firm’s internal research, product development, and external marketing efforts and produces periodic reports for the Firm's CIOs, executives, and Board of Trustees. Portfolio Analytics works closely with the Risk & Quantitative Data Analytics and Performance & Peer Analytics teams, and interacts regularly with sales, accounting, marketing, and most other departments at the Firm.

Team members collaborate with one another and with departments across the Firm—including the Investment team (equity research analysts and PMs), IT developers, and the accounting department—to analyze the Firm’s investment strategy exposures and performance, and to provide accurate reports and metrics summarizing results and characteristics.

About the Role

The Senior Associate, Strategy Specialist will play a key role in providing portfolio insights, strategy analysis, and decision-support analytics to PMs, senior leadership, and client-facing teams. This individual will transform complex data into actionable intelligence, enabling investment, risk, and distribution teams to make better-informed decisions, and will conduct analysis on assigned investment strategies/portfolios, asset class characteristics, portfolio construction, and positioning to support the needs of PMs. The role also involves developing and enhancing portfolio analytics for different investment vehicles within specific portfolio strategies.

The Strategy Specialist also conducts portfolio analyses supporting marketing, sales, and client service efforts. To effectively respond to ad hoc and periodic requests for analytics, the individual is expected to understand assigned strategies and portfolio mandates, the Baron investment philosophy and process, and relevant market events and trends. The Strategy Specialist must communicate results clearly to both the team and other areas of the Firm. Analysis and content developed by the Strategy Specialist support the Firm's efforts to deliver outstanding client service and to gather and retain assets.

The individual will use portfolio analytics tools to fulfill periodic, technical, ad hoc requests from the Investment team for performance and holdings-based analytics, and to prepare standardized portfolio analytics packets. This role requires familiarity with equity analytics tools and portfolio management concepts, along with formal training in the statistical and quantitative aspects of investment analysis. Importantly, the position also requires the ability to convey complex statistical and portfolio analytics concepts and processes to client-facing teams at the Firm, and to apply these analytical tools to produce content used by groups across the Firm.

This is a highly visible role requiring strong technical, analytical, and communication skills, along with the ability to collaborate across investment, sales, marketing, and operations teams in a boutique, entrepreneurial environment. The PR&DA group has a strong team-based orientation, yet relies on its members to take initiative and ownership of their own individual projects. A highly proactive, entrepreneurial, and professional attitude is essential.

Because markets, strategy lifecycles, and performance cycles change over time, the Strategy Specialist must continuously grow and adapt to meet evolving demands and a wide range of requests for support. This individual must excel at working independently, collaborating with key professionals, and leading projects to completion, including participating in project teams and collaborating effectively with groups across the Firm. An active interest in acquiring new fundamental knowledge and practical analytics skills is highly encouraged.

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio and Strategy Coverage

• Serve as the dedicated analytics specialist for assigned equity strategies, developing a deep understanding of investment objectives, guidelines, holdings, performance drivers, and risk exposures.

• Own monthly reporting for certain Baron Strategies, alongside other members of the Portfolio Analytics team.

• Build strong familiarity with how each PM approaches and manages risk, and translate that understanding into data-driven insights and commentary that illustrate it in action.

• Partner directly with PMs to provide ongoing analytics, competitive intelligence, and customized insights to support portfolio positioning and communication.

Analytics and Insights

• Develop a strong working knowledge of all PR&DA tools available, including FactSet Portfolio Analytics (PA), MSCI Barra, Morningstar Direct, Nasdaq eVestment, Advent Portfolio Exchange (APX), and Baron proprietary tools and models.

• Conduct quantitative and qualitative analysis of performance, performance contribution and attribution, style/factor exposures, and portfolio and performance-based characteristics across strategies and peer groups.

• Prepare materials and summaries for PMs and client reviews.

• Identify trends and insights that inform both portfolio management decisions and firm-wide strategic initiatives.

Collaboration and Stakeholder Support

• Act as a bridge between investment teams, distribution (sales/marketing), and PR&DA leadership by delivering tailored analytics and presentations.

• Support cross-functional initiatives, including product development, investor communications, and competitive positioning.

• Liaise with the Risk & Quantitative Data Analytics and Performance & Peer Analytics teams to ensure consistency and alignment in analytics delivery.

• Partner with different departments to ensure data accuracy and investigate performance-related issues.

• Assist the Investor Data and Information Group with the completion of RFP materials, addressing complex, strategy-specific questions as needed.

Reporting and Visualization

• Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and presentations leveraging FactSet PA, Morningstar Direct, Nasdaq eVestment, and other analytical tools.

• Translate technical analysis into clear, compelling narratives suitable for board-level, client, and internal leadership audiences.

Process and Innovation

• Contribute to the ongoing enhancement of the Portfolio Analytics function by automating reporting, creating and maintaining reporting templates, improving data workflows, and adopting best practices.

• Keep project tracking current and accurate using tools such as Wrike, ensuring the team stays on schedule.

• Mentor junior associates, supporting their development and ensuring quality in deliverables.

Qualifications

Education and Experience:

• Bachelor’s or post-graduate/master’s degree in business, finance, or a quantitative field such as quantitative finance, statistics, applied mathematics, engineering, or computer science.

• Professional accreditations such as a CFA designation, or progress toward one, are desired.

• Five or more years of relevant experience in performance/portfolio analytics, equity research, risk/quantitative analysis, or a related function within the investment management industry.

Knowledge:

• Financial Knowledge: Understanding of investment instruments, financial markets, economic indicators, and the investment management industry.

• Technical Platforms: Proficiency with financial applications such as FactSet PA, Morningstar Direct, Nasdaq eVestment, Bloomberg, or similar platforms.

• Performance Attribution: Familiarity with performance attribution methodologies.

• Programming and Data Visualization: Working knowledge of relevant programming languages (Python, SQL, R) and data visualization tools (Microsoft Power BI and/or Tableau) for data manipulation and automation. The ideal candidate can create and maintain complex spreadsheets, databases, reports, and visually appealing presentations in Excel, PowerPoint, and internal dashboards.

• Office Productivity: Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel, VBA, PowerPoint, and Word.

Skills and Abilities:

• Strong Analytical and Quantitative Skills: Ability to interpret complex investment concepts and draw actionable insights, with proficiency in financial modeling, statistical analysis, data interpretation.

• Communication Skills: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex concepts to a broad audience, including PMs, senior management, and external stakeholders.

• Mindset: Proactive and energetic, self-motivated, and intellectually curious, with a commitment to continuous learning, a strong work ethic, and a service-oriented, analytical approach.

• Attention to Detail: Keen attention to detail, ensuring the accuracy and reliability of analyses, reports, and models.

• Adaptability: Willingness and ability to learn and adapt to new tools, techniques, and methodologies as required by the role, the Firm’s dynamic environment, and the industry.

• Organizational and Time Management Skills: Ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously, meeting deadlines and delivering high-quality work under pressure.

• Team Player: Ability to work well in a collaborative environment while also taking initiative, ownership, and responsibility for individual projects.

The base salary range for this position is based on skills, experience, qualifications, and internal equity. It is eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. It also participates in the Firm's 401(k) and Profit-Sharing Plan. The Firm's comprehensive benefits package includes medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage, along with short and long-term disability insurance coverage. In addition, the Firm offers paid time off programs, free corporate gym access, subsidized in-office lunch options, and various employee discounts/perks programs.

Note to third parties: Baron Capital is not seeking or accepting any unsolicited assistance from search and selection firms or employment agencies at this time.

Base Salary

$120,000—$140,000 USD

jobs.title: VP, Marketing Strategy & Operational Excellence
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
VP, Marketing Strategy & Operational Excellence

Role Overview

Smartly is seeking a visionary and execution-focused Vice President (VP) of Marketing Strategy & Operational Excellence. This represents a newly revamped leadership role replacing our former "VP of Growth." At Smartly, we believe growth is a shared responsibility across the entire marketing department. Therefore, this role shifts the focus from siloed lead-generation execution connecting company strategy to marketing strategy and building the underlying systems, cross-functional operating models, data-driven capabilities, and automation frameworks required to scale our entire global marketing organization.

Reporting directly to the Chief Marketing Officer (CMO), the VP of Marketing Strategy & Operational Excellence will run the "machinery" of the department. This leader will be tasked with transforming Smartly’s marketing into a highly automated, data-literate, and operationally rigorous unit capable of delivering on ambitious commercial objectives while building a healthy, sustainable, and high-performing team. This leader doesn’t just make marketing run better… They help determine what marketing should prioritize, why, and how the pieces fit together. Then build the operating rigor to execute it. /// ALT: This leader must be equally comfortable answering the question “what should marketing do and why” as “how do we execute it better?”

18-Month Strategic Mandate

This leader will own the operational strategy, planning process, and enablement pipelines to achieve the following departmental objectives:

• Pipeline Scaling: Enable the team to scale from the current 430–440 Sales Accepted Leads (SALs) to 600 weighted SALs within 18 months.

• Budget Optimization: Drive a 5% optimization in SAL acquisition costs.

• Commercial Event Impact: Standardize execution and pipeline analytics to grow event-influenced pipeline from $10M to 12M–13M, ensuring a 98%+ customer retention rate for event and certificate participants.

• Marketing Conversion: Drive a 10% year-on-year increase in the conversion of accepted leads to qualified leads.

• Brand Health & Validation: Increase annual third-party validations (reviews, analyst mentions, G2) from 15 to 20.

• Internal Alignment: Enhance employee brand advocacy and elevate internal understanding of company mission/vision to an 8+ out of 10 score.

Key Responsibilities

Marketing Strategy & Integrated Planning

• Establish a disciplined process for translating company strategy into marketing strategy. Partner with the CMO and marketing leadership team to translate Smartly’s company goals, growth priorities and market opportunities into marketing objectives and OKRs.

• Drive integrated marketing planning. Lead annual and quarterly marketing planning across functions, turning priorities into an integrated roadmap with clear priorities and lead upstream marketing briefing process for global and tentpole marketing initiatives.

Cross-Functional Governance & the "Three-Legged Stool" Model

• Rebuild Cross-Functional Handoffs: Standardize and enforce the operating model between Product/Product Marketing, Partnerships, and Brand Marketing. Solve the current "reactive" work cycle by acting as the ultimate gatekeeper for resource planning.

• Establish SLA Governance: Author and enforce strict Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Implement a zero-tolerance policy for partner marketing requests arriving without a fully documented brief and a mandatory 12-week lead time (such as joint campaigns with key platforms like Meta, Roku, Google, and LinkedIn).

• Lead Strategic Agency Partnerships: Lead the operational and budgetary governance of external creative and execution agencies. Direct the strategy to shift creative ideation for events to external partners, allowing the internal team to focus on budget management and commercial execution.

Systems Integration, Data Operations & Enablement

• Unify Marketing & Sales Funnels: Partner closely with the Revenue Operations (RevOps) team—specifically collaborating with our newly transitioned Revenue Operations Lead—to bridge marketing and sales funnels and ensure single-source-of-truth reporting.

• Champion Data Literacy: Turn the department's data literacy from a baseline score of 2/10 for data-pulling into a model of self-service. Design and implement mandatory data onboarding, continuous training, and self-service protocols.

• De-silo Systems & Hygiene: Drive data sanitization across Salesforce, Marketo, Greenhouse, and other marketing systems to align algorithms, ensure data hygiene, and restore absolute executive confidence in reporting.

AI Automation & Workflow Orchestration

• Own the Marketing Tech Stack: Transition the department from manual, repetitive execution (e.g., chasing case studies, manual reporting, and repetitive copywriting) to high-efficiency automated workflows.

• Lead AI Agent Deployment: Direct the roadmap to build and deploy custom AI agents, establishing a centralized Campaign Performance Knowledge Hub to synthesize historical creatives, benchmarks, and campaign strategies in minutes.

• Manage Automation Headcount: Supervise and guide technical resources, including the newly created AI Integration Specialist role, to build robust, automated API pipelines and always-on metrics dashboards.

Commercial Event Refocusing & Operational Efficiency

• Refocus Headcount on Revenue: Partner with the CMO to transform the Global Events, Comms &Design teams from an internal administrative coordinator into a commercial powerhouse. Own the operational strategy to transfer all non-marketing administrative tasks (such as board meetings, executive off-sites, and company All-Hands) to Workplace and Executive Assistant teams.

• Streamline Post-Event Analytics: Replace the current, labor-intensive post-event reporting pipeline (currently requiring six cross-functional representatives) with automated Salesforce dashboards that track daily registrations, real-time budgets, and post-event pipeline performance.

Workload Management & Employee Retention Strategy

• Mitigate Burnout: Actively manage and rebalance team capacity. Convert Workday Peakon Employee Engagement data (specifically addressing our current baseline scores of 4.7/10 in Workload Manageability and 6.2/10 in Mental Wellbeing) into active, operational retention strategies.

• Lead Distraction Audits: Conduct recurring "operational distraction audits" to log and eliminate low-value tasks, unnecessary meeting overhead, and administrative bottlenecks.

• Model Behavioral Standards: Establish concrete behavioral expectations for managers to address and eliminate "blame culture," ensuring overloaded staff are supported rather than penalized during high-stakes campaigns.

Core Competencies & Skills

• Operational Governance: Exceptional capability in process design, structured operating models, and change management. High discipline in enforcing project timelines, SLAs, and briefs.

• Data & Technical Literacy: High competency in marketing technology architecture (Salesforce, Marketo, DemandBase, RevOps systems). Strong ability to build, analyze, and interpret multi-touch attribution reports and unified dashboards.

• AI & Automation Fluency: Strong understanding of how to leverage API integrations, custom LLM agents, and automated design-repurposing tools (e.g., Smartly platform capabilities) to scale content creation.

• Empathy-Led People Leadership: A proven ability to lead through times of high-growth change with an employee-first mindset. Mastery of workload balancing, capacity planning, and psychological safety standards.

• Financial & Agency Management: Strong budget management and negotiation skills. Extensive experience managing large agency retainers, contract execution, and outsourced creative operations.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience: 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, GTM Strategy, or Business Transformation.

• Scale: Proven track record of scaling marketing departments in mid-sized B2B SaaS or digital media organizations (500–2,000 employees).

• Transformation Track Record: Demonstrated success in dismantling manual operational workflows, in-housing or out-housing agency retainers, and driving department-wide tech stack transformations (Salesforce, Marketo, HubSpot).

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a highly analytical field. MBA or advanced certifications in Agile/Six Sigma are a strong plus.

What We Offer You...

• Five weeks paid time off (PTO), 11 company paid holidays, unlimited sick days

• Generous healthcare packages & mental health benefits

• 401K plus matching & equity grants for all new Smartlies

• Wellness benefit & learning reimbursement opportunities

• Volunteer time off days & company donation matching opportunities

• And so much more…

The base pay range for this position is as mentioned below per year, plus an annual performance bonus. We take into consideration an individual’s background, expertise, and experience in determining final salary. In addition to annual salary, Smartly’s total rewards provide employees with stock options, medical/dental/vision insurances, retirement savings benefits, parental leave, 5 weeks vacation, unlimited sick days, life insurance, and disability benefits. This information is provided in accordance with applicable law. Base pay information is based on market location.

Base Salary in USD : $195,000 - 275,000

Curious what it's like to work at Smartly? Visit our Careers page to see how we grow, collaborate, and make impact together.

About Smartly

Smartly is the AI-powered advertising technology company transforming ad experiences for brands and their consumers. Our comprehensive advertising platform seamlessly integrates the capabilities of media, creative, and intelligence to power more than 800 billion impressions and generate more than 300 billion creatives annually, delivering tangible business outcomes for brands and advertisers.

Smartly is the only company in the industry recognized as a Leader in The Forrester Wave: Creative Advertising Technologies with PwC validating the results it delivers for brands. We manage creative and media for 700+ brands worldwide and $6B in ad spend across the largest media platforms, including Facebook, Google, Instagram, Pinterest, Snap, and TikTok. Our end-to-end technology, unmatched access to media platforms and exceptional customer service help Fortune 500 brands to reach and engage consumers and learn what performs best.Smartly is a multinational and diverse team of 750+ Smartlies from 60+ nationalities, working in 13 countries. Together, we want to create and maintain an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected and heard. Our Diversity, Equity & Inclusion approach is at the heart of it.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive, AMER
jobs.description:
ABOUT TALON.ONE:

Talon.One is the most powerful incentives engine that unifies loyalty, promotions and gamification into one holistic platform. Backed by enterprise-grade security and scalability, Talon.One empowers companies to build personalized, profitable promotions and loyalty programs using any data.

Today, over 250 of the world’s most-loved brands including Adidas, Sephora and Carlsberg work with Talon.One to drive deeper engagement and lasting loyalty with their customers.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As an Enterprise Account Executive at Talon.One, you’ll play a mission-critical role in driving new business across the Americas by selling the world’s most flexible promotions & loyalty platform to top-tier brands. You’ll be selling a composable, API-first solution that integrates with partners like Shopify, Braze, Salesforce, Segment, and other best-of-breed players in the marketing and commerce tech stacks.

We’re looking for strategic sellers with initiative, intellectual curiosity, and ownership. You’ll own the full sales cycle—from outbounding to discovery through closing—and serve as the quarterback both externally and internally. If you enjoy selling into complex organizations, both technical and business audiences, C-suites, and brands that want to transform the way they incentivize their customers, then this role is the right opportunity for you.

This is a remote role; we prefer candidates within commuting distance of Chicago, Boston or New York City, and you should be comfortable working Eastern or Central time zone hours.  This role also requires occasional domestic and international travel (<50% of the time).

ABOUT THE TEAM:

You will be joining our 5-person Enterprise Sales team in AMER, which is an integral part of our Sales unit. This is a dynamic and collaborative Sales organization, where we focus on building strong partnerships with prospects. Our mission is to drive revenue by delivering measurable value to enterprise clients through highly personalized, technically robust solutions. As part of the AMER Sales team, you’ll report to the Enterprise Sales Director and collaborate closely with Sales Engineers, Customer Success, and Marketing to build meaningful client relationships and close complex deals. We are a global team of self-starters who thrive on accountability and mutual success.

ONCE YOU ARE HERE YOU WILL:

• Drive new logo acquisition and expansion in the Enterprise segment (companies up to $2B in annual revenue)

• Own complex, multi-stakeholder deal cycles from first touch to close, often presenting to VP and C-level executives

• Serve as the internal quarterback, leveraging Solutions Engineers, product leadership, business consultants, customer success, and partners to advance deals

• Proactively identify blockers and build strategies to overcome them

• Represent Talon.One at industry events, networking forums, and partner co-selling opportunities

• Develop fluency in our API-based solution and communicate its value within a composable tech stack, aligning to our prospects’ biggest challenges and goals

• Manage Salesforce hygiene and pipeline accuracy with autonomy & minimal oversight

WHAT WE NEED YOU TO BRING TO THE TABLE:

• 5–8 years of SaaS sales or professional services sales experience, ideally in complex enterprise environments with long deal cycles

• Proven ability to sell into digital-first organizations (eCommerce, retail, or DTC)

• Exceptional project management and stakeholder coordination skills—you know when to pull in technical, product, or executive resources and can manage internal alignment effectively

• Master sales qualification methodologies (MEDDPICC) and can effectively manage multiple complex deal cycles simultaneously

• Self-starter mindset: You build your plan, identify blockers, and take initiative to move forward

• Technical understanding: You enjoy learning how integrations work and can communicate technical value to non-technical buyers

• Experience with best-of-breed or composable solutions, especially ones that integrate with Customer Data Platforms, Salesforce, Braze, etc

• Experience in selling into eCommerce, understanding the landscape and challenges in today's market, while leveraging existing relationships

• Availability to travel when needed to progress sales cycles and close deals

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU:

• Choose from top-tier Medical, Dental, and Vision plans (Blue Cross Blue Shield MA, MetLife, VSP)

• Manage your own time off with our flexible PTO policy

• $1,200 annual learning budget

• $350 home office setup budget, a $50 monthly home office allowance

• Freedom to work from abroad for up to 90 days worldwide!

• WeWork On-Demand access for flexible workspace solutions

• Mental health support with nilo.health

• Build your savings with our 401(k) plan, including a 100% company match on your contributions up to 4%

• We provide 100% company-paid Life Insurance, Short-Term, and Long-Term Disability coverage

The estimated total compensation for this role is $200,000 - $250,000, though actual compensation may vary depending on factors such as relevant experience, skills, qualifications, certifications, and location. The salary range is subject to change and may be adjusted at any time.

jobs.title: Industrial Designer
jobs.description:
Industrial Designer

Location: Remote

About Us

Atari, one of the world's most iconic entertainment brands, is a pioneer in interactive entertainment. With operations spanning gaming, e-commerce, licensing, and hardware, Atari thrives at the intersection of innovation and legacy. Join our dynamic team and play a key role in shaping the financial health of our diverse business operations.

About the Role

We are seeking a creative and passionate Industrial Designer to help establish our internal product design capabilities. You’ll bring your knowledge of concept design, manufacturing, video games, pop culture, and niche fandoms to our growing team. In this role, you will create and iterate on industrial designs in electronics and collectibles to surprise, delight, and connect with our fans.

You’ll support the design process from early concepts through production, creating beautiful, functional, and brand-appropriate consoles, controllers, and collectibles. Our collaborative, fast-paced team values creativity, ownership, and bringing products to life quickly. This is a hands-on role for a designer who enjoys prototyping, iterating, and solving real-world product challenges.

What You'll Do

Product Design & Development

• Design exciting products that capture the heart of our brands and licensed collaborators while satisfying the needs of our audiences.

• Collaborate closely with the Creative team to bring 3D designs to life in solutions that convey appropriate visual and tactile messages with consideration for the production process and cost targets.

• Help develop and mature our existing product design language.

• Generate multiple concept directions for assigned projects and advance strong solutions within the agreed concept and refinement timelines

• Prepare and develop concepts for user testing through prototypes or renderings.

• Support designers with generating and communicating the visual and physical aspects of designs through sketches, illustrations, renderings, and 3D prototype models.

• Develop manufacturable, durable products by identifying and helping resolve design, engineering, material, and assembly challenges before final production handoff.

• Help drive efforts surrounding R&D in new materials, 3D rendering, and on-site production.

• Support design team with creative feedback, production assistance, etc.

• Collaborate cross-functionally and with vendors to maintain project momentum and achieve 100% alignment with agreed development milestones and deliverable dates.

• Deliver high-quality design solutions on schedule and achieve approximately 90% approval from cross-functional partners within each project phase, incorporating feedback promptly when revisions are needed.

Design Process & Collaboration

• Clearly communicate design strategy and creative process to internal stakeholders, including design and executive teams.

• Participate in regular group design critiques and planning/concepting meetings in order to arrive at the best possible products and experiences for our customers.

• Collaborate with team members to identify social, industry, and technology trends that influence the development of future products.

• Set and meet design project deadlines on-time, with team support.

Collaboration

• Work closely with the Creative Team and other LOBs inside the company to develop designs that align with visual assets and overall product launch goals

• Thrive in a fast-paced startup environment with a can-do, problem-solving attitude.

What We're Looking For

• A strong portfolio that illustrates your creative skills across the design process.

• Great sketching, concept generation, and design development skills, knowledge of design methodology.

• Excellent visualization skills (hand sketching, digital 2D and 3D rendering).

• Prototyping, mock-up, and modeling ability.

• Understanding of prototyping, materials, and manufacturing processes within product development.

• Acute attention to detail.

• Ability to develop an understanding of human factors and design trends as they relate to project needs.

Software

• Strong knowledge of 2D, 3D, and rendering software – including Rhino 3D, AutoCAD, Sketchbook, Keyshot, Photoshop, Illustrator, Solidworks, Cinema 4D, and Blender; Maya a plus but not mandatory.

Manufacturing & Materials

• Knowledge of manufacturing materials and processes, primarily plastic injection molding, metal die casting, and stamping.

• Familiarity with defining and implementing color, materials, and finishes is a plus.

• Knowledge of plastics, manufacturing processes, and design for manufacturing

• Strong hands-on prototyping skills across materials and methods

Industry Knowledge

• An interest in and knowledge of consumer electronics products.

• Strong understanding of pop culture trends, fandoms, and the licensing landscape.

Professional Skills

• Entrepreneurial and self-motivated, with a strong work ethic.

• Strong creative and analytical thinking/problem solving skills.

• Ability to handle multiple tasks and projects simultaneously, providing deliverables on time.

• Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable owning projects with guidance

• Excellent communication skills (verbal, written, and giving presentations).

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

Education & Experience

• BS/BA in Industrial Design, Toy Design, or a related field.

• 5-7 years of experience as a product designer, preferably within the entertainment, licensing, creative agency, or pop culture industries.

• 1-3 years of consumer product development experience

Salary Range: $90-100K

jobs.title: Recruiting Operations Consultant
jobs.description:
ABOUT THIS ROLE

Hi, I’m Casey, Head Customer Success Management and Customer Education at Ashby. I’m thrilled to be hiring our first EMEA-based Recruiting Operations Consultant to support Strategic, Mid-Market, and Startup customers in the EMEA region. In this role, you’ll be part of the Customer Education team, blending 1:1 customer consulting, CSM enablement, and educational content creation to scale advanced recruiting operations expertise, strengthen CSM RecOps literacy, and help customers achieve measurable recruiting outcomes.

You’ll also collaborate with Professional Services to scope and deliver paid consulting engagements (SOWs), helping shape and evolve offerings such as Process Optimization and Fractional RecOps — and, when needed, building reports or processes on behalf of customers to support their goals.




DAY-TO-DAY, THIS LOOKS LIKE:

 - Delivering high-impact consulting via RecOps Connects (complimentary 1:1 engagements) and paid engagements, focused on recruiting strategy, analytics interpretation, and operational best practices.

 - Partnering with AEs, CSMs, and Professional Services to scope, sell, and deliver paid consulting engagements using the RecOps SOW framework.

 - Translating 1:1 consulting insights into scalable education — Academy courses, guides, webinars, and segment-specific playbooks — that go beyond “how” to explain “why.”

 - Contributing to advanced product education (e.g., interpreting Quality of Hire dashboards, building analytics strategies) and shaping our most sophisticated Customer Education offerings.

 - Partnering closely with the Product Team to distill your observations into tangible feedback.

 - Enabling CSMs on foundational RecOps strategies and tactics.




YOU COULD BE A GREAT FIT IF

 - You have hands-on experience with Ashby’s product and are excited by the power it offers Talent Acquisition teams.

 - You love helping customers learn — supporting them as they grow into power users.

 - You are an excellent communicator, skilled at clear and concise facilitation.

 - You can navigate a range of stakeholders (e.g., Heads of Talent vs. recruiters) and help them align on shared goals.

 - You’re comfortable working across a spectrum of complexity — from solving simple interview plan questions to building advanced Quality of Hire reporting strategies.

 - You excel at holding stakeholders accountable, setting clear expectations, and facilitating alignment.

 - You are proactive about defining boundaries — enabling CSMs to own foundational RecOps work so you can focus on high-leverage contributions.

 - You are skilled at enabling others, whether in 1:1 sessions or group settings.

 - You have deep empathy for customers and can translate their feedback into actionable insights that shape internal priorities and product direction.

 - You have 2+ years experience in recruiting operations, analytics, and process design — and enjoy helping others level up in these areas.




YOU MIGHT NOT BE A GREAT FIT IF:

 - You prefer rigid structure and are uncomfortable with ambiguity or evolving priorities.

 - You don’t enjoy hands-on building with customers, as this role is a mix of both consulting engagements and build-for-me engagements.

 - You are not comfortable running projects from beginning to end, including scoping, execution, and follow-through

 - You want to focus exclusively on individual customer conversations and not contribute to scaled education or internal enablement.

 - You hesitate to hold customers or internal teams accountable, or avoid facilitating alignment when competing opinions are presented.

 - You find it difficult to set boundaries and tend to default to saying “yes” to all requests.




INTERVIEW PROCESS:

 - Recruiter Screen with Talent Acquisition Team - 30 minutes

 - Hiring Manager Interview - 45 minutes

 - Take Home / Mock Call - 45 minutes

 - Final Panel:
   
   - Interview with CSM Leadership - 30 min
   
   - Interview with CS Senior Leadership - 30 minutes




BENEFITS:

 - Competitive salary and equity.

 - Opportunity to work with a talented and passionate team.

 - 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

 - Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it!

 - Generous family paid family leave. We plan to expand this to employees in other countries as situations arise.

 - Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

 - $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

jobs.title: Head of Communications & Brand
jobs.description:

Lumafield builds industrial X-ray CT scanners and physical AI software that let engineers see inside the things they make without cutting anything apart. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Senior Technical Program Manager, Services Operations, you will be tasked with driving program execution across several high-priority workstreams within Customer Outcomes, which includes Customer Experience, Services, and Detection & Engineering. This role reports to the Principal Technical Program Manager and will own the operational rhythm for threat intelligence partnerships, AI model program management, and strategic projects. Our Threat Operations organization sits at the intersection of intelligence, detection, and AI, powering the capabilities that keep our customers protected and our platform ahead of the threat landscape.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

• Support the management of SentinelOne's threat intelligence partnership portfolio, including both external paid data feeds and intelligence-sharing arrangements with strategic partners, and coordinate internal intelligence-sharing programs across Information Security, Marketing, and other product teams to ensure threat data is leveraged effectively across the organization.

• Drive partnership lifecycle management, from evaluation and onboarding through ongoing governance, renewals, and performance tracking, serving as the operational point of contact for intelligence partnership coordination and ensuring deliverables, data-sharing agreements, and timelines are met.

• Support the program management of SentinelOne's AI model access arrangements within the Customer Outcomes organization, including coordination of vendor programs, usage tracking, and cross-functional alignment on model deployment; drive structured planning, execution, and reporting for AI model integration initiatives across related teams.

• Partner with Engineering, Product, and Research teams to translate model capabilities and access terms into actionable project plans with clear milestones and success criteria; track program status, identify risks, and ensure timely delivery of AI-related initiatives from kickoff through implementation.

• Lead program management for high-visibility ThreatOps engagements, including industry evaluations, annual and quarterly threat reports, and other special projects, guiding each engagement from initial scope definition through planning, execution, and delivery to ensure all objectives, timelines, and quality standards are met.

• Coordinate cross-functional resources and stakeholders to deliver on project commitments, proactively identifying and mitigating risks along the way; deliver regular, transparent status updates to leadership and stakeholders, and identify process gaps to implement SOPs that improve delivery efficiency.

• Build and maintain structured program cadences, including status reviews, decision logs, dependency tracking, KPI tracking, and stakeholder communications across all workstreams, partnering closely with ThreatOps, Engineering, Product, IT Security, Marketing, Legal, and external partners to drive alignment and execution.

• Identify operational friction and recurring execution gaps and translate those into process, tooling, or organizational improvements; communicate requirements for change effectively and quickly, in alignment with broader organizational goals.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

• A blend of technical program management rigor and cybersecurity domain knowledge, with the ability to keep multiple concurrent workstreams moving without dropping threads.

• 7 or more years of experience in technical program management, project management, or service delivery within a technology or cybersecurity company.

• Experience managing external vendor and partner relationships, including contract governance, SLAs, data-sharing agreements, and performance tracking.

• Familiarity with AI/ML model deployment, vendor model access programs, or related technical program management in an AI-adjacent domain.

• Strong ability to translate complex technical concepts into actionable project deliverables and success criteria for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Exceptional communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects.

• A proactive, accountable approach to problem-solving, with the ability to create structure in ambiguous environments and drive execution without direct authority.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

• Experience with cybersecurity solutions (EDR, XDR, threat intelligence platforms) or security operations is highly desirable.

• Experience with threat intelligence programs, MITRE ATT&CK framework, or threat reporting is a significant plus.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Linux Engineer
jobs.description:
Apptronik is a human-centered robotics company developing AI-powered robots to support humanity in every facet of life. Our flagship humanoid robot, Apollo, is built to collaborate thoughtfully with people, starting with critical industries such as manufacturing and logistics, with future applications in healthcare, the home, and beyond.

We operate at the cutting edge of Applied AI, applying our expertise across the full robotics stack to solve some of society's most important problems. You will join a team dedicated to bringing Apollo to market at scale, tackling the complex challenges like safety, commercialization, and mass production to change the world for the better.

JOB SUMMARY

We are seeking a Senior Embedded BSP Engineer to own the board support package and OS configuration for the NVIDIA Jetson Thor compute platform in our humanoid robots. You will collaborate with our firmware, hardware, and robot software teams to bring up custom carrier boards, develop and maintain the boot chain, kernel or RTOS configuration, and device drivers, and deliver reproducible, secure, field-updatable OS images. You will tune the platform for low-latency, real-time performance, support hardware bring-up from prototype through production, and help own platform quality and reliability as we scale from prototypes to fleets of hundreds and thousands of robots in the field. As you grow on the team, you will participate in code and design reviews and contribute to the architectural direction of our compute platform alongside your peers.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES or KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

• Develop and maintain the BSP for NVIDIA Jetson Thor modules and custom carrier boards, including board bring-up, device tree, pinmux, and peripheral enablement. ● Customize and maintain the boot chain (firmware, UEFI, and OS loader), kernel or QNX microkernel configuration, and out-of-tree kernel modules or QNX resource managers and drivers.

• Build and maintain OS images (Linux via Yocto or JetPack/Ubuntu, and/or QNX via QNX SDP) with reproducible, CI-driven builds.

• Tune the OS for real-time and low-latency behavior, including PREEMPT_RT, CPU isolation, IRQ affinity, QNX scheduling and partitioning, and power and thermal profiles. ● Own OS lifecycle tooling: JetPack / NVIDIA BSP upgrades, A/B OTA updates, secure boot, disk encryption, and fleet flashing and provisioning.

• Triage lab and field issues such as boot failures, kernel panics, driver regressions, and thermal throttling, and document root causes.

• Define new hardware requirements and review schematics and layout with the hardware team.

• Work with cross-functional engineering teams, including Hardware, Robot Software, QA, Validation, and Manufacturing, to bring up compute hardware from prototype through production.

• Collaborate with validation teams to develop test strategies and test plans. ● Participate in code reviews, design reviews, and pair debugging; help raise the bar for platform quality across the team.

SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.

• Minimum of 5 years of experience building, debugging, and shipping embedded systems using Linux and/or QNX.

• Hands-on experience with NVIDIA Jetson (Thor or Orin) and JetPack, including flashing and carrier board customization.

• Strong OS-level skills: Linux kernel configuration, device tree, driver development and debugging, kernel upgrades or backports.

• Experience with Yocto, Buildroot, or a comparable image build system. ● Solid understanding of the boot process: bootloaders, initramfs, and rootfs layout. ● Proficiency in C/C++; working knowledge of Python or Bash for tooling, and Git. ● Strong hardware debugging skills using tools such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and JTAG / serial debug.

• Ability to read and interpret system schematics and hardware datasheets. ● Working knowledge of embedded networking protocols such as CAN, EtherCAT, and Ethernet.

• Familiarity with embedded Linux security fundamentals such as secure boot, PKI, and hardware key storage.

• Experience writing and understanding technical specifications.

Strong collaboration and communication skills, with a desire to grow technical leadership within a team setting.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

• Experience with QNX Neutrino, including SDP, BSP development, and resource managers. Experience with real-time Linux tuning such as PREEMPT_RT.

• Experience with humanoid robotics, industrial robotics, or other high-performance real-time systems.

• Experience with CUDA, TensorRT, and container environments on Jetson. Experience with OTA update frameworks (RAUC, SWUpdate, Mender) and fleet provisioning. Familiarity with ROS 2 and DDS middleware.

• Familiarity with safety-critical embedded system design standards, including ISO 26262. Contributions to upstream kernel or open-source BSP projects.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer

• Must be able to lift 15 pounds at times

• Vision to read printed materials and a computer screen

• Hearing and speech to communicate

*This is a direct hire.  Please, no outside Agency solicitations.

jobs.title: Firmware Engineer – Hands
jobs.description:
Apptronik is a human-centered robotics company developing AI-powered robots to support humanity in every facet of life. Our flagship humanoid robot, Apollo, is built to collaborate thoughtfully with people, starting with critical industries such as manufacturing and logistics, with future applications in healthcare, the home, and beyond.

We operate at the cutting edge of Applied AI, applying our expertise across the full robotics stack to solve some of society's most important problems. You will join a team dedicated to bringing Apollo to market at scale, tackling the complex challenges like safety, commercialization, and mass production to change the world for the better.

JOB SUMMARY

We are seeking a Firmware Engineer to help develop firmware for the dexterous hands of our humanoid robots. You will collaborate with our existing hands firmware team to implement, test, and debug the embedded software that drives our in-house hand designs, including motor control, sensor integration, and the real-time communications that connect the hand to the rest of the robot. You will work closely with mechanical, electrical, and systems engineers as the hand evolves from prototype to production, contribute to hardware bring-up, and help build out HIL and SIL tests for hand firmware. You will help maintain firmware quality and reliability as we scale from prototypes to fleets of hundreds of hands deployed in the field. As you grow on the team, you will participate in code and design reviews and contribute to our hands firmware stack alongside more experienced engineers, with mentorship and support along the way.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES or KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

• Collaborate with the hands firmware team to develop, deploy, and maintain firmware for in-house dexterous hand designs, including motor control, sensor I/O, and real-time communications.

• Work closely with mechanical engineers as the hand design evolves; ensure firmware tracks the mechanical design and exposes the right interfaces for tuning and validation. ● Contribute to motor control firmware for the small motors that drive the hand, including current control and basic position/torque loops.

• Develop firmware for distributed embedded networks that connect multiple MCUs. ● Help shape and execute the Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) and Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) testing strategy to validate hand performance, safety, and reliability at scale. ● Help drive firmware quality, reliability, and field performance for fleets of hundreds of hands deployed in production humanoid robots, including telemetry, diagnostics, and root-cause analysis of field failures.

• Work with cross-functional engineering teams to bring up hand hardware from prototype through production.

• Participate in code reviews, design reviews, and pair debugging, learning from and contributing alongside senior engineers.

• Contribute to discussions on tooling, processes, and patterns, with guidance from more experienced engineers.

SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience; Master's degree with a focus on controls, motor drives, or embedded systems is especially valued.

• 0–2 years of relevant experience developing embedded software, including internships, co-ops, research, or significant academic or personal projects; recent graduates are encouraged to apply.

• Solid working proficiency in C/C++; familiarity with Python, Docker, and Git. ● Exposure to firmware development for resource-constrained embedded hardware (limited flash, RAM, and CPU; many peripherals across few MCUs).

• Familiarity with real-time embedded firmware concepts and an eagerness to develop hard real-time skills.

• Familiarity with motor control concepts for BLDC motors (e.g., field-oriented control, current control, or position control).

• Familiarity with distributed embedded networks where multiple MCUs cooperate over real-time buses.

• Exposure to deploying firmware to embedded devices through internships, projects, or coursework.

• Strong hardware debugging skills using tools such as oscilloscopes and logic analyzers. ● Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics (Altium Designer preferred) and hardware datasheets.

• Experience with embedded communication protocols such as SPI, UART, RS485, and CAN.

• Demonstrated ability to work closely with mechanical engineers on tightly integrated electromechanical assemblies.

• Eagerness to learn, take feedback, and grow technically within a collaborative team setting.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

• Experience with humanoid robotics, prosthetics, dexterous manipulation, or other compact electromechanical systems.

• Experience with EtherCAT for real-time embedded communications.

• Experience developing in C and C++ for TI C2000 microcontrollers.

• Familiarity with safety-critical embedded system design standards, including MISRA C and ISO 26262.

• Exposure to Agile workflows, including sprint planning, design reviews, and code reviews.

• Experience integrating tactile, force, or position sensors into embedded systems. ● Familiarity with model-based design tools (e.g., MATLAB/Simulink) for control design and code generation.

• Contributions to firmware tooling, build systems, or developer infrastructure.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer

• Must be able to lift 15 pounds at times

• Vision to read printed materials and a computer screen

• Hearing and speech to communicate

jobs.title: Support Engineer I - Dallas, TX
jobs.description:
At ExtraHop, we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running.

Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you.

Position Summary
We are looking for a Global Support Engineer I who can support a remote-first, flexible shift schedule. This is a growth role—you will advance your career as a support engineering professional while simultaneously increasing your knowledge and hands-on experience with networking infrastructure as a service. You will regularly support  interesting and challenging technical matters and questions and bring clarity to our customers as they leverage our tools to secure their networks in an ever-changing security threat landscape.

Key Responsibilities
As a member of the Global Support Engineering team, you will work with customers to resolve technical issues with our product(s) using a variety of internal resources and provide data analysis to understand and troubleshoot systems. Your day-to-day responsibilities could include any of the following:

• Provide hardware and firmware deployment support for our appliances.

• Actively participate in Knowledge Centered Services (KCS) by learning from documented knowledge and contributing to discussions.

• Engage in troubleshooting activities, following guidance and existing documentation.

• Assist with the initial stages of ticket handling and escalate when necessary.

• Work collaboratively with more experienced engineers and cross functional teams to gain deeper insights into complex issues.

• Assist customers with configuration of network infrastructure, virtualization, and third-party integrations.

• Assist customers with hardware support and replacement.

• Utilize a ticketing system to update, communicate, and move work items to completion.

• Act as the single point of contact for customer questions and concerns.

• Communicate with customers in a highly professional manner via various channels including phone, ticketing system, and video conferencing.

• Pair your existing knowledge with a continuous learning mindset to elevate your service to our customers while being a force-multiplier to your colleagues.

• Attend regular “in-office” meetings (limited to no more than monthly) and annual in-office training sessions

Required Qualifications

• Two years of experience in B2B Technical Support — this is not an entry-level position.

• In-depth knowledge of the OSI model.

• Understanding of network infrastructure routing and switching concepts.

• In-depth knowledge of data traversal within an internal environment and its interaction with external networks.

• Specific networking knowledge related to protocols, DHCP, TCP, DNS resolution, TLS and TLS connection establishment, HTTP, SSO, network topologies, etc.

• Ability to translate technical concepts into applicable troubleshooting best practices.

• Ability to troubleshoot complex architectural incidents based on the application or incident.

• Excellent customer service, organizational, and documentation skills.

• Ability to work cooperatively with others within the organization and other cross-functional stakeholders.

• Ability to work well in fast-paced, high-stress environments.

• Predictable, reliable attendance.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Unix/Linux-based operating systems.

• An understanding of cybersecurity concepts, terminology and tools

• Javascript familiarity and comfort.

• Certifications in networking or infrastructure (like CompTIA Network+).

• Certifications in Cyber Security (like CompTia Security+)

The hourly rate for this role is $28 -$32/hour + bonus + benefits

ABOUT EXTRAHOP

ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.

This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise.

OUR VALUES

Our culture is rooted in our five Values. These set the expectations for how we work individually and collectively as a team.

Lead with Purpose: We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues.

Act with Integrity: We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company.

Find a Way: We are resourceful, tackle hard problems with a sense of urgency and ownership, and do what it takes to get the job done.

Innovate: We listen to customers, partners, and the market, and respectfully push boundaries and challenge the status quo.

Share Success: We run together, we win together. We value diverse perspectives, hold space for all voices, and achieve the best results as a team.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Program Structure & Trust
jobs.description:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 



Vanta's Governance and Compliance platform is the operating layer enterprises trust to run their security programs. We are hiring an engineer who will own the architectural foundation that makes it work for their most complex organizational structures.



Program Structure and Trust is a newly chartered group at Vanta with a focused mission: build the enterprise org model that lets customers bring their compliance and security structure — product lines, business units, isolated data environments, cross-cutting audits, scoped approvals, and data residency requirements — natively into the platform. The problems this team solves determine whether Vanta can serve the enterprise customers it's increasingly winning.



This is the defining technical role of the group. The Staff Engineer owns the design, phased delivery, and long-term technical direction of Vanta's enterprise org model — a multi-quarter initiative that cuts across the platform and establishes the foundation for how enterprise customers structure, segment, and operate inside Vanta.



Visit our Vanta Engineering Blog https://www.vanta.com/all-categories/engineering to learn more about what our team is working on! 

 



What you'll do as a Staff Engineer at Vanta:

 - Own the design and multi-quarter delivery of Vanta's enterprise org model, including hierarchical product lines and business units, isolated data access and ownership, cross-cutting audit workflows, scoped approvals, and EU and GovCloud data residency support

 - Define and evolve the core abstractions that let the platform absorb structurally diverse, often conflicting enterprise requirements — solving for the general case rather than one-off customer accommodations

 - Retrofit a live production system toward a multi-tenant org structure: design safe migration paths, sequence delivery incrementally, and preserve continuity for existing customers as the architecture evolves

 - Carve out and ship meaningful customer value each quarter while progressing toward the full solution — this requires product judgment, direct engagement with enterprise customers, and the discipline to draw clean increment lines through a complex problem space

 - Drive execution across squads outside your direct area, building alignment through technical clarity and credibility rather than authority

 - Partner with Engineering leadership, Product, and Design to translate the long-term vision for enterprise structure into phased, deliverable work

 - Set the technical standard for the group — define patterns others build to, shape architecture across teams, and model the engineering excellence the Program Structure and Trust charter is organized around



How to be successful in this role:

 - 10+ years of deep backend engineering experience with a track record of leading complex, multi-quarter technical initiatives in fast-paced, product-focused environments

 - Designed platform abstractions that absorbed messy, conflicting enterprise requirements across a diverse customer base — you've solved for the general case, not the loudest customer request

 - A track record of shipping in stages: you've moved large, structurally complex problems forward incrementally, with each phase standing on its own, without getting ahead of what customers and the product can absorb

 - A history of operating effectively across squads and teams you don't own — alignment built through technical clarity and credibility, not org chart proximity

 - Deep familiarity with enterprise architectural patterns: tenancy models, role-based access control, data isolation, scoped permissions, cross-tenant operations, and access boundary design

 - Strong communication skills — you make complex systems legible to engineering leadership, product partners, and customer-facing stakeholders, in writing and in the room

 - Data residency or GovCloud exposure is a plus; the right person ramps on this in a quarter once the core structural problems are in hand

 - Open to using AI to amplify your skills and strengthen your work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.



What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

 - Industry-competitive salary and equity

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

 - 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

 - Health & wellness stipend

 - Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

 - Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

 - Family planning benefits

 - Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

 - Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

 - 11 company-paid holidays

 - Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

 - Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney
   
   

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors and may vary based on candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials. 



#LI-remote



At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.



About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. 

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.



Referral Instructions

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

jobs.title: Thermofluids Engineer II
jobs.description:
About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

About this Role

As the Thermofluids Engineer II, you will be responsible for driving fluid system design for thermal management on the spacecraft through analysis, test, and validation. This role supports development and characterization of thermomechanical and fluid systems for payload, vehicle, and propulsion applications. You will be responsible for defining performance metrics, operational requirements, and hardware requirements for ground testing and flight.

Day-to-day responsibilities include sizing thermofluid and system and component performance via hand calculations, simulation, and testing. Familiarity with typical thermomechanical hardware (valves, pumps, accumulators, heat exchangers, etc.), 0D and 1D fluid networks, and fluid system modeling is essential. Successful candidates thrive on solving hard problems, adapting to dynamic requirements, and collaborating across multiple domains. You will gain significant ownership, see your contributions rapidly come to life.

Responsibilities

• Develop active thermal control systems for vehicle and payload thermal management

• Develop fluid network models to interface with top level vehicle thermal model

• Define hardware and operational requirements for fluid systems based on analysis and testing

• Inform manufacturing and integration of thermal/fluid hardware onto the vehicle

• Work collaboratively with other spacecraft disciplines (payload, mechanical, software, propulsion) to design and develop thermal/fluid systems to meet vehicle requirements

• Characterize thermofluid performance of propulsion systems from analysis, ground testing, and flight data

• Develop data processing infrastructure for ground and flight thermofluids systems

Basic Qualifications

• B.S. in Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline, with consideration given to equivalent professional experience (typically 1–3+ years)

• 1+ years experience in thermofluids and/or propulsion systems in a manufacturing environment

• Strong heat transfer and incompressible fluid mechanics first principles

• Background in 0D and 1D thermal and/or fluid networks

• Expertise in one or more fluid or thermal modeling tools (SINDA/FLUINT, ANSYS, GFSSP, etc.)

• Knowledge with thermomechanical systems: heat exchangers, cold plates, vacuum chambers, pumps, valves, RTDs, transducers, etc.

• Hands-on experience in thermal and TVAC testing

• Experience in MATLAB (or equivalent) for data processing and task automation

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with an aptitude for interdisciplinary technical communication

Preferred Skills and Experience
