jobs.title: Senior Application Security Engineer
jobs.description:
This is a fully remote role in the United States.

Turquoise is hiring a Senior Application Security Engineer to drive security for the applications and data our customers rely on. This role owns application-layer security across Turquoise's platform and is the software counterpart to our infrastructure security. You'll build and tune our code scanning program, driving vulnerabilities from discovery to remediation. Day to day, you'll work closely with engineering teams on the design, architecture, and services our product teams build.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and run our application security scanning program (SAST, DAST, dependency/SCA, container and IaC scanning), tuning tools to reduce noise and surface real risk.

 - Triage findings from scans, penetration tests, and bug bounty reports; prioritize by risk and track remediation through to closure.

 - Partner with engineering teams to fix vulnerabilities, including hands-on debugging and code-level guidance when needed.

 - Build trust and cooperation with engineering, product, and design teams so security is considered early in the process, not bolted on at the end (mature SDLC, CI/CD pipelines).

 - Perform threat modeling and maintain secure-coding standards.

 - Support incident response for application-layer security issues.

 - Coordinate and help manage third-party penetration tests.

 - Track and report on security posture metrics (open vulnerabilities, remediation SLAs, scan coverage) to engineering and leadership.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 5+ years of experience in application security, security engineering, or a related software engineering role with a security focus.

 - Hands-on experience with SAST, DAST, and dependency/SCA scanning tools, and the judgment to distinguish real risk from noise.

 - Deep understanding of common vulnerability classes (OWASP Top 10, authentication/authorization flaws, injection, SSRF, etc.), including the ability to review code and architecture to spot these issues and propose effective fixes.

 - Experience with cloud environments (AWS preferred) and securing modern CI/CD pipelines.

 - Strong communication skills, able to explain risk and remediation steps clearly to engineers and non-security stakeholders alike.

 - A collaborative, pragmatic approach to security that balances risk reduction with shipping velocity.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience in healthcare, fintech, or another regulated industry.

 - Experience working within compliance frameworks such as HIPAA, SOC 2, or GDPR.

 - Security certifications such as OSCP, GWAPT, or CSSLP.

 - Experience building or maturing an AppSec program from an early stage.

 - Scripting or automation experience (Python, Go, Terraform, or infrastructure-as-code tool like Terraform.

 - Red team experience performing internal campaigns and providing remediation reports


BENEFITS

 - Competitive pay with equity options

 - Stellar health care plan options (Medical, Dental & Vision), with FSA, DCFSA, & HSA options

 - Company-sponsored disability & life insurance

 - Unlimited PTO

 - 401(k) + 4% Matching

 - Fully remote work + flexible working hours

 - $750 work-from-home setup budget

 - Paid biannual in-person company summits

 - Quarterly $150 co-hanging stipend to meet up with coworkers

 - Monthly $100 health and wellness benefit

 - Generous paid family leave

 - Annual $1,200 learning & development stipend




ABOUT TURQUOISE HEALTH

Turquoise Health is a Series C price transparency platform for finance leaders across healthcare. Backed by a16z, Oak HC/FT, Adams Street, Yosemite, Bessemer Venture Partners, and others, we power price transparency for 300+ enterprise organizations and are building the infrastructure for a more open, efficient healthcare marketplace. We're a remote-first, US-based team that values transparency, empathy, inclusivity, creativity, and ownership.

We operate on US business hours and work with clients entirely based in the US. For this role, we are seeking US-based candidates.

We strongly encourage BIPOC, people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA+ folks to apply for any open roles of interest. Healthcare affects all people differently, but it significantly affects those in underserved communities. With a robust, diverse team, we are stronger and better equipped to change the future of healthcare for all.




WORK AUTHORIZATION

This role requires current authorization to work in the United States. Turquoise does not sponsor employment visas (H-1B, PERM, etc.) or assume sponsorship of existing visas for this position.




DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION EMAIL

Turquoise is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants and employees with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job. Examples of reasonable accommodation include making a change to the application process or work procedures, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require assistance or an accommodation with the hiring process, please contact recruiting@turquoise.health

jobs.title: Staff Dyno Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
About ALSO.

We’re ALSO, an electric mobility company originally conceived as a part of Rivian. We’re a passionate team of builders, dreamers, doers and innovators, focused on creating entirely new (not to mention, innovative and delightful) vertically integrated, small EVs designed to meet the global mobility challenges of today and tomorrow. Our mission is to inspire everyone to ride ALSO—replacing many local car, truck and SUV miles with ones on vehicles that are more affordable, more enjoyable and 10-50x more efficient.



ALSO is looking for a Dyno Controls Engineer to build in-house and highly customized dyno controls software platform, and work with the “dream drive” team to validate all small EVs and drive units built at ALSO.

 

What You Will Do 

 - Develop, implement and validate in-house customized drive unit dynos, vehicle dynos, and test benches models, software and GUI.

 - Software Integration of drive units, dyno electric drives, speed/torque/temperature sensors, power supplies, cooling systems into dyno control systems.

 - Develop dyno and embedded controls interfaces for automatic validation and profiles.

 - Perform test and troubleshoot in dyno labs, or vehicle environments on control topics.

 - Identify, report, and track software bugs from dyno tests; analyze logs to troubleshoot issues.

 - Contribute to other propulsion control and motor control development.

 - Collaborate with controls, firmware, electrical, mechanical and system engineers to contribute to validation, development and requirements.

 

What You Will Bring 

 - BS or MS (preferred) degree in Controls, Electrical Engineering, or related field.

 - Proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink, including model-based design, Stateflow, and developing automation scripts.

 - Experience with real-time simulation systems (e.g. Speedgoat, NI PXIe, dSpace, etc.) and GUI development. Experience with NI Veristand, LABVIEW is a PLUS.

 - Hands on experience of dynamometers, power supplies and power meters, testing motor drive systems. Experience with motor control and electric drives. Experience with Siemens drives is a PLUS.

 - Familiar with embedded controllers and programming languages such as C and Python. 

 - Familiar with automotive and electric drives communication protocols (e.g., CAN, etherCAT) and tools such as Vector CANalyzer, CANape, etc. Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git) and continuous integration workflows.

 

The salary for this position ranges from $225,000 - 275,000 per year, depending on experience and qualifications.

 

Perks and Benefits

 - Robust health coverage. Excellent health, dental and vision insurance covered up to 100% by Also. with FSA & HSA options.

 - One Medical membership and dedicated insurance advocates.

 - Rich fertility and family building benefits with Progyny.

 - Flexible time off. 

 - 401(k) match.



Why ALSO.

We’re passionate about helping the world find a better way to get there—wherever it is you’re headed.

We’re located in the heart of Silicon Valley and have brought together a world-class team from some of the biggest brands in the technology, automotive, cycling, outdoor recreation and retail spaces. 

Together we’re working hands-on to imagine, design and build an entirely new solution to a global set of transportation challenges.

jobs.title: Supplier Quality Engineer (Mechanical)
jobs.description:
Astranis builds advanced satellites for high orbits, expanding humanity’s reach into the solar system. Today Astranis satellites provide dedicated, secure networks to highly-sophisticated customers across the globe – large enterprises, sovereign governments, and the US military.

With five satellites on orbit and many more set to launch soon, the company is servicing a backlog of more than $1 billion of commercial contracts. Astranis is the preferred satellite communications partner for buyers with stringent requirements for uptime, data security, network visibility, and customization.

Astranis has raised over $1.2 billion from some of the world’s best investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Baillie Gifford, Blackrock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton, and Snowpoint, and employs a team of 500 engineers and entrepreneurs. Astranis designs, builds, and operates its satellites out of its 153,000 sq. ft. headquarters in Northern California, USA.

Supplier Quality Engineer

As a Supplier Quality Engineer, you will be responsible for successful driving our vendor base to a ZERO defects and scale Astranis production at suppliers as we build our satellite manufacturing business. The Supplier Quality team is responsible for supplier identification, qualification, ongoing development, and corrective action. The job involves technical communication with internal and external teams, traveling to suppliers in different regions, and on-the-spot critical decision making. This role is critical to expanding our manufacturing capability while ensuring extreme reliability to make Astranis a world-class satellite manufacturing company.

Role

• Define product specifications – raw material, testing and inspection, GD&T/CMM, and workmanship – in collaboration with Product Engineering

• Establish and execute vendor qualification processes from onsite audits, technical assessments, through qualification builds

• Lead Design For Manufacturing (DFM) reviews and feedback. Become the main vendor's manufacturing and quality point of contact

• Establish phase gates at suppliers for new product introduction – Critical Design Review (CDR), Manufacturing Readiness Review (MRR)

• Develop Incoming Quality Control (IQC) – inspection procedures for thermal, electromechanical assemblies, RF passives, and metal-machined components; as well as supplier documentation (Certificates of Conformance and End Item Data Package) reviews

• Spearhead root cause analysis and corrective actions with the vendors and qualify dispositions (rework, repair, re-build)

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Material Science/Physics or similar technical field

• 3+ years experience in manufacturing engineering, quality engineering, or supply chain engineering

• Background in GD&T, mechanical and thermal engineering, and manufacturing processes (CNC, forging, welding, assembly)

• Ability to work extended hours and travel 40%+ of the time, as needed to meet critical deadlines

Bonus

• Experience in aerospace manufacturing or automotive manufacturing – AS9100, IAFT 16949, Quality Management Systems

• Statistical tools domain – Cpk & Ppk, SPC), DOE, and GR&R

• Experience in electronics manufacturing – PCBA and Harnesses (IPC 600, IPC 610, and IPC 620)

What we offer:

All our positions offer a compensation package that includes equity and robust benefits.

Base pay is just one component of Astranis’s total rewards package. Your compensation also includes a significant equity package via incentive stock options, high-quality company-subsidized healthcare, disability and life insurance, 401(k) retirement planning, flexible PTO, and free on-site catered meals.

Astranis pay ranges are informed and defined through professional-grade salary surveys and compensation data sources. The actual base salary offered to a successful candidate will additionally be influenced by a variety of factors including experience, credentials & certifications, educational attainment, skill level requirements, and the level and scope of the position.

Base Salary

$100,000—$150,000 USD

U.S. Citizenship, Lawful Permanent Residency, or Refugee/Asylee Status Required

(To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the United States, or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3))

Our mission and products are built for everyone, regardless of gender, race, creed, or background. We believe in a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we invite all people to join our team and bring their unique perspectives to make us stronger.

Astranis SMS Terms of Service

• Recruiting Updates: By opting in, you agree to receive SMS updates, interview coordination, and recruiting communications from Astranis Space Technologies Corp.

• Opt-Out: You can cancel this service at any time by replying STOP. We will send one final text confirming your unsubscription.

• Opt-In Again: To resume receiving messages, reply START or YES.

• Support & Rates: For assistance, reply HELP or contact us at coordinators@astranis.com. Message and data rates may apply. Message frequency varies; carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.

• Privacy: For details on how we protect your data, view our Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Strategic Accounts
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States, San Francisco, California, United States
jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager, Strategic Accounts

San Francisco, CA or New York, NY

Product management at Dealpath looks different than it did even a year ago. AI has changed what one PM can own, and the lines between product, design, and engineering are coming together  in a good way. We're seeking a Senior Product Manager to join our Strategic Accounts pod, the team responsible for the roadmap that keeps Dealpath's largest and most important customers growing with us. You'll report to Jeff Blasbalg and work directly with enterprise clients to define the features and experiences that drive retention, upsell, and expansion across our biggest accounts.

How we think about AI for this role

This isn't a nice-to-have. Our design team went from two people to one over the past year, in large part because PMs now build their own prototypes and drive solution design directly with AI, rather than waiting on a dedicated designer for every artifact. We're looking for someone who can genuinely leverage AI to move faster and think bigger, not someone who leans on it as a crutch or ships AI slop. That balance, real capability plus real judgment, is the bar.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will:

• Use AI as a core part of how you work: build your own prototypes, drive solution design, and move fast, in true partnership with design and engineering rather than waiting on them

• Own major product features end to end, from discovery through release, on the team responsible for our largest accounts

• Get in front of customers directly. We don't have a dedicated UX research team, so PMs own discovery and validation with our CS and Implementation teams

• Translate account health signals (gross and net retention, upsell, seat expansion) into a clear, prioritized product roadmap

• Learn and become an expert in Commercial Real Estate, working alongside a highly experienced team and executive-level clients

• Shape product culture on Dealpath's largest pod through strong judgment, clear decision-making, and hands-on ownership

We're excited that you have:

• Real fluency with AI tools in a PM workflow, with the judgment to know when AI output is good enough to ship and when it isn't. You use AI to move faster, not to skip the thinking

• Confidence and experience owning customer-facing discovery and validation directly with enterprise clients

• Strong analytical skills and command of common product and data tools (Mixpanel, Looker, SQL, Jira, or similar)

• Excellent written and verbal communication and a proven history of driving alignment across cross-functional teams

Qualifications:

• 6+ years of experience in product management conceiving, developing, and delivering B2B SaaS features in a data-driven, agile product process, with a track record of moving retention, engagement, or revenue metrics.

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field; MBA or relevant master's degree a plus.

• Ability to work from our San Francisco or NYC office 3+ days per week

Bonus points:

• Background in commercial real estate, private equity, alternatives, investment banking, or management consulting

• Deep familiarity with Dealpath's product or the CRE investment space

• Experience with enterprise collaboration software, data visualization, or analytics products

The Perks & Culture:

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance

• Health Savings Account (HSA) & Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options

• 401(k) retirement plan

• Paid Parental Leave

• Flexible Time Off (FTO) policy

• Commuter benefits program

• Monthly wellness reimbursement to support physical and mental well-being

• Hybrid Work Policy

• Base salary: $140,000 - $185,000 + Variable

• Your compensation will be based upon several factors including your experience, qualifications, education, location, and the skills assessed in Dealpath's interview process. Your actual compensation will be confirmed in writing at the time of offer.

• Dealpath's compensation ranges are determined by current market data, so compensation data posted on our job posts may change as new market data becomes available.

About Dealpath

Dealpath is the world's largest and most trusted AI-powered operating system for real estate investing. To date, the platform has powered more than $10 trillion in transactions, partnering with hundreds of firms, including leading global institutions such as Blackstone, Nuveen, LaSalle, CBRE IM, MetLife, Newmark, New York Life, UBS, Manulife, DWS, and Principal.

By bringing together the only private exchange for institutional real estate listings, investment data, and intelligent execution workflows into a single platform, Dealpath enables firms to capture more opportunities, make faster decisions, execute efficiently, and deliver superior returns.

Our company is led by an experienced team and backed by a combination of top tier venture capital firms and strategic industry partners including Blackstone, Nasdaq, 8VC, JLL Spark, WTI, GreenSoil Investments, LeFrak, Milstein, Bechtel, and Morgan Stanley Expansion Capital.

We value your voice! If you get excited about solving real business challenges and working closely with other smart folks in a winning culture, we'd love to meet you.

Interview Process Notice

Dealpath conducts interviews via video conference. To support our interviewers with accurate note-taking, we may use AI-assisted transcription tools during your interview sessions. By participating in the interview process, you acknowledge that interviews may be recorded or transcribed using these tools for note-taking purposes only. Transcripts are used solely for internal evaluation and are not shared outside of the hiring team.

jobs.title: Technical Recruiter - Hardware Engineering
jobs.description:
About the Company:

General Matter enriches uranium.
We are designing, building, and operating the world's lowest-cost enrichment services, here in the US.
In the process, we are restoring America's ability to produce nuclear fuel to power AI, advanced manufacturing and critical industries our country relies on to remain competitive.
Fuel drives the cost of advanced reactor electricity production, and enrichment drives the cost of the fuel that advanced reactors consume. Reliable, low-cost enrichment is the catalyst for the nuclear Renaissance now under way.
Our mission is to make nuclear not only the cleanest and safest source of baseload power, but also the most affordable. We believe abundant nuclear energy will lead to a post-scarcity society.
We were incubated inside Founders Fund, like Anduril and Palantir before us, and are backed by over a dozen of the world's top venture capital firms.
Our lean, world-class team of engineers and operators is applying a first-principles approach to solving the problem of nuclear fuel production.
We are a mission-driven company with a culture of urgency, accountability, and transparency.
Help us build a high-energy society by making the cleanest, safest form of baseload energy the most affordable.

About the Role:

General Matter is hiring a tenacious Technical Recruiter in Los Angeles to build the hardware engineering, manufacturing, and nuclear teams behind America's next uranium enrichment facility. You'll join a lean, high-impact talent acquisition team. You will own full-cycle technical recruiting for interdisciplinary roles across the company, including mechanical engineering, hardware design, test, manufacturing, construction, nuclear engineering, and supply chain. You'll handle every step, from intake and sourcing to screening and closing exceptional engineering talent.

We are building a team that has not only launched products, but launched entire industries across nuclear, space, defense, and finance. If you've recruited mechanical and hardware engineers in aerospace, defense, or other hard-tech environments, this role puts that experience to work on a mission of national importance.

The team is highly collaborative, operates with integrity, and is deeply committed to bringing nuclear fuel enrichment back to US soil. If you enjoy Skunkworks style projects, value autonomy and ownership, and are passionate about building world-class engineering teams, we'd love to hear from you.

We are open to multiple experience levels for the role. We care about capability, drive, and impact more than years of experience. Scope and responsibility will commensurate with experience.

Responsibilities:

• Own full-cycle technical recruiting for hardware engineering, manufacturing, and operational roles, from intake to closing.

• Act as a key business partner to engineering leaders and hiring managers by providing market insights, rapidly calibrating on top talent, and refining interview processes to drive successful hiring outcomes.

• Conduct thorough initial interviews that assess technical ability, excellence, and cultural alignment while delivering a positive candidate experience and strong interview-to-offer outcomes.

• Design and execute sourcing strategies for mechanical, hardware, and manufacturing engineering talent that go beyond Boolean searches to include events, networking, and other creative approaches.

• Deliver exceptional candidate experiences across the interview process that reflects General Matter's mission, culture, and high-performance culture.

• Track and analyze recruiting metrics to continuously refine processes and drive operational excellence.

• Maintain applicant tracking system accuracy and cleanliness to improve reporting quality and recruiting efficiency.

• Wear many hats across the recruiting function, from managing university recruitment initiatives and coordinating onsite interviews to process improvement projects as we scale.

Basic Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree and 2+ years of recruiting experience (academic, internships, and extracurriculars at university level qualify) or associate degree and 3+ years of experience; or 4+ years of professional experience as a recruiter in lieu of a degree.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence, negotiate, and clearly articulate value to both candidates and hiring teams.

• Proven ability to manage and execute multiple competing priorities with autonomy.

• Holds a high bar for personal accountability and performance, consistently delivering quality results with speed, ownership, and attention to detail.

• Strong judgement and discretion when handling sensitive information and advising on hiring decisions.

Preferred Skills and Experience:

• Experience recruiting mechanical and hardware engineers (e.g., design, structures, propulsion, manufacturing, test, and integration) at high-growth aerospace, defense, space, automotive, or other hard-tech companies, either in-house or agency.

• An established network across the Los Angeles aerospace, defense, and hardware engineering talent market, and a track record of closing engineers in competitive, multi-offer situations.

• Experience recruiting other technical talent such as electrical, chemical, and/or software engineers.

• Full lifecycle recruiting experience, from sourcing to closing.

• Proven success hiring for highly specialized or niche roles such as building architects, chemical engineers, nuclear licensing engineers, or other technical experts.

• Ability to distinguish between the top 50% and the top 5% of talent within their respective fields.

• Demonstrated expertise in non-standard recruiting methods: cold calling candidates and companies, organizing and executing ad hoc networking events, identifying industry experts, creating unique targeted sourcing campaigns, etc.

• Deeply motivated by General Matter's mission to restore U.S. fuel enrichment capabilities and strengthen national energy security.

Additional Requirements:

• Ability to work extended hours and weekends as needed.

• This position is based in Los Angeles and requires being onsite full-time – hybrid and remote work will not be considered.

Compensation and Benefits:

The base salary range for this role is $100,000–$180,000 annually.
Compensation bands are determined by role, level, location, and alignment with market data. Individual level and base pay is determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on job-related skills, education, experience, technical capabilities and internal equity. Please note that the stated salary range is an estimate and may be adjusted based on market conditions, business needs, or other factors. In addition to base salary, for full-time hires, you may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of stock options, and access to medical, vision & dental coverage as well as access to a 401(k) retirement plan.

About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

About this Role

As the Thermal Hardware and Test Engineer II, you will be responsible for hardware design, build, and test for ground and spacecraft thermal and fluid systems. This is a hands-on role, spanning mechanical, electrical, fluid, and control disciplines with opportunities to innovate at every stage: concept, fabrication, instrumentation, and commissioning. You will be responsible for developing active and passive thermal control systems, such as heat pipes, pumped fluid loops, thermal switches, etc. as well as the supporting infrastructure for testing and data-processing.

Day-to-day responsibilities will be focused in thermomechanical hardware and system sizing, CAD design, fabrication, testing, instrumentation, and troubleshooting. Successful candidates thrive on solving hard problems, adapting to dynamic requirements, and collaborating across multiple domains. You will gain significant ownership, see your contributions rapidly come to life, and help us uphold the highest standards of performance, reliability, and safety in our hardware. If expanding the capability of in-orbit manufacturing to serve life-changing products to patients sounds intriguing, this role is for you. This role is open at the Eng II level, with levels determined based on candidate experience.

Responsibilities

• Drive end-to-end development of thermal hardware and test infrastructure: concept, design, fabrication, integration, validation, and maintenance

• Develop active and passive thermal control systems with thermal analysis engineers for payload and vehicle thermal control

• Inform manufacturing and integration of thermal/fluid hardware onto the vehicle

• Conduct component level acceptance and qualification thermal vacuum tests

• Evaluate the impact of hardware design decisions on packaging, thermal, environmental, and loads to ensure the best system-level solution

• Architect and assemble fluid, thermal, mechanical, and electrical designs, test rigs, and fixtures that support a broad range of development activities

• Implement instrumentation and data acquisition (DAQ) solutions, integrating sensors, transducers, actuators, PLCs, and embedded controllers

• Generate documentation for procedures, schematics, reports for ground test and flight hardware

• Apply first-principles thinking to diagnose issues, resolve anomalies, and optimize equipment reliability to >99% uptime

Basic Qualifications

• B.S. in Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline, with consideration given to equivalent professional experience (typically 1–3+ years)

• 3+ years of experience and knowledge applying engineering principles to thermal design, test, and fabrication in a manufacturing environment

• Proficiency in detailed thermal analysis in Thermal Desktop, SINDA/FLUINT

• Experience anchoring thermal models to test and/or flight data

• Experience in planning and executing Thermal Vacuum Chamber (TVac) testing

• Experience in MATLAB (or equivalent) for data processing and task automation

• Familiarity with thermal margins and qualification test requirements in SMC-S-016

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with an aptitude for interdisciplinary technical communication

Preferred Skills and Experience

• Hands-on fabrication skills: basic machining, welding, or rapid prototyping.

• Experience in thermal analysis tools: Thermal Desktop, ANSYS

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

Verkada's Connectivity products secure people and property in remote and edge environments. Our Cellular and Wi-Fi Gateways bring Verkada's full platform including threat detection, deterrence, and real-time visibility, anywhere it's needed. Verkada Gateways enable cameras, intercoms, access control, and sensors to be deployed in locations without stable internet or power.

This leader will own the communication strategy, brand narrative, and event operations to achieve the following departmental objectives:

• Commercial Event Impact: Reorient the events team to scale event-influenced pipeline from the current $10M baseline to 12M–13M, while achieving a 98%+ customer retention rate for event and certificate program participants.

• Strategic Industry Validation: Build a proactive earned media, thought leadership, and executive visibility strategy that positions Smartly and its leaders at the center of the industry conversations shaping advertising, AI, creative, and intelligence to accelerate brand validation by increasing annual third-party milestones (top-tier business publications, analyst Wave commentary, G2 reviews) from 10 to 15 quarterly validations.

• Pipeline Scaling: Support the broader marketing organization in scaling from 430–440 Sales Accepted Leads (SALs) to 600 weighted SALs within 18 months, while optimizing SAL acquisition costs by 5%.

• Funnel Conversion: Drive a 10% year-on-year increase in the conversion of sales accepted leads (SALs) to sales qualified leads (SQLs), sharing this muscle closely with the sales enablement and commercial teams.

• Brand Framework & Internal Alignment: Drive an 8+ point score in our internal understanding of Smartly's company mission, vision, and revamped brand principles.

• Brand Advocacy & Awareness: Propel overall global brand awareness and familiarity by 5%, while establishing structured employee advocacy programs to scale our social presence.

• Customer & Partner Academy: Collaboratively launch and scale our customer/agency partner academy—a shared OKR with Ed's client enablement and agency teams.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Communications, PR & Executive Visibility

• Global Communications Strategy: Own and execute Smartly’s global corporate and brand communications strategy across earned media, executive communications, thought leadership, analyst engagement, awards & industry influence.

• Speaking & Thought Leadership: Build and manage a strategic speaking program for Smartly executives, identifying and securing high-value opportunities across major industry events, conferences, podcasts, and other programs. Prepare executives for those moments through speechwriting, briefing materials, message development, rehearsal and media/speaker preparation.

• Narrative Development: Maintain a clear, differentiated corporate narrative and messaging architecture that connects Smartly’s company strategy, product innovation, customer impact and market POV across PR, events, executive communications & GTM programs.

Reoriented Event Operations & Administrative Offloading

• Revenue-Driven Event Strategy: Reorient the Global Events team (led by Stephanie Karlas) from administrative logistics coordinators into commercial powerhouses. Align event goals around clean real-time registration data, strict daily budget tracking, and immediate post-event sales follow-up.

• Administrative Offloading: Ruthlessly protect the capacity of the event planning team. Transition all internal, non-marketing administrative event coordination (including Board of Directors meetings, executive dinners, internal SLT off-sites, and company All-Hands) completely out of the marketing department to Executive Assistants (REAs) and Workplace Experience teams.

• Creative Outsourcing: Implement a "buy over build" creative strategy for special events. Outsource event creative ideation and experience design to specialized external agencies, freeing internal events headcount to focus solely on operations, budget execution, and pipeline generation.

Comms Ops, AI-Augmented Workflows & Agency In-Housing

• Establish a Comms Ops Hub: Introduce a specialized "Comms Ops" capability to run the underlying technology, automation engines, and predictive analytics that power communications.

• AI-Augmented Content Pipelines: Work alongside the creative and copy teams to build AI-augmented content workflows. Automate repetitive asset repurposing, multi-market translations, and variation generation—aiming to reduce manual content-updating burdens by 50% to 75% while maintaining strict human-in-the-loop oversight to protect brand integrity.

• Optimize PR Retainer Spend: Actively in-house routine PR execution—such as media list building, first-draft pitches, and coverage clip tracking—using advanced AI tools. Reduce external PR agency retainer spend by 20% to 35%, reserving agency budget strictly for high-tier media pitching and crisis counsel.

Case Study Automation & Customer Advocacy

• End the "Chasing" Model: Overhaul the customer advocacy and case study lifecycle. Replace the highly manual, slow process of chasing Customer Success (CS) and clients with an automated, standardized case study pipeline.

• Advocacy Governance: Establish automated consent workflows, streamlined brief development, and multi-market localization reviews. This will allow the team to rapidly deploy authoritative, localized customer success stories to the sales team, reducing the cycle from weeks to days.

Cross-Functional SLA Governance

• Implement Strict Team Protection: Address the severe cross-functional bottlenecks where the Partnerships or Product teams sign GTM agreements without marketing’s advance knowledge (such as the Google Creative Readiness Fund, Roku, and LinkedIn initiatives).

• Enforce Zero-Tolerance SLAs: Act as a rigid gatekeeper. Establish a mandatory 12-week minimum lead time and a fully documented business brief for any joint partnership campaign. Protect the team from budget-depleting, reactive, and high-stress "bombs" that compromise work quality.

Workload Sustainability & Psychological Safety

• Mitigate Employee Burnout: Actively manage and rebalance team workloads to directly address our Workday Peakon Employee Engagement data—specifically targeting our critical focus areas of Workload Manageability (scoring 4.7/10) and Mental Wellbeing (scoring 6.2/10).

• Eliminate "Blame Culture": Establish and model strict behavioral standards for managers. Ensure that teams executing high-stakes campaigns are structurally supported, scopes are audited recurringly, and a culture of blame and managers "throwing staff under the bus" is eradicated.

Core Competencies & Skills

• Commercial Brand Narrative: Mastery of high-impact strategic storytelling, corporate positioning, executive communications and thought leadership, and translating complex product capabilities (e.g., hybrid MCP/API architectures) into compelling executive narratives.

• Operational & Financial Rigor: Exceptional capability in large-scale event budget planning, real-time registration tracking, and automated ROI analytics.

• AI & Automation Literacy: Hands-on understanding of how to leverage API integrations, AI-augmented design tools, automated translation engines, and Comms Ops technologies to streamline content workflows.

• Process & SLA Enforcement: Strong leadership backbone to implement and protect team boundaries, enforce briefs, and maintain operational discipline across cross-functional partners.

• Empathy-Led People Management: Proven commitment to workload balancing, capacity planning, and maintaining psychological safety standards to mitigate burnout and retain top-tier talent.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience: 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in Corporate Communications, PR, Brand Marketing, or Comms Operations.

• Scale: Proven track record of scaling communications and branding departments in mid-sized B2B SaaS or digital media organizations (500–2,000 employees).

• Agency & Budget Management: Extensive experience managing large global PR agency retainers, contract execution, and outsourced creative operations.

• Transformation Track Record: Successful experience establishing a Hub-and-Spoke Center of Excellence model or transitioning traditional communications teams into automated, Comms Ops frameworks.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, or an analytical business field. MBA or advanced training in Agile process frameworks is a strong plus.

What We Offer You...

• Five weeks paid time off (PTO), 11 company paid holidays, unlimited sick days

• Generous healthcare packages & mental health benefits

• 401K plus matching & equity grants for all new Smartlies

• Wellness benefit & learning reimbursement opportunities

• Volunteer time off days & company donation matching opportunities

• And so much more…

We take into consideration an individual’s background, expertise, and experience in determining final salary. In addition to annual salary, Smartly’s total rewards provide employees with stock options, medical/dental/vision insurances, retirement savings benefits, parental leave, 5 weeks vacation, unlimited sick days, life insurance, and disability benefits. jobs.title: Service Reliability Engineering Technical Lead
jobs.description:
DRW is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk.

Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.

We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. DRW is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.

The Container Infrastructure team provides scalable on-premises and cloud-based container orchestration services for DRW’s trading desks, data scientists, and enterprise application teams. Our goal is to enable teams to keep focused on their business goals by providing simple, scalable solutions with off the shelf tools and the right amount of focused engineering. We're looking for a Technical Lead for our Container Infrastructure team. In this role you work closely with other teams and trading desks to ensure the performance and reliability of our Kubernetes platform. The platform is large: hundreds of clusters, thousands of nodes, and dozens of components. Common day-two tasks include development of new components, monitoring costs, and ensuring compute consumption for each desk is optimized. The Technical Lead is responsible for key design of architectural decisions for our platform, setting engineering standards, prioritizing and assigning technical work, as well and identifying and eliminating risks and technical debt.

Our philosophy:

• We believe in relentless automation of repetitive tasks.

• We have the curiosity and drive to dig deep and find creative solutions.

• We believe our goal is to find the right solution rather than always being right.

• We provide exceptional customer service to our teams and trading desks.

• We care more that the right thing is done than about rigid job descriptions or boundaries.

What you’ll do:

• Own and improve infrastructure, processes, and standards for DRW’s Kubernetes platform.

• Work with different business units to ensure a successful onboarding and deployment of applications into DRW’s Kubernetes platform.

• Promote DRW’s Kubernetes platform with demos, lightning talks, and presentations.

• Relentlessly automate repetitive manual tasks.

• Provide exceptional customer service to our platform’s users.

• Coach engineers on best practices, help solve complex problems, set a high standard for operational and technical excellence

Your background:

• Multiple years of Kubernetes administration experience.

• Deep knowledge of networking, storage, and containerization fundamentals

• Familiarity with AWS and/or Google Cloud Platform.

• A service focused attitude: you ask questions and focus on getting the right resources and solutions to people instead of rigid boundaries.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills. You can work across teams and have evidence-based discussions on technical and operational topics

• You enjoy leading by example. You cultivate technical excellence and soft skills in your team members.

Bonus points if you have:

• Experience with common Kubernetes operators (Flux, Fluentbit, Fluentd, Prometheus, etc.)

• Experience administering on-premise infrastructure.

• Experience developing, deploying, and supporting full stack web applications.

• Experience with multiple programming languages in both greenfield development and legacy maintenance.

The annual base salary range for this position is $250,000 to $300,000 depending on the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and relevant skill set. The position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition, DRW offers a comprehensive suite of employee benefits including group medical, pharmacy, dental and vision insurance, 401k (with discretionary employer match), short and long-term disability, life and AD&D insurance, health savings accounts, and flexible spending accounts.

California residents, please review the California Privacy Notice for information about certain legal rights at https://drw.com/california-privacy-notice.

Job Summary:

The Retail Sales Representative is responsible for representing our brand, driving sales, and maintaining strong relationships with retail partners, including grocery stores, supermarkets, and other food & beverage outlets. The ideal candidate will have a passion for consumer products, excellent communication skills, and the ability to meet sales targets in a fast-paced retail environment.

Sales and Account Management:

• Build and maintain strong relationships with store managers, buyers, and key decision-makers.

• Conduct product presentations and demonstrations to retail staff and customers to increase product visibility and sales.

• Support and execute promotional activities, new product launches, and seasonal campaigns in retail stores.

Product Knowledge & Inventory Management:

jobs.title: Chief Estimator - Mechanical/Structural
jobs.description:
Job Title: Chief Estimator - Mechanical/Structural

Company: Loenbro, LLC
Business Unit/Department: Loenbro Industrial Construction
Location:
Reports to:
Employment Type: Full Time
FLSA Classification: Exempt

About Loenbro

Loenbro is a trusted, long-term construction lifecycle partner to thousands of customers across the U.S. Our market spans all industries and our service offerings include Critical Electrical, Mechanical & Structural, Soft Crafts, Inspection, Underground Maintenance and Installation, and Fabrication. Our expertise lies in simplifying the complex and establishing long-standing relationships with our partners. We have a national presence but a local approach—every customer benefits from our capabilities and our care.

At Loenbro, we don’t just offer jobs—we build careers grounded in integrity, teamwork, excellence, and purpose. Join a team where your expertise is valued, your growth is supported, and your work helps maintain and enhance the critical infrastructure that powers communities across the nation.

Job Summary
The Chief Estimator is responsible for leading and developing a high-performing team of estimators while ensuring the delivery of accurate, competitive, and timely proposals. This role encompasses full estimating and proposal preparation for industrial facilities, including new construction and maintenance projects valued up to $100M. Estimates will span multiple disciplines, including civil, structural, and mechanical work, across energy, mining, power, manufacturing, pulp and paper, agricultural, pharmaceutical, and other industries served by Loenbro. The Chief Estimator drives excellence in execution, accountability in outcomes, and disciplined estimating practices that consistently exceed client expectations.

Essential Job Responsibilities

• Provide strategic leadership and oversight to a team of estimators responsible for the development and delivery of accurate, competitive, and timely proposals across all project sizes and disciplines.

• Establish priorities, allocate resources, and ensure alignment of estimating efforts with business objectives, client expectations, and pursuit strategies.

• Direct and validate the interpretation of bid documents, including specifications, drawings, and technical data, ensuring complete and compliant proposal execution.

• Ensure the consistent development of high-quality, full-scope estimates through standardized processes, rigorous review, and disciplined application of best practices.

• Drive the training, mentoring, and professional development of estimating staff, fostering technical competency, consistency, and accountability across the team.

• Champion the use and continuous improvement of historical cost data, production rates, and estimating tools to enhance accuracy, efficiency, and competitiveness.

• Lead estimate reviews and governance processes, ensuring all proposals are defensible, aligned with execution strategies, and reflective of project risks and opportunities.

• Oversee the effective turnover of estimates to Operations, ensuring clarity, completeness, and alignment to support successful project execution.

• Maintain accountability for pricing integrity, including oversight of change order estimates and subcontractor/material procurement strategies.

• Drive cross-functional collaboration with Operations, Business Development, and leadership to align estimating strategies with market conditions and client objectives.

• Establish and monitor key performance indicators, including win/loss metrics and estimate accuracy, implementing continuous improvements to strengthen organizational performance.

• Lead the development and standardization of estimating systems, cost structures, and processes to ensure scalability and consistency across the organization.

• Build, scale, and develop the estimating organization in alignment with company growth, ensuring the team is equipped to meet increasing demand and complexity.

• Promote a culture of leadership, accountability, discipline, and excellence consistent with Loenbro’s LEAD values.

• Perform additional responsibilities as required by the Preconstruction Manager in support of strategic and operational objectives.

Minimum Qualifications

Required:

• 5+ years of experience in heavy industrial/process facility estimating and cost control across civil, structural, mechanical, or piping disciplines.

• Strong knowledge of estimating techniques, engineering disciplines, and cost control practices, with the ability to estimate projects of varying size and complexity.

• Proven ability to prepare comprehensive and complex proposals with minimal supervision.

• Working knowledge of the industries served by Loenbro.

• Strong communication and organizational skills, both written and verbal.

• Proficiency across industry-standard estimating, scheduling, and ERP platforms, including systems comparable to HeavyBid, Primavera P6, and Viewpoint.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects concurrently and perform effectively under tight deadlines and demanding workloads.

• Willingness to travel periodically to job sites as required.

• OSHA certification or equivalent safety training.

• Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record.

Potential Hazards:

• Potential exposure to extreme cold and hot temperatures

• Exposure to manufacturing, pipeline, and refining environment

• Exposure to noise above 85 decibels and intense odors

• Exposure to areas with limited visibility

Physical Demands and Work Environment

• Climbing up and down stairs and ladders to both get in and out of trenches and up to elevated platforms (scaffolding at significant heights)

• Lifting necessary equipment and materials 1-50 pounds, 50% of the time on a monthly basis for required tasks

• Potential or Periodic amounts of time for the following: Walking on uneven terrain, with an average of 2 miles per day Standing Sit, stoop, crawl, and kneel Use of respirator if position requires Driving if required to travel

• If driving is required, valid driver license and proof of insurability is required. All drivers are subject to a DMV background records search.

Benefits

Loenbro offers a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits package, and rewards to those who join our team:

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance

• 401(k) retirement plan with company match

• Paid time off (PTO) and holiday pay

• Life and disability insurance

• Professional development and training opportunities

• Employee assistance program (EAP)

Benefits eligibility may vary based on employment classification and hours worked.

Guided by Core Values (LEAD), grounded in grit and a commitment to excellence, Loenbro betters our families, customers, and local communities.  If you’re ready to be part of a company that LEADS by:

• Living with Integrity

• Exceeding Expectations

• Acting with Urgency

• Delivering Excellence

…we want to hear from you.

Loenbro is an Equal Opportunity Employer

This job will remain open until filled.

jobs.title: Sr. Counsel
jobs.description:
About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

Millions of people across the world come to Pinterest to find new ideas every day. It’s where they get inspiration, dream about new possibilities and plan for what matters most. Our mission is to help those people find their inspiration and create a life they love. As a Pinterest employee, you’ll be challenged to take on work that upholds this mission and pushes Pinterest forward. You’ll grow as a person and leader in your field, all the while helping users make their lives better in the positive corner of the internet.

At Pinterest we pride ourselves on building connections, partnerships, and collaborations across the business. You will have an opportunity to work with business requesters across a multitude of organizations, thus allowing you the opportunity to build those business relationships and become a trusted ally with business requesters.

The Commercial Legal Team at Pinterest negotiates Pinterest’s inbound and supplier agreements. We are looking for a Senior Commercial Counsel with a strong background in negotiating complex SaaS, AI and cloud infrastructure agreements to join our team. The position will manage workloads for and relationships with several of our cross functional partners, including Engineering, Security, Privacy, Finance, Procurement and IT. This role will play an important part in supporting Pinterest’s cloud strategy across multiple platforms and helping the business efficiently scale its technology and infrastructure partnerships.

What you’ll do:

• Autonomously negotiate a high volume of complex SaaS, AI, compute infrastructure, data processing, professional services and other commercial transactions in a fast-paced environment.

• Lead legal support for enterprise-level cloud negotiations with AWS and other cloud service providers, including advising on pricing structures, committed spend models, service descriptions, renewal terms, service levels, support, audit rights, termination and exit provisions.

• Use your knowledge of data security, data privacy, AI, intellectual property and general commercial concerns to counsel the business on risks related to their transactions and offer practical solutions for addressing such risks in supplier agreements.

• Partner closely with Engineering, Finance, Procurement, Security and Privacy teams to support cloud needs forecasting, budget alignment and strategic decision-making for major cloud and infrastructure transactions.

• Advise on key legal and business issues in cloud and infrastructure transactions, including uptime commitments, business continuity, subcontracting, data use, compliance, portability and supplier accountability.

• Help operationalize the key commercial, financial and legal terms of cloud infrastructure agreements by partnering with internal stakeholders to implement contracting requirements, track committed spend and renewal milestones, support compliance with reporting and audit provisions, and build practical processes that enable the business to realize the value of negotiated terms.

• Support the business in evaluating alternative technologies, providers and contracting approaches to drive efficiency, flexibility and innovation.

• Partner with internal business partners, attorneys and contracts managers to develop processes, playbooks and systems that help scale Pinterest’s cloud and commercial contracting function globally.

• Stay current with cloud contracting trends, emerging licensing and consumption models, and industry best practices to help Pinterest make informed, pragmatic decisions in a rapidly evolving space.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager, Security Trailers
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

About the Role

Physical AI only goes as far as power and the internet can reach. Verkada's edge products push that boundary, securing people and property in places where no building infrastructure exists: construction sites, parking lots, substations, campuses, and events. Our Security Trailers and connectivity hardware bring Verkada's AI threat detection, deterrence, and operational insights anywhere they're needed.

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own Verkada's Trailer Product Line. Your mission is to make turn-key edge deployments as reliable and easy to manage as anything inside the building.

We are committed to a thriving in-office culture. This role requires you to work onsite at our HQ in San Mateo, CA.

What You'll Do

• Own strategy and execution for Verkada's Security Trailer Product line

• Deliver the trailer platform's core promise: continuous off-grid uptime with zero site infrastructure. Push solar, battery, and cellular intelligence until the trailer runs itself, then expand into new form factors and use cases

• Own the commercial model for the trailer business: pricing and packaging, hardware-plus-license economics, data plans, and new acquisition options such as financing, leasing, or trailer-as-a-service

• Grow and shape the Qualified Trailer Partner channel with Sales and Channel teams, defining what partners sell, install, and service, and how Verkada supports them

• Work with manufacturing partners and supply chain on reliability, cost, and serviceability, turning field learnings into hardware and software improvements

What You Bring

• 5+ years of product management experience, preferably in hardware, IoT, or connected-device products

• Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience

• Proven history of launching and scaling hardware and embedded-systems products. Strong customer intuition, technical depth, and ability to navigate tradeoffs are critical in this role

• Working knowledge of power systems (solar, batteries, PoE) and networking fundamentals (LTE/5G, Wi-Fi, WAN failover, SIM/carrier management), plus foundational knowledge of firmware, device bring-up, and hardware design

• Ability to build platform and recurring-revenue business models, with a structured approach to ambiguous problems like product + install pricing, channel partnerships, and ROI analysis

• Excited to roll up your sleeves and get out of the office. You'll spend time with installers, integrators, and customers deploying in unwired environments, and use that insight to shape the product

Employee Benefits

Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:

• Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs. Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans

• Nationwide medical, vision, and dental coverage

• Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) with tax saving options

• Expanded mental health support

• Paid parental leave policy & fertility benefits

• Time off to relax and recharge through our paid holidays, firmwide extended holidays, flexible PTO, and personal sick time

• Professional development stipend

• Fertility stipend

• Wellness/fitness benefits

• Healthy lunches provided daily

• Commuter benefits

Additional Information:

• We do sponsor and take over sponsorship of employment visas for this role. If we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa.

Annual Pay Range

At Verkada, we want to attract and retain the best employees, and compensate them in a way that appropriately and fairly values their individual contribution to the company. With that in mind, we carefully consider a number of factors to determine the appropriate starting pay for an employee, including their primary work location and an assessment of a candidate's skills and experience, as well as market demands and internal parity. jobs.title: Head of Strategic Partnerships
jobs.description:
About HeyGen

At HeyGen, our mission is to make visual storytelling accessible to all. Over the last decade, visual content has become the preferred method of information creation, consumption, and retention. But the ability to create such content, in particular videos, continues to be costly and challenging to scale. Our ambition is to build technology that equips more people with the power to reach, captivate, and inspire audiences.
Learn more at www.heygen.com.  Visit our Mission and Culture doc here.

The Role

We're looking for a Head of Strategic Partnerships to make HeyGen the AI avatar & video partner of choice for the world's leading platforms and AI companies.

This role has two priorities. The first is landing distribution partnerships with the largest social, content, and creative platforms, putting HeyGen inside the products where billions of people create and share content. The second is building strategic partnerships with leading AI-native companies across voice, productivity, presentations, legal, and other categories, so that HeyGen is known as one of the defining companies in AI and the company other AI leaders choose to build with.

You'll own partnerships end-to-end, from identifying targets and reaching the right executives to structuring, negotiating, and closing deals, and then making them succeed after launch.

You'll be the founding leader of this function, reporting directly to the CMO. You'll start as a hands-on dealmaker, personally sourcing and closing the first wave of partnerships, with the opportunity to build a team as the function scales.

What You'll Do

Land tier-1 distribution partnerships

• Identify and prioritize the platforms where a HeyGen integration would reach the most creators, businesses, and users: social and content platforms, creative and productivity tools, and enterprise software suites.

• Build relationships with executive, product, and GTM leaders at these companies, and get HeyGen in front of the people who make integration decisions.

• Structure and close integration deals, including native in-product integrations, OEM and embedded partnerships, API partnerships, white-label and licensing arrangements, and revenue-share models.

• Work with product, engineering, and design teams on both sides to prototype integrations, set technical requirements, and ship partner launches.

Build HeyGen's position in the AI ecosystem

• Develop partnerships with leading AI companies across voice, presentations, productivity, legal, and other categories where AI avatars makes their product better.

• Create partnerships with substance: product integrations, joint launches, co-marketing, shared customers, and bundled offerings.

• Track the AI ecosystem closely and move early on the companies that are becoming category leaders.

• Make HeyGen a visible part of the AI conversation through partner announcements, joint events, and relationships with founders and executives across the industry.

• Represent HeyGen at industry events and conferences alongside our partners.

Grow the HeyGen API as a partner platform

• Identify companies that should build HeyGen video into their own products, and bring them onto the HeyGen API.

• Work with the API product team on partner tiers, terms, and pricing.

• Build the partner program, documentation, and support model that let integrations scale beyond what can be managed one deal at a time.

Own deals end-to-end

• Lead the full partnership lifecycle: sourcing, pitching, structuring, negotiation, and closing.

• Design deal structures that align incentives for both sides and protect HeyGen's long-term position on exclusivity, data, brand, and economics.

• Work cross-functionally with Legal, Finance, Product, and Marketing to finalize agreements and get them launched quickly.

• Partner with PR and Marketing to turn major partnerships into launch moments that earn coverage and attention.

• Manage partners after launch: track performance, run regular business reviews, co-sell with partner GTM teams, and expand the partnerships that work.

Build the function

• Set HeyGen's partnerships strategy, including where we focus and where we don't, tied to clear revenue and growth targets.

• Define how partnerships are prioritized, measured, and reviewed with leadership.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means HeyGen is integrated into the platforms that matter and is seen as one of the companies that leading AI companies choose to partner with. Examples include:

• Live integrations with multiple tier-1 platforms that bring HeyGen to new audiences at scale.

• Partnerships with leading AI companies that result in shipped integrations, joint launches, and shared customers.

• Measurable reach, usage, and revenue driven by partner channels.

• A growing base of companies building on the HeyGen API.

• Partnership announcements that earn tier-1 press and strengthen HeyGen's standing in AI.

• Inbound interest from top platforms and AI companies that want to partner with HeyGen.

• A repeatable partnerships playbook and a pipeline for the next wave of deals.

What We're Looking For

• 10+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, business development, or corporate development, with several years in a senior leadership role.

• A proven track record of sourcing and closing large partnerships with major technology platforms, such as social, content, creative, or productivity platforms.

• Experience with OEM, embedded, or platform partnerships that put a company's technology inside another company's product.

• Existing relationships with executive, product, and GTM leaders at major tech platforms and AI companies.

• Experience structuring complex deals, including integrations, API and platform partnerships, licensing, revenue share, and co-marketing.

• A track record of driving post-deal value: partnerships that grew in usage and revenue after signing, not just closed.

• Enough technical fluency to scope integrations with Product and Engineering and talk credibly about APIs, models, and product roadmaps.

• Strong product instincts. You can see how HeyGen fits into a partner's product and pitch it in terms of their users and their roadmap.

• Excellent executive presence and negotiation skills. You're comfortable across the table from a founder, a platform VP, or a Big Tech partnerships team.

• Comfortable spanning strategy and execution. You can set partnerships strategy with the leadership team and personally run the deal the same week.

• Experience building a function from an early stage and hiring a team.

• Experience at a fast-growing AI, platform, or PLG company is a strong plus.

AI-Native Mindset

We believe the best operators today are AI-native.

You should be deeply fluent in both AI tools and the AI ecosystem itself: who the important companies are, what they're building, and where the category is heading. You should use AI tools every day to research targets, prepare for meetings, draft proposals, analyze partnership performance, and multiply your output. We're looking for someone who is part of the AI community, not someone watching it from the outside.

Location

• Preferred: San Francisco Bay Area

Salary Range
$250,000 – $300,000 + equity + rewards + benefits
Please note that the salary information is a general guideline only.  HeyGen considers factors such as scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/training, key skills, and internal equity, as well as location, market and business considerations when extending an offer.  As part of our total rewards package, HeyGen offers comprehensive benefits including a 401k plan, health benefits, generous PTO, a parental leave program and emotional health resources.

HeyGen is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Join us at HeyGen and be part of a team that's making visual storytelling accessible to all!
